units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|name|16|0
units.english: Register with the Heliarchs
units.italian: Registrati presso gli Heliarchs

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|description|17|0
units.english: You have been told to travel to the <planet> to register with the rulers of Coalition space and petition them for permission to do business here.
units.italian: Ti è stato detto di viaggiare fino a <planet> per registrarti presso i governanti dello spazio della Coalizione e chiedere loro il permesso di commerciare qui.

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|log|24|0
units.english: The Coalition is an alliance of three different alien species living in peace with each other: the Saryds, the Kimek, and the Arachi. On many Coalition worlds, all three species live together in harmony, which is made easier by the fact that each species prefers a very different climate and thus gravitates to different parts of a planet. They are ruled by individuals known as the Heliarchs.
units.italian: La Coalizione è un'alleanza di tre diverse specie aliene che vivono in pace tra loro: i Saryd, i Kimek e gli Arachi. Su molti mondi della Coalizione le tre specie vivono insieme in armonia, cosa resa più facile dal fatto che ogni specie preferisce un clima molto diverso e quindi gravita verso parti diverse di un pianeta. Sono governati da individui noti come gli Heliarchs.

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|This planet seems to be inhabited by at least three different sentient species. First are giant beetles, about a meter tall, who scurry quickly toward your ship and swarm around it, gawking at you, as soon as you land. The second species, even more disturbing than the beetles, are giant spiders. And the third species are centaurs. Not just something vaguely resembling centaurs; they look like they could have stepped right off the page of a story book from ancient Earth.|26|0
units.english: This planet seems to be inhabited by at least three different sentient species. First are giant beetles, about a meter tall, who scurry quickly toward your ship and swarm around it, gawking at you, as soon as you land. The second species, even more disturbing than the beetles, are giant spiders. And the third species are centaurs. Not just something vaguely resembling centaurs; they look like they could have stepped right off the page of a story book from ancient Earth.
units.italian: Questo pianeta sembra abitato da almeno tre diverse specie senzienti. Le prime sono scarafaggi giganti, alti circa un metro, che corrono rapidamente verso la tua nave e la circondano, fissandoti a bocca aperta, appena atterri. La seconda specie, ancora più inquietante degli scarafaggi, sono ragni giganti. E la terza specie sono centauri. Non qualcosa che ricorda vagamente i centauri: sembrano usciti direttamente dalle pagine di un libro di fiabe della Terra antica.

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	One of the spiders walks up to you, stretching its legs to raise its face and many eyes to the level of your own face, and says something to you in a gloopy sort of burbling language that you don't understand. The beetles, meanwhile, are talking to each other in a different language, all clicks and chittering. And the centaur stands quietly at a distance and keeps glancing back toward the spaceport as if waiting for someone.|27|0
units.english: One of the spiders walks up to you, stretching its legs to raise its face and many eyes to the level of your own face, and says something to you in a gloopy sort of burbling language that you don't understand. The beetles, meanwhile, are talking to each other in a different language, all clicks and chittering. And the centaur stands quietly at a distance and keeps glancing back toward the spaceport as if waiting for someone.
units.italian: Uno dei ragni ti si avvicina, allungando le zampe per portare il viso e i molti occhi all'altezza del tuo, e ti dice qualcosa in una lingua gorgogliante e viscida che non capisci. Gli scarafaggi, intanto, parlano tra loro in una lingua diversa, fatta di schiocchi e cinguettii. E il centauro se ne sta zitto a distanza e continua a guardare verso lo spazioporto come se aspettasse qualcuno.

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	And eventually, someone does arrive: a beetle, a spider, and a centaur all wearing yellow armbands, small, triangle-shaped metal headpieces, and some sort of electric box hanging on a chain around each of their necks. They walk up to you, and the centaur speaks. After a brief delay, the box around its neck says, "In the name of the Heliarchs, who drove out the oppressors, who maintain peace, we the human visitor greet."|28|0
units.english: And eventually, someone does arrive: a beetle, a spider, and a centaur all wearing yellow armbands, small, triangle-shaped metal headpieces, and some sort of electric box hanging on a chain around each of their necks. They walk up to you, and the centaur speaks. After a brief delay, the box around its neck says, "In the name of the Heliarchs, who drove out the oppressors, who maintain peace, we the human visitor greet."
units.italian: E alla fine qualcuno arriva davvero: uno scarafaggio, un ragno e un centauro, tutti con fasce gialle sul braccio, piccoli copricapi metallici triangolari e una specie di scatola elettrica appesa a una catena al collo. Ti si avvicinano e il centauro parla. Dopo un breve ritardo, la scatola al suo collo dice: "In nome degli Heliarchs, che scacciarono gli oppressori, che mantengono la pace, noi il visitatore umano salutiamo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	"Thank you."|30|0
units.english: "Thank you."
units.italian: "Grazie."

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	"How do you know my language?"|32|0
units.english: "How do you know my language?"
units.italian: "Come fate a conoscere la mia lingua?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	The spider speaks, and the box around its neck translates. "Our nearest and most recent neighbor you are. The Heliarchs in their great wisdom, all things that come to pass in our region of space, they are aware of."|33|0
units.english: The spider speaks, and the box around its neck translates. "Our nearest and most recent neighbor you are. The Heliarchs in their great wisdom, all things that come to pass in our region of space, they are aware of."
units.italian: Il ragno parla, e la scatola al suo collo traduce. "Il nostro vicino più prossimo e più recente voi siete. Gli Heliarchs, nella loro grande saggezza, di tutte le cose che accadono nella nostra regione di spazio sono consapevoli."

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	Speaking through its own translation box, the beetle says, "To the seat of the Heliarch government must you go. Once to the Heliarchs you have become known, in many ways to our society, contribute you may."|35|0
units.english: Speaking through its own translation box, the beetle says, "To the seat of the Heliarch government must you go. Once to the Heliarchs you have become known, in many ways to our society, contribute you may."
units.italian: Parlando attraverso la propria scatola di traduzione, lo scarafaggio dice: "Alla sede del governo degli Heliarchs andare dovete. Una volta che agli Heliarchs sarete noti, in molti modi alla nostra società contribuire potrete."

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	The centaur pulls out a map printed on a thin sheet of plastic. You recognize it as a star map of this region. Lines mark out three different territories, and where they meet are three star systems colored yellow. The centaur points to the southernmost of the three. "Where you must go, here it is," they say.|36|0
units.english: The centaur pulls out a map printed on a thin sheet of plastic. You recognize it as a star map of this region. Lines mark out three different territories, and where they meet are three star systems colored yellow. The centaur points to the southernmost of the three. "Where you must go, here it is," they say.
units.italian: Il centauro tira fuori una mappa stampata su un sottile foglio di plastica. La riconosci come una mappa stellare di questa regione. Delle linee delimitano tre territori diversi, e dove si incontrano ci sono tre sistemi stellari colorati di giallo. Il centauro indica il più meridionale dei tre. "Dove andare dovete, qui è," dice.

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	"Thank you. I will go there."|38|0
units.english: "Thank you. I will go there."
units.italian: "Grazie. Ci andrò."

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	"Can you tell me more about yourselves, first?"|40|0
units.english: "Can you tell me more about yourselves, first?"
units.italian: "Potete prima dirmi qualcosa di più su di voi?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	The spider says, "The wise Heliarchs, all your questions they will answer."|41|0
units.english: The spider says, "The wise Heliarchs, all your questions they will answer."
units.italian: Il ragno dice: "Gli Heliarchs saggi, a tutte le vostre domande risponderanno."

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	Eventually the crowd disperses and allows you to visit the spaceport, although no one offers you any jobs or the opportunity to buy anything but basic commodities. Perhaps you need to register with the "Heliarchs" first.|43|0
units.english: Eventually the crowd disperses and allows you to visit the spaceport, although no one offers you any jobs or the opportunity to buy anything but basic commodities. Perhaps you need to register with the "Heliarchs" first.
units.italian: Alla fine la folla si disperde e ti permette di visitare lo spazioporto, anche se nessuno ti offre lavori né la possibilità di comprare altro che merci di base. Forse devi prima registrarti presso gli "Heliarchs".

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|log|49|0
units.english: The Heliarchs are the rulers of Coalition space: apparently not elected, but instead selected by merit from among the citizens of the Coalition in such a way as to ensure that all three species are equally represented. Thousands of years ago, the Heliarchs led their three species to band together and drive the Quarg out of Coalition space. The Heliarch centers of government are the three Quarg ringworlds that they captured in that war. They are the only ones in Coalition space who are allowed to have weapons on their starships, and they act as a sort of police force, maintaining peace between the Coalition species.
units.italian: Gli Heliarchs sono i governanti dello spazio della Coalizione: apparentemente non eletti, ma scelti per merito tra i cittadini della Coalizione in modo da garantire che tutte e tre le specie siano equamente rappresentate. Migliaia di anni fa gli Heliarchs guidarono le loro tre specie a unirsi e a scacciare i Quarg dallo spazio della Coalizione. I centri di governo degli Heliarchs sono i tre mondi ad anello dei Quarg che catturarono in quella guerra. Sono gli unici nello spazio della Coalizione a cui è permesso avere armi sulle astronavi, e agiscono come una specie di forza di polizia, mantenendo la pace tra le specie della Coalizione.

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|Your first view of the landing area confirms beyond a doubt that this is a Quarg ringworld, not just an imitation of one. The interior architecture is unmistakable. But no Quarg are present here, only the three species of the Coalition. Soon after you land, a delegation approaches your ship: again, one of each species, but these are wearing golden circlets around their heads. The circlets are not merely decorative, but seem to contain some electronics as well.|51|0
units.english: Your first view of the landing area confirms beyond a doubt that this is a Quarg ringworld, not just an imitation of one. The interior architecture is unmistakable. But no Quarg are present here, only the three species of the Coalition. Soon after you land, a delegation approaches your ship: again, one of each species, but these are wearing golden circlets around their heads. The circlets are not merely decorative, but seem to contain some electronics as well.
units.italian: La tua prima vista dell'area di atterraggio conferma senza dubbio che questo è un mondo ad anello dei Quarg, non solo un'imitazione. L'architettura interna è inconfondibile. Ma qui non ci sono Quarg, solo le tre specie della Coalizione. Poco dopo l'atterraggio, una delegazione si avvicina alla tua nave: di nuovo uno per specie, ma questi portano cerchietti d'oro intorno alla testa. I cerchietti non sono solo decorativi, ma sembrano contenere anche dell'elettronica.

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	Again, the centaur speaks first. "To our territory, to welcome you we are glad," they say.|52|0
units.english: Again, the centaur speaks first. "To our territory, to welcome you we are glad," they say.
units.italian: Di nuovo il centauro parla per primo. "Nel nostro territorio, a darvi il benvenuto siamo lieti," dice.

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	The beetle says, "With our people you may mingle. The beauty of our culture, you may experience."|53|0
units.english: The beetle says, "With our people you may mingle. The beauty of our culture, you may experience."
units.italian: Lo scarafaggio dice: "Con la nostra gente potete mescolarvi. La bellezza della nostra cultura potete sperimentare."

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	The spider adds, "Our people and yours perhaps one day may trade. Perhaps one day the humans our great and free Coalition may join."|54|0
units.english: The spider adds, "Our people and yours perhaps one day may trade. Perhaps one day the humans our great and free Coalition may join."
units.italian: Il ragno aggiunge: "La nostra gente e la vostra forse un giorno commerceranno insieme. Forse un giorno gli umani alla nostra grande e libera Coalizione potranno unirsi."

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	"Tell me more about your Coalition."|56|0
units.english: "Tell me more about your Coalition."
units.italian: "Ditemi di più sulla vostra Coalizione."

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	"Is this a Quarg ringworld? Where are the Quarg?"|57|0
units.english: "Is this a Quarg ringworld? Where are the Quarg?"
units.italian: "È un mondo ad anello dei Quarg, questo? Dove sono i Quarg?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	The centaur says, "Like you, our three species once, by the Quarg were ruled. But with each other, connections we made. An alliance we formed, and the oppressors we drove away. For six thousand Earth years now, in prosperity and freedom from Quarg constraint and in friendship with each other we have lived."|58|0
units.english: The centaur says, "Like you, our three species once, by the Quarg were ruled. But with each other, connections we made. An alliance we formed, and the oppressors we drove away. For six thousand Earth years now, in prosperity and freedom from Quarg constraint and in friendship with each other we have lived."
units.italian: Il centauro dice: "Come voi, le nostre tre specie un tempo dai Quarg erano governate. Ma tra noi, legami abbiamo creato. Un'alleanza abbiamo formato, e gli oppressori abbiamo scacciato. Da seimila anni terrestri ormai, in prosperità e libertà dai vincoli dei Quarg e in amicizia tra noi abbiamo vissuto."

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	"The Quarg don't seem that oppressive to me."|60|0
units.english: "The Quarg don't seem that oppressive to me."
units.italian: "I Quarg non mi sembrano così oppressivi."

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	"How did you defeat the Quarg?"|62|0
units.english: "How did you defeat the Quarg?"
units.italian: "Come avete sconfitto i Quarg?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	The spider says, "Alone, no species all skills or all knowledge possesses. But when our abilities we combine, powerful we may become. That, the reason is, that the Quarg all species in isolation keep."|63|0
units.english: The spider says, "Alone, no species all skills or all knowledge possesses. But when our abilities we combine, powerful we may become. That, the reason is, that the Quarg all species in isolation keep."
units.italian: Il ragno dice: "Da sola, nessuna specie tutte le abilità o tutta la conoscenza possiede. Ma quando le nostre capacità combiniamo, potenti possiamo diventare. Questa, la ragione è, per cui i Quarg tutte le specie in isolamento tengono."

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	The spider says, "In separate boxes, they each species keep. And in subtle ways, your development and discoveries they limit. And on your technology, restrictions they place."|66|0
units.english: The spider says, "In separate boxes, they each species keep. And in subtle ways, your development and discoveries they limit. And on your technology, restrictions they place."
units.italian: Il ragno dice: "In scatole separate, ciascuna specie tengono. E in modi sottili, il vostro sviluppo e le vostre scoperte limitano. E sulla vostra tecnologia, restrizioni impongono."

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	The beetle says, "Or, wrong are we? And the jump drive that brought you here, a gift from the Quarg it is? They its secret no longer hoard?" You tell them that the Quarg do indeed refuse to give jump drives to humans, and they say, "Then, prisoners indeed you are."|67|0
units.english: The beetle says, "Or, wrong are we? And the jump drive that brought you here, a gift from the Quarg it is? They its secret no longer hoard?" You tell them that the Quarg do indeed refuse to give jump drives to humans, and they say, "Then, prisoners indeed you are."
units.italian: Lo scarafaggio dice: "O sbagliati siamo? E il motore di salto che qui vi ha portato, un dono dei Quarg è? Il suo segreto non custodiscono più?" Dite loro che i Quarg rifiutano davvero di dare motori di salto agli umani, e loro dicono: "Allora, prigionieri davvero siete."

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	"I suppose you may be right about the Quarg."|72|0
units.english: "I suppose you may be right about the Quarg."
units.italian: "Suppongo che abbiate ragione sui Quarg."

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	"Perhaps the Quarg will change their minds in the future."|74|0
units.english: "Perhaps the Quarg will change their minds in the future."
units.italian: "Forse i Quarg cambieranno idea in futuro."

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	The giant beetle considers you gravely. "Hope, we can only," they say.|75|0
units.english: The giant beetle considers you gravely. "Hope, we can only," they say.
units.italian: Lo scarafaggio gigante ti considera gravemente. "Sperare, solo possiamo," dice.

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	"I suppose you may be right about the Quarg."|79|0
units.english: "I suppose you may be right about the Quarg."
units.italian: "Suppongo che abbiate ragione sui Quarg."

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	"But, the Quarg do let the humans and the Hai make contact with each other."|81|0
units.english: "But, the Quarg do let the humans and the Hai make contact with each other."
units.italian: "Però i Quarg permettono agli umani e agli Hai di entrare in contatto."

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	This, apparently, is news to them. You explain to them who the Hai are, and that some humans have made contact with them and are living in their territory. "A second Coalition you are forming!" says the centaur, tapping their hooves on the floor in excitement. "Once again, foiled the Quarg are. A secret way for species to work together, they have overlooked. Great things, from this may come."|82|0
units.english: This, apparently, is news to them. You explain to them who the Hai are, and that some humans have made contact with them and are living in their territory. "A second Coalition you are forming!" says the centaur, tapping their hooves on the floor in excitement. "Once again, foiled the Quarg are. A secret way for species to work together, they have overlooked. Great things, from this may come."
units.italian: Questa, a quanto pare, è una novità per loro. Spieghi chi sono gli Hai, e che alcuni umani sono entrati in contatto con loro e vivono nel loro territorio. "Una seconda Coalizione state formando!" dice il centauro, battendo gli zoccoli sul pavimento per l'eccitazione. "Ancora una volta, sconfitti i Quarg sono. Un modo segreto per collaborare, le specie hanno trascurato. Grandi cose, da questo possono venire."

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	You talk with them for a while longer, and learn that the centaurs are called "Saryds," and are the oldest of the three species. The beetles are the "Kimek," and come next, and the spiders are called "Arachi," and were the last of the three to discover spaceflight.|86|0
units.english: You talk with them for a while longer, and learn that the centaurs are called "Saryds," and are the oldest of the three species. The beetles are the "Kimek," and come next, and the spiders are called "Arachi," and were the last of the three to discover spaceflight.
units.italian: Parli con loro ancora un po', e scopri che i centauri si chiamano "Saryd" e sono i più antichi delle tre specie. Gli scarafaggi sono i "Kimek", e vengono dopo, e i ragni si chiamano "Arachi" e sono stati gli ultimi dei tre a scoprire il volo spaziale.

units.id: mission:Coalition: First Contact|	They tell you that the best way to learn more about them is to visit their worlds, and to see for yourself how the three species live in friendship and equality. They also offer to give you jobs to do in their territory, so that you may become a "valuable contributor" to their society.|87|0
units.english: They tell you that the best way to learn more about them is to visit their worlds, and to see for yourself how the three species live in friendship and equality. They also offer to give you jobs to do in their territory, so that you may become a "valuable contributor" to their society.
units.italian: Ti dicono che il modo migliore per saperne di più su di loro è visitare i loro mondi e vedere di persona come le tre specie vivano in amicizia e uguaglianza. Ti offrono anche dei lavori da svolgere nel loro territorio, così che tu possa diventare un "collaboratore prezioso" per la loro società.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Contributor|name|111|0
units.english: Return to the <planet>
units.italian: Torna su <planet>

units.id: mission:Coalition: Contributor|description|112|0
units.english: Return to the <planet> to see if the Heliarchs will grant you a higher status in the Coalition now that you have been working among them for some time.
units.italian: Torna su <planet> per vedere se gli Heliarchs ti concederanno uno status superiore nella Coalizione, ora che lavori tra loro da qualche tempo.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Contributor|A Heliarch agent contacts you soon after you land, and says, "In many useful ways, among us you have been working. The Heliarchs you should petition, and your rights and status among us they may elevate." The agent instructs you to return to the <planet> and petition the Heliarch rulers there.|121|0
units.english: A Heliarch agent contacts you soon after you land, and says, "In many useful ways, among us you have been working. The Heliarchs you should petition, and your rights and status among us they may elevate." The agent instructs you to return to the <planet> and petition the Heliarch rulers there.
units.italian: Un agente degli Heliarchs ti contatta poco dopo l'atterraggio e dice: "In molti modi utili, tra noi avete lavorato. Agli Heliarchs dovreste rivolgervi, e i vostri diritti e il vostro status tra noi potrebbero elevare." L'agente ti ordina di tornare su <planet> e di rivolgerti lì ai governanti Heliarchs.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Contributor|log|127|0
units.english: Completed a lot of Coalition jobs and received permission to purchase civilian technology and ships.
units.italian: Hai completato molti lavori per la Coalizione e hai ricevuto il permesso di acquistare tecnologia civile e navi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Contributor|log|128|0
units.english: Saryds are an alien species who look suspiciously similar to the centaurs found in early human mythology. They prefer to live on worlds with as much green space as possible, and even their major cities are full of parks and gardens. Most Saryds live in small communes with up to a few dozen of them per house.
units.italian: I Saryd sono una specie aliena che somiglia sospettosamente ai centauri della mitologia umana antica. Preferiscono vivere su mondi con quanta più terra verde possibile, e anche le loro città principali sono piene di parchi e giardini. La maggior parte dei Saryd vive in piccoli comuni, con al massimo qualche dozzina di loro per casa.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Contributor|log|129|0
units.english: The Kimek are large insectoid aliens, and are members of the Coalition. They discovered spaceflight after the Saryds, but before the Arachi. They are intensely social creatures, preferring to live together in massive buildings with thousands of inhabitants, and many of their worlds have populations in the tens of billions, far more than any human world.
units.italian: I Kimek sono grandi alieni insettoidi, membri della Coalizione. Hanno scoperto il volo spaziale dopo i Saryd, ma prima degli Arachi. Sono creature intensamente sociali, che preferiscono vivere insieme in edifici enormi con migliaia di abitanti, e molti dei loro mondi hanno popolazioni nell'ordine delle decine di miliardi, molto più di qualsiasi mondo umano.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Contributor|log|130|0
units.english: The spider-like Arachi were the last of the three Coalition species to discover interstellar travel. Most members of their society owe allegiance to one of the great Arach "Houses," organizations that are somewhat similar to guilds and that each specialize in one particular form of industry or technology.
units.italian: Gli Arachi, simili a ragni, sono stati gli ultimi delle tre specie della Coalizione a scoprire il viaggio interstellare. La maggior parte dei membri della loro società deve fedeltà a una delle grandi "Case" Arach, organizzazioni in qualche modo simili a corporazioni, ognuna specializzata in una particolare forma di industria o tecnologia.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Contributor|Once again, when you exit your ship you are met by a member of each of the three Coalition species, wearing the golden circlets that mark them as Heliarchs. "Told we have been," says the Saryd, "that among us with great diligence and commitment, small tasks you have performed."|132|0
units.english: Once again, when you exit your ship you are met by a member of each of the three Coalition species, wearing the golden circlets that mark them as Heliarchs. "Told we have been," says the Saryd, "that among us with great diligence and commitment, small tasks you have performed."
units.italian: Ancora una volta, quando esci dalla nave ti accoglie un membro di ciascuna delle tre specie della Coalizione, con i cerchietti d'oro che li identificano come Heliarchs. "Detto ci è stato," dice il Saryd, "che tra noi con grande diligenza e impegno, piccoli compiti avete svolto."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Contributor|	The Kimek says, "Those who in our society's prosperity have invested, with our society's technology may be trusted."|133|0
units.english: The Kimek says, "Those who in our society's prosperity have invested, with our society's technology may be trusted."
units.italian: Il Kimek dice: "Coloro che nella prosperità della nostra società hanno investito, della tecnologia della nostra società possono essere fidati."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Contributor|	"But," says the Arach, "like all civilians, even citizens, to you our weapons and warships we still cannot sell."|134|0
units.english: "But," says the Arach, "like all civilians, even citizens, to you our weapons and warships we still cannot sell."
units.italian: "Ma," dice l'Arach, "come tutti i civili, anche i cittadini, a voi le nostre armi e le nostre navi da guerra ancora non possiamo vendere."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Contributor|	"Thank you."|136|0
units.english: "Thank you."
units.italian: "Grazie."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Contributor|	"Why don't you allow civilians to purchase weapons or warships?"|138|0
units.english: "Why don't you allow civilians to purchase weapons or warships?"
units.italian: "Perché non permettete ai civili di acquistare armi o navi da guerra?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Contributor|	"For the sake of peace it is," says the Saryd. "The Heliarch military, well trained to use weapons only for defense and only for justice, they are. And to place the needs of the Coalition over the ambitions of their own native species, each one committed is. No such discipline do civilians have, even you. But as a respectful guest you are, to maintain your weapons we shall allow."|139|0
units.english: "For the sake of peace it is," says the Saryd. "The Heliarch military, well trained to use weapons only for defense and only for justice, they are. And to place the needs of the Coalition over the ambitions of their own native species, each one committed is. No such discipline do civilians have, even you. But as a respectful guest you are, to maintain your weapons we shall allow."
units.italian: "Per amore della pace è," dice il Saryd. "L'esercito degli Heliarchs, bene addestrato a usare le armi solo per difesa e solo per giustizia, è. E a mettere i bisogni della Coalizione sopra le ambizioni della propria specie d'origine, ognuno si è impegnato. Nessuna simile disciplina i civili hanno, nemmeno voi. Ma poiché un ospite rispettoso siete, a mantenere le vostre armi permetteremo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Contributor|	Apparently nothing is for sale here, but they assure you that many Coalition worlds will now grant you access to their shipyards and outfitters.|141|0
units.english: Apparently nothing is for sale here, but they assure you that many Coalition worlds will now grant you access to their shipyards and outfitters.
units.italian: A quanto pare qui non c'è niente in vendita, ma ti assicurano che molti mondi della Coalizione ti concederanno ora l'accesso ai loro cantieri e ai loro fornitori di equipaggiamento.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Lost: Marker|name|175|0
units.english: Foreign Aid
units.italian: Aiuti stranieri

units.id: mission:Coalition: Lost: Marker|description|176|0
units.english: The Heliarchs have noticed that you've lost your jump drive, being now stranded in Coalition space, and have offered to help. Head to the <destination> to speak with them.
units.italian: Gli Heliarchs hanno notato che hai perso il tuo motore di salto, restando bloccato nello spazio della Coalizione, e si sono offerti di aiutarti. Dirigiti su <destination> per parlare con loro.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Lost: Marker|You're approached by a Heliarch delegation shortly after you leave your ship.|185|0
units.english: You're approached by a Heliarch delegation shortly after you leave your ship.
units.italian: Vieni avvicinato da una delegazione degli Heliarchs poco dopo aver lasciato la nave.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Lost: Marker|	"Cautiously observed during the past few weeks, scans of your ship have been, Captain <last>," the Saryd begins.|186|0
units.english: "Cautiously observed during the past few weeks, scans of your ship have been, Captain <last>," the Saryd begins.
units.italian: "Con cautela osservate nelle ultime settimane, le scansioni della vostra nave sono state, capitano <last>," esordisce il Saryd.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Lost: Marker|	"Unlike previous scans, a jump drive in your ship, our scanners found not," the Kimek continues.|187|0
units.english: "Unlike previous scans, a jump drive in your ship, our scanners found not," the Kimek continues.
units.italian: "A differenza delle scansioni precedenti, un motore di salto nella vostra nave, i nostri scanner non hanno trovato," continua il Kimek.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Lost: Marker|	"Though appreciate the work you here perform, we do, for you to be cut-off from the galaxy, we wish not," the Arach says. "Discussed much, our consuls have, and to help you, they decided. To the <destination> you must go, there discussed, the terms will be."|188|0
units.english: "Though appreciate the work you here perform, we do, for you to be cut-off from the galaxy, we wish not," the Arach says. "Discussed much, our consuls have, and to help you, they decided. To the <destination> you must go, there discussed, the terms will be."
units.italian: "Anche se apprezziamo il lavoro che qui svolgete, noi lo facciamo, che voi siate tagliato fuori dalla galassia, non desideriamo," dice l'Arach. "Discusso molto, i nostri consoli hanno, e di aiutarvi, hanno deciso. Su <destination> dovete andare, lì discusso, i termini saranno."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Lost: Marker|	"By that you mean you'll get me another jump drive? That's pretty generous of you."|190|0
units.english: "By that you mean you'll get me another jump drive? That's pretty generous of you."
units.italian: "Con questo intendete dire che mi procurerete un altro motore di salto? È piuttosto generoso da parte vostra."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Lost: Marker|	"What? I lost my jump drive? You've gotta be kidding!"|191|0
units.english: "What? I lost my jump drive? You've gotta be kidding!"
units.italian: "Come? Ho perso il motore di salto? State scherzando!"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Lost: Marker|	"Generous we are indeed. Lucky you are, that under our jurisdiction this happened. Were it the Quarg's, stranded you would remain," the Saryd responds.|193|0
units.english: "Generous we are indeed. Lucky you are, that under our jurisdiction this happened. Were it the Quarg's, stranded you would remain," the Saryd responds.
units.italian: "Generosi siamo davvero. Fortunato siete, che sotto la nostra giurisdizione questo è accaduto. Se fosse stato dei Quarg, bloccato sareste rimasto," risponde il Saryd.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Lost: Marker|	"A good thing that a watchful eye we keep, if noticed you had not," the Kimek says. "But even still, more careful with your outfits you should be."|196|0
units.english: "A good thing that a watchful eye we keep, if noticed you had not," the Kimek says. "But even still, more careful with your outfits you should be."
units.italian: "Una buona cosa che un occhio vigile teniamo, se notato non lo aveste," dice il Kimek. "Ma anche così, più attento ai vostri equipaggiamenti dovreste essere."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Lost: Marker|	You thank them for bringing you this information, and go back to your ship to prepare a route to the <destination>.|198|0
units.english: You thank them for bringing you this information, and go back to your ship to prepare a route to the <destination>.
units.italian: Li ringrazi per l'informazione e torni alla nave per preparare una rotta verso <destination>.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Lost: Offer|name|206|0
units.english: Jump Drive Loan
units.italian: Motore di salto in prestito

units.id: mission:Coalition: Lost: Offer|description|207|0
units.english: The Heliarchs have provided you a jump drive to leave Coalition space. Bring another jump drive to the <destination> by <date>, to replace the one you borrowed, or they will be extremely angered by you breaking their trust.
units.italian: Gli Heliarchs ti hanno fornito un motore di salto per lasciare lo spazio della Coalizione. Porta un altro motore di salto su <destination> entro <date>, per sostituire quello che hai preso in prestito, o saranno estremamente adirati per il tuo tradimento della loro fiducia.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Lost: Offer|The Heliarchs are waiting for you when you land. You see no civilians as you look around, but there are enough armed guards to man several of their Punishers. Said Punishers are all parked near your own ship.|215|0
units.english: The Heliarchs are waiting for you when you land. You see no civilians as you look around, but there are enough armed guards to man several of their Punishers. Said Punishers are all parked near your own ship.
units.italian: Gli Heliarchs ti aspettano quando atterri. Non vedi civili guardandoti intorno, ma ci sono abbastanza guardie armate per equipaggiare diversi dei loro Punisher. Detti Punisher sono tutti parcheggiati vicino alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Lost: Offer|	The Saryd starts speaking, "As to be trusted, you have been deemed, provide you with a jump drive, so that stranded you are not, we will."|216|0
units.english: The Saryd starts speaking, "As to be trusted, you have been deemed, provide you with a jump drive, so that stranded you are not, we will."
units.italian: Il Saryd comincia a parlare: "Come degno di fiducia, siete stato giudicato; fornirvi un motore di salto, così che bloccato non siate, noi lo faremo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Lost: Offer|	"Mind you, not a gift this is, but a loan, Captain," the Kimek continues. "Another one to replace this one, you must bring us, so that losing a copy of such valuable equipment, we are not."|217|0
units.english: "Mind you, not a gift this is, but a loan, Captain," the Kimek continues. "Another one to replace this one, you must bring us, so that losing a copy of such valuable equipment, we are not."
units.italian: "Badate bene, non un regalo questo è, ma un prestito, capitano," continua il Kimek. "Un altro che sostituisca questo, dovete portarci, così che perdere una copia di un equipaggiamento così prezioso, non accada."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Lost: Offer|	"By <date>, brought here the replacement jump drive must be. If any longer you take, assume that betrayed our trust you have, we will, and an enemy, considered you will be," the Arach finishes explaining. "Agree with those terms, do you, Captain?"|218|0
units.english: "By <date>, brought here the replacement jump drive must be. If any longer you take, assume that betrayed our trust you have, we will, and an enemy, considered you will be," the Arach finishes explaining. "Agree with those terms, do you, Captain?"
units.italian: "Entro <date>, portato qui il motore di salto sostitutivo deve essere. Se impiegate più tempo, considereremo che abbiate tradito la nostra fiducia, e un nemico, considerati sarete," conclude la spiegazione dell'Arach. "D'accordo con questi termini, siete, capitano?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Lost: Offer|	"Yes, I promise I'll return with a second jump drive."|220|0
units.english: "Yes, I promise I'll return with a second jump drive."
units.italian: "Sì, prometto che tornerò con un secondo motore di salto."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Lost: Offer|	"Sorry, I need more time to think on this."|221|0
units.english: "Sorry, I need more time to think on this."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, mi serve più tempo per pensarci."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Lost: Offer|	Their engineers proceed to install the jump drive in your ship. A couple of the guards come a bit closer during the process. When it's all done, you're reminded that you need to bring another jump drive here by <date>.|223|0
units.english: Their engineers proceed to install the jump drive in your ship. A couple of the guards come a bit closer during the process. When it's all done, you're reminded that you need to bring another jump drive here by <date>.
units.italian: I loro ingegneri procedono a installare il motore di salto nella tua nave. Un paio delle guardie si avvicinano un po' durante l'operazione. Quando è tutto fatto, ti ricordano che devi portare qui un altro motore di salto entro <date>.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Lost: Offer|dialog|234|0
units.english: After you once again land near several of their warships and armed guards, the Heliarchs take the jump drive you brought them. They thank you for keeping true to your word, and ask that you avoid losing such an important outfit again.
units.italian: Dopo che atterri di nuovo vicino a diverse delle loro navi da guerra e a guardie armate, gli Heliarchs prendono il motore di salto che hai portato. Ti ringraziano per aver mantenuto la parola e ti chiedono di evitare di perdere di nuovo un equipaggiamento così importante.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 1|name|241|0
units.english: More Yottrite
units.italian: Altro yottrite

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 1|description|242|0
units.english: You were offered great payment for bringing three more samples of the rare mineral yottrite to <destination>.
units.italian: Ti è stato offerto un grande pagamento per portare altri tre campioni del raro minerale yottrite su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 1|Some Coalition citizens, most of which are Arachi, start surrounding your ship after you land, talking among themselves while also glancing at a Heliarch Neutralizer that followed you as you prepared to land on <origin>. The Heliarch agents step off their ship and speak with an Arach of the civilian group. They head back inside their ship after a while and hail you: it seems they've noticed you're carrying samples of the exotic yottrite, and would like to know if you're willing to sell it to them.|253|0
units.english: Some Coalition citizens, most of which are Arachi, start surrounding your ship after you land, talking among themselves while also glancing at a Heliarch Neutralizer that followed you as you prepared to land on <origin>. The Heliarch agents step off their ship and speak with an Arach of the civilian group. They head back inside their ship after a while and hail you: it seems they've noticed you're carrying samples of the exotic yottrite, and would like to know if you're willing to sell it to them.
units.italian: Alcuni cittadini della Coalizione, per lo più Arachi, cominciano a circondare la tua nave dopo l'atterraggio, parlando tra loro e guardando nello stesso tempo un Neutralizer degli Heliarchs che ti ha seguito mentre ti preparavi ad atterrare su <origin>. Gli agenti degli Heliarchs scendono dalla loro nave e parlano con un Arach del gruppo di civili. Dopo un po' tornano nella loro nave e ti chiamano: sembra che abbiano notato che trasporti campioni del raro yottrite, e vorrebbero sapere se sei disposto a venderglielo.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 1|	(Yes.)|255|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 1|	(No.)|256|0
units.english: (No.)
units.italian: (No.)

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 1|	When you approach them, the Arach explains that he is one of the people that oversee the mining operations on <planet> and that he would like to bring the yottrite there so that they can attempt to study it with their most advanced equipment.|258|0
units.english: When you approach them, the Arach explains that he is one of the people that oversee the mining operations on <planet> and that he would like to bring the yottrite there so that they can attempt to study it with their most advanced equipment.
units.italian: Quando ti avvicini, l'Arach spiega che è una delle persone che sovrintendono alle operazioni minerarie su <planet> e che vorrebbe portare lì lo yottrite perché possano provare a studiarlo con le loro attrezzature più avanzate.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 1|	"Few entries on yottrite, my predecessors managed to catalog," he says. "Naturally occur in our territory, it does not. Few opportunities to study it, we've had."|259|0
units.english: "Few entries on yottrite, my predecessors managed to catalog," he says. "Naturally occur in our territory, it does not. Few opportunities to study it, we've had."
units.italian: "Poche voci sullo yottrite, i miei predecessori sono riusciti a catalogare," dice. "Presentarsi naturalmente nel nostro territorio, non è. Poche occasioni di studiarlo, abbiamo avuto."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 1|	After discussing with his colleagues for a bit, he announces that he is willing to pay you 350,000 credits for the mineral sample.|260|0
units.english: After discussing with his colleagues for a bit, he announces that he is willing to pay you 350,000 credits for the mineral sample.
units.italian: Dopo aver discusso un po' con i suoi colleghi, annuncia che è disposto a pagarti 350.000 crediti per il campione di minerale.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 1|	"Sounds like a fair deal to me. Sold."|262|0
units.english: "Sounds like a fair deal to me. Sold."
units.italian: "Mi sembra un affare giusto. Venduto."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 1|	"Sorry, but I think I'll hold on to it. It was very hard to get it in the first place."|263|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I think I'll hold on to it. It was very hard to get it in the first place."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma credo che me lo terrò. È stato molto difficile procurarmelo."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 1|	He thanks you and transfers the yottrite from your ship to his own, an Arach Spindle, with the help of some spaceport workers. Right before departing he hands you the credits and says that you should bring a few more samples to <destination>. "Three more, you should bring, if interested you are."|265|0
units.english: He thanks you and transfers the yottrite from your ship to his own, an Arach Spindle, with the help of some spaceport workers. Right before departing he hands you the credits and says that you should bring a few more samples to <destination>. "Three more, you should bring, if interested you are."
units.italian: Ti ringrazia e trasferisce lo yottrite dalla tua nave alla sua, uno Spindle Arach, con l'aiuto di alcuni operai dello spazioporto. Poco prima di partire ti consegna i crediti e dice che dovresti portare altri campioni su <destination>. "Tre ancora, dovreste portare, se interessati siete."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 2|name|274|0
units.english: Even More Yottrite
units.italian: Ancora altro yottrite

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 2|description|275|0
units.english: You were once again asked to bring seven samples of the rare mineral yottrite to <destination>.
units.italian: Ti è stato chiesto di nuovo di portare sette campioni del raro minerale yottrite su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 2|As you land on <origin>, you're contacted by the Arach you sold some yottrite to. He asks if you have any more samples to sell him.|285|0
units.english: As you land on <origin>, you're contacted by the Arach you sold some yottrite to. He asks if you have any more samples to sell him.
units.italian: Mentre atterri su <origin>, vieni contattato dall'Arach a cui hai venduto dello yottrite. Ti chiede se hai altri campioni da vendergli.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 2|	"Not right now, sorry."|287|0
units.english: "Not right now, sorry."
units.italian: "Non adesso, mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 2|	"I have some, yeah. Where should I bring them to?"|289|0
units.english: "I have some, yeah. Where should I bring them to?"
units.italian: "Ne ho alcuni, sì. Dove dovrei portarli?"

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 2|	He tells you to land as usual. Once your ship is brought to the underground area, some workers help unload the yottrite, and ask you to follow them into a restricted section of the complex to get your payment. The guards at the entrance watch closely as your group passes by.|290|0
units.english: He tells you to land as usual. Once your ship is brought to the underground area, some workers help unload the yottrite, and ask you to follow them into a restricted section of the complex to get your payment. The guards at the entrance watch closely as your group passes by.
units.italian: Ti dice di atterrare come al solito. Una volta che la tua nave è portata nell'area sotterranea, alcuni operai aiutano a scaricare lo yottrite e ti chiedono di seguirli in una sezione riservata del complesso per ricevere il pagamento. Le guardie all'ingresso osservano attentamente mentre il tuo gruppo passa.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 2|	You walk along extremely wide industrial catwalks overlooking endless smelters and forges of various sizes. Though the heat of the place may be influencing your perception, you're almost certain the largest smelters must be around the size of a light warship.|291|0
units.english: You walk along extremely wide industrial catwalks overlooking endless smelters and forges of various sizes. Though the heat of the place may be influencing your perception, you're almost certain the largest smelters must be around the size of a light warship.
units.italian: Cammini lungo passerelle industriali estremamente larghe che dominano infinite fonderie e forge di varie dimensioni. Anche se il calore del luogo può influenzare la tua percezione, sei quasi certo che le fonderie più grandi siano delle dimensioni di una nave da guerra leggera.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 2|	After walking for too long in the uncomfortably hot and stuffy interiors of the underground compound, you and the several tons of yottrite are finally brought to a large area similar to a warehouse. Several workers are operating machinery and making sure ore pieces are brought to specific conveyor belts.|292|0
units.english: After walking for too long in the uncomfortably hot and stuffy interiors of the underground compound, you and the several tons of yottrite are finally brought to a large area similar to a warehouse. Several workers are operating machinery and making sure ore pieces are brought to specific conveyor belts.
units.italian: Dopo aver camminato troppo a lungo negli interni scomodamente caldi e soffocanti del complesso sotterraneo, tu e le diverse tonnellate di yottrite venite finalmente portati in un'ampia area simile a un magazzino. Diversi operai manovrano macchinari e si assicurano che i pezzi di minerale siano portati su specifici nastri trasportatori.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 2|	As the workers leave you to bring the yottrite to a separate section of the facility, you're greeted by the Arach who contacted you. "In your debt, we are, Captain <last>," he says, handing you 1,050,000 credits. "Much will be achieved, if significant progress with the samples we make."|293|0
units.english: As the workers leave you to bring the yottrite to a separate section of the facility, you're greeted by the Arach who contacted you. "In your debt, we are, Captain <last>," he says, handing you 1,050,000 credits. "Much will be achieved, if significant progress with the samples we make."
units.italian: Mentre gli operai ti lasciano per portare lo yottrite in una sezione separata della struttura, ti accoglie l'Arach che ti aveva contattato. "In debito con voi, siamo, capitano <last>," dice, consegnandoti 1.050.000 crediti. "Molto sarà ottenuto, se progressi significativi con i campioni faremo."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 2|	"What sort of progress?"|295|0
units.english: "What sort of progress?"
units.italian: "Che tipo di progressi?"

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 2|	"What are you hoping to achieve?"|297|0
units.english: "What are you hoping to achieve?"
units.italian: "Cosa sperate di ottenere?"

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 2|	"Non-standard thermodynamic properties, yottrite has. Absorb heat around them, the crystals do. Difficult to mix it into a compound, it is," he explains. "If how to overcome this obstacle, we learn, many applications, the element could have."|300|0
units.english: "Non-standard thermodynamic properties, yottrite has. Absorb heat around them, the crystals do. Difficult to mix it into a compound, it is," he explains. "If how to overcome this obstacle, we learn, many applications, the element could have."
units.italian: "Proprietà termodinamiche non standard, lo yottrite ha. Assorbire il calore intorno a loro, i cristalli fanno. Difficile mescolarlo in un composto, è," spiega. "Se come superare questo ostacolo impariamo, molte applicazioni, l'elemento potrebbe avere."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 2|	"Run several tests on the Quarg equipment, for centuries, our Coalition has. React similarly to yottrite, some of their equipment does. A material involved in the making of their outfits, it is," he explains. "If how to do such a thing ourselves, we learn, maybe replicate their technology, or resume construction of the ringworlds, we could."|303|0
units.english: "Run several tests on the Quarg equipment, for centuries, our Coalition has. React similarly to yottrite, some of their equipment does. A material involved in the making of their outfits, it is," he explains. "If how to do such a thing ourselves, we learn, maybe replicate their technology, or resume construction of the ringworlds, we could."
units.italian: "Diverse prove sull'attrezzatura dei Quarg, per secoli, la nostra Coalizione ha fatto. Reagire in modo simile allo yottrite, parte della loro attrezzatura fa. Un materiale coinvolto nella fabbricazione dei loro equipaggiamenti, è," spiega. "Se come fare una cosa del genere noi stessi impariamo, forse replicare la loro tecnologia, o riprendere la costruzione dei mondi ad anello, potremmo."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 2|	A worker by the yottrite crates shouts something, and the Arach signals he will be heading there shortly.|305|0
units.english: A worker by the yottrite crates shouts something, and the Arach signals he will be heading there shortly.
units.italian: Un operaio vicino alle casse di yottrite grida qualcosa, e l'Arach fa segno che ci andrà tra poco.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 2|	"Once again, if any more yottrite, you acquire, bring it here, you may," he says before leaving. "Tirelessly researching it, we are. If in a larger batch, you could bring them, progress quicker, we might."|306|0
units.english: "Once again, if any more yottrite, you acquire, bring it here, you may," he says before leaving. "Tirelessly researching it, we are. If in a larger batch, you could bring them, progress quicker, we might."
units.italian: "Ancora una volta, se altro yottrite acquisite, portatelo qui, potete," dice prima di andarsene. "Instancabilmente lo studiamo, noi. Se in un lotto più grande poteste portarlo, più in fretta progredire, potremmo."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 2|	He says that about seven samples of the mineral should do for next time and finally leaves. Some workers come shortly after to escort you back to your ship through the maze of smelters.|307|0
units.english: He says that about seven samples of the mineral should do for next time and finally leaves. Some workers come shortly after to escort you back to your ship through the maze of smelters.
units.italian: Dice che circa sette campioni del minerale dovrebbero bastare per la prossima volta e infine se ne va. Poco dopo arrivano alcuni operai per scortarti alla nave attraverso il labirinto di fonderie.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 3|name|316|0
units.english: Neighbor's Mailbox
units.italian: La cassetta della posta del vicino

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 3|description|317|0
units.english: Deliver the <cargo> to the sister world of <origin>, <destination>.
units.italian: Consegna <cargo> al mondo gemello di <origin>, <destination>.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 3|Once again, you arrive at <origin> with a supply of yottrite and are contacted by the Arachi here. They ask if you're ready to sell what samples you've brought them.|327|0
units.english: Once again, you arrive at <origin> with a supply of yottrite and are contacted by the Arachi here. They ask if you're ready to sell what samples you've brought them.
units.italian: Ancora una volta arrivi su <origin> con una scorta di yottrite e vieni contattato dagli Arachi del posto. Ti chiedono se sei pronto a vendere i campioni che hai portato loro.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 3|	"Maybe some other time."|329|0
units.english: "Maybe some other time."
units.italian: "Magari un'altra volta."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 3|	"Sure am. Have some people wait by the docking area to help me unload the samples."|331|0
units.english: "Sure am. Have some people wait by the docking area to help me unload the samples."
units.italian: "Certo che sì. Fate aspettare qualcuno vicino all'area di attracco per aiutarmi a scaricare i campioni."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 3|	As the workers get the ore samples out of your ship, you realize that this time the Arach that asked for your help wasn't the one to contact you, nor was he waiting for you on the ground.|332|0
units.english: As the workers get the ore samples out of your ship, you realize that this time the Arach that asked for your help wasn't the one to contact you, nor was he waiting for you on the ground.
units.italian: Mentre gli operai tirano fuori i campioni di minerale dalla tua nave, ti rendi conto che questa volta l'Arach che aveva chiesto il tuo aiuto non è quello che ti ha contattato, né ti stava aspettando a terra.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 3|	The workers say they will bring the yottrite to the warehouse on their own, and you're told to wait. When they return, they're accompanied by other workers with different crates. They hand you 2,450,000 credits, and ask for permission to load the crates onto your ship.|333|0
units.english: The workers say they will bring the yottrite to the warehouse on their own, and you're told to wait. When they return, they're accompanied by other workers with different crates. They hand you 2,450,000 credits, and ask for permission to load the crates onto your ship.
units.italian: Gli operai dicono che porteranno loro lo yottrite al magazzino, e ti dicono di aspettare. Quando tornano, sono accompagnati da altri operai con casse diverse. Ti consegnano 2.450.000 crediti e chiedono il permesso di caricare le casse sulla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 3|	"Roughly 5 tons, they weigh. To <destination>, this planet's neighboring world, you must bring them. Requested it so, the overseer has," they say.|334|0
units.english: "Roughly 5 tons, they weigh. To <destination>, this planet's neighboring world, you must bring them. Requested it so, the overseer has," they say.
units.italian: "Pesano circa 5 tonnellate. Su <destination>, il mondo vicino a questo pianeta, dovete portarle. Richiesto così, il sovrintendente ha," dicono.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 3|	"What's in the crates?"|336|0
units.english: "What's in the crates?"
units.italian: "Cosa c'è nelle casse?"

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 3|	"That's gotta be the shortest courier mission I've ever heard of. Can't some other ship do the trip?"|338|0
units.english: "That's gotta be the shortest courier mission I've ever heard of. Can't some other ship do the trip?"
units.italian: "Sarebbe la missione di corriere più breve che abbia mai sentito. Non può farla un'altra nave?"

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 3|label|340|0
units.english: inside crate
units.italian: inside crate

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 3|	"Older samples that you've brought to us, they contain. Experimented with, the yottrite was. Unsure of the details, I am."|341|0
units.english: "Older samples that you've brought to us, they contain. Experimented with, the yottrite was. Unsure of the details, I am."
units.italian: "Campioni più vecchi che ci avete portato, contengono. Sperimentato, lo yottrite è stato. Incerto sui dettagli, sono."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 3|label|343|0
units.english: so it would seem
units.italian: so it would seem

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 3|	"For you to carry them, the overseer asked. Why you in particular, unsure I am."|344|0
units.english: "For you to carry them, the overseer asked. Why you in particular, unsure I am."
units.italian: "Che le portiate voi, il sovrintendente ha chiesto. Perché proprio voi, incerto sono."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 3|	You figure that since it's so little cargo and to a planet in this very system, there's no harm in delivering the crates. They place them in your ship.|346|0
units.english: You figure that since it's so little cargo and to a planet in this very system, there's no harm in delivering the crates. They place them in your ship.
units.italian: Pensi che, dato che il carico è così poco e la destinazione è un pianeta di questo stesso sistema, non ci sia nulla di male a consegnare le casse. Le sistemano nella tua nave.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 3|dialog|352|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying the yottrite samples hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con i campioni di yottrite non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 3|Though on <origin> you weren't greeted by him, the same Arach from the other trips now contacts you as you prepare to land on <planet>.|355|0
units.english: Though on <origin> you weren't greeted by him, the same Arach from the other trips now contacts you as you prepare to land on <planet>.
units.italian: Anche se su <origin> non ti ha accolto lui, lo stesso Arach degli altri viaggi ti contatta ora che ti prepari ad atterrare su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 3|	"Captain <last>! Forgive me for my absence in our latest deal, you must. Sort out some business here, I had to," he says.|356|0
units.english: "Captain <last>! Forgive me for my absence in our latest deal, you must. Sort out some business here, I had to," he says.
units.italian: "Capitano <last>! Perdonarmi per la mia assenza nel nostro ultimo affare, dovete. Sbrigare alcuni affari qui, ho dovuto," dice.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 3|	He directs you to land on a separate area of the planet, and halfway there little by little a Heliarch fleet starts tailing your ship. You spend a few minutes hovering over the area until they finally give you permission to land. Some of the ships land along with you while others remain in flight, as you come to a massive warehouse complex on a large valley. The facility is walled with some odd kind of barbed wire on top of the walls and fences, and several armed Heliarch agents are patrolling the area.|357|0
units.english: He directs you to land on a separate area of the planet, and halfway there little by little a Heliarch fleet starts tailing your ship. You spend a few minutes hovering over the area until they finally give you permission to land. Some of the ships land along with you while others remain in flight, as you come to a massive warehouse complex on a large valley. The facility is walled with some odd kind of barbed wire on top of the walls and fences, and several armed Heliarch agents are patrolling the area.
units.italian: Ti indica di atterrare in un'area separata del pianeta, e a metà strada una flotta degli Heliarchs comincia poco a poco a seguire la tua nave. Passi qualche minuto a librare sopra l'area finché finalmente ti danno il permesso di atterrare. Alcune navi atterrano insieme a te mentre altre restano in volo, e arrivi a un enorme complesso di magazzini in una grande valle. La struttura è circondata da mura con uno strano tipo di filo spinato in cima alle mura e alle recinzioni, e diversi agenti armati degli Heliarchs pattugliano la zona.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 3|	As you leave your ship, the Arach is waiting for you alongside some Heliarch officers. They have the cargo removed from your ship without saying much.|358|0
units.english: As you leave your ship, the Arach is waiting for you alongside some Heliarch officers. They have the cargo removed from your ship without saying much.
units.italian: Quando esci dalla nave, l'Arach ti aspetta insieme ad alcuni ufficiali degli Heliarchs. Fanno scaricare il carico dalla tua nave senza dire molto.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 3|	Right before the Heliarch ships prepare to escort you back to the standard docking area, he says, "In the spaceport, meet you I will."|359|0
units.english: Right before the Heliarch ships prepare to escort you back to the standard docking area, he says, "In the spaceport, meet you I will."
units.italian: Proprio prima che le navi degli Heliarchs si preparino a scortarti all'area di attracco standard, dice: "Nello spazioporto, incontrarvi io verrò."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 4|name|364|0
units.english: Yottrite Research
units.italian: Ricerca sullo yottrite

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 4|description|365|0
units.english: Lugglop, one of the Arachi that oversees the mining operations in Bloptab, asked that you pick up some friends of his on <destination> so that they may help with the yottrite research.
units.italian: Lugglop, uno degli Arachi che sovrintendono alle operazioni minerarie a Bloptab, ti ha chiesto di prendere alcuni suoi amici su <destination> perché possano aiutare con la ricerca sullo yottrite.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 4|You wait around the spaceport for some minutes before finally spotting the Arach. He invites you to his office.|372|0
units.english: You wait around the spaceport for some minutes before finally spotting the Arach. He invites you to his office.
units.italian: Aspetti nello spazioporto per qualche minuto prima di scorgere finalmente l'Arach. Ti invita nel suo ufficio.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 4|	"Responsible for overseeing deliveries of such exotic materials to the warehouses here, I also am. For the inconvenience and bureaucracy, I apologize," he says. "Forget to properly introduce myself, I often do. Lugglop, I am called."|373|0
units.english: "Responsible for overseeing deliveries of such exotic materials to the warehouses here, I also am. For the inconvenience and bureaucracy, I apologize," he says. "Forget to properly introduce myself, I often do. Lugglop, I am called."
units.italian: "Responsabile di sovrintendere alle consegne di materiali così esotici ai magazzini qui, anch'io sono. Per il fastidio e la burocrazia, mi scuso," dice. "Dimenticare di presentarmi come si deve, spesso lo faccio. Lugglop, mi chiamo."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 4|	"Nice to meet you, I suppose."|375|0
units.english: "Nice to meet you, I suppose."
units.italian: "Piacere di conoscerti, suppongo."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 4|	"Do you need more samples? Is that why you called me here?"|376|0
units.english: "Do you need more samples? Is that why you called me here?"
units.italian: "Ti servono altri campioni? È per questo che mi hai chiamato?"

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 4|	"Harder to keep track of them, it becomes, the more samples there are," he says. "Notified by the Heliarchs, I was. No more samples, for now, I can request. Risk letting them be stolen, they cannot." He then shows you a map of the Coalition, pointing to a system in Saryd space. "Use more delicate procedures and research, to study the samples we must. For that, friends of mine on <destination>, will be waiting," he says. "Bring them here, would you, Captain?"|377|0
units.english: "Harder to keep track of them, it becomes, the more samples there are," he says. "Notified by the Heliarchs, I was. No more samples, for now, I can request. Risk letting them be stolen, they cannot." He then shows you a map of the Coalition, pointing to a system in Saryd space. "Use more delicate procedures and research, to study the samples we must. For that, friends of mine on <destination>, will be waiting," he says. "Bring them here, would you, Captain?"
units.italian: "Più difficile tenerne traccia, diventa, più campioni ci sono," dice. "Avvisato dagli Heliarchs, sono stato. Niente altri campioni, per ora, posso richiedere. Rischio di lasciarli rubare, non possono correre." Poi ti mostra una mappa della Coalizione, indicando un sistema nello spazio dei Saryd. "Procedure più delicate e ricerca, per studiare i campioni dobbiamo usare. Per questo, amici miei su <destination> vi aspetteranno," dice. "Portarli qui, vorreste, capitano?"

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 4|	"Of course, they'll be here soon."|379|0
units.english: "Of course, they'll be here soon."
units.italian: "Ma certo, arriveranno presto."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 4|	"Sorry, I'm not one to take passenger jobs."|381|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not one to take passenger jobs."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non sono tipo da lavori con passeggeri."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 4|dialog|384|0
units.english: When you land on <planet>, Lugglop contacts you and informs you that he has already told his friends about you. He says they will be waiting in the spaceport.
units.italian: Quando atterri su <planet>, Lugglop ti contatta e ti informa che ha già parlato di te ai suoi amici. Dice che ti aspetteranno nello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 5|name|389|0
units.english: Saryd Specialists
units.italian: Specialisti Saryd

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 5|description|390|0
units.english: Transport the twins Nasilor and Alituri to <destination>, where they will assist in the yottrite research.
units.italian: Trasporta i gemelli Nasilor e Alituri su <destination>, dove aiuteranno nella ricerca sullo yottrite.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 5|blocked|392|0
units.english: You need <capacity> in order to take on the next mission. Return here when you have the required space free.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> per accettare la prossima missione. Torna qui quando avrai lo spazio libero richiesto.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 5|A Saryd wearing their version of a lab coat is waiting for you when you enter the spaceport.|399|0
units.english: A Saryd wearing their version of a lab coat is waiting for you when you enter the spaceport.
units.italian: Un Saryd che indossa la loro versione di un camice da laboratorio ti aspetta quando entri nello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 5|	"Working with Lugglop, you are?" He asks, and you nod. "Nasilor, my name is. Packing up our belongings, my sister is. Bring you to our laboratory, I shall."|400|0
units.english: "Working with Lugglop, you are?" He asks, and you nod. "Nasilor, my name is. Packing up our belongings, my sister is. Bring you to our laboratory, I shall."
units.italian: "Con Lugglop lavorate, voi?" chiede, e tu annuisci. "Nasilor, il mio nome è. Preparare i nostri bagagli, mia sorella sta. Portarvi al nostro laboratorio, io dovrò."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 5|	You follow him deep into the underground spaceport to the "residential" section, which, to you, is indistinguishable from a research compound. The endless doors to your left and right occasionally give space for large glass panels, giving you a nice view of the massive crystal formations here.|401|0
units.english: You follow him deep into the underground spaceport to the "residential" section, which, to you, is indistinguishable from a research compound. The endless doors to your left and right occasionally give space for large glass panels, giving you a nice view of the massive crystal formations here.
units.italian: Lo segui in profondità nello spazioporto sotterraneo fino alla sezione "residenziale", che per te è indistinguibile da un complesso di ricerca. Le infinite porte alla tua sinistra e alla tua destra ogni tanto lasciano spazio a grandi pannelli di vetro, offrendoti una bella vista sulle enormi formazioni cristalline del posto.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 5|	Nasilor stops by a door immediately after one of these "viewing sites" and opens it. He introduces you to his sister, Alituri, and you two start helping her pack what remains. Most of what they're bringing are several research papers, though you can't figure out what's written on them.|402|0
units.english: Nasilor stops by a door immediately after one of these "viewing sites" and opens it. He introduces you to his sister, Alituri, and you two start helping her pack what remains. Most of what they're bringing are several research papers, though you can't figure out what's written on them.
units.italian: Nasilor si ferma davanti a una porta subito dopo uno di questi "punti panoramici" e la apre. Ti presenta sua sorella, Alituri, e voi due cominciate ad aiutarla a fare i bagagli di quel che resta. La maggior parte di quello che portano sono diversi articoli di ricerca, anche se non riesci a capire cosa ci sia scritto.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 5|	Finally, you start heading back to your ship. Noticing your interest in the beauty of the gypsum caves, the two Saryd researchers slow down their pace and start to tell you more about themselves. They are twins, both born on Saros, but have been working here for decades. Though you don't understand much of the technical jargon, you figure out that Nasilor specializes in cryptocrystalline compounds, while Alituri focuses her studies on planetary and cosmic conditions that lead to the formation of the gypsum caves here.|403|0
units.english: Finally, you start heading back to your ship. Noticing your interest in the beauty of the gypsum caves, the two Saryd researchers slow down their pace and start to tell you more about themselves. They are twins, both born on Saros, but have been working here for decades. Though you don't understand much of the technical jargon, you figure out that Nasilor specializes in cryptocrystalline compounds, while Alituri focuses her studies on planetary and cosmic conditions that lead to the formation of the gypsum caves here.
units.italian: Alla fine vi avviate verso la tua nave. Notando il tuo interesse per la bellezza delle grotte di gesso, i due ricercatori Saryd rallentano il passo e cominciano a raccontarti di più su di loro. Sono gemelli, entrambi nati su Saros, ma lavorano qui da decenni. Anche se non capisci molto del gergo tecnico, capisci che Nasilor è specializzato in composti criptocristallini, mentre Alituri concentra i suoi studi sulle condizioni planetarie e cosmiche che portano alla formazione delle grotte di gesso qui.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 5|	With the little "tour" over, when you three reach your ship, you show them to their bunks and prepare to head back to <planet>.|404|0
units.english: With the little "tour" over, when you three reach your ship, you show them to their bunks and prepare to head back to <planet>.
units.italian: Concluso il piccolo "tour", quando voi tre raggiungete la nave mostri loro le cuccette e ti prepari a tornare su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 5|dialog|407|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying the Saryd twins hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con i gemelli Saryd non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 6|name|412|0
units.english: Master Shipwright
units.italian: Maestro costruttore di navi

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 6|description|413|0
units.english: Head to <destination> to pick up a member of House Mallob so that they may help in trying to apply yottrite to an alloy.
units.italian: Dirigiti su <destination> per prendere un membro della Casa Mallob perché possa aiutare a cercare di applicare lo yottrite a una lega.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 6|Lugglop is waiting for you when you land and greets the two researchers as you help them get their things out of the ship.|422|0
units.english: Lugglop is waiting for you when you land and greets the two researchers as you help them get their things out of the ship.
units.italian: Lugglop ti aspetta quando atterri e saluta i due ricercatori mentre li aiuti a tirare fuori le loro cose dalla nave.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 6|	He points them to a hotel where he had a room prepared for them, and asks you to follow him to his office again.|423|0
units.english: He points them to a hotel where he had a room prepared for them, and asks you to follow him to his office again.
units.italian: Indica loro un hotel dove ha preparato una stanza per loro, e ti chiede di seguirlo di nuovo nel suo ufficio.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 6|	"Filled to the brim with cutting edge equipment, our facilities here and on the neighbor planet are. Alas, venture much into the theoretical field needed to study such rare elements, our personnel here does not."|424|0
units.english: "Filled to the brim with cutting edge equipment, our facilities here and on the neighbor planet are. Alas, venture much into the theoretical field needed to study such rare elements, our personnel here does not."
units.italian: "Piena zeppa di attrezzature all'avanguardia, la nostra struttura qui e quella sul pianeta vicino sono. Ahimè, avventurarsi molto nel campo teorico necessario a studiare elementi così rari, il nostro personale qui non lo fa."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 6|	He shows you to his map again, this time pointing to a nearby Arach world. "Once cracked some aspects of yottrite, the twins have, an expert in ship making, we will need," he says. "On <destination>, prepared one of their representatives, House Mallob has. Bring them here, you must."|425|0
units.english: He shows you to his map again, this time pointing to a nearby Arach world. "Once cracked some aspects of yottrite, the twins have, an expert in ship making, we will need," he says. "On <destination>, prepared one of their representatives, House Mallob has. Bring them here, you must."
units.italian: Ti mostra di nuovo la sua mappa, questa volta indicando un mondo Arach vicino. "Una volta risolti alcuni aspetti dello yottrite, i gemelli hanno; un esperto nella costruzione di navi, ci servirà," dice. "Su <destination>, preparato uno dei loro rappresentanti, la Casa Mallob ha. Portarlo qui, dovete."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 6|	You're about to head back to your ship when he hands you 200,000 credits. "Nearly forgot to pay you for this last service, I did."|426|0
units.english: You're about to head back to your ship when he hands you 200,000 credits. "Nearly forgot to pay you for this last service, I did."
units.italian: Stai per tornare alla nave quando ti consegna 200.000 crediti. "Quasi dimenticavo di pagarvi per quest'ultimo servizio, io."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 7|name|432|0
units.english: Master Shipwright
units.italian: Maestro costruttore di navi

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 7|description|433|0
units.english: Bring Pichiie to <destination>, where she will join Lugglop's team in their yottrite research.
units.italian: Porta Pichiie su <destination>, dove si unirà alla squadra di Lugglop nella ricerca sullo yottrite.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 7|blocked|435|0
units.english: You need <capacity> in order to take on the next mission. Return here when you have the required space free.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> per accettare la prossima missione. Torna qui quando avrai lo spazio libero richiesto.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 7|You're immediately hailed by House Mallob when your ship is entering the atmosphere of <origin>. They guide you through the planet, bringing you to what looks like a massive, castle-like structure, which appears to be made out of a similar material to that of Arach ships, sitting at the base of a mountain.|443|0
units.english: You're immediately hailed by House Mallob when your ship is entering the atmosphere of <origin>. They guide you through the planet, bringing you to what looks like a massive, castle-like structure, which appears to be made out of a similar material to that of Arach ships, sitting at the base of a mountain.
units.italian: Vieni immediatamente chiamato dalla Casa Mallob quando la tua nave entra nell'atmosfera di <origin>.
