Ti guidano attraverso il pianeta, portandoti a quella che sembra una struttura enorme, simile a un castello, che sembra fatta di un materiale simile a quello delle navi Arach, ai piedi di una montagna.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 7|	You land on a large docking area, where some other ships are also conducting business. Stepping off of your ship you're greeted by what is unmistakably an outfitter, and as you look around you spot some other large buildings dotting the surrounding area, with members of the Coalition going to and from them. The atmosphere feels like that of a small village turned into an outdoor shopping mall.|444|0
units.english: You land on a large docking area, where some other ships are also conducting business. Stepping off of your ship you're greeted by what is unmistakably an outfitter, and as you look around you spot some other large buildings dotting the surrounding area, with members of the Coalition going to and from them. The atmosphere feels like that of a small village turned into an outdoor shopping mall.
units.italian: Atterri su una grande area di attracco, dove altre navi stanno anch'esse facendo affari. Scendendo dalla nave ti accoglie quello che è inequivocabilmente un fornitore di equipaggiamento, e guardandoti intorno scorgi altri grandi edifici sparsi nella zona circostante, con membri della Coalizione che vanno e vengono. L'atmosfera è quella di un piccolo villaggio trasformato in un centro commerciale all'aperto.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 7|	Shortly after landing you're greeted by an Arach wearing what you judge to be some sort of uniform. He takes a translation device out of his pocket and formally greets you. "Honored to have you as a guest, the great House Mallob is, Captain <first> <last>."|445|0
units.english: Shortly after landing you're greeted by an Arach wearing what you judge to be some sort of uniform. He takes a translation device out of his pocket and formally greets you. "Honored to have you as a guest, the great House Mallob is, Captain <first> <last>."
units.italian: Poco dopo l'atterraggio ti accoglie un Arach che indossa quello che giudichi essere una specie di uniforme. Tira fuori un dispositivo di traduzione dalla tasca e ti saluta formalmente. "Onorata di avervi come ospite, la grande Casa Mallob è, capitano <first> <last>."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 7|	"Are you the shipwright I'll be taking to Lugglop?"|447|0
units.english: "Are you the shipwright I'll be taking to Lugglop?"
units.italian: "Sei tu il costruttore di navi che devo portare da Lugglop?"

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 7|	"What's with this place? Why are there so many buildings all over?"|449|0
units.english: "What's with this place? Why are there so many buildings all over?"
units.italian: "Che succede in questo posto? Perché ci sono così tanti edifici dappertutto?"

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 7|	"Mountains, no! But a servant of House Mallob, I am. Mostly as a chauffeur, I work."|452|0
units.english: "Mountains, no! But a servant of House Mallob, I am. Mostly as a chauffeur, I work."
units.italian: "Montagne, no! Ma un servitore della Casa Mallob, io sono. Soprattutto come autista, lavoro."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 7|	"No mere mansion, the private property of House Mallob is," he says as he starts pointing to different areas. "A museum, there we have, detailing the history of Arach ships. To the left, a marketplace is. To the right, House Mallob's private university is, where study the advanced methods of ship making, honor students from all over the Coalition do."|455|0
units.english: "No mere mansion, the private property of House Mallob is," he says as he starts pointing to different areas. "A museum, there we have, detailing the history of Arach ships. To the left, a marketplace is. To the right, House Mallob's private university is, where study the advanced methods of ship making, honor students from all over the Coalition do."
units.italian: "Non una semplice villa, la proprietà privata della Casa Mallob è," dice mentre comincia a indicare diverse zone. "Un museo, lì abbiamo, che racconta la storia delle navi Arach. A sinistra, un mercato è. A destra, l'università privata della Casa Mallob è, dove studiare i metodi avanzati di costruzione delle navi, studenti d'onore da tutta la Coalizione vengono."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 7|	He then asks that you follow him, saying, "Assist Lugglop in his research, my mistress will. Meet her in the mansion, you must." You follow him along the path, and he gives a bit more detail on some of the buildings as you walk near them. What really piques your interest though is that one of the buildings, which he seemed to willingly ignore, had armed guards at the door, with no indication of being members of the Heliarch.|457|0
units.english: He then asks that you follow him, saying, "Assist Lugglop in his research, my mistress will. Meet her in the mansion, you must." You follow him along the path, and he gives a bit more detail on some of the buildings as you walk near them. What really piques your interest though is that one of the buildings, which he seemed to willingly ignore, had armed guards at the door, with no indication of being members of the Heliarch.
units.italian: Poi ti chiede di seguirlo, dicendo: "Aiutare Lugglop nella sua ricerca, la mia signora farà. Incontrarla nella villa, dovete." Lo segui lungo il sentiero, e ti dà qualche dettaglio in più su alcuni degli edifici mentre gli passate vicino. Quello che però ti incuriosisce davvero è che uno degli edifici, che sembrava voler ignorare di proposito, aveva guardie armate alla porta, senza alcun segno che fossero membri degli Heliarchs.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 7|	Reaching the entrance of the mansion, it isn't as castle-like as the walls, but it all still looks strangely pompous. Up close it almost looks like all the several parts and pods of an Arach Hulk or two were crumpled together into one single building.|458|0
units.english: Reaching the entrance of the mansion, it isn't as castle-like as the walls, but it all still looks strangely pompous. Up close it almost looks like all the several parts and pods of an Arach Hulk or two were crumpled together into one single building.
units.italian: Arrivando all'ingresso della villa, questa non è simile a un castello come le mura, ma l'insieme sembra comunque stranamente pomposo. Da vicino sembra quasi che tutte le varie parti e capsule di uno o due Hulk Arach siano state accartocciate insieme in un unico edificio.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 7|	He guides you through the mansion. You pass by several other servants, notice rooms where he mentions that members of House Mallob are having meetings, and even meet a group of Saryd and Kimek students who came here to study with the shipwrights of House Mallob.|459|0
units.english: He guides you through the mansion. You pass by several other servants, notice rooms where he mentions that members of House Mallob are having meetings, and even meet a group of Saryd and Kimek students who came here to study with the shipwrights of House Mallob.
units.italian: Ti guida attraverso la villa. Passi davanti a diversi altri servitori, noti stanze in cui ti dice che membri della Casa Mallob stanno avendo riunioni, e incontri persino un gruppo di studenti Saryd e Kimek venuti qui a studiare con i costruttori di navi della Casa Mallob.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 7|	Finally, he brings you to a room on the third floor, claiming that your passenger is waiting inside. You enter, only to see a Kimek glancing out the window.|460|0
units.english: Finally, he brings you to a room on the third floor, claiming that your passenger is waiting inside. You enter, only to see a Kimek glancing out the window.
units.italian: Alla fine ti porta in una stanza al terzo piano, sostenendo che il tuo passeggero aspetta là dentro. Entri, e vedi solo un Kimek che guarda fuori dalla finestra.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 7|	"I take it that's the shipwright?"|462|0
units.english: "I take it that's the shipwright?"
units.italian: "Suppongo che quello sia il costruttore di navi?"

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 7|	"So, is my passenger crawling around somewhere? In some corner hidden in a web?"|464|0
units.english: "So, is my passenger crawling around somewhere? In some corner hidden in a web?"
units.italian: "Allora il mio passeggero striscia da qualche parte? In qualche angolo nascosto in una ragnatela?"

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 7|	"A Kimek? I thought this was an Arach House."|465|0
units.english: "A Kimek? I thought this was an Arach House."
units.italian: "Un Kimek? Pensavo che questa fosse una Casa Arach."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 7|	The butler ignores what you said and introduces you to the Kimek in question. "Marry into House Mallob at a young age, Miss Pichiie did. A former student at the university here, she was."|466|0
units.english: The butler ignores what you said and introduces you to the Kimek in question. "Marry into House Mallob at a young age, Miss Pichiie did. A former student at the university here, she was."
units.italian: Il maggiordomo ignora quello che hai detto e ti presenta il Kimek in questione. "Sposandosi nella Casa Mallob in giovane età, la signorina Pichiie l'ha fatto. Una ex studentessa dell'università qui, lei era."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 7|	"Correct you are, Captain," he says. "Proud to introduce you to Miss Pichiie, I am. A former student at the university here, she was, before marry into House Mallob, she did."|469|0
units.english: "Correct you are, Captain," he says. "Proud to introduce you to Miss Pichiie, I am. A former student at the university here, she was, before marry into House Mallob, she did."
units.italian: "Ragione avete, capitano," dice. "Orgoglioso di presentarvi la signorina Pichiie, io sono. Una ex studentessa dell'università qui, lei era, prima di sposarsi nella Casa Mallob, lei ha fatto."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 7|	Finally, the reason why you had to come all the way to this part of <origin> becomes clear; Pichiie mentions she would like to hear your stories about where you got the yottrite in the first place before boarding your ship to head to <planet>. You tell her all samples you've come across were found in systems where the star had gone supernova. It's a short explanation, but she appears to be satisfied, and after saying her goodbyes to other members of the House, you're both brought to your ship.|471|0
units.english: Finally, the reason why you had to come all the way to this part of <origin> becomes clear; Pichiie mentions she would like to hear your stories about where you got the yottrite in the first place before boarding your ship to head to <planet>. You tell her all samples you've come across were found in systems where the star had gone supernova. It's a short explanation, but she appears to be satisfied, and after saying her goodbyes to other members of the House, you're both brought to your ship.
units.italian: Alla fine il motivo per cui hai dovuto arrivare fino a questa parte di <origin> diventa chiaro: Pichiie dice che le piacerebbe sentire le tue storie su come hai trovato lo yottrite, prima di salire sulla tua nave per andare su <planet>. Le racconti che tutti i campioni che hai incontrato sono stati trovati in sistemi dove la stella era diventata una supernova. È una spiegazione breve, ma sembra soddisfatta, e dopo aver salutato gli altri membri della Casa, venite entrambi portati alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 7|dialog|474|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Pichiie hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Pichiie non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 7|As with the Saryd twins, Lugglop greets Pichiie and tells her of a hotel he prepared for her time here.|479|0
units.english: As with the Saryd twins, Lugglop greets Pichiie and tells her of a hotel he prepared for her time here.
units.italian: Come con i gemelli Saryd, Lugglop accoglie Pichiie e le parla di un hotel che ha preparato per la sua permanenza.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 7|	"Ready, my team is now, Captain," he says, after Pichiie leaves with her luggage. "Enrich and research samples as needed, for the next few months we will. Contact you again, I will, should the need for your services arise once again."|480|0
units.english: "Ready, my team is now, Captain," he says, after Pichiie leaves with her luggage. "Enrich and research samples as needed, for the next few months we will. Contact you again, I will, should the need for your services arise once again."
units.italian: "Pronta, la mia squadra è ora, capitano," dice, dopo che Pichiie se ne va con i suoi bagagli. "Arricchire e studiare i campioni secondo necessità, per i prossimi mesi faremo. Contattarvi di nuovo, io verrò, se la necessità dei vostri servizi dovesse sorgere ancora."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 7|	He hands you <payment>, and walks away.|481|0
units.english: He hands you <payment>, and walks away.
units.italian: Ti consegna <payment> e se ne va.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 8|name|490|0
units.english: One Last Sample
units.italian: Un ultimo campione

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 8|description|491|0
units.english: Acquire one sample of yottrite and deliver it to <destination> so that Lugglop has some for his presentation to the Coalition's scientific community.
units.italian: Procurati un campione di yottrite e consegnalo su <destination>, così che Lugglop ne abbia un po' per la sua presentazione alla comunità scientifica della Coalizione.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 8|When you land, you receive a message from Lugglop, the Arach to whom you brought several yottrite samples.|500|0
units.english: When you land, you receive a message from Lugglop, the Arach to whom you brought several yottrite samples.
units.italian: Quando atterri, ricevi un messaggio da Lugglop, l'Arach a cui hai portato diversi campioni di yottrite.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 8|	"Captain, some major findings, we have. Preparing a presentation about our research, to present in Ring of Wisdom, we are," he says. "Only, run out of pure samples, we have. Bring us one once more, would you? Willing to pay slightly more for the inconvenience, we are. <payment>."|501|0
units.english: "Captain, some major findings, we have. Preparing a presentation about our research, to present in Ring of Wisdom, we are," he says. "Only, run out of pure samples, we have. Bring us one once more, would you? Willing to pay slightly more for the inconvenience, we are. <payment>."
units.italian: "Capitano, alcune scoperte importanti, abbiamo. Preparare una presentazione sulla nostra ricerca, per presentarla a Ring of Wisdom, stiamo," dice. "Solo che esaurito i campioni puri, abbiamo. Portarcene uno ancora, vorreste? Disposti a pagare un po' di più per il disturbo, siamo. <payment>."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 8|	"Okay, I'll bring you a piece of yottrite once again."|503|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll bring you a piece of yottrite once again."
units.italian: "Va bene, ti porterò ancora un pezzo di yottrite."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 8|	"Sorry, but I'm not mining that any more."|504|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'm not mining that any more."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non lo estraggo più."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 8|	He thanks you and says he and the rest of the team will be waiting in <destination>. "Moved here about halfway through the project, we did, to make use of the station's facilities."|506|0
units.english: He thanks you and says he and the rest of the team will be waiting in <destination>. "Moved here about halfway through the project, we did, to make use of the station's facilities."
units.italian: Ti ringrazia e dice che lui e il resto della squadra ti aspetteranno su <destination>. "Trasferiti qui circa a metà del progetto, noi ci siamo, per usare le strutture della stazione."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 8|dialog|511|0
units.english: Lugglop pays you <payment> as you deliver the yottrite, accompanied by a Heliarch agent. "Finish preparing our presentation, we now must. If to help us further you wish, in the spaceport meet us you must."
units.italian: Lugglop ti paga <payment> mentre consegni lo yottrite, accompagnato da un agente degli Heliarchs. "Finire di preparare la nostra presentazione, ora dobbiamo. Se aiutarci ancora desiderate, allo spazioporto incontrarci dovete."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 9|name|516|0
units.english: Yottrite Presentation
units.italian: Presentazione sullo yottrite

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 9|description|517|0
units.english: Transport Lugglop and his team, alongside <cargo>, to the <destination>, where they will share with the Coalition's scientific community their findings on yottrite.
units.italian: Trasporta Lugglop e la sua squadra, insieme a <cargo>, su <destination>, dove condivideranno con la comunità scientifica della Coalizione le loro scoperte sullo yottrite.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 9|blocked|520|0
units.english: You need <capacity> in order to take on the next mission. Return here when you have the required space free.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> per accettare la prossima missione. Torna qui quando avrai lo spazio libero richiesto.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 9|You meet Lugglop in the spaceport and follow him to meet with Nasilor, Alituri, and Pichiie, who are overseeing some workers place a few sealed metal crates inside a container and the yottrite sample you just brought here into another. They detail how they have prepared all the material they needed and now just need a transport to the <destination>.|527|0
units.english: You meet Lugglop in the spaceport and follow him to meet with Nasilor, Alituri, and Pichiie, who are overseeing some workers place a few sealed metal crates inside a container and the yottrite sample you just brought here into another. They detail how they have prepared all the material they needed and now just need a transport to the <destination>.
units.italian: Incontri Lugglop nello spazioporto e lo segui per incontrare Nasilor, Alituri e Pichiie, che stanno sovrintendendo ad alcuni operai che mettono alcune casse metalliche sigillate dentro un contenitore e il campione di yottrite che hai appena portato qui dentro un altro. Ti spiegano che hanno preparato tutto il materiale necessario e che ora serve solo un trasporto fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 9|	"If with us, you come, Captain, perhaps a better detailed description of the systems where the yottrite was found, you could provide," Nasilor says.|528|0
units.english: "If with us, you come, Captain, perhaps a better detailed description of the systems where the yottrite was found, you could provide," Nasilor says.
units.italian: "Se con noi venite, capitano, forse una descrizione più dettagliata dei sistemi dove lo yottrite è stato trovato, potreste fornire," dice Nasilor.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 9|	"<payment>, I would pay you," Lugglop says.|529|0
units.english: "<payment>, I would pay you," Lugglop says.
units.italian: "<payment>, vi pagherei," dice Lugglop.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 9|	"Of course I'll take you there. Have the containers loaded into my ship."|531|0
units.english: "Of course I'll take you there. Have the containers loaded into my ship."
units.italian: "Ma certo che vi porto lì. Fate caricare i contenitori sulla mia nave."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 9|	"What discoveries have you made about it?"|533|0
units.english: "What discoveries have you made about it?"
units.italian: "Che scoperte avete fatto?"

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 9|	"To share our findings with you, allowed we are not," Pichiie says.|536|0
units.english: "To share our findings with you, allowed we are not," Pichiie says.
units.italian: "Condividere le nostre scoperte con voi, non ci è permesso," dice Pichiie.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 9|	"Forgive us you must, Captain, but told to keep everything a secret, we were," Lugglop continues. "Perhaps after our presentation, public our findings could be made."|537|0
units.english: "Forgive us you must, Captain, but told to keep everything a secret, we were," Lugglop continues. "Perhaps after our presentation, public our findings could be made."
units.italian: "Perdonarci dovete, capitano, ma tenere tutto segreto, ci è stato detto," continua Lugglop. "Forse dopo la nostra presentazione, pubblici i nostri risultati potrebbero essere resi."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 9|	They all follow you to your ship after the containers are ready to be loaded.|539|0
units.english: They all follow you to your ship after the containers are ready to be loaded.
units.italian: Ti seguono tutti alla nave dopo che i contenitori sono pronti per essere caricati.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 9|	After they are put into your cargo, Nasilor, Alituri and Pichiie head to their bunks, but as Lugglop is coming on board, you see that two Heliarch agents, both Kimek, are accompanying him. "Here to ensure the secrecy of our discoveries, they are," he says. Seeing as they are only two more passengers, you agree to carry them to <planet>, and they all board your ship.|540|0
units.english: After they are put into your cargo, Nasilor, Alituri and Pichiie head to their bunks, but as Lugglop is coming on board, you see that two Heliarch agents, both Kimek, are accompanying him. "Here to ensure the secrecy of our discoveries, they are," he says. Seeing as they are only two more passengers, you agree to carry them to <planet>, and they all board your ship.
units.italian: Dopo che sono stati messi nel cargo, Nasilor, Alituri e Pichiie si dirigono alle loro cuccette, ma mentre Lugglop sta salendo a bordo vedi che due agenti degli Heliarchs, entrambi Kimek, lo accompagnano. "Qui per garantire la segretezza delle nostre scoperte, loro sono," dice. Dato che sono solo due passeggeri in più, accetti di portarli su <planet>, e salgono tutti sulla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 9|dialog|543|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Lugglop's team and their presentation materials hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con la squadra di Lugglop e i materiali della loro presentazione non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 9|Immediately when you land, Lugglop gives you your payment of <payment>. You and the four researchers then follow some Heliarch agents that were waiting for you at the docks. You five are brought to an area akin to a theater with some type of podium on the stage. The seats are all taken by Heliarch agents.|547|0
units.english: Immediately when you land, Lugglop gives you your payment of <payment>. You and the four researchers then follow some Heliarch agents that were waiting for you at the docks. You five are brought to an area akin to a theater with some type of podium on the stage. The seats are all taken by Heliarch agents.
units.italian: Appena atterri, Lugglop ti dà il tuo pagamento di <payment>. Tu e i quattro ricercatori seguite poi alcuni agenti degli Heliarchs che vi aspettavano alle banchine. Venite portati tutti e cinque in un'area simile a un teatro con una specie di podio sul palco. Tutti i posti sono occupati da agenti degli Heliarchs.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 9|	Lugglop's team apparently will wait until the contents of the two containers are brought here, so you're asked to describe the systems with supernovae where you encountered yottrite asteroids. This only lasts a few minutes, as the audience doesn't seem too keen on inquiring about details, though one particular Saryd did puzzle you when they asked about the state of the supernovas you visited. You tell them you don't know what they mean, and they press the topic no further.|548|0
units.english: Lugglop's team apparently will wait until the contents of the two containers are brought here, so you're asked to describe the systems with supernovae where you encountered yottrite asteroids. This only lasts a few minutes, as the audience doesn't seem too keen on inquiring about details, though one particular Saryd did puzzle you when they asked about the state of the supernovas you visited. You tell them you don't know what they mean, and they press the topic no further.
units.italian: La squadra di Lugglop a quanto pare aspetterà che il contenuto dei due contenitori venga portato qui, quindi ti chiedono di descrivere i sistemi con supernove dove hai incontrato gli asteroidi di yottrite. La cosa dura solo pochi minuti, perché il pubblico non sembra troppo desideroso di chiedere dettagli, anche se un Saryd in particolare ti ha lasciato perplesso quando ha chiesto dello stato delle supernove che hai visitato. Gli dici che non sai cosa intende, e non insiste sull'argomento.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 9|	After you finish, and right as the materials for Lugglop's presentation arrive, you're escorted back to your ship by some agents. Several hours later, you're contacted by Lugglop, who says the presentation is finished, and his group is coming back to your ship. When they arrive, they each thank you for providing the means to perform their experiments. "Officially commended for our efforts, we were!" he says.|549|0
units.english: After you finish, and right as the materials for Lugglop's presentation arrive, you're escorted back to your ship by some agents. Several hours later, you're contacted by Lugglop, who says the presentation is finished, and his group is coming back to your ship. When they arrive, they each thank you for providing the means to perform their experiments. "Officially commended for our efforts, we were!" he says.
units.italian: Dopo che hai finito, proprio mentre arrivano i materiali per la presentazione di Lugglop, alcuni agenti ti scortano alla tua nave. Diverse ore dopo vieni contattato da Lugglop, che dice che la presentazione è finita e che il suo gruppo sta tornando alla tua nave. Quando arrivano, ognuno ti ringrazia per aver fornito i mezzi per fare i loro esperimenti. "Ufficialmente encomiati per i nostri sforzi, siamo stati!" dice.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 9|	"Though allowed to publicly share our findings, we are not still, invited to be part of the team here that will continue the research, we were," Pichiie adds. The Saryd twins say they will reside here for as long as the project continues, while Pichiie comments on how she'll often be taking trips to visit her family in House Mallob's property.|550|0
units.english: "Though allowed to publicly share our findings, we are not still, invited to be part of the team here that will continue the research, we were," Pichiie adds. The Saryd twins say they will reside here for as long as the project continues, while Pichiie comments on how she'll often be taking trips to visit her family in House Mallob's property.
units.italian: "Anche se autorizzati a condividere pubblicamente le nostre scoperte, non lo siamo ancora; invitati a far parte della squadra qui che continuerà la ricerca, siamo stati," aggiunge Pichiie. I gemelli Saryd dicono che resteranno qui finché il progetto continua, mentre Pichiie commenta che farà spesso viaggi per andare a trovare la famiglia nelle proprietà della Casa Mallob.

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 9|	"As for me, a job as overseer, I still have to perform," Lugglop says. "Stay here for a few days I will, but even with all the advanced equipment of this ring, still our Coalition's most capable, the smelters of Bloptab's Furnace are. In their optimal state they must be, if to deepen our knowledge on yottrite, we are. Return there shortly, I will."|551|0
units.english: "As for me, a job as overseer, I still have to perform," Lugglop says. "Stay here for a few days I will, but even with all the advanced equipment of this ring, still our Coalition's most capable, the smelters of Bloptab's Furnace are. In their optimal state they must be, if to deepen our knowledge on yottrite, we are. Return there shortly, I will."
units.italian: "Quanto a me, un lavoro come sovrintendente, devo ancora svolgere," dice Lugglop. "Restare qui qualche giorno, io lo farò, ma anche con tutte le attrezzature avanzate di questo anello, ancora le più capaci della nostra Coalizione, le fonderie di Bloptab's Furnace sono. Nel loro stato ottimale devono essere, se approfondire la nostra conoscenza dello yottrite vogliamo. Tornarci presto, io lo farò."

units.id: mission:Coalition Yottrite 9|	They thank you again for all your help and wish you safe travels as you continue exploring.|552|0
units.english: They thank you again for all your help and wish you safe travels as you continue exploring.
units.italian: Ti ringraziano ancora per tutto l'aiuto e ti augurano buon viaggio mentre continui a esplorare.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|name|558|0
units.english: Transport Chikee
units.italian: Trasporta Chikee

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|description|559|0
units.english: Chikee, a young Kimek, is studying to become a Heliarch. Transport him to <destination>, where he was offered a job, so that he can make a living while studying on his own.
units.italian: Chikee, un giovane Kimek, studia per diventare un Heliarch. Trasportalo su <destination>, dove gli è stato offerto un lavoro, così che possa mantenersi mentre studia da solo.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|At any given time there are thousands of Kimek here in the spaceport, either mingling among themselves during a break from work or negotiating travel prices with starship captains. You imagine that if you weren't a human and clearly stood out, you too would be constantly getting offers to travel to another world, as many civilian captains here wish to fill a last bunk or two they have vacant on their ship before departing.|567|0
units.english: At any given time there are thousands of Kimek here in the spaceport, either mingling among themselves during a break from work or negotiating travel prices with starship captains. You imagine that if you weren't a human and clearly stood out, you too would be constantly getting offers to travel to another world, as many civilian captains here wish to fill a last bunk or two they have vacant on their ship before departing.
units.italian: In qualsiasi momento ci sono migliaia di Kimek qui nello spazioporto, che si mescolano tra loro durante una pausa dal lavoro o negoziano prezzi di viaggio con i capitani delle astronavi. Immagini che, se non fossi un umano e non ti distinguessi chiaramente, anche tu riceveresti continuamente offerte per viaggiare verso un altro mondo, dato che molti capitani civili qui desiderano riempire una o due cuccette rimaste vuote sulla loro nave prima di partire.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|	You manage to find a restaurant here where you spot some food you've already learned you can eat, so you take a seat and order something.|568|0
units.english: You manage to find a restaurant here where you spot some food you've already learned you can eat, so you take a seat and order something.
units.italian: Riesci a trovare un ristorante dove vedi del cibo che hai già imparato a poter mangiare, quindi ti siedi e ordini qualcosa.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|	You're halfway through your meal when you notice the waiter who brought it to you still hasn't moved away from the table.|569|0
units.english: You're halfway through your meal when you notice the waiter who brought it to you still hasn't moved away from the table.
units.italian: Sei a metà del pasto quando noti che il cameriere che te l'ha portato non si è ancora allontanato dal tavolo.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|	"Can I help you?"|571|0
units.english: "Can I help you?"
units.italian: "Posso aiutarti?"

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|	"Sorry, should I have paid first before eating?"|572|0
units.english: "Sorry, should I have paid first before eating?"
units.italian: "Scusa, dovevo pagare prima di mangiare?"

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|	The Kimek doesn't have a translation box, so your words don't reach him. While he insists on remaining by the table, you also notice he has been constantly glancing at the entrance, as if waiting for someone to come in.|575|0
units.english: The Kimek doesn't have a translation box, so your words don't reach him. While he insists on remaining by the table, you also notice he has been constantly glancing at the entrance, as if waiting for someone to come in.
units.italian: Il Kimek non ha una scatola di traduzione, quindi le tue parole non lo raggiungono. Mentre insiste a restare vicino al tavolo, noti anche che continua a guardare verso l'ingresso, come se aspettasse che entri qualcuno.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|	When a Heliarch agent passes by the entrance, the Kimek says something in his language, heading to meet the Heliarch, and speaking with them briefly. The Heliarch agent then accompanies the Kimek waiter to your table.|576|0
units.english: When a Heliarch agent passes by the entrance, the Kimek says something in his language, heading to meet the Heliarch, and speaking with them briefly. The Heliarch agent then accompanies the Kimek waiter to your table.
units.italian: Quando un agente degli Heliarchs passa dall'ingresso, il Kimek dice qualcosa nella sua lingua, si dirige a incontrare l'Heliarch e parla brevemente con lui. L'agente degli Heliarchs poi accompagna il cameriere Kimek al tuo tavolo.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|	"Does he need something?"|578|0
units.english: "Does he need something?"
units.italian: "Gli serve qualcosa?"

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|	"Did I do something wrong?"|579|0
units.english: "Did I do something wrong?"
units.italian: "Ho fatto qualcosa di sbagliato?"

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|	"Wish to speak to you, this Kimek does, Captain," the agent says, as they continue listening to what the Kimek is telling them, and makes an effort to translate their message to you. "Called Chikee, he is. A student, aspiring to join the ranks of the Heliarchs. Looking for transportation to <destination>, he is, so that a better job there he may acquire."|580|0
units.english: "Wish to speak to you, this Kimek does, Captain," the agent says, as they continue listening to what the Kimek is telling them, and makes an effort to translate their message to you. "Called Chikee, he is. A student, aspiring to join the ranks of the Heliarchs. Looking for transportation to <destination>, he is, so that a better job there he may acquire."
units.italian: "Parlare con voi, questo Kimek vuole, capitano," dice l'agente, continuando ad ascoltare quello che il Kimek gli dice, e sforzandosi di tradurre il messaggio per te. "Chiamarsi Chikee, lui. Uno studente, che aspira a entrare nei ranghi degli Heliarchs. Cercare un trasporto per <destination>, sta, così che un lavoro migliore lì possa ottenere."

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|	"Sure, I'll take him there."|582|0
units.english: "Sure, I'll take him there."
units.italian: "Certo, lo porto io."

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|	"How much will he pay me?"|584|0
units.english: "How much will he pay me?"
units.italian: "Quanto mi pagherà?"

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|	"I'm not headed that way, sorry."|585|0
units.english: "I'm not headed that way, sorry."
units.italian: "Non vado in quella direzione, mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|	The Heliarch asks the young Kimek about payment, to which he takes a pause before responding, and when he does so he speaks a lot slower than before.|587|0
units.english: The Heliarch asks the young Kimek about payment, to which he takes a pause before responding, and when he does so he speaks a lot slower than before.
units.italian: L'Heliarch chiede al giovane Kimek del pagamento, e lui fa una pausa prima di rispondere, e quando lo fa parla molto più lentamente di prima.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|	"Not enough funds to pay you for the trip, he has," the agent says. "However, to pay you once well established he is, he promises."|588|0
units.english: "Not enough funds to pay you for the trip, he has," the agent says. "However, to pay you once well established he is, he promises."
units.italian: "Fondi sufficienti per pagarvi il viaggio, non ha," dice l'agente. "Però di pagarvi una volta ben sistemato, promette."

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|	"Okay then, I'll take him there."|590|0
units.english: "Okay then, I'll take him there."
units.italian: "Va bene allora, lo porto io."

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|	"I prefer not having to wait to get paid, sorry."|591|0
units.english: "I prefer not having to wait to get paid, sorry."
units.italian: "Preferisco non dover aspettare per essere pagato, mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|	You're told to wait for Chikee before departing the planet, and the Heliarch agent leaves. You leave the restaurant yourself shortly after, and head to your ship.|594|0
units.english: You're told to wait for Chikee before departing the planet, and the Heliarch agent leaves. You leave the restaurant yourself shortly after, and head to your ship.
units.italian: Ti dicono di aspettare Chikee prima di partire dal pianeta, e l'agente degli Heliarchs se ne va. Anche tu lasci il ristorante poco dopo e ti dirigi alla nave.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|	The Kimek is a bit surprised by you having a translation box, but seems to be put at ease knowing that he can speak with you directly now.|597|0
units.english: The Kimek is a bit surprised by you having a translation box, but seems to be put at ease knowing that he can speak with you directly now.
units.italian: Il Kimek è un po' sorpreso che tu abbia una scatola di traduzione, ma sembra più tranquillo sapendo che ora può parlarti direttamente.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|	"Chikee, my name is, Captain. A student. Looking for transportation to <destination>, I am," he blabs, scrambling to show you what you assume is some kind of letter. "A job in the mines there, I was offered. Better payment than this one, it has."|598|0
units.english: "Chikee, my name is, Captain. A student. Looking for transportation to <destination>, I am," he blabs, scrambling to show you what you assume is some kind of letter. "A job in the mines there, I was offered. Better payment than this one, it has."
units.italian: "Chikee, il mio nome è, capitano. Uno studente. Cercare un trasporto per <destination>, io sto," blatera, affannandosi a mostrarti quella che supponi sia una specie di lettera. "Un lavoro nelle miniere lì, mi è stato offerto. Pagamento migliore di questo, ha."

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|	"Sure, I'll take you there."|600|0
units.english: "Sure, I'll take you there."
units.italian: "Certo, ti porto io."

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|	"How much will you pay me?"|602|0
units.english: "How much will you pay me?"
units.italian: "Quanto mi pagherai?"

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|	"I'm not headed that way, sorry."|603|0
units.english: "I'm not headed that way, sorry."
units.italian: "Non vado in quella direzione, mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|	He pauses for a bit, and you see his mandibles clicking together time and again.|605|0
units.english: He pauses for a bit, and you see his mandibles clicking together time and again.
units.italian: Fa una pausa, e vedi le sue mandibole chiudersi e aprirsi più volte.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|	"Lacking proper funds, I currently am," he says, speaking much slower than before. "Once paid by this new job I am, however, pay you I will. I promise."|606|0
units.english: "Lacking proper funds, I currently am," he says, speaking much slower than before. "Once paid by this new job I am, however, pay you I will. I promise."
units.italian: "Fondi adeguati, al momento non ho," dice, parlando molto più lentamente di prima. "Una volta pagato da questo nuovo lavoro, però, pagarvi io lo farò. Prometto."

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|	"Ok, I'll take you there."|608|0
units.english: "Ok, I'll take you there."
units.italian: "Va bene, ti porto io."

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|	"I prefer not having to wait to get paid, sorry."|609|0
units.english: "I prefer not having to wait to get paid, sorry."
units.italian: "Preferisco non dover aspettare per essere pagato, mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|	He thanks you and says to wait for him by your ship before you depart. You leave the restaurant shortly after, and head to your ship.|612|0
units.english: He thanks you and says to wait for him by your ship before you depart. You leave the restaurant shortly after, and head to your ship.
units.italian: Ti ringrazia e dice di aspettarlo vicino alla nave prima di partire. Lasci il ristorante poco dopo e ti dirigi alla nave.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|	Night falls, but there hasn't been any decrease to the activities here, as the hordes of captains and workers still populate the docking area and the spaceport.|614|0
units.english: Night falls, but there hasn't been any decrease to the activities here, as the hordes of captains and workers still populate the docking area and the spaceport.
units.italian: Scende la notte, ma l'attività qui non è diminuita per niente: le orde di capitani e operai popolano ancora l'area di attracco e lo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|	Around midnight, Chikee arrives at your ship, and you show him to his bunk. He is only bringing a single, old rugged bag with him.|615|0
units.english: Around midnight, Chikee arrives at your ship, and you show him to his bunk. He is only bringing a single, old rugged bag with him.
units.italian: Verso mezzanotte Chikee arriva alla tua nave, e tu gli mostri la cuccetta. Porta con sé solo una vecchia borsa sgangherata.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|dialog|618|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Chikee hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Chikee non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 1|dialog|622|0
units.english: You drop Chikee off on <planet>, and wish him good luck on the new job.
units.italian: Lasci Chikee su <planet> e gli auguri buona fortuna con il nuovo lavoro.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 2|name|631|0
units.english: Transport Chikee
units.italian: Trasporta Chikee

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 2|description|632|0
units.english: Chikee, a young Kimek, is studying to become a Heliarch. Transport him to <destination>, where he was offered an internship and hopes to be awarded with a recommendation letter.
units.italian: Chikee, un giovane Kimek, studia per diventare un Heliarch. Trasportalo su <destination>, dove gli è stato offerto uno stage e spera di ricevere una lettera di raccomandazione.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 2|While strolling through the spaceport, you're flagged down by a familiar face. It's Chikee, the Kimek student whom you brought here months ago.|642|0
units.english: While strolling through the spaceport, you're flagged down by a familiar face. It's Chikee, the Kimek student whom you brought here months ago.
units.italian: Mentre passeggi per lo spazioporto, vieni fermato da un volto familiare. È Chikee, lo studente Kimek che hai portato qui mesi fa.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 2|	He excitedly greets you and talks about how well his studies have been going. You notice that he now has a translation device of his own, positioned by his neck.|643|0
units.english: He excitedly greets you and talks about how well his studies have been going. You notice that he now has a translation device of his own, positioned by his neck.
units.italian: Ti saluta con entusiasmo e racconta quanto bene stiano andando i suoi studi. Noti che ora ha un dispositivo di traduzione tutto suo, posizionato vicino al collo.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 2|	"Purchased it recently, I did, so that hindered by language barriers, I am not," he says. "Excellent timing you have, Captain. Looking for transportation, once again I am."|644|0
units.english: "Purchased it recently, I did, so that hindered by language barriers, I am not," he says. "Excellent timing you have, Captain. Looking for transportation, once again I am."
units.italian: "L'ho comprato di recente, così da non essere ostacolato dalle barriere linguistiche," dice. "Tempismo eccellente avete, capitano. Cercare un trasporto, ancora una volta sto."

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 2|	He tells you how his academic successes have earned him an internship in one of the laboratories on <destination>, and that he needs someone to transport him there by <date> so that he may begin working right away.|645|0
units.english: He tells you how his academic successes have earned him an internship in one of the laboratories on <destination>, and that he needs someone to transport him there by <date> so that he may begin working right away.
units.italian: Ti racconta come i suoi successi accademici gli abbiano fatto ottenere uno stage in uno dei laboratori su <destination>, e che ha bisogno di qualcuno che lo porti lì entro <date> perché possa iniziare a lavorare subito.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 2|	"Better, the payment is, but also hoping for a recommendation letter, I am," he says, explaining that such letters from a Heliarch laboratory could help him significantly in joining their ranks.|646|0
units.english: "Better, the payment is, but also hoping for a recommendation letter, I am," he says, explaining that such letters from a Heliarch laboratory could help him significantly in joining their ranks.
units.italian: "Migliore, il pagamento è, ma anche una lettera di raccomandazione spero di ottenere," dice, spiegando che lettere del genere da un laboratorio degli Heliarchs potrebbero aiutarlo molto a entrare nei loro ranghi.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 2|	"Sounds like you've worked pretty hard for this. Let's go to my ship, I'll take you there."|648|0
units.english: "Sounds like you've worked pretty hard for this. Let's go to my ship, I'll take you there."
units.italian: "Sembra che tu abbia lavorato sodo per questo. Andiamo alla mia nave, ti porto lì."

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 2|	"You still haven't paid me for last time, though."|650|0
units.english: "You still haven't paid me for last time, though."
units.italian: "Però non mi hai ancora pagato per l'ultima volta."

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 2|	He freezes up for a bit, not responding.|651|0
units.english: He freezes up for a bit, not responding.
units.italian: Si blocca per un momento, senza rispondere.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 2|	"Just enough money to rent an apartment there, I have. Save up until the laboratory pays me, I must," he says. "Scamming you, I am not, Captain. Thankful I am, and pay you handsomely, I will."|652|0
units.english: "Just enough money to rent an apartment there, I have. Save up until the laboratory pays me, I must," he says. "Scamming you, I am not, Captain. Thankful I am, and pay you handsomely, I will."
units.italian: "Giusto i soldi per affittare un appartamento lì, ho. Risparmiare finché il laboratorio non mi paga, devo," dice. "Truffarvi, non lo sto facendo, capitano. Grato sono, e pagarvi profumatamente, io lo farò."

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 2|	"Alright, I'll wait again. Let's go to my ship."|654|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll wait again. Let's go to my ship."
units.italian: "Va bene, aspetterò ancora. Andiamo alla mia nave."

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 2|	"Sorry, but I'm not one to be fooled twice."|656|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'm not one to be fooled twice."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non sono tipo da farmi fregare due volte."

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 2|	He thanks you, and this time follows you right away, as he already has his bags prepared.|659|0
units.english: He thanks you, and this time follows you right away, as he already has his bags prepared.
units.italian: Ti ringrazia, e questa volta ti segue subito, dato che ha già i bagagli pronti.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 2|	"Hoping to join the research teams on Ring of Wisdom, I am," he says as you two walk to your ship, explaining the reason he needs to study so much is because he is aiming to work for the scientific branch of the government, instead of the more military-focused side.|660|0
units.english: "Hoping to join the research teams on Ring of Wisdom, I am," he says as you two walk to your ship, explaining the reason he needs to study so much is because he is aiming to work for the scientific branch of the government, instead of the more military-focused side.
units.italian: "Sperare di entrare nelle squadre di ricerca su Ring of Wisdom, io spero," dice mentre camminate verso la nave, spiegando che il motivo per cui deve studiare così tanto è che punta a lavorare per il ramo scientifico del governo, invece che per il lato più militare.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 2|	You lead him to his bunk and prepare for the trip.|661|0
units.english: You lead him to his bunk and prepare for the trip.
units.italian: Lo accompagni alla sua cuccetta e ti prepari al viaggio.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 2|dialog|664|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Chikee hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Chikee non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 2|It seems the laboratory Chikee will work in is quite far away from the docking area, so after bidding you farewell, he decides to walk there immediately to get acquainted with his new bosses as soon as possible.|669|0
units.english: It seems the laboratory Chikee will work in is quite far away from the docking area, so after bidding you farewell, he decides to walk there immediately to get acquainted with his new bosses as soon as possible.
units.italian: Sembra che il laboratorio in cui lavorerà Chikee sia piuttosto lontano dall'area di attracco, quindi dopo avervi salutato decide di andarci subito a piedi per conoscere i suoi nuovi capi il prima possibile.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 2|	As he starts crossing one of the bridges linking the canyon walls here, he visibly struggles against the strong winds, as his bags seem to weigh him down.|670|0
units.english: As he starts crossing one of the bridges linking the canyon walls here, he visibly struggles against the strong winds, as his bags seem to weigh him down.
units.italian: Mentre comincia ad attraversare uno dei ponti che collegano le pareti del canyon qui, si vede che lotta contro i venti forti, dato che le sue borse sembrano appesantirlo.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 2|	(Help him with his bags.)|672|0
units.english: (Help him with his bags.)
units.italian: (Aiutalo con le borse.)

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 2|	(Let him go on his own.)|673|0
units.english: (Let him go on his own.)
units.italian: (Lascia che vada da solo.)

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 2|	You catch up to him without too much trouble, though you too are also somewhat troubled by the winds here. You pick up one of his bags, and he becomes much more comfortable with facing the constant blasts of air, though he still walks slower than the expected from a Kimek.|675|0
units.english: You catch up to him without too much trouble, though you too are also somewhat troubled by the winds here. You pick up one of his bags, and he becomes much more comfortable with facing the constant blasts of air, though he still walks slower than the expected from a Kimek.
units.italian: Lo raggiungi senza troppa fatica, anche se anche tu sei un po' in difficoltà per i venti del posto. Prendi una delle sue borse, e lui si trova molto più a suo agio nell'affrontare le folate continue d'aria, anche se continua a camminare più lentamente di quanto ci si aspetterebbe da un Kimek.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 2|	The two of you walk for about twenty minutes before finally reaching the laboratory. It is shielded by several large thick walls of stone slabs, much like many buildings in this unorthodox city.|676|0
units.english: The two of you walk for about twenty minutes before finally reaching the laboratory. It is shielded by several large thick walls of stone slabs, much like many buildings in this unorthodox city.
units.italian: Camminate per una ventina di minuti prima di arrivare finalmente al laboratorio. È protetto da diversi grandi e spessi muri di lastre di pietra, proprio come molti edifici di questa città poco ortodossa.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 2|	You wish Chikee the best of luck and head back to your ship.|677|0
units.english: You wish Chikee the best of luck and head back to your ship.
units.italian: Auguri a Chikee la migliore fortuna e torni alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 3|name|682|0
units.english: Transport Chikee
units.italian: Trasporta Chikee

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 3|description|683|0
units.english: Chikee, a young Kimek, is studying to become a Heliarch. Transport him to <destination>, where he will work with some members of House Idriss to further his research project.
units.italian: Chikee, un giovane Kimek, studia per diventare un Heliarch. Trasportalo su <destination>, dove lavorerà con alcuni membri della Casa Idriss per portare avanti il suo progetto di ricerca.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 3|As you land on <origin>, you notice that 170,000 credits have been transferred to your account, along with a message.|695|0
units.english: As you land on <origin>, you notice that 170,000 credits have been transferred to your account, along with a message.
units.italian: Mentre atterri su <origin>, noti che 170.000 crediti sono stati trasferiti sul tuo conto, insieme a un messaggio.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 3|	It's from Chikee, the Kimek student whom you brought here. He asks that you meet him in an area here more well protected from the winds, so you head there.|696|0
units.english: It's from Chikee, the Kimek student whom you brought here. He asks that you meet him in an area here more well protected from the winds, so you head there.
units.italian: È di Chikee, lo studente Kimek che hai portato qui. Ti chiede di incontrarlo in un'area qui più riparata dai venti, quindi ti dirigi là.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 3|	Upon meeting him, he says in a jolly tone, "Kept my promise, I did, Captain. Paid you, I have."|697|0
units.english: Upon meeting him, he says in a jolly tone, "Kept my promise, I did, Captain. Paid you, I have."
units.italian: Quando lo incontri, dice con tono allegro: "Mantenuta la promessa, io l'ho fatto, capitano. Pagato voi, io ho."

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 3|	His internship here apparently went really well, and he got the recommendation letter he wanted and is once again looking for transportation.|698|0
units.english: His internship here apparently went really well, and he got the recommendation letter he wanted and is once again looking for transportation.
units.italian: Il suo stage qui a quanto pare è andato molto bene, ha ottenuto la lettera di raccomandazione che voleva ed è di nuovo in cerca di un trasporto.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 3|	"Passing by a month ago, some members of House Idriss were. The Arach House that deals with the construction of hardware, they are," he says. "Interested by my work, they were. Offered a partnership on <destination>, they have."|699|0
units.english: "Passing by a month ago, some members of House Idriss were. The Arach House that deals with the construction of hardware, they are," he says. "Interested by my work, they were. Offered a partnership on <destination>, they have."
units.italian: "Di passaggio un mese fa, alcuni membri della Casa Idriss erano. La Casa Arach che si occupa della costruzione di hardware, loro sono," dice. "Interessati al mio lavoro, erano. Offerto una collaborazione su <destination>, hanno."

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 3|	"I thought you wanted to become a Heliarch. How exactly will all of this help you?"|701|0
units.english: "I thought you wanted to become a Heliarch. How exactly will all of this help you?"
units.italian: "Pensavo che volessi diventare un Heliarch. Come ti aiuterà esattamente tutto questo?"

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 3|	"Hold on, what sort of 'work' were they interested by? What have you been working on?"|703|0
units.english: "Hold on, what sort of 'work' were they interested by? What have you been working on?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, che tipo di 'lavoro' li ha interessati? Su cosa hai lavorato?"

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 3|	"If well known among the scientific community, I become, more merit, my curriculum will have," he says. "Make it easier to pass the trials, all the knowledge and experience I've gathered until now will as well."|706|0
units.english: "If well known among the scientific community, I become, more merit, my curriculum will have," he says. "Make it easier to pass the trials, all the knowledge and experience I've gathered until now will as well."
units.italian: "Se ben conosciuto nella comunità scientifica divento, più meriti, il mio curriculum avrà," dice. "Rendere più facile superare le prove, tutta la conoscenza e l'esperienza che ho raccolto fino a ora lo faranno allo stesso modo."

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 3|	"Larger than most, the Kimek population is. Struggle to properly distribute medication or other chemicals, even worlds richer than my homeworld do," he says. "Seeking to create an independent network to provide better distribution, I am."|709|0
units.english: "Larger than most, the Kimek population is. Struggle to properly distribute medication or other chemicals, even worlds richer than my homeworld do," he says. "Seeking to create an independent network to provide better distribution, I am."
units.italian: "Più grande della maggior parte, la popolazione Kimek è. Faticano a distribuire adeguatamente medicinali o altre sostanze chimiche, anche mondi più ricchi del mio," dice. "Cercare di creare una rete indipendente per fornire una distribuzione migliore, io sto."

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 3|	He jokes about how it's silly that although his species has such incredible advancements in their alimentary transport network, it's still difficult for most of the population to find medicine for what is translated as "the common cold" by the device. He claims that, were he on the Heliarch council, he could directly propose changes and solutions to such problems.|710|0
units.english: He jokes about how it's silly that although his species has such incredible advancements in their alimentary transport network, it's still difficult for most of the population to find medicine for what is translated as "the common cold" by the device. He claims that, were he on the Heliarch council, he could directly propose changes and solutions to such problems.
units.italian: Scherza sul fatto che sia assurdo che, nonostante la sua specie abbia progressi così incredibili nella rete di trasporto alimentare, per la maggior parte della popolazione sia ancora difficile trovare medicine per quello che il dispositivo traduce come "raffreddore comune". Sostiene che, se fosse nel consiglio degli Heliarchs, potrebbe proporre direttamente cambiamenti e soluzioni a questi problemi.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 3|	He tells you a bit more about his work here, how it was working with Saryds, and the cultural exchange. Though he seems to have garnered some fond memories of his time here, you notice while heading for your ship that he still hasn't gotten used to the wind.|712|0
units.english: He tells you a bit more about his work here, how it was working with Saryds, and the cultural exchange. Though he seems to have garnered some fond memories of his time here, you notice while heading for your ship that he still hasn't gotten used to the wind.
units.italian: Ti racconta qualcosa di più sul suo lavoro qui, su com'è stato lavorare con i Saryd e sullo scambio culturale. Anche se sembra aver accumulato bei ricordi del suo periodo qui, noti mentre andate verso la nave che non si è ancora abituato al vento.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 3|	You show him to his bunk and prepare for the journey to <destination>.|713|0
units.english: You show him to his bunk and prepare for the journey to <destination>.
units.italian: Gli mostri la cuccetta e ti prepari al viaggio verso <destination>.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 3|dialog|716|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Chikee hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Chikee non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 3|dialog|721|0
units.english: Chikee hands you 130,000 credits when you land. "As always, for transporting me, grateful I am, Captain," he says, as he heads off to meet with the members of House Idriss.
units.italian: Chikee ti consegna 130.000 crediti quando atterri. "Come sempre, per avermi trasportato, grato sono, capitano," dice, mentre si avvia a incontrare i membri della Casa Idriss.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 4|name|726|0
units.english: Transport Chikee
units.italian: Trasporta Chikee

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 4|description|727|0
units.english: Chikee, the young Kimek whom you've transported many times, has finally become a candidate for elevation to the rank of Heliarch. Bring him to the <destination> by <date>.
units.italian: Chikee, il giovane Kimek che hai trasportato molte volte, è finalmente diventato candidato all'elevazione al rango di Heliarch. Portalo su <destination> entro <date>.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 4|You're contacted by Chikee when you land.|739|0
units.english: You're contacted by Chikee when you land.
units.italian: Vieni contattato da Chikee quando atterri.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 4|	"Captain <last>! Good news and another job for you, I have," he says, asking that you meet him in the spaceport.|740|0
units.english: "Captain <last>! Good news and another job for you, I have," he says, asking that you meet him in the spaceport.
units.italian: "Capitano <last>! Buone notizie e un altro lavoro per voi, ho," dice, chiedendoti di incontrarlo nello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 4|	You head there, and he's already with his bags, prepared to board your ship. "Helped me a lot, House Idriss has. An audience with the Heliarch, on the <destination> I have!"|741|0
units.english: You head there, and he's already with his bags, prepared to board your ship. "Helped me a lot, House Idriss has. An audience with the Heliarch, on the <destination> I have!"
units.italian: Ti dirigi là, e lui è già con i bagagli, pronto a salire sulla tua nave. "Aiutato molto, la Casa Idriss mi ha. Un'udienza con l'Heliarch, su <destination> ho!"

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 4|	He tells you that he needs to be there by <date>, and wastes no time as he heads into your ship.|742|0
units.english: He tells you that he needs to be there by <date>, and wastes no time as he heads into your ship.
units.italian: Ti dice che deve essere lì entro <date>, e non perde tempo mentre entra nella tua nave.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 4|dialog|745|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Chikee hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Chikee non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 4|Chikee hands you <payment> before leaving your ship. Heliarch agents are waiting for him, and receive him in a bit of a ceremony.|750|0
units.english: Chikee hands you <payment> before leaving your ship. Heliarch agents are waiting for him, and receive him in a bit of a ceremony.
units.italian: Chikee ti consegna <payment> prima di lasciare la tua nave. Gli agenti degli Heliarchs lo aspettano, e lo ricevono con una specie di cerimonia.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 4|	You spend a few hours browsing some shops here and have some food once you find an establishment that serves something appetizing to humans.|751|0
units.english: You spend a few hours browsing some shops here and have some food once you find an establishment that serves something appetizing to humans.
units.italian: Passi qualche ora a girare per alcuni negozi e mangi qualcosa quando trovi un locale che serve qualcosa di appetitoso per gli umani.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 4|	Ringworlds have no day or night, but looking at your ship's internal clock, it is almost night time when Chikee returns to your ship in a hurry.|752|0
units.english: Ringworlds have no day or night, but looking at your ship's internal clock, it is almost night time when Chikee returns to your ship in a hurry.
units.italian: I mondi ad anello non hanno giorno né notte, ma guardando l'orologio interno della nave è quasi notte quando Chikee torna di corsa alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 4|	"Accepted I was! Grant me the rank, they did!" he says, showing you a Heliarch circlet as he puts it on his head. "Infinitely grateful for your help in all of this I am, Captain."|753|0
units.english: "Accepted I was! Grant me the rank, they did!" he says, showing you a Heliarch circlet as he puts it on his head. "Infinitely grateful for your help in all of this I am, Captain."
units.italian: "Accettato sono stato! Concedermi il rango, loro l'hanno fatto!" dice, mostrandoti un cerchietto degli Heliarchs mentre se lo mette in testa. "Infinitamente grato per il vostro aiuto in tutto questo, io sono, capitano."

units.id: mission:Kimek Student 4|	You congratulate him on the achievement, and he starts to tell you how what he calls the "trial" went. Aside from explaining his work on places that got him a recommendation letter, he was told to do a presentation on his own work to some type of jury and pass an interview. "Wait in a line with other candidates, I had to. To be selected, only a few were. So nervous, I was," he says. After thanking you again and trying to shake hands with you, he leaves your ship one last time, and you wish him the best of luck in his new line of work.|754|0
units.english: You congratulate him on the achievement, and he starts to tell you how what he calls the "trial" went. Aside from explaining his work on places that got him a recommendation letter, he was told to do a presentation on his own work to some type of jury and pass an interview. "Wait in a line with other candidates, I had to. To be selected, only a few were. So nervous, I was," he says. After thanking you again and trying to shake hands with you, he leaves your ship one last time, and you wish him the best of luck in his new line of work.
units.italian: Ti congratuli con lui per il risultato, e lui comincia a raccontarti com'è andata quella che chiama la "prova". A parte spiegare il suo lavoro sui luoghi che gli hanno fatto ottenere una lettera di raccomandazione, gli è stato chiesto di fare una presentazione del proprio lavoro a una specie di giuria e di superare un colloquio. "Aspettare in fila con altri candidati, ho dovuto. Per essere selezionati, solo pochi lo sono stati. Così nervoso, ero," dice. Dopo averti ringraziato di nuovo e aver provato a stringerti la mano, lascia la tua nave un'ultima volta, e tu gli auguri la migliore fortuna nel suo nuovo lavoro.

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 1|name|760|0
units.english: Transport Doctors
units.italian: Trasporta medici

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 1|description|761|0
units.english: Bring these <bunks> doctors, along with <cargo> to <destination> by <date>, where they will work to address a major viral outbreak
units.italian: Porta questi <bunks> medici, insieme a <cargo>, su <destination> entro <date>, dove lavoreranno per affrontare un grave focolaio virale

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 1|As you enter the spaceport, you notice several battalions of Coalition doctors roaming about, talking with merchant captains and then following some of them back to their ships.|773|0
units.english: As you enter the spaceport, you notice several battalions of Coalition doctors roaming about, talking with merchant captains and then following some of them back to their ships.
units.italian: Mentre entri nello spazioporto, noti diversi battaglioni di medici della Coalizione che gironzolano, parlano con i capitani mercanti e poi seguono alcuni di loro alle loro navi.

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 1|	One such crowd approaches you, and a Saryd among them says, "Broken out on <destination>, a deadly virus has. Captains willing to transport us and <cargo>, we seek." She shows you to the group of doctors, <bunks> of them.|774|0
units.english: One such crowd approaches you, and a Saryd among them says, "Broken out on <destination>, a deadly virus has. Captains willing to transport us and <cargo>, we seek." She shows you to the group of doctors, <bunks> of them.
units.italian: Una di queste folle si avvicina a te, e un Saryd tra loro dice: "Scoppiato su <destination>, un virus mortale è. Capitani disposti a trasportarci noi e <cargo>, cerchiamo." Ti mostra il gruppo di medici, <bunks> in tutto.

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 1|	"I'd be glad to help with something serious like that. Let's go to my ship."|776|0
units.english: "I'd be glad to help with something serious like that. Let's go to my ship."
units.italian: "Sarei felice di aiutare in una cosa seria così. Andiamo alla mia nave."

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 1|	"I can't afford to fill so many bunks right now, sorry."|777|0
units.english: "I can't afford to fill so many bunks right now, sorry."
units.italian: "Al momento non posso permettermi di riempire così tante cuccette, mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 1|	The doctors rush inside your ship, and spaceport workers quickly place the <cargo> in your cargo hold.|779|0
units.english: The doctors rush inside your ship, and spaceport workers quickly place the <cargo> in your cargo hold.
units.italian: I medici si precipitano nella tua nave, e gli operai dello spazioporto mettono rapidamente <cargo> nella stiva.

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 1|	When you get the chance, you ask them what exactly the virus is, and they explain as best as they can how it causes "tumorous-like behavior on Kimek exoskeletons, rapidly degenerating the tissue and exposing the flesh, all the while increasing the risk of infection." They say that although it is most dangerous to Kimek, there are confirmed cases of some Arachi having contracted the disease.|780|0
units.english: When you get the chance, you ask them what exactly the virus is, and they explain as best as they can how it causes "tumorous-like behavior on Kimek exoskeletons, rapidly degenerating the tissue and exposing the flesh, all the while increasing the risk of infection." They say that although it is most dangerous to Kimek, there are confirmed cases of some Arachi having contracted the disease.
units.italian: Quando ne hai l'occasione, chiedi loro che cos'è esattamente il virus, e spiegano come meglio possono che causa "un comportamento simile a quello tumorale sugli esoscheletri Kimek, degenerando rapidamente il tessuto ed esponendo la carne, aumentando nel frattempo il rischio di infezione". Dicono che, anche se è più pericoloso per i Kimek, ci sono casi confermati di alcuni Arachi che hanno contratto la malattia.

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 1|	It seems pretty serious, so you should make sure these doctors and their supplies are brought to <destination> as quickly as possible.|781|0
units.english: It seems pretty serious, so you should make sure these doctors and their supplies are brought to <destination> as quickly as possible.
units.italian: Sembra piuttosto serio, quindi dovresti assicurarti che questi medici e le loro forniture arrivino su <destination> il più rapidamente possibile.

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 1|dialog|784|0
units.english: You've reached <planet>, but the doctors and the medical supplies haven't arrived yet. Depart and wait for the ships carrying them.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma i medici e le forniture mediche non sono ancora arrivati. Parti e aspetta le navi che li trasportano.

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 1|dialog|788|0
units.english: The medical workers exit your ship just as quickly as they entered it and head off to different sections of the city, directed by some emergency workers. After the <cargo> are also taken off your ship, a worker hands you <payment> and says you could look for more ways to help with the outbreak by looking for their colleagues in the spaceport.
units.italian: Il personale medico esce dalla tua nave con la stessa rapidità con cui è entrato e si dirige verso diverse zone della città, guidato da alcuni operatori di emergenza. Dopo che anche <cargo> è stato scaricato, un operaio ti consegna <payment> e dice che potresti cercare altri modi per aiutare con il focolaio cercando i loro colleghi nello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 2|name|793|0
units.english: Collect Vaccines
units.italian: Raccogli i vaccini

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 2|description|794|0
units.english: Head to <stopovers>, where Saryd researchers have been working on a vaccine for the new virus, and deliver it to <destination> by <date>.
units.italian: Dirigiti su <stopovers>, dove i ricercatori Saryd hanno lavorato a un vaccino per il nuovo virus, e consegnalo su <destination> entro <date>.

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 2|blocked|797|0
units.english: You need <capacity> in order to take on the next mission. Return here when you have the required space free.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> per accettare la prossima missione. Torna qui quando avrai lo spazio libero richiesto.

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 2|As before, the spaceport is completely dominated by doctors and nurses. You don't find the person who told you to come here, but as you ask one of the other emergency workers, they direct you to a makeshift office set up next to a few trading panels.|805|0
units.english: As before, the spaceport is completely dominated by doctors and nurses. You don't find the person who told you to come here, but as you ask one of the other emergency workers, they direct you to a makeshift office set up next to a few trading panels.
units.italian: Come prima, lo spazioporto è completamente dominato da medici e infermieri. Non trovi la persona che ti ha detto di venire qui, ma chiedendo a uno degli altri operatori di emergenza ti indicano un ufficio improvvisato allestito accanto ad alcuni pannelli commerciali.

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 2|	"Fairly new to us, this virus is," the Kimek manning the stand says. "But finally developed an initial batch of vaccines for it, the researchers on Secret Sky thankfully have."|806|0
units.english: "Fairly new to us, this virus is," the Kimek manning the stand says. "But finally developed an initial batch of vaccines for it, the researchers on Secret Sky thankfully have."
units.italian: "Piuttosto nuovo per noi, questo virus è," dice il Kimek al banco. "Ma sviluppato finalmente un primo lotto di vaccini, i ricercatori su Secret Sky per fortuna hanno."

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 2|	"What do you mean 'finally?' Didn't this virus just break out recently?"|808|0
units.english: "What do you mean 'finally?' Didn't this virus just break out recently?"
units.italian: "Cosa vuoi dire con 'finalmente'? Non è scoppiato di recente questo virus?"

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 2|	"You want me to go there retrieve the vaccines?"|809|0
units.english: "You want me to go there retrieve the vaccines?"
units.italian: "Vuoi che vada lì a ritirare i vaccini?"

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 2|	He looks puzzled by your question.|811|0
units.english: He looks puzzled by your question.
units.italian: Sembra confuso dalla tua domanda.

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 2|	"That some weeks have already passed, true it is, but hard at work, the researchers have been," he says. "Blame them for taking a few days more than usual, we cannot. Intricate, this virus is."|812|0
units.english: "That some weeks have already passed, true it is, but hard at work, the researchers have been," he says. "Blame them for taking a few days more than usual, we cannot. Intricate, this virus is."
units.italian: "Che alcune settimane sono già passate, vero è, ma lavorare sodo, i ricercatori hanno fatto," dice. "Incolparli per aver impiegato qualche giorno più del solito, non possiamo. Intricato, questo virus è."

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 2|	He shows you a detailed map of Kimek space, explaining that most of the confirmed and suspected cases have been there. Given that the Kimek population is more than double that of the Arachi and the Saryds combined, it's not surprising.|814|0
units.english: He shows you a detailed map of Kimek space, explaining that most of the confirmed and suspected cases have been there. Given that the Kimek population is more than double that of the Arachi and the Saryds combined, it's not surprising.
units.italian: Ti mostra una mappa dettagliata dello spazio Kimek, spiegando che la maggior parte dei casi confermati e sospetti sono lì. Dato che la popolazione Kimek è più del doppio di quella degli Arachi e dei Saryd messi insieme, non sorprende.

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 2|	"To <destination>, this initial batch must be brought. From there, distributing more batches of the vaccines to other worlds, you will be tasked with."|815|0
units.english: "To <destination>, this initial batch must be brought. From there, distributing more batches of the vaccines to other worlds, you will be tasked with."
units.italian: "Su <destination>, portato questo primo lotto deve essere. Da lì, distribuire altri lotti dei vaccini agli altri mondi, incaricato voi sarete."

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 2|	As the line of volunteering merchant captains continues to grow behind you, he is swift to inform you that payment will be <payment>, and asks that the next person come forward.|816|0
units.english: As the line of volunteering merchant captains continues to grow behind you, he is swift to inform you that payment will be <payment>, and asks that the next person come forward.
units.italian: Mentre la fila di capitani mercanti volontari continua a crescere dietro di te, ti informa in fretta che il pagamento sarà <payment>, e chiede che avanzi la persona successiva.

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 2|dialog|819|0
units.english: A group of Saryd workers is waiting for you, and they load the <cargo> onto your ship. A laboratory worker babbles about how you must care for them.
units.italian: Un gruppo di operai Saryd ti aspetta, e caricano <cargo> sulla tua nave. Un addetto del laboratorio blatera su come devi prendertene cura.

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 2|dialog|821|0
