units.english: You've reached <planet>, but the vaccines aren't here yet. Once you've picked them up, make sure all ships that are carrying them arrive in this system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma i vaccini non sono ancora qui. Una volta che li hai presi, assicurati che tutte le navi che li trasportano arrivino in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 2|An incessant stream of freighters has the landing pads of the spaceport here overcrowded, and from the looks of it you were only given a quick clearance due to carrying the vaccines.|826|0
units.english: An incessant stream of freighters has the landing pads of the spaceport here overcrowded, and from the looks of it you were only given a quick clearance due to carrying the vaccines.
units.italian: Un flusso incessante di mercantili ha reso sovraffollate le piazzole di atterraggio dello spazioporto, e a quanto pare ti è stato dato un permesso rapido solo perché trasporti i vaccini.

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 2|	The people here, who are surprisingly managing to keep the place organized despite the overwhelming traffic, pay you <payment> as they unload the vaccines from your cargo hold.|827|0
units.english: The people here, who are surprisingly managing to keep the place organized despite the overwhelming traffic, pay you <payment> as they unload the vaccines from your cargo hold.
units.italian: La gente qui, che riesce sorprendentemente a tenere il posto organizzato nonostante il traffico schiacciante, ti paga <payment> mentre scarica i vaccini dalla stiva.

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 2|	"Waiting in the spaceport with more tasks for you, our colleagues will be, Captain <last>," one says before running off to tend to other ships carrying doctors or supplies.|828|0
units.english: "Waiting in the spaceport with more tasks for you, our colleagues will be, Captain <last>," one says before running off to tend to other ships carrying doctors or supplies.
units.italian: "Ad aspettare nello spazioporto con altri compiti per voi, i nostri colleghi staranno, capitano <last>," dice uno prima di correre a occuparsi di altre navi con medici o forniture.

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 3|name|833|0
units.english: Distribute Vaccines
units.italian: Distribuisci i vaccini

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 3|description|834|0
units.english: Accompanied by the three volunteer ships, head to the designated Kimek worlds, delivering vaccines to deal with the current viral outbreak, then return to <destination> by <date>.
units.italian: Accompagnato dalle tre navi volontarie, dirigiti verso i mondi Kimek designati, consegnando i vaccini per affrontare l'attuale focolaio virale, poi torna su <destination> entro <date>.

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 3|This time you're expected and are brought to a large conference room where many Saryds, and the occasional Arach, are waiting. A Kimek that is part of the team organizing the containment procedures comes in and says you will once again be transporting vaccines.|850|0
units.english: This time you're expected and are brought to a large conference room where many Saryds, and the occasional Arach, are waiting. A Kimek that is part of the team organizing the containment procedures comes in and says you will once again be transporting vaccines.
units.italian: Questa volta sei atteso e vieni portato in una grande sala conferenze dove aspettano molti Saryd, e qualche Arachi ogni tanto. Entra un Kimek che fa parte della squadra che organizza le procedure di contenimento e dice che trasporterai di nuovo i vaccini.

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 3|	"In a few hours, fully replicated, the vaccine samples will be. Load them onto your ships, we will. Deliver them to <stopovers>, you must."|851|0
units.english: "In a few hours, fully replicated, the vaccine samples will be. Load them onto your ships, we will. Deliver them to <stopovers>, you must."
units.italian: "Tra qualche ora, completamente replicati, i campioni del vaccino saranno. Caricarli sulle vostre navi, noi lo faremo. Consegnarli su <stopovers>, voi dovrete."

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 3|	Everyone is then separated into groups. You're put with two Saryd captains and an Arach who is wearing some protective suit of sorts that covers his entire body, making it somewhat difficult for him to walk.|852|0
units.english: Everyone is then separated into groups. You're put with two Saryd captains and an Arach who is wearing some protective suit of sorts that covers his entire body, making it somewhat difficult for him to walk.
units.italian: Poi tutti vengono divisi in gruppi. Tu vieni messo con due capitani Saryd e un Arach che indossa una specie di tuta protettiva che gli copre tutto il corpo, rendendogli un po' difficile camminare.

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 3|	The captains agree to follow your lead and deliver the vaccines along with you, so you all head back to your ships.|853|0
units.english: The captains agree to follow your lead and deliver the vaccines along with you, so you all head back to your ships.
units.italian: I capitani accettano di seguire la tua guida e di consegnare i vaccini insieme a te, quindi tornate tutti alle vostre navi.

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 3|dialog|862|0
units.english: You and the Coalition captains have delivered the final batch of vaccines. You must now return to <origin>.
units.italian: Tu e i capitani della Coalizione avete consegnato l'ultimo lotto di vaccini. Ora devi tornare su <origin>.

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 3|dialog|864|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but you're missing something! Either you haven't visited <stopovers>, or you left the Coalition ships behind.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma ti manca qualcosa! O non hai visitato <stopovers>, o hai lasciato indietro le navi della Coalizione.

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 3|You and the other captains are told to wait in one of several lines formed here. Your group chats with some others while you wait, and a few mention how their batch of vaccines was delivered to Arach and Saryd space. Apparently many tourists had contracted the disease before flying to those areas.|869|0
units.english: You and the other captains are told to wait in one of several lines formed here. Your group chats with some others while you wait, and a few mention how their batch of vaccines was delivered to Arach and Saryd space. Apparently many tourists had contracted the disease before flying to those areas.
units.italian: Tu e gli altri capitani ricevete l'ordine di aspettare in una delle diverse file che si sono formate qui. Il tuo gruppo chiacchiera con altri mentre aspettate, e alcuni raccontano che il loro lotto di vaccini è stato consegnato nello spazio Arach e Saryd. A quanto pare molti turisti avevano contratto la malattia prima di volare in quelle zone.

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 3|	The line moves quickly, and once it's your turn, you're paid <payment>, and then swiftly shoved along by the workers who are already paying the person who was behind you.|870|0
units.english: The line moves quickly, and once it's your turn, you're paid <payment>, and then swiftly shoved along by the workers who are already paying the person who was behind you.
units.italian: La fila avanza in fretta, e quando arriva il tuo turno vieni pagato <payment>, e poi spinto via rapidamente dagli operai che stanno già pagando la persona dietro di te.

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 3|	Looking back at the line, and seeing the sheer number of captains waiting for their share, it's no wonder the Kimek that paid you were extremely brief. As you come back to your ship, you see that a message was sent to you by the Coalition government. More specifically, it appears to have been sent by their Department of Health.|871|0
units.english: Looking back at the line, and seeing the sheer number of captains waiting for their share, it's no wonder the Kimek that paid you were extremely brief. As you come back to your ship, you see that a message was sent to you by the Coalition government. More specifically, it appears to have been sent by their Department of Health.
units.italian: Guardando la fila e vedendo la quantità di capitani in attesa della loro parte, non c'è da meravigliarsi che i Kimek che ti hanno pagato siano stati estremamente brevi. Mentre torni alla tua nave, vedi che ti è stato inviato un messaggio dal governo della Coalizione. Più precisamente, sembra essere stato inviato dal loro Dipartimento della Salute.

units.id: mission:Coalition Outbreak 3|	"To all captains who helped in dealing with the recent viral outbreak, you have our gratitude and may rest tonight knowing you've contributed to the continued prosperity of our Coalition."|872|0
units.english: "To all captains who helped in dealing with the recent viral outbreak, you have our gratitude and may rest tonight knowing you've contributed to the continued prosperity of our Coalition."
units.italian: "A tutti i capitani che hanno contribuito ad affrontare il recente focolaio virale, va la nostra gratitudine, e potete riposare stanotte sapendo di aver contribuito alla continua prosperità della nostra Coalizione."

units.id: mission:Kimek Gift|name|878|0
units.english: Not One Minute Late
units.italian: Nemmeno un minuto in ritardo

units.id: mission:Kimek Gift|description|879|0
units.english: A Kimek researcher from <origin> forgot the birthday of her Saryd friend, who lives on <destination>. Since you have a jump drive and can make it there in time, she asked you to deliver the present by <date>.
units.italian: Una ricercatrice Kimek di <origin> ha dimenticato il compleanno della sua amica Saryd, che vive su <destination>. Dato che tu hai un motore di salto e puoi arrivarci in tempo, ti ha chiesto di consegnare il regalo entro <date>.

units.id: mission:Kimek Gift|A Kimek in a lab coat is desperately running around the spaceport here, carrying a small package with some papers attached.|888|0
units.english: A Kimek in a lab coat is desperately running around the spaceport here, carrying a small package with some papers attached.
units.italian: Una Kimek in camice da laboratorio corre disperatamente per lo spazioporto, portando un piccolo pacchetto con alcuni fogli allegati.

units.id: mission:Kimek Gift|	As soon as she spots you, she quickly approaches you and says, "Human! The visitor I've heard about, you are! From the outside! A jump drive you have, if our space you've reached, yes?"|889|0
units.english: As soon as she spots you, she quickly approaches you and says, "Human! The visitor I've heard about, you are! From the outside! A jump drive you have, if our space you've reached, yes?"
units.italian: Appena ti vede, ti si avvicina in fretta e dice: "Umano! Il visitatore di cui ho sentito parlare, voi siete! Da fuori! Un motore di salto avete, se il nostro spazio avete raggiunto, sì?"

units.id: mission:Kimek Gift|	You nod, and she continues, "Live on <planet>, a Saryd friend of mine does. Forgotten that his birthday was on <date>, I had! Make it in time for the party, I cannot. Busy with work, I am. At least send his present, I'd like to, but make it in time, regular ships here can't! With your jump drive, get there in a day you could. Help me, would you, Captain?"|890|0
units.english: You nod, and she continues, "Live on <planet>, a Saryd friend of mine does. Forgotten that his birthday was on <date>, I had! Make it in time for the party, I cannot. Busy with work, I am. At least send his present, I'd like to, but make it in time, regular ships here can't! With your jump drive, get there in a day you could. Help me, would you, Captain?"
units.italian: Annuisci, e lei continua: "Vivere su <planet>, un'amica Saryd mia fa. Dimenticato che il suo compleanno fosse il <date>, io l'avevo! Arrivare in tempo per la festa, non posso. Impegnata con il lavoro, sono. Almeno mandare il suo regalo, vorrei, ma arrivare in tempo, le navi normali qui non possono! Con il vostro motore di salto, arrivare in un giorno potreste. Aiutarmi, vorreste, capitano?"

units.id: mission:Kimek Gift|	"Just that small package? Easy enough, I'll do it."|892|0
units.english: "Just that small package? Easy enough, I'll do it."
units.italian: "Solo quel pacchetto piccolo? Abbastanza facile, lo faccio."

units.id: mission:Kimek Gift|	"I'm not headed there, sorry, have another mission to do. Somewhere else."|894|0
units.english: "I'm not headed there, sorry, have another mission to do. Somewhere else."
units.italian: "Non vado in quella direzione, mi dispiace, ho un'altra missione da fare. Da un'altra parte."

units.id: mission:Kimek Gift|Apparently the Saryd in question doesn't live here in the spaceport village, so you must take a train to go to his home. Thankfully, a train ticket was attached to the package, so you waste no time and get on the next train there.|900|0
units.english: Apparently the Saryd in question doesn't live here in the spaceport village, so you must take a train to go to his home. Thankfully, a train ticket was attached to the package, so you waste no time and get on the next train there.
units.italian: A quanto pare il Saryd in questione non vive qui nel villaggio dello spazioporto, quindi devi prendere un treno per andare a casa sua. Per fortuna al pacchetto era allegato un biglietto del treno, quindi non perdi tempo e sali sul treno successivo.

units.id: mission:Kimek Gift|	Even for a world without too large a population, the train wagons here feel unusually empty, with only a handful of other passengers on the one you settle in. The trip takes a few hours, so you have plenty of time to look out the window and gaze at the sights of the seemingly infinite winter forest.|901|0
units.english: Even for a world without too large a population, the train wagons here feel unusually empty, with only a handful of other passengers on the one you settle in. The trip takes a few hours, so you have plenty of time to look out the window and gaze at the sights of the seemingly infinite winter forest.
units.italian: Anche per un mondo senza una popolazione troppo grande, le carrozze qui sembrano insolitamente vuote, con solo una manciata di altri passeggeri in quella dove ti sistemi. Il viaggio dura qualche ora, quindi hai tutto il tempo per guardare fuori dal finestrino e ammirare i panorami della foresta invernale che sembra infinita.

units.id: mission:Kimek Gift|	Halfway through, a blizzard makes it tough to see much outside. The ticket inspectors come through again, now serving a creamy blue drink which seems to be their equivalent of hot chocolate.|902|0
units.english: Halfway through, a blizzard makes it tough to see much outside. The ticket inspectors come through again, now serving a creamy blue drink which seems to be their equivalent of hot chocolate.
units.italian: A metà strada una bufera rende difficile vedere molto fuori. I controllori tornano di nuovo, stavolta servendo una bevanda blu cremosa che sembra il loro equivalente della cioccolata calda.

units.id: mission:Kimek Gift|	Once you arrive at the village, you follow the makeshift map of the streets the Kimek included and deliver the present to her Saryd friend. Apparently the party had just started.|903|0
units.english: Once you arrive at the village, you follow the makeshift map of the streets the Kimek included and deliver the present to her Saryd friend. Apparently the party had just started.
units.italian: Quando arrivi al villaggio, segui la mappa improvvisata delle strade che la Kimek ha incluso e consegni il regalo alla sua amica Saryd. A quanto pare la festa era appena cominciata.

units.id: mission:Kimek Gift|	When you get back to your ship, <payment> are transferred to your account, and you get a short message from the Kimek researcher, thanking you for helping out.|904|0
units.english: When you get back to your ship, <payment> are transferred to your account, and you get a short message from the Kimek researcher, thanking you for helping out.
units.italian: Quando torni alla tua nave, <payment> vengono trasferiti sul tuo conto, e ricevi un breve messaggio dalla ricercatrice Kimek, che ti ringrazia per l'aiuto.

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 1|name|910|0
units.english: Acquire Arach Rum
units.italian: Procurati del rum Arach

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 1|description|911|0
units.english: Some Saryd students on <origin> have offered to pay you for bringing them a shipment of traditional Arach rum, currently only sold on <destination>. To make it in time, the rum must be bought by <date>.
units.italian: Alcuni studenti Saryd su <origin> si sono offerti di pagarti per portare loro una spedizione di rum tradizionale Arach, attualmente venduto solo su <destination>. Per arrivare in tempo, il rum deve essere comprato entro <date>.

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 1|While walking by some shops, a young Saryd bumps into you as you're turning a corner, knocking you to the ground. He helps you up, apologizing. A couple others that were with him entered a shop without even noticing you, but almost immediately come back out.|919|0
units.english: While walking by some shops, a young Saryd bumps into you as you're turning a corner, knocking you to the ground. He helps you up, apologizing. A couple others that were with him entered a shop without even noticing you, but almost immediately come back out.
units.italian: Mentre passi davanti ad alcuni negozi, un giovane Saryd ti urta mentre svolti un angolo, facendoti cadere a terra. Ti aiuta a rialzarti, scusandosi. Un paio di altri che erano con lui sono entrati in un negozio senza nemmeno notarti, ma tornano fuori quasi subito.

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 1|	They speak with him, pointing at the shop and to where they must have been before bumping into you, while their friend tinkers with a translation box.|922|0
units.english: They speak with him, pointing at the shop and to where they must have been before bumping into you, while their friend tinkers with a translation box.
units.italian: Parlano con lui, indicando il negozio e il punto in cui dovevano essere prima di urtarti, mentre il loro amico traffica con una scatola di traduzione.

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 1|	"No luck?" he asks them, tinkering with a translation box, not realizing you have your own.|925|0
units.english: "No luck?" he asks them, tinkering with a translation box, not realizing you have your own.
units.italian: "Nessuna fortuna?" chiede loro, trafficando con una scatola di traduzione, senza rendersi conto che tu ne hai una tua.

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 1|	His colleagues shake their heads, "Told the same as in the other store, we were. Shipping here, the Arachi no longer are," they say, pointing to the shop and to where they must have been before bumping into you. Their friend continues messing with the device.|926|0
units.english: His colleagues shake their heads, "Told the same as in the other store, we were. Shipping here, the Arachi no longer are," they say, pointing to the shop and to where they must have been before bumping into you. Their friend continues messing with the device.
units.italian: I suoi colleghi scuotono la testa: "Detto la stessa cosa che nell'altro negozio, ci è stato. Spedire qui, gli Arachi non lo fanno più," dicono, indicando il negozio e il punto in cui dovevano essere prima di urtarti. Il loro amico continua a pasticciare con il dispositivo.

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 1|	Once he's done, he asks, "Human, a merchant captain you are, correct? Looking for work, are you?"|928|0
units.english: Once he's done, he asks, "Human, a merchant captain you are, correct? Looking for work, are you?"
units.italian: Quando ha finito, chiede: "Umano, un capitano mercante voi siete, giusto? In cerca di lavoro, siete?"

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 1|	"What kind of work?"|930|0
units.english: "What kind of work?"
units.italian: "Che tipo di lavoro?"

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 1|	"Oh no, I live here actually. In the humantown district, right around the corner."|932|0
units.english: "Oh no, I live here actually. In the humantown district, right around the corner."
units.italian: "Oh no, io vivo qui in realtà. Nel quartiere della città umana, proprio dietro l'angolo."

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 1|	"Actually I'm just here for the view, sorry."|933|0
units.english: "Actually I'm just here for the view, sorry."
units.italian: "In realtà sono qui solo per il panorama, mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 1|	They all start laughing, some clearly finding your joke much funnier than you anticipated. Given the way they are stumbling on flat ground and the scent of alcohol that's permeated the air ever since one of them bumped into you, you realize why.|935|0
units.english: They all start laughing, some clearly finding your joke much funnier than you anticipated. Given the way they are stumbling on flat ground and the scent of alcohol that's permeated the air ever since one of them bumped into you, you realize why.
units.italian: Scoppiano tutti a ridere, e alcuni trovano la tua battuta chiaramente molto più divertente di quanto ti aspettassi. Dato il modo in cui barcollano su un terreno pianeggiante e l'odore di alcol che ha permeato l'aria da quando uno di loro ti è venuto addosso, capisci perché.

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 1|	"Fair enough. Not a common sight here, humans are, Captain," the one with a translation box says. "Asking for such a response, I was."|936|0
units.english: "Fair enough. Not a common sight here, humans are, Captain," the one with a translation box says. "Asking for such a response, I was."
units.italian: "Giusto. Non è uno spettacolo comune qui, gli umani, capitano," dice quello con la scatola di traduzione. "Chiedere una risposta del genere, io stavo."

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 1|	They tell you that they are students at Starlit University and will be graduating soon. They intend on throwing a party to celebrate and had the idea of buying some traditional Arach rum for that.|938|0
units.english: They tell you that they are students at Starlit University and will be graduating soon. They intend on throwing a party to celebrate and had the idea of buying some traditional Arach rum for that.
units.italian: Ti dicono che sono studenti della Starlit University e che si laureeranno presto. Intendono organizzare una festa per festeggiare e hanno avuto l'idea di comprare del rum tradizionale Arach per l'occasione.

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 1|	"Stopped shipping it here, the Arachi have," another Saryd says, pulling on the translation box on his friend's neck and nearly yanking it off. "Happened with many other drinks, this also has."|939|0
units.english: "Stopped shipping it here, the Arachi have," another Saryd says, pulling on the translation box on his friend's neck and nearly yanking it off. "Happened with many other drinks, this also has."
units.italian: "Smesso di spedirlo qui, gli Arachi l'hanno," dice un altro Saryd, tirando la scatola di traduzione sul collo del suo amico e quasi strappandogliela. "Successo con molte altre bevande, anche questo l'ha."

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 1|	They explain that the rum is produced on <destination>, and that you'll probably have an easier time finding it there. Despite you not knowing for sure how many people they intend on inviting to this party, and the fact that you don't know how much a Saryd can drink, you still worry a bit when they say that "two tons should do." They also tell you that to make it in time for the party, the rum should be bought by <date>.|940|0
units.english: They explain that the rum is produced on <destination>, and that you'll probably have an easier time finding it there. Despite you not knowing for sure how many people they intend on inviting to this party, and the fact that you don't know how much a Saryd can drink, you still worry a bit when they say that "two tons should do." They also tell you that to make it in time for the party, the rum should be bought by <date>.
units.italian: Spiegano che il rum è prodotto su <destination>, e che probabilmente lì avrai più facilità a trovarlo. Anche se non sai con certezza quante persone intendano invitare a questa festa, e non sai quanto possa bere un Saryd, ti preoccupi comunque un po' quando dicono che "due tonnellate dovrebbero bastare". Ti dicono anche che, per arrivare in tempo per la festa, il rum deve essere comprato entro <date>.

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 1|	"Sounds good, I'll go get it and bring it to you."|942|0
units.english: "Sounds good, I'll go get it and bring it to you."
units.italian: "Mi sembra bene, vado a prenderlo e ve lo porto."

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 1|	"How much would I need to pay for two tons?"|944|0
units.english: "How much would I need to pay for two tons?"
units.italian: "Quanto dovrei pagare per due tonnellate?"

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 1|	"Sorry, but I'm against smuggling alcohol to students."|945|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'm against smuggling alcohol to students."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma sono contrario a contrabbandare alcol per degli studenti."

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 1|	"One of the pricier drinks, this rum is," the Saryd explains. "Some thousands of credits per ton, you should expect to pay. But well compensated, you will be."|947|0
units.english: "One of the pricier drinks, this rum is," the Saryd explains. "Some thousands of credits per ton, you should expect to pay. But well compensated, you will be."
units.italian: "Una delle bevande più costose, questo rum è," spiega il Saryd. "Qualche migliaio di crediti a tonnellata, dovreste aspettarvi di pagare. Ma ben ricompensati, voi sarete."

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 1|	"Sounds good, I'll go get it and bring it to you."|949|0
units.english: "Sounds good, I'll go get it and bring it to you."
units.italian: "Mi sembra bene, vado a prenderlo e ve lo porto."

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 1|	"Sorry, but I'm against smuggling alcohol to students."|951|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'm against smuggling alcohol to students."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma sono contrario a contrabbandare alcol per degli studenti."

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 1|dialog|954|0
units.english: You ask around and are directed to a large refinery on one of the more populated cities here. The rum's price is impressive indeed, 5,642 credits per ton, but what is more impressive is how you worried about the students' irresponsibility when they asked you to buy this when you yourself aren't responsible enough to have a bit over ten thousand credits to spend. Go earn some money, then return here.
units.italian: Chiedi in giro e vieni indirizzato a una grande raffineria in una delle città più popolate qui. Il prezzo del rum è davvero notevole, 5.642 crediti a tonnellata, ma quello che è ancora più notevole è come ti preoccupassi dell'irresponsabilità degli studenti quando ti hanno chiesto di comprarlo, mentre tu stesso non sei abbastanza responsabile da avere poco più di diecimila crediti da spendere. Vai a guadagnare un po' di soldi, poi torna qui.

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 2|name|961|0
units.english: Deliver Arach Rum
units.italian: Consegna il rum Arach

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 2|description|962|0
units.english: Now that you've bought the two tons of Arach rum, deliver it to the Saryd students on <destination> by <date>.
units.italian: Ora che hai comprato le due tonnellate di rum Arach, consegnale agli studenti Saryd su <destination> entro <date>.

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 2|blocked|966|0
units.english: You need <capacity> in order to take on the next mission. Return here when you have the required space free.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> per accettare la prossima missione. Torna qui quando avrai lo spazio libero richiesto.

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 2|You ask around and are directed to a large refinery on one of the more populated cities here. Apparently it's the original building where the Arach rum was first produced.|973|0
units.english: You ask around and are directed to a large refinery on one of the more populated cities here. Apparently it's the original building where the Arach rum was first produced.
units.italian: Chiedi in giro e vieni indirizzato a una grande raffineria in una delle città più popolate qui. A quanto pare è l'edificio originale dove il rum Arach è stato prodotto per la prima volta.

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 2|	You ask for two tons, avoiding giving the exact details of what it's for, as you do not wish to be held accountable for whatever some drunken Saryds may do, and pay the price for all the rum: 11,284 credits.|974|0
units.english: You ask for two tons, avoiding giving the exact details of what it's for, as you do not wish to be held accountable for whatever some drunken Saryds may do, and pay the price for all the rum: 11,284 credits.
units.italian: Chiedi due tonnellate, evitando di dare i dettagli esatti sullo scopo, dato che non vuoi essere ritenuto responsabile per quello che potrebbero fare dei Saryd ubriachi, e paghi il prezzo per tutto il rum: 11.284 crediti.

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 2|	The Arachi that take care to load the rum into your ship give you some odd looks, and when it's all done the manager tells you to try and slow down on the drinking.|975|0
units.english: The Arachi that take care to load the rum into your ship give you some odd looks, and when it's all done the manager tells you to try and slow down on the drinking.
units.italian: Gli Arachi che si occupano di caricare il rum sulla tua nave ti lanciano qualche sguardo strano, e quando hanno finito il responsabile ti dice di provare a rallentare con il bere.

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 2|Besides the students who tasked you with buying the rum, about a dozen others are waiting for your ship when you land and help you unload the beverages.|980|0
units.english: Besides the students who tasked you with buying the rum, about a dozen others are waiting for your ship when you land and help you unload the beverages.
units.italian: Oltre agli studenti che ti hanno incaricato di comprare il rum, un'altra dozzina circa aspetta la tua nave quando atterri e ti aiuta a scaricare le bevande.

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 2|	"Saved our party you have, Captain," the Saryd with the translation device says, handing you <payment>.|981|0
units.english: "Saved our party you have, Captain," the Saryd with the translation device says, handing you <payment>.
units.italian: "Salvato la nostra festa, voi l'avete, capitano," dice il Saryd con il dispositivo di traduzione, consegnandoti <payment>.

units.id: mission:Saryd Students 2|	They head off, excitedly dragging along the cargo carts with the many kegs on top. Some of them have already taken the liberty of opening a keg and begun drinking.|982|0
units.english: They head off, excitedly dragging along the cargo carts with the many kegs on top. Some of them have already taken the liberty of opening a keg and begun drinking.
units.italian: Si allontanano, trascinando eccitati i carrelli del carico con i molti fusti sopra. Alcuni si sono già presi la libertà di aprire un fusto e hanno cominciato a bere.

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 1|name|988|0
units.english: Saryd Census
units.italian: Censimento Saryd

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 1|description|989|0
units.english: Transport these <bunks> Saryd census workers to <destination>, where they will collect data on the population growth there.
units.italian: Trasporta questi <bunks> operatori del censimento Saryd su <destination>, dove raccoglieranno dati sulla crescita della popolazione locale.

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 1|Over a dozen Saryds walk up to you as you're entering the spaceport. They explain that they are census workers, and are in need of a transport to <destination>. "Left us hanging, our previous transport has."|1001|0
units.english: Over a dozen Saryds walk up to you as you're entering the spaceport. They explain that they are census workers, and are in need of a transport to <destination>. "Left us hanging, our previous transport has."
units.italian: Più di una dozzina di Saryd ti si avvicinano mentre entri nello spazioporto. Spiegano che sono operatori del censimento e che hanno bisogno di un trasporto per <destination>. "Lasciati in sospeso, il nostro trasporto precedente ci ha."

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 1|	"What sort of data are you gathering? Just general information?"|1003|0
units.english: "What sort of data are you gathering? Just general information?"
units.italian: "Che tipo di dati state raccogliendo? Solo informazioni generali?"

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 1|	"Sure, I'll show you to your bunks."|1004|0
units.english: "Sure, I'll show you to your bunks."
units.italian: "Certo, vi mostro le cuccette."

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 1|	"You're not in luck then, I'm also not looking for any transport missions now."|1006|0
units.english: "You're not in luck then, I'm also not looking for any transport missions now."
units.italian: "Allora non siete fortunati, neanch'io cerco missioni di trasporto adesso."

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 1|	"Collecting data on population growth, we are. Agreed to help our colleagues, many other ships already have," one of them says.|1008|0
units.english: "Collecting data on population growth, we are. Agreed to help our colleagues, many other ships already have," one of them says.
units.italian: "Raccogliere dati sulla crescita della popolazione, noi stiamo. Accettato di aiutare i nostri colleghi, già molte altre navi lo hanno," dice uno di loro.

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 1|	"Alright, I'll show you to your bunks."|1010|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll show you to your bunks."
units.italian: "Va bene, vi mostro le cuccette."

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 1|	"Well I'm sure you can find someone else then. I'm not looking for any transport missions now."|1012|0
units.english: "Well I'm sure you can find someone else then. I'm not looking for any transport missions now."
units.italian: "Beh, allora sono sicuro che troverete qualcun altro. Non cerco missioni di trasporto adesso."

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 1|	They thank you and start following you to your ship. There are <bunks> of them in total, now that you've had the time to count.|1015|0
units.english: They thank you and start following you to your ship. There are <bunks> of them in total, now that you've had the time to count.
units.italian: Ti ringraziano e cominciano a seguirti alla nave. Sono <bunks> in tutto, ora che hai avuto il tempo di contarli.

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 1|	You ask if this search will stick to Saryd space, and they say that each species usually sticks to their own home territory when gathering this type of data, so you shouldn't worry about having to take them from one end of Coalition space to the other.|1016|0
units.english: You ask if this search will stick to Saryd space, and they say that each species usually sticks to their own home territory when gathering this type of data, so you shouldn't worry about having to take them from one end of Coalition space to the other.
units.italian: Chiedi se questa ricerca resterà nello spazio Saryd, e dicono che ogni specie di solito si limita al proprio territorio d'origine quando raccoglie questo tipo di dati, quindi non devi preoccuparti di doverli portare da un capo all'altro dello spazio della Coalizione.

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 1|	They settle in their bunks, and prepare for the trip.|1017|0
units.english: They settle in their bunks, and prepare for the trip.
units.italian: Si sistemano nelle cuccette e si preparano al viaggio.

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 1|dialog|1020|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying the census workers hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con gli operatori del censimento non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 1|dialog|1024|0
units.english: You're paid <payment> for transporting the Saryds here, and they leave your ship, ready to get to work and ask around. They say that they'll probably all be back in the spaceport by night time, so you should check there later if you want to help them further.
units.italian: Vieni pagato <payment> per aver trasportato i Saryd qui, e lasciano la tua nave, pronti a mettersi al lavoro e a fare domande in giro. Dicono che probabilmente saranno tutti di nuovo allo spazioporto per sera, quindi più tardi dovresti passare di lì se vuoi aiutarli ancora.

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 2|name|1029|0
units.english: Saryd Census
units.italian: Censimento Saryd

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 2|description|1030|0
units.english: Transport these <bunks> Saryd census workers to <destination>, where they will collect data on the population growth there.
units.italian: Trasporta questi <bunks> operatori del censimento Saryd su <destination>, dove raccoglieranno dati sulla crescita della popolazione locale.

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 2|blocked|1032|0
units.english: You need <capacity> in order to take on the next mission. Return here when you have the required space free.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> per accettare la prossima missione. Torna qui quando avrai lo spazio libero richiesto.

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 2|Apparently you got lucky to have transported a group that was assigned to an area close to the spaceport city, as you see many other Coalition captains impatiently waiting for their own passengers to return, some looking at maps of the planet and grumbling.|1039|0
units.english: Apparently you got lucky to have transported a group that was assigned to an area close to the spaceport city, as you see many other Coalition captains impatiently waiting for their own passengers to return, some looking at maps of the planet and grumbling.
units.italian: A quanto pare sei stato fortunato a trasportare un gruppo assegnato a un'area vicina alla città dello spazioporto, dato che vedi molti altri capitani della Coalizione aspettare con impazienza il ritorno dei propri passeggeri, alcuni che guardano mappe del pianeta brontolando.

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 2|	Most of the Saryds are here, but three of them still haven't come back, so the 14 that have already arrived just keep discussing the results they've found.|1040|0
units.english: Most of the Saryds are here, but three of them still haven't come back, so the 14 that have already arrived just keep discussing the results they've found.
units.italian: La maggior parte dei Saryd è qui, ma tre non sono ancora tornati, quindi i 14 già arrivati continuano a discutere i risultati che hanno trovato.

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 2|	(Go browse some shops, then come back later.)|1042|0
units.english: (Go browse some shops, then come back later.)
units.italian: (Vai a dare un'occhiata ai negozi, poi torna più tardi.)

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 2|	(Ask them about the data they have collected.)|1044|0
units.english: (Ask them about the data they have collected.)
units.italian: (Chiedi loro dei dati che hanno raccolto.)

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 2|	They explain how this census was mostly focused on the total population growth of the Coalition and how things are going as expected.|1045|0
units.english: They explain how this census was mostly focused on the total population growth of the Coalition and how things are going as expected.
units.italian: Spiegano che questo censimento si è concentrato soprattutto sulla crescita totale della popolazione della Coalizione e che le cose stanno andando come previsto.

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 2|	"Remained stable, the Saryd population has," one of them comments. "At about 30 billion individuals, our numbers still are, though slightly increasing the fertility rate has been."|1046|0
units.english: "Remained stable, the Saryd population has," one of them comments. "At about 30 billion individuals, our numbers still are, though slightly increasing the fertility rate has been."
units.italian: "Rimasta stabile, la popolazione Saryd è," commenta uno di loro. "A circa 30 miliardi di individui, i nostri numeri ancora sono, anche se leggermente aumentato il tasso di fertilità è."

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 2|	As you continue to chat, one of them gets curious and asks you about humanity's population, to which you respond that your species numbers about 100 billion people.|1047|0
units.english: As you continue to chat, one of them gets curious and asks you about humanity's population, to which you respond that your species numbers about 100 billion people.
units.italian: Mentre continuate a chiacchierare, uno di loro diventa curioso e ti chiede della popolazione dell'umanità, e tu rispondi che la tua specie conta circa 100 miliardi di persone.

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 2|	"Double that of the Arachi," one of the workers says.|1048|0
units.english: "Double that of the Arachi," one of the workers says.
units.italian: "Il doppio di quella degli Arachi," dice uno degli operatori.

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 2|	"And half that of the Kimek," another one completes.|1049|0
units.english: "And half that of the Kimek," another one completes.
units.italian: "E la metà di quella dei Kimek," completa un altro.

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 2|	They ask you some more questions about human territory, but avoid getting too technical to the point where it's difficult for you to respond.|1050|0
units.english: They ask you some more questions about human territory, but avoid getting too technical to the point where it's difficult for you to respond.
units.italian: Ti fanno qualche altra domanda sul territorio umano, ma evitano di diventare troppo tecnici al punto da renderti difficile rispondere.

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 2|	You try and entertain yourself by looking at the shops here, but pretty much all of them are just filled with the produce of local farms.|1053|0
units.english: You try and entertain yourself by looking at the shops here, but pretty much all of them are just filled with the produce of local farms.
units.italian: Provi a intrattenerti guardando i negozi qui, ma praticamente tutti sono pieni solo dei prodotti delle fattorie locali.

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 2|	One of them has a few toys made out of straw. You take a look at the Saryd designs for them. They're nothing particularly special, nor as stereotypical as one might have expected from a species that resembles centaurs. Most of them appear to be replicating creatures of the local fauna or buildings like small houses.|1054|0
units.english: One of them has a few toys made out of straw. You take a look at the Saryd designs for them. They're nothing particularly special, nor as stereotypical as one might have expected from a species that resembles centaurs. Most of them appear to be replicating creatures of the local fauna or buildings like small houses.
units.italian: Uno di loro ha qualche giocattolo fatto di paglia. Dai un'occhiata ai disegni Saryd. Non hanno niente di particolarmente speciale, né sono stereotipati come si sarebbe potuto aspettarsi da una specie che somiglia ai centauri. La maggior parte sembra replicare creature della fauna locale o edifici come piccole case.

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 2|	You notice two other census workers have come back, so you decide to return to the group and wait for the final member. Some Coalition captains from earlier have gathered together in a bar to lament the long wait.|1055|0
units.english: You notice two other census workers have come back, so you decide to return to the group and wait for the final member. Some Coalition captains from earlier have gathered together in a bar to lament the long wait.
units.italian: Noti che altri due operatori del censimento sono tornati, quindi decidi di tornare al gruppo e aspettare l'ultimo membro. Alcuni capitani della Coalizione di prima si sono radunati in un bar a lamentarsi della lunga attesa.

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 2|	After the final Saryd arrives, you all head back to your ship, and you're told that the next destination is <destination>.|1057|0
units.english: After the final Saryd arrives, you all head back to your ship, and you're told that the next destination is <destination>.
units.italian: Dopo che arriva l'ultimo Saryd, tornate tutti alla tua nave, e ti dicono che la prossima destinazione è <destination>.

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 2|dialog|1060|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying the census workers hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con gli operatori del censimento non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 2|This time the workers mention how they were tasked with gathering data on a part of the planet other than the surroundings of the spaceport, as they pay you <payment>.|1065|0
units.english: This time the workers mention how they were tasked with gathering data on a part of the planet other than the surroundings of the spaceport, as they pay you <payment>.
units.italian: Questa volta gli operatori raccontano che sono stati incaricati di raccogliere dati su una parte del pianeta diversa dai dintorni dello spazioporto, mentre ti pagano <payment>.

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 2|	Thankfully, they mention how the census is nearly over and that this was their final destination, so you won't need to wait for hours in the spaceport like the captains you saw on <origin>.|1066|0
units.english: Thankfully, they mention how the census is nearly over and that this was their final destination, so you won't need to wait for hours in the spaceport like the captains you saw on <origin>.
units.italian: Per fortuna raccontano che il censimento è quasi finito e che questa era la loro destinazione finale, quindi non dovrai aspettare per ore nello spazioporto come i capitani che hai visto su <origin>.

units.id: mission:Saryd Census 2|	They thank you for helping them do their job, and wish you safe travels.|1067|0
units.english: They thank you for helping them do their job, and wish you safe travels.
units.italian: Ti ringraziano per averli aiutati a fare il loro lavoro e ti augurano buon viaggio.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 1|name|1073|0
units.english: Acquiring Funds
units.italian: Raccogliere fondi

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 1|description|1074|0
units.english: Inturi and Aunaris, a young Saryd couple, need to make enough money to buy their dream home. Transport Aunaris to <destination>, where she was offered a job in the university there.
units.italian: Inturi e Aunaris, una giovane coppia Saryd, devono guadagnare abbastanza soldi per comprare la casa dei loro sogni. Trasporta Aunaris su <destination>, dove le è stato offerto un lavoro all'università locale.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 1|While walking around the spaceport, you notice one of the Saryd workers that was refueling your ship is quickly galloping somewhere, only without his uniform, as if his shift just ended. He meets up with another Saryd and starts looking at a map with her.|1084|0
units.english: While walking around the spaceport, you notice one of the Saryd workers that was refueling your ship is quickly galloping somewhere, only without his uniform, as if his shift just ended. He meets up with another Saryd and starts looking at a map with her.
units.italian: Mentre giri per lo spazioporto, noti che uno degli operai Saryd che stavano rifornendo la tua nave sta galoppando in fretta da qualche parte, solo senza la divisa, come se il suo turno fosse appena finito. Si incontra con un'altra Saryd e comincia a guardare una mappa con lei.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 1|	(Approach them.)|1086|0
units.english: (Approach them.)
units.italian: (Avvicinati a loro.)

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 1|	(Go back to my ship and check if it was properly refueled.)|1087|0
units.english: (Go back to my ship and check if it was properly refueled.)
units.italian: (Torna alla mia nave e controlla se è stata rifornita come si deve.)

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 1|	They pause their map-gazing and introduce themselves as Inturi and Aunaris, a young couple who are looking to move out of <origin> and build a home they've always dreamed of on another world.|1089|0
units.english: They pause their map-gazing and introduce themselves as Inturi and Aunaris, a young couple who are looking to move out of <origin> and build a home they've always dreamed of on another world.
units.italian: Interrompono l'osservazione della mappa e si presentano come Inturi e Aunaris, una giovane coppia che cerca di lasciare <origin> e costruirsi su un altro mondo la casa che hanno sempre sognato.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 1|	"Only, in need of money for that we are," Inturi says. "Worked in a ship as a crew member, I did, before decided to stay here and work on ship repairs and maintenance, I had."|1090|0
units.english: "Only, in need of money for that we are," Inturi says. "Worked in a ship as a crew member, I did, before decided to stay here and work on ship repairs and maintenance, I had."
units.italian: "Solo che, in bisogno di soldi per questo siamo," dice Inturi. "Lavorato in una nave come membro dell'equipaggio, io l'ho fatto, prima di decidere di restare qui e lavorare alla riparazione e manutenzione delle navi, io ho dovuto."

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 1|	"Much too far away, his old job took him, and well paid, crew members are not," Aunaris says, bringing up the map again and showing it to you. "Offered a job in Starlit University, on <destination>, I was. Not too distant from <origin>, it is, and a higher pay, it offers. Transport me there, would you, Captain? Once ready our house is, pay you we would."|1091|0
units.english: "Much too far away, his old job took him, and well paid, crew members are not," Aunaris says, bringing up the map again and showing it to you. "Offered a job in Starlit University, on <destination>, I was. Not too distant from <origin>, it is, and a higher pay, it offers. Transport me there, would you, Captain? Once ready our house is, pay you we would."
units.italian: "Troppo lontano, il suo vecchio lavoro lo portava, e ben pagati, i membri dell'equipaggio non sono," dice Aunaris, riprendendo la mappa e mostrandotela. "Offerto un lavoro alla Starlit University, su <destination>, a me è stato. Non troppo distante da <origin>, è, e un pagamento più alto offre. Trasportarmi lì, vorreste, capitano? Una volta pronta la nostra casa, pagarvi noi lo faremo."

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 1|	"Of course, just come to my ship when you've finished preparing your luggage."|1093|0
units.english: "Of course, just come to my ship when you've finished preparing your luggage."
units.italian: "Ma certo, venite alla mia nave quando avete finito di preparare i bagagli."

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 1|	"Sorry, I'm headed elsewhere now."|1094|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm headed elsewhere now."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ora vado da un'altra parte."

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 1|	They both thank you, and you head back to your ship.|1096|0
units.english: They both thank you, and you head back to your ship.
units.italian: Vi ringraziano entrambi, e tu torni alla nave.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 1|	By nightfall, Aunaris arrives, accompanied by Inturi and some other Saryds, who you guess must be family members, as they all say their goodbyes. Once she enters your ship, you show her to her bunk, and prepare to leave.|1097|0
units.english: By nightfall, Aunaris arrives, accompanied by Inturi and some other Saryds, who you guess must be family members, as they all say their goodbyes. Once she enters your ship, you show her to her bunk, and prepare to leave.
units.italian: Al calar della notte arriva Aunaris, accompagnata da Inturi e da altri Saryd che supponi siano familiari, dato che si salutano tutti. Quando entra nella tua nave le mostri la cuccetta e ti prepari a partire.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 1|	When you get to your ship, you check the control panel and do a short check-up. The fuel tank has been filled, and everything else is working properly. You leave your ship again, and move on with your business.|1100|0
units.english: When you get to your ship, you check the control panel and do a short check-up. The fuel tank has been filled, and everything else is working properly. You leave your ship again, and move on with your business.
units.italian: Quando arrivi alla nave, controlli il pannello di controllo e fai un breve check-up. Il serbatoio del carburante è pieno e tutto il resto funziona correttamente. Lasci di nuovo la nave e prosegui con i tuoi affari.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 1|dialog|1103|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Aunaris hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Aunaris non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 1|dialog|1107|0
units.english: Aunaris thanks you for bringing her here, and apologizes for not being able to pay you right away, but promises once she and Inturi have figured out their home, they will work hard to pay you. "Stay here for a few months, I probably will, before the remaining funds I have acquired," she says before saying goodbye and taking a cable car to her new workplace.
units.italian: Aunaris ti ringrazia per averla portata qui e si scusa per non poterti pagare subito, ma promette che, una volta che lei e Inturi avranno sistemato la loro casa, lavoreranno sodo per pagarti. "Restare qui qualche mese, probabilmente io lo farò, prima dei fondi rimanenti che ho raccolto," dice prima di salutarti e prendere una funivia verso il suo nuovo posto di lavoro.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 2|name|1116|0
units.english: Home Sweet Plot Of Land
units.italian: Un appezzamento tutto nostro

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 2|description|1117|0
units.english: The Saryd couple Inturi and Aunaris have finally amassed enough money to buy a plot of land on <destination>, where they will begin building their very own home. Bring both of them there so that they can settle the purchase.
units.italian: La coppia Saryd Inturi e Aunaris è finalmente riuscita a mettere da parte abbastanza soldi per comprare un appezzamento di terra su <destination>, dove cominceranno a costruire la propria casa. Portali entrambi lì perché possano concludere l'acquisto.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 2|You're met with two familiar faces in the spaceport: the Saryd couple you met some time ago, Inturi and Aunaris, who were working on acquiring the funding needed to build their own home.|1125|0
units.english: You're met with two familiar faces in the spaceport: the Saryd couple you met some time ago, Inturi and Aunaris, who were working on acquiring the funding needed to build their own home.
units.italian: Nello spazioporto ti accolgono due volti familiari: la coppia Saryd che hai conosciuto tempo fa, Inturi e Aunaris, che stavano lavorando per raccogliere i fondi necessari a costruire la propria casa.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 2|	"Worked for a week in another ship, I did, until landed here we had," Inturi says, joking about his way of catching a ride on a ship without paying a transport fee.|1126|0
units.english: "Worked for a week in another ship, I did, until landed here we had," Inturi says, joking about his way of catching a ride on a ship without paying a transport fee.
units.italian: "Lavorato una settimana su un'altra nave, io l'ho fatto, fino a che non siamo atterrati qui," dice Inturi, scherzando sul suo modo di farsi dare un passaggio su una nave senza pagare il trasporto.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 2|	"Sleeping well, I have not been, but helped much with the campus administration, I have. A bonus, I was given," Aunaris tells you.|1127|0
units.english: "Sleeping well, I have not been, but helped much with the campus administration, I have. A bonus, I was given," Aunaris tells you.
units.italian: "Dormito bene, non ho, ma aiutato molto con l'amministrazione del campus, io l'ho fatto. Un bonus, mi è stato dato," ti racconta Aunaris.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 2|	They say they just need a transport to <destination>, the world they have chosen to put down roots on, and after everything is done, they will work on getting you your payment.|1128|0
units.english: They say they just need a transport to <destination>, the world they have chosen to put down roots on, and after everything is done, they will work on getting you your payment.
units.italian: Dicono che gli serve solo un trasporto per <destination>, il mondo che hanno scelto per mettere radici, e che quando tutto sarà fatto si daranno da fare per procurarti il pagamento.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 2|	"Glad to hear it all worked out. Let's go to my ship, and I'll set a route to <planet>."|1130|0
units.english: "Glad to hear it all worked out. Let's go to my ship, and I'll set a route to <planet>."
units.italian: "Sono contento che sia andato tutto per il verso giusto. Andiamo alla mia nave, e imposterò una rotta per <planet>."

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 2|	"Sorry, but I'm not going there right now."|1131|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'm not going there right now."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma adesso non vado lì."

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 2|	You show them to their bunks, and prepare for the trip.|1133|0
units.english: You show them to their bunks, and prepare for the trip.
units.italian: Mostri loro le cuccette e ti prepari al viaggio.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 2|dialog|1136|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Aunaris and Inturi hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Aunaris e Inturi non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 3|name|1143|0
units.english: Reversed House Spider
units.italian: Ragno domestico alla rovescia

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 3|description|1144|0
units.english: Take Inturi to <destination>, where he will purchase a small Arach ship that he and Aunaris will repurpose into a home.
units.italian: Porta Inturi su <destination>, dove acquisterà una piccola nave Arach che lui e Aunaris convertiranno in una casa.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 3|The couple leaves your ship and heads to a real estate agency. From what they told you during the trip, they have about two and a half million credits they can spend, which they claim is in line with the standard properties in the most valued (and most sought-after) locations here, and that they should still have enough money to pay you afterwards.|1153|0
units.english: The couple leaves your ship and heads to a real estate agency. From what they told you during the trip, they have about two and a half million credits they can spend, which they claim is in line with the standard properties in the most valued (and most sought-after) locations here, and that they should still have enough money to pay you afterwards.
units.italian: La coppia lascia la tua nave e si dirige a un'agenzia immobiliare. Da quello che ti hanno raccontato durante il viaggio, hanno circa due milioni e mezzo di crediti da spendere, che sostengono essere in linea con le proprietà standard nelle zone più pregiate (e più richieste) qui, e che dovrebbero avere ancora abbastanza soldi per pagarti dopo.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 3|	They return from consulting, the both of them with disappointed looks on their faces. Inturi starts looking at the ships landing and departing while Aunaris comes talk to you.|1154|0
units.english: They return from consulting, the both of them with disappointed looks on their faces. Inturi starts looking at the ships landing and departing while Aunaris comes talk to you.
units.italian: Tornano dalla consulenza, entrambi con espressioni deluse. Inturi comincia a guardare le navi che atterrano e partono mentre Aunaris viene a parlare con te.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 3|	"Kept watch of one property, for months we had. On a mountain village, overlooking a lake, and with access to a nearby forest, it is. A few days ago, purchased it was," she sighs. "Available, another plot of land neighboring it is, but over half our funds, the land alone costs."|1155|0
units.english: "Kept watch of one property, for months we had. On a mountain village, overlooking a lake, and with access to a nearby forest, it is. A few days ago, purchased it was," she sighs. "Available, another plot of land neighboring it is, but over half our funds, the land alone costs."
units.italian: "Tenuto d'occhio una proprietà, per mesi abbiamo fatto. Su un villaggio di montagna, con vista su un lago, e con accesso a una foresta vicina, è. Qualche giorno fa, comprata è stata," sospira. "Disponibile, un altro appezzamento di terra vicino c'è, ma più della metà dei nostri fondi, la terra da sola costa."

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 3|	Inturi then looks over, as if he had just received a shock, and says, "That's it! A ship! Live in a ship, we could!"|1156|0
units.english: Inturi then looks over, as if he had just received a shock, and says, "That's it! A ship! Live in a ship, we could!"
units.italian: Poi Inturi guarda verso di te, come se avesse appena ricevuto una scossa, e dice: "Ecco! Una nave! Vivere in una nave, potremmo!"

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 3|	"What do you mean?"|1158|0
units.english: "What do you mean?"
units.italian: "Cosa vuoi dire?"

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 3|	"I like the enthusiasm, but unfortunately I'm not looking for any more crew members right now."|1159|0
units.english: "I like the enthusiasm, but unfortunately I'm not looking for any more crew members right now."
units.italian: "Mi piace l'entusiasmo, ma purtroppo al momento non cerco altri membri dell'equipaggio."

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 3|	"If you say so. Just don't forget the oranges, scurvy probably is a problem for Saryds too."|1160|0
units.english: "If you say so. Just don't forget the oranges, scurvy probably is a problem for Saryds too."
units.italian: "Se lo dici tu. Solo non dimenticare le arance, lo scorbuto probabilmente è un problema anche per i Saryd."

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 3|	"Live in a ship?" Aunaris repeats the sentence, puzzled.|1161|0
units.english: "Live in a ship?" Aunaris repeats the sentence, puzzled.
units.italian: "Vivere in una nave?" ripete Aunaris la frase, perplessa.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 3|	"In an Arach ship, for that week I worked. Taught me some things, the captain did. Often repurposed into houses, their ships are," he explains. "Their smallest ship, we could buy. Save time and money otherwise spent building a home, it would."|1162|0
units.english: "In an Arach ship, for that week I worked. Taught me some things, the captain did. Often repurposed into houses, their ships are," he explains. "Their smallest ship, we could buy. Save time and money otherwise spent building a home, it would."
units.italian: "Su una nave Arach, per quella settimana ho lavorato. Insegnato qualche cosa, il capitano mi ha. Spesso convertite in case, le loro navi sono," spiega. "La loro nave più piccola, potremmo comprarla. Risparmiare tempo e soldi che altrimenti spenderemmo per costruire una casa, ci permetterebbe."

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 3|	They talk for a bit in private, and after a few minutes Inturi apparently managed to fully explain his idea and convince her.|1163|0
units.english: They talk for a bit in private, and after a few minutes Inturi apparently managed to fully explain his idea and convince her.
units.italian: Parlano in disparte per un po', e dopo qualche minuto Inturi a quanto pare è riuscito a spiegare del tutto la sua idea e a convincerla.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 3|	They head back to the real estate agency and arrange the purchase of the plot of land. Inturi then asks that you transport him to <destination>, where the basic Arach ship model is sold, and after buying it he will return here with the new "house."|1164|0
units.english: They head back to the real estate agency and arrange the purchase of the plot of land. Inturi then asks that you transport him to <destination>, where the basic Arach ship model is sold, and after buying it he will return here with the new "house."
units.italian: Tornano all'agenzia immobiliare e organizzano l'acquisto dell'appezzamento. Inturi poi ti chiede di trasportarlo su <destination>, dove si vende il modello base di nave Arach, e dopo averla comprata tornerà qui con la nuova "casa".

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 3|	Aunaris will remain here to finish sorting out all the paperwork and will be waiting by the property once you two return.|1165|0
units.english: Aunaris will remain here to finish sorting out all the paperwork and will be waiting by the property once you two return.
units.italian: Aunaris resterà qui per finire di sistemare tutte le pratiche e aspetterà vicino alla proprietà quando voi due tornerete.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 3|dialog|1168|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Inturi hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Inturi non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 4|name|1173|0
units.english: Test Drive, Final Drive
units.italian: Prova di guida, ultima corsa

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 4|description|1174|0
units.english: Escort Inturi's ship, which will be repurposed into a home for him and Aunaris, to <destination>.
units.italian: Scorta la nave di Inturi, che sarà convertita in una casa per lui e Aunaris, fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 4|Inturi heads right to the shipyard, and you help him with the purchase itself. He says that although he has worked in many ships over the years, he never went to the shipyard for more than picking up some parts for repair, or to polish a newly produced model.|1182|0
units.english: Inturi heads right to the shipyard, and you help him with the purchase itself. He says that although he has worked in many ships over the years, he never went to the shipyard for more than picking up some parts for repair, or to polish a newly produced model.
units.italian: Inturi va dritto al cantiere, e lo aiuti con l'acquisto vero e proprio. Dice che, anche se negli anni ha lavorato su molte navi, non era mai andato al cantiere per altro che ritirare qualche pezzo da riparare, o per lucidare un modello appena prodotto.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 4|	Only when you're with him inside the Arach vessel do you think of asking if he even knows how to fly a ship, but he reassures you that it won't be a problem.|1183|0
units.english: Only when you're with him inside the Arach vessel do you think of asking if he even knows how to fly a ship, but he reassures you that it won't be a problem.
units.italian: Solo quando sei con lui dentro il vascello Arach ti viene in mente di chiedergli se sappia persino pilotare una nave, ma lui ti rassicura che non sarà un problema.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 4|	"To work as a copilot for an old friend, my first job was. Worry about me crashing the ship, you need not," he jokes.|1184|0
units.english: "To work as a copilot for an old friend, my first job was. Worry about me crashing the ship, you need not," he jokes.
units.italian: "Fare il copilota per un vecchio amico, il mio primo lavoro è stato. Preoccuparti che io distrugga la nave, non devi," scherza.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 4|	He says he will wait for your lead and follow you to <destination> once you depart.|1185|0
units.english: He says he will wait for your lead and follow you to <destination> once you depart.
units.italian: Dice che aspetterà il tuo via e ti seguirà fino a <destination> quando partirai.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 4|dialog|1192|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that Inturi's ship hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to get here.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la nave di Inturi non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 4|You help Inturi park the ship on the plot of land, but since the Arach Courier takes up almost the entire area, your own ship has to land on a regular landing pad.|1197|0
units.english: You help Inturi park the ship on the plot of land, but since the Arach Courier takes up almost the entire area, your own ship has to land on a regular landing pad.
units.italian: Aiuti Inturi a parcheggiare la nave sull'appezzamento, ma dato che il Courier Arach occupa quasi tutta l'area, la tua nave deve atterrare su una piazzola normale.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 4|	After taking a transport up the mountain, you see that some workers are already there and are starting to remove ship components that won't be needed, like its engines and hyperdrive. A house doesn't need to be able to traverse the void of space, after all.|1198|0
units.english: After taking a transport up the mountain, you see that some workers are already there and are starting to remove ship components that won't be needed, like its engines and hyperdrive. A house doesn't need to be able to traverse the void of space, after all.
units.italian: Dopo aver preso un trasporto su per la montagna, vedi che alcuni operai sono già lì e stanno iniziando a rimuovere i componenti della nave che non serviranno, come i motori e l'iperguida. Dopo tutto, una casa non ha bisogno di poter attraversare il vuoto dello spazio.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 4|	The couple comes to meet up with you. "In a day or two, after some shopping we do, fully furnished the house will be," Aunaris says, looking at the ship.|1199|0
units.english: The couple comes to meet up with you. "In a day or two, after some shopping we do, fully furnished the house will be," Aunaris says, looking at the ship.
units.italian: La coppia viene a incontrarti. "Entro un giorno o due, dopo qualche acquisto che facciamo, completamente arredata la casa sarà," dice Aunaris, guardando la nave.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 4|	"Helped us a lot in getting it all sorted out you have, Captain <last>. Focus on working hard to pay you back in full, we will," Inturi adds.|1200|0
units.english: "Helped us a lot in getting it all sorted out you have, Captain <last>. Focus on working hard to pay you back in full, we will," Inturi adds.
units.italian: "Aiutato molto a sistemare tutto, voi ci avete, capitano <last>. Concentrarci sul lavorare sodo per ripagarvi per intero, noi lo faremo," aggiunge Inturi.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 4|	"You don't need to worry about paying me, I helped because I wanted to, not for a payday."|1202|0
units.english: "You don't need to worry about paying me, I helped because I wanted to, not for a payday."
units.italian: "Non dovete preoccuparvi di pagarmi, vi ho aiutato perché volevo, non per un guadagno."

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 4|	"Well, I hope everything goes well. Best of luck to you two!"|1203|0
units.english: "Well, I hope everything goes well. Best of luck to you two!"
units.italian: "Beh, spero che vada tutto bene. Buona fortuna a voi due!"

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 4|	They look at you confused and then try to insist on paying you, but after some minutes they agree. "Too kind a heart you are, Captain," Aunaris says.|1207|0
units.english: They look at you confused and then try to insist on paying you, but after some minutes they agree. "Too kind a heart you are, Captain," Aunaris says.
units.italian: Ti guardano confusi e poi provano a insistere per pagarti, ma dopo qualche minuto accettano. "Troppo buono di cuore, voi siete, capitano," dice Aunaris.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple 4|	They thank you again, and you head back to your ship.|1209|0
units.english: They thank you again, and you head back to your ship.
units.italian: Ti ringraziano di nuovo, e tu torni alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple Follow-Up A|When you land, you're notified of <payment> being transferred to your account.|1228|0
units.english: When you land, you're notified of <payment> being transferred to your account.
units.italian: Quando atterri, vieni avvisato che <payment> sono stati trasferiti sul tuo conto.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple Follow-Up A|	With it, there's a message. It's from Inturi and Aunaris, the Saryd couple who you helped move out to their very own home.|1229|0
units.english: With it, there's a message. It's from Inturi and Aunaris, the Saryd couple who you helped move out to their very own home.
units.italian: Insieme al pagamento c'è un messaggio. È di Inturi e Aunaris, la coppia Saryd che hai aiutato a trasferirsi nella loro casa.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple Follow-Up A|	In the message, they apologize for taking so long to pay you, and go on to tell you about how they've been doing there. Aunaris has been working in a school there, while Inturi has been helping other residents set up their own "ship-houses," as he calls them. Apparently it's become somewhat popular there after people saw the couple's home.|1230|0
units.english: In the message, they apologize for taking so long to pay you, and go on to tell you about how they've been doing there. Aunaris has been working in a school there, while Inturi has been helping other residents set up their own "ship-houses," as he calls them. Apparently it's become somewhat popular there after people saw the couple's home.
units.italian: Nel messaggio si scusano per aver impiegato tanto a pagarti, e raccontano come se la stanno cavando lì. Aunaris lavora in una scuola del posto, mentre Inturi ha aiutato altri residenti ad allestire le proprie "case-nave", come le chiama lui. A quanto pare è diventata una cosa piuttosto popolare lì, dopo che la gente ha visto la casa della coppia.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple Follow-Up A|	They thank you again and say you're welcome to visit anytime.|1231|0
units.english: They thank you again and say you're welcome to visit anytime.
units.italian: Ti ringraziano di nuovo e dicono che sei il benvenuto quando vuoi.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple Follow-Up B|When you land, you see you've received a message. It's from Inturi and Aunaris, the Saryd couple who you helped move out to their very own home.|1245|0
units.english: When you land, you see you've received a message. It's from Inturi and Aunaris, the Saryd couple who you helped move out to their very own home.
units.italian: Quando atterri, vedi che hai ricevuto un messaggio. È di Inturi e Aunaris, la coppia Saryd che hai aiutato a trasferirsi nella loro casa.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple Follow-Up B|	Along with the message, they've sent a picture of them both tending to some flowers and short trees in a little garden they've started up near the ship. In the message they go on to tell you about how they've been doing there. Aunaris has been working in a school there, while Inturi has been helping other residents set up their own "ship-houses," as he calls them. Apparently it's become somewhat popular there after people saw the couple's home.|1246|0
units.english: Along with the message, they've sent a picture of them both tending to some flowers and short trees in a little garden they've started up near the ship. In the message they go on to tell you about how they've been doing there. Aunaris has been working in a school there, while Inturi has been helping other residents set up their own "ship-houses," as he calls them. Apparently it's become somewhat popular there after people saw the couple's home.
units.italian: Insieme al messaggio ti hanno mandato una foto che li ritrae entrambi mentre si prendono cura di alcuni fiori e piccoli alberi in un giardinetto che hanno creato vicino alla nave. Nel messaggio raccontano come se la stanno cavando lì. Aunaris lavora in una scuola del posto, mentre Inturi ha aiutato altri residenti ad allestire le proprie "case-nave", come le chiama lui. A quanto pare è diventata una cosa piuttosto popolare lì, dopo che la gente ha visto la casa della coppia.

units.id: mission:Saryd Couple Follow-Up B|	They thank you again and say you're welcome to visit anytime.|1247|0
units.english: They thank you again and say you're welcome to visit anytime.
units.italian: Ti ringraziano di nuovo e dicono che sei il benvenuto quando vuoi.

units.id: mission:Longcow Antibiotics 1|name|1253|0
units.english: Longcow Antibiotics
units.italian: Antibiotici per le longcow

units.id: mission:Longcow Antibiotics 1|description|1254|0
units.english: Arach ranchers have asked you to pick up <cargo> on <stopovers>, then deliver them to <destination>.
units.italian: Alcuni allevatori Arach ti hanno chiesto di ritirare <cargo> su <stopovers> e poi di consegnarlo su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Longcow Antibiotics 1|You see some Arachi talking among themselves in the spaceport, occasionally glancing at and pointing at you.|1267|0
units.english: You see some Arachi talking among themselves in the spaceport, occasionally glancing at and pointing at you.
units.italian: Vedi alcuni Arachi che parlano tra loro nello spazioporto, che ogni tanto ti guardano e ti indicano.

units.id: mission:Longcow Antibiotics 1|	One of them finally comes to you and says, "Greetings, Captain. Interested in performing a cargo mission for us, are you?"|1268|0
units.english: One of them finally comes to you and says, "Greetings, Captain. Interested in performing a cargo mission for us, are you?"
units.italian: Alla fine uno di loro viene da te e dice: "Salve, capitano. Interessato a svolgere una missione di carico per noi, siete?"

units.id: mission:Longcow Antibiotics 1|	She tells you that they are a cooperative of Arach ranchers, explains that the safety and health regulations for their business, longcow ranching, were recently updated, and that they need someone to pick up the newest antibiotics for the cattle on <stopovers>.|1269|0
units.english: She tells you that they are a cooperative of Arach ranchers, explains that the safety and health regulations for their business, longcow ranching, were recently updated, and that they need someone to pick up the newest antibiotics for the cattle on <stopovers>.
units.italian: Ti dice che sono una cooperativa di allevatori Arach, spiega che le norme di sicurezza e salute per la loro attività, l'allevamento di longcow, sono state aggiornate di recente, e che hanno bisogno di qualcuno che ritiri i nuovi antibiotici per il bestiame su <stopovers>.

units.id: mission:Longcow Antibiotics 1|	"A jump drive you have, so get them faster - and allow us to resume business faster - you would."|1270|0
units.english: "A jump drive you have, so get them faster - and allow us to resume business faster - you would."
units.italian: "Un motore di salto avete, quindi prenderli più in fretta, e permetterci di riprendere l'attività più in fretta, voi potreste."

units.id: mission:Longcow Antibiotics 1|	"You've found the perfect person for the job. I'm in."|1272|0
units.english: "You've found the perfect person for the job. I'm in."
units.italian: "Avete trovato la persona perfetta per il lavoro. Ci sto."
