units.id: mission:Longcow Antibiotics 1|	"I suppose that's true, but I'm not looking for courier jobs, sorry."|1273|0
units.english: "I suppose that's true, but I'm not looking for courier jobs, sorry."
units.italian: "Suppongo che sia vero, ma non cerco lavori da corriere, mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Longcow Antibiotics 1|	The other Arachi come over to thank you after she signals to them that you've accepted to help. They explain that after you've picked up the antibiotics on <stopovers>, you'll have to drop them off on <planet> before wishing you a good trip.|1275|0
units.english: The other Arachi come over to thank you after she signals to them that you've accepted to help. They explain that after you've picked up the antibiotics on <stopovers>, you'll have to drop them off on <planet> before wishing you a good trip.
units.italian: Gli altri Arachi vengono a ringraziarti dopo che lei segnala loro che hai accettato di aiutare. Spiegano che, dopo aver ritirato gli antibiotici su <stopovers>, dovrai lasciarli su <planet>, prima di augurarti buon viaggio.

units.id: mission:Longcow Antibiotics 1|dialog|1278|0
units.english: The dockworkers load <cargo> into your cargo hold after verifying you've been hired by the Arach cooperative. A bit after the last crate has been placed, you're contacted by the Arachi, and they say you should bring the antibiotics to <destination>, where they will pay you <payment>.
units.italian: I lavoratori portuali caricano <cargo> nella stiva dopo aver verificato che sei stato assunto dalla cooperativa Arach. Poco dopo che l'ultima cassa è stata sistemata, vieni contattato dagli Arachi, che dicono che dovresti portare gli antibiotici su <destination>, dove ti pagheranno <payment>.

units.id: mission:Longcow Antibiotics 1|dialog|1280|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but the Arach ranchers don't come to meet you as you've not brought the longcow antibiotics. Make sure all your ships carrying the cargo arrive in this system after you've picked it up.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma gli allevatori Arach non vengono a incontrarti perché non hai portato gli antibiotici per le longcow. Assicurati che tutte le tue navi con il carico arrivino in questo sistema dopo che l'hai ritirato.

units.id: mission:Longcow Antibiotics 2|name|1288|0
units.english: Longcow Antibiotics
units.italian: Antibiotici per le longcow

units.id: mission:Longcow Antibiotics 2|description|1289|0
units.english: Deliver the remaining <cargo> to <destination>, where some Arachi also work as longcow ranchers.
units.italian: Consegna il resto di <cargo> su <destination>, dove alcuni Arachi lavorano anch'essi come allevatori di longcow.

units.id: mission:Longcow Antibiotics 2|You're paid 421,000 credits when you land, but as you help the ranchers unload the antibiotics, they say that something is off.|1298|0
units.english: You're paid 421,000 credits when you land, but as you help the ranchers unload the antibiotics, they say that something is off.
units.italian: Vieni pagato 421.000 crediti quando atterri, ma mentre aiuti gli allevatori a scaricare gli antibiotici, dicono che qualcosa non va.

units.id: mission:Longcow Antibiotics 2|	"Only 6 tons of antibiotics, we requested," one of them says. "That extra ton surplus, ours is not."|1299|0
units.english: "Only 6 tons of antibiotics, we requested," one of them says. "That extra ton surplus, ours is not."
units.italian: "Solo 6 tonnellate di antibiotici, abbiamo chiesto," dice uno di loro. "Quella tonnellata in più, nostra non è."

units.id: mission:Longcow Antibiotics 2|	She goes away for about ten minutes to contact the lab workers back on New Finding. When she comes back, she seemingly jokes with the other ranchers in the Arach language, before talking to you.|1300|0
units.english: She goes away for about ten minutes to contact the lab workers back on New Finding. When she comes back, she seemingly jokes with the other ranchers in the Arach language, before talking to you.
units.italian: Si allontana per una decina di minuti per contattare i lavoratori del laboratorio su New Finding. Quando torna, sembra scherzare con gli altri allevatori in lingua Arach, prima di parlare con te.

units.id: mission:Longcow Antibiotics 2|	"Mixed up the cargo, they have. His own longcow ranch on <destination>, a cousin of mine has," she says. "Sent along with my own, his batch of antibiotics was."|1301|0
units.english: "Mixed up the cargo, they have. His own longcow ranch on <destination>, a cousin of mine has," she says. "Sent along with my own, his batch of antibiotics was."
units.italian: "Scambiato il carico, loro hanno. Il suo allevamento di longcow su <destination>, un mio cugino ha," dice. "Mandato insieme al mio, il suo lotto di antibiotici era."

units.id: mission:Longcow Antibiotics 2|	They contact the cousin in question and he asks that you transport his own part of the antibiotics to <destination>, where he will pay you <payment>.|1302|0
units.english: They contact the cousin in question and he asks that you transport his own part of the antibiotics to <destination>, where he will pay you <payment>.
units.italian: Contattano il cugino in questione e lui chiede che tu trasporti la sua parte di antibiotici su <destination>, dove ti pagherà <payment>.

units.id: mission:Longcow Antibiotics 2|dialog|1305|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying the longcow antibiotics hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con gli antibiotici per le longcow non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Longcow Antibiotics 2|dialog|1309|0
units.english: You land and meet up with the cousin of the Corral of Meblumem rancher, and he pays you <payment>. "Mix up our batches due to our family name, the doctors always do!" he grumbles as the antibiotics are being removed from your cargo hold.
units.italian: Atterri e incontri il cugino dell'allevatore del Recinto di Meblumem, e lui ti paga <payment>. "Confondere i nostri lotti per il cognome, i dottori lo fanno sempre!" brontola mentre gli antibiotici vengono tolti dalla stiva.

units.id: mission:Arachi Orphans|name|1315|0
units.english: Arach Orphans
units.italian: Orfani Arach

units.id: mission:Arachi Orphans|description|1316|0
units.english: Bring these 4 Arach orphans, their caretaker, and their <cargo> to <destination>, where they will join a foster home.
units.italian: Porta questi 4 orfani Arach, il loro tutore e il loro <cargo> su <destination>, dove entreranno in una casa affidataria.

units.id: mission:Arachi Orphans|An elderly Arach beckons to you as you enter the spaceport. He is accompanied by four Arach children, who all stand close to a large pile of luggage.|1328|0
units.english: An elderly Arach beckons to you as you enter the spaceport. He is accompanied by four Arach children, who all stand close to a large pile of luggage.
units.italian: Un anziano Arach ti fa cenno mentre entri nello spazioporto. È accompagnato da quattro bambini Arach, che stanno tutti vicini a un grande mucchio di bagagli.

units.id: mission:Arachi Orphans|	He explains that he used to run an orphanage here, but has now gotten too old for the job. He has arranged for the four kids to be transferred to a foster home on <destination>.|1329|0
units.english: He explains that he used to run an orphanage here, but has now gotten too old for the job. He has arranged for the four kids to be transferred to a foster home on <destination>.
units.italian: Spiega che gestiva un orfanotrofio qui, ma ora è troppo vecchio per il lavoro. Ha organizzato il trasferimento dei quattro bambini in una casa affidataria su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Arachi Orphans|	"Take care of them, the Saryds there will," he says, patting the head of the youngest and shortest of the kids. "Retiring, I am, but abandon them, I will not. An apartment close to the foster home, I will purchase."|1330|0
units.english: "Take care of them, the Saryds there will," he says, patting the head of the youngest and shortest of the kids. "Retiring, I am, but abandon them, I will not. An apartment close to the foster home, I will purchase."
units.italian: "Prendersi cura di loro, i Saryd lì lo faranno," dice, accarezzando la testa del più piccolo e basso dei bambini. "In pensione, io vado, ma abbandonarli, io non lo farò. Un appartamento vicino alla casa affidataria, io lo comprerò."

units.id: mission:Arachi Orphans|	He offers to pay you <payment> to bring the five of them and their <cargo> to <destination>.|1331|0
units.english: He offers to pay you <payment> to bring the five of them and their <cargo> to <destination>.
units.italian: Si offre di pagarti <payment> per portare loro cinque e il loro <cargo> su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Arachi Orphans|	"Of course I'll help. Here, let me help you get the luggage into my ship."|1333|0
units.english: "Of course I'll help. Here, let me help you get the luggage into my ship."
units.italian: "Ma certo che aiuto. Ecco, lascia che ti aiuti a portare i bagagli nella mia nave."

units.id: mission:Arachi Orphans|	"I hope things work out for you, but I'm actually not going to stay in or fly around Coalition space for long now."|1335|0
units.english: "I hope things work out for you, but I'm actually not going to stay in or fly around Coalition space for long now."
units.italian: "Spero che le cose si sistemino per voi, ma in realtà non resterò né volerò per lo spazio della Coalizione ancora a lungo."

units.id: mission:Arachi Orphans|You help the old Arach caretaker and some workers take the luggage out of your ship then head to the orphanage.|1341|0
units.english: You help the old Arach caretaker and some workers take the luggage out of your ship then head to the orphanage.
units.italian: Aiuti l'anziano tutore Arach e alcuni operai a togliere i bagagli dalla tua nave, poi ti dirigi all'orfanotrofio.

units.id: mission:Arachi Orphans|	A Saryd couple runs the place and greets you and the old Arach when you get there. Aside from a few Saryd kids, you notice the place already has an Arach child and some Kimek too.|1342|0
units.english: A Saryd couple runs the place and greets you and the old Arach when you get there. Aside from a few Saryd kids, you notice the place already has an Arach child and some Kimek too.
units.italian: Una coppia Saryd gestisce il posto e accoglie te e l'anziano Arach quando arrivate. Oltre a qualche bambino Saryd, noti che il posto ha già un bambino Arach e anche alcuni Kimek.

units.id: mission:Arachi Orphans|	After you make sure all their belongings are inside the foster house, the Arach children head on inside to get acquainted with their new family. Their caretaker thanks you and hands you <payment> before heading inside himself.|1343|0
units.english: After you make sure all their belongings are inside the foster house, the Arach children head on inside to get acquainted with their new family. Their caretaker thanks you and hands you <payment> before heading inside himself.
units.italian: Dopo che ti sei assicurato che tutte le loro cose siano dentro la casa affidataria, i bambini Arach entrano per conoscere la loro nuova famiglia. Il loro tutore ti ringrazia e ti consegna <payment> prima di entrare lui stesso.

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 1|name|1349|0
units.english: A New Design
units.italian: Un nuovo design

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 1|description|1350|0
units.english: The Arach cartoonist Drugub is currently struggling to find inspiration for new spaceship designs in his comics. Head to <destination> and find something you can bring back to show him the ship models produced there.
units.italian: Il fumettista Arach Drugub sta faticando a trovare l'ispirazione per nuovi design di astronavi nei suoi fumetti. Dirigiti su <destination> e trova qualcosa che puoi riportargli per mostrargli i modelli di navi prodotti lì.

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 1|As you're moving along one of the larger underground tunnels that connect the spaceport here, a dozen makeshift stands, each with a different apparent 'theme' to them, captures your attention. When you get closer, it's clear that the event is something of a convention, each stand managed by a different artist that lives here.|1357|0
units.english: As you're moving along one of the larger underground tunnels that connect the spaceport here, a dozen makeshift stands, each with a different apparent 'theme' to them, captures your attention. When you get closer, it's clear that the event is something of a convention, each stand managed by a different artist that lives here.
units.italian: Mentre percorri uno dei tunnel sotterranei più grandi che collegano lo spazioporto, una dozzina di bancarelle improvvisate, ognuna con un diverso apparente 'tema', attira la tua attenzione. Quando ti avvicini, è chiaro che l'evento è una specie di convention, con ogni bancarella gestita da un artista diverso che vive qui.

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 1|	After you're done looking at a stand that showcased various fantasy attires and move on to the neighboring one, its owner jumps as soon as he turns to see you, looking dumbfounded. He introduces himself as Drugub, a cartoonist of local fame for his science fiction comics, showing various examples of them as he speaks with you. "Many styles of ships produced in our space are, but only so many ideas from them, I can get," he says. "That you came here, lucky I am. To expand my creative horizon, I need, and seeing the general shape of some human ships would."|1358|0
units.english: After you're done looking at a stand that showcased various fantasy attires and move on to the neighboring one, its owner jumps as soon as he turns to see you, looking dumbfounded. He introduces himself as Drugub, a cartoonist of local fame for his science fiction comics, showing various examples of them as he speaks with you. "Many styles of ships produced in our space are, but only so many ideas from them, I can get," he says. "That you came here, lucky I am. To expand my creative horizon, I need, and seeing the general shape of some human ships would."
units.italian: Dopo che hai finito di guardare una bancarella che esponeva vari abiti fantasy e passi a quella accanto, il suo proprietario sobbalza appena si volta e ti vede, con un'aria sbalordita. Si presenta come Drugub, un fumettista di fama locale per i suoi fumetti di fantascienza, mostrandoti vari esempi mentre parla con te. "Molti stili di navi prodotto nel nostro spazio sono, ma solo tante idee da loro riesco a trarre," dice. "Che siate venuto qui, fortunato sono. Per ampliare il mio orizzonte creativo, ho bisogno, e vedere la forma generale di alcune navi umane lo farebbe."

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 1|	"I can help with that. Do you have any type of ship in mind?"|1360|0
units.english: "I can help with that. Do you have any type of ship in mind?"
units.italian: "Posso aiutarti. Hai in mente qualche tipo di nave?"

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 1|	"Sorry, I'm just passing by, not looking for a job or anything."|1361|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm just passing by, not looking for a job or anything."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, sono solo di passaggio, non cerco un lavoro né altro."

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 1|	He looks puzzled. "For a variety of purposes, ships in my comics are used, so to know of a variety of ships, preferable it would be."|1363|0
units.english: He looks puzzled. "For a variety of purposes, ships in my comics are used, so to know of a variety of ships, preferable it would be."
units.italian: Sembra perplesso. "Per una varietà di scopi, le navi nei miei fumetti sono usate, quindi conoscere una varietà di navi, preferibile sarebbe."

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 1|	You decide to give him a brief description of the biggest shipyards in human space, citing their history and design philosophy, from Syndicated Shipyards' cheaper designs to Deep Sky's sophisticated (by human standards) technology.|1364|0
units.english: You decide to give him a brief description of the biggest shipyards in human space, citing their history and design philosophy, from Syndicated Shipyards' cheaper designs to Deep Sky's sophisticated (by human standards) technology.
units.italian: Decidi di dargli una breve descrizione dei più grandi cantieri dello spazio umano, citando la loro storia e la loro filosofia progettuale, dai progetti più economici del Cantiere Sindacato alla tecnologia sofisticata (per gli standard umani) di Deep Sky.

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 1|	When you're done, he thinks for a bit, then concludes that Betelgeuse Shipyards' older, historical designs, are what he's looking for. "Set during a less developed time, what I'm working on is," he explains.|1365|0
units.english: When you're done, he thinks for a bit, then concludes that Betelgeuse Shipyards' older, historical designs, are what he's looking for. "Set during a less developed time, what I'm working on is," he explains.
units.italian: Quando hai finito, riflette un po', poi conclude che i progetti più vecchi e storici del Cantiere Betelgeuse sono quello che cerca. "Ambientato in un'epoca meno sviluppata, quello su cui sto lavorando è," spiega.

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 1|	"In that case, I'll head to their home shipyard and see what I can bring back for you."|1367|0
units.english: "In that case, I'll head to their home shipyard and see what I can bring back for you."
units.italian: "In tal caso, andrò al loro cantiere d'origine e vedrò cosa posso riportarti."

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 1|	"Alright, it's a bit of a long trip to <planet>, but if you're sure, let's head to my ship and I'll show you your bunk."|1369|0
units.english: "Alright, it's a bit of a long trip to <planet>, but if you're sure, let's head to my ship and I'll show you your bunk."
units.italian: "Va bene, è un viaggio un po' lungo fino a <planet>, ma se sei sicuro, andiamo alla mia nave e ti mostro la cuccetta."

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 1|	"I happen to own a ship matching that description, a Betelgeuse Leviathan. Would you like to see it?"|1370|0
units.english: "I happen to own a ship matching that description, a Betelgeuse Leviathan. Would you like to see it?"
units.italian: "Guarda caso possiedo una nave che corrisponde a quella descrizione, un Leviathan del Cantiere Betelgeuse. Vuoi vederla?"

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 1|	"Oh, leave I cannot. Whether far away or not this <planet> you speak of is, allowed to leave Coalition space, we are not," he says. "Go on without me you must, Captain."|1374|0
units.english: "Oh, leave I cannot. Whether far away or not this <planet> you speak of is, allowed to leave Coalition space, we are not," he says. "Go on without me you must, Captain."
units.italian: "Oh, andarmene non posso. Che sia lontano o no questo <planet> di cui parli, permesso di lasciare lo spazio della Coalizione, noi non abbiamo," dice. "Andare avanti senza di me dovete, capitano."

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 1|	He thanks you and wishes you safe travels on your journey to <planet>.|1376|0
units.english: He thanks you and wishes you safe travels on your journey to <planet>.
units.italian: Ti ringrazia e ti augura buon viaggio per il tuo tragitto verso <planet>.

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 1|label|1378|0
units.english: has leviathan
units.italian: has leviathan

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 1|	Though reading emotions from a giant spider proves challenging, Drugub appears to be star-struck.|1382|0
units.english: Though reading emotions from a giant spider proves challenging, Drugub appears to be star-struck.
units.italian: Anche se leggere le emozioni da un ragno gigante è difficile, Drugub sembra incantato.

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 1|	"Own a ship, a 'Leviathan,' you do? To your hangar, we must go!"|1383|0
units.english: "Own a ship, a 'Leviathan,' you do? To your hangar, we must go!"
units.italian: "Possedere una nave, un 'Leviathan', voi lo fate? Al vostro hangar, dobbiamo andare!"

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 1|	After a brief walk to the hangar where your ship is parked, Drugub immediately begins crawling over the Leviathan. It seems what you've provided him with is far more substantial than any secondhand reference could possibly convey. He spends a while examining the ship up close before hopping down and taking many pictures from every conceivable angle -- as well as drawing a few quick sketches.|1384|0
units.english: After a brief walk to the hangar where your ship is parked, Drugub immediately begins crawling over the Leviathan. It seems what you've provided him with is far more substantial than any secondhand reference could possibly convey. He spends a while examining the ship up close before hopping down and taking many pictures from every conceivable angle -- as well as drawing a few quick sketches.
units.italian: Dopo una breve camminata fino all'hangar dove è parcheggiata la tua nave, Drugub comincia subito a gattonare sopra il Leviathan. Sembra che quello che gli hai fornito sia molto più sostanzioso di quanto qualsiasi riferimento di seconda mano potrebbe trasmettere. Passa un po' di tempo a esaminare la nave da vicino prima di saltare giù e scattare molte foto da ogni angolazione immaginabile, oltre a disegnare qualche schizzo veloce.

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 1|	Once he's finished, he hands you a payment of <payment> and spends some more time with you, asking you all the questions he can think of about the ship.|1385|0
units.english: Once he's finished, he hands you a payment of <payment> and spends some more time with you, asking you all the questions he can think of about the ship.
units.italian: Quando ha finito, ti consegna un pagamento di <payment> e passa altro tempo con te, facendoti tutte le domande che riesce a immaginare sulla nave.

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 1|	"Very beautiful, this 'Leviathan' is. Thinking of many ways to draw it, I already am," he says. "Maybe a flagship of one of my characters, make it I will..."|1386|0
units.english: "Very beautiful, this 'Leviathan' is. Thinking of many ways to draw it, I already am," he says. "Maybe a flagship of one of my characters, make it I will..."
units.italian: "Molto bello, questo 'Leviathan' è. Pensare a molti modi per disegnarlo, già io sto," dice. "Forse l'ammiraglia di uno dei miei personaggi, ne farò..."

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 1|	He spends some more minutes listening to you after he asks that you describe how your ship performs, thanks you again, and prepares to leave.|1387|0
units.english: He spends some more minutes listening to you after he asks that you describe how your ship performs, thanks you again, and prepares to leave.
units.italian: Passa altri minuti ad ascoltarti dopo averti chiesto di descrivere come si comporta la tua nave, ti ringrazia di nuovo e si prepara ad andarsene.

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 1|	"Oh, before I go, Captain <last>, use the name of your own ship for that 'Leviathan,' may I? Just as a small thank you."|1388|0
units.english: "Oh, before I go, Captain <last>, use the name of your own ship for that 'Leviathan,' may I? Just as a small thank you."
units.italian: "Oh, prima che vada, capitano <last>, usare il nome della vostra nave per quel 'Leviathan', posso? Solo come piccolo ringraziamento."

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 1|	"Of course! It's called <ship>."|1390|0
units.english: "Of course! It's called <ship>."
units.italian: "Ma certo! Si chiama <ship>."

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 1|	"The name is nothing special. I wouldn't even get the reference of it if I read your comic in the future, honestly."|1391|0
units.english: "The name is nothing special. I wouldn't even get the reference of it if I read your comic in the future, honestly."
units.italian: "Il nome non ha niente di speciale. Onestamente, non ne capirei nemmeno il riferimento se leggessi il tuo fumetto in futuro."

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 1|	"<ship> it is! Do it justice I will, Captain. Thanks again."|1393|0
units.english: "<ship> it is! Do it justice I will, Captain. Thanks again."
units.italian: "<ship> sia! Renderle giustizia, io lo farò, capitano. Grazie ancora."

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 1|label|1395|0
units.english: no ship
units.italian: no ship

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 1|	"Ah, I see. Well, just a reference it would be, so the name matters not, I suppose. Anyway, thanks again, Captain."|1396|0
units.english: "Ah, I see. Well, just a reference it would be, so the name matters not, I suppose. Anyway, thanks again, Captain."
units.italian: "Ah, capisco. Beh, sarebbe solo un riferimento, quindi il nome non importa, suppongo. Comunque grazie ancora, capitano."

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 2|description|1403|0
units.english: Return to Drugub on <destination>, and give him the flyer with pictures and some details of Betelgeuse's ship models.
units.italian: Torna da Drugub su <destination> e dagli il volantino con le immagini e qualche dettaglio dei modelli di nave di Betelgeuse.

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 2|When you ask the shipyard clerk if you could have something that detailed their ship models to "show a friend who is new to spaceships," she hands you a flyer. Inside, all of Betelgeuse's ships are depicted with some details on each (along with the pricing, of course).|1411|0
units.english: When you ask the shipyard clerk if you could have something that detailed their ship models to "show a friend who is new to spaceships," she hands you a flyer. Inside, all of Betelgeuse's ships are depicted with some details on each (along with the pricing, of course).
units.italian: Quando chiedi alla commessa del cantiere se puoi avere qualcosa che descriva i loro modelli di navi per "mostrarlo a un amico che è nuovo alle astronavi", ti consegna un volantino. Dentro, tutte le navi di Betelgeuse sono raffigurate con qualche dettaglio su ciascuna (insieme ai prezzi, naturalmente).

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 2|	"Usually we show these to first time buyers, but you can take one if you want. Is your friend interested in buying? Maybe I could help you figure out what ship would best suit them."|1412|0
units.english: "Usually we show these to first time buyers, but you can take one if you want. Is your friend interested in buying? Maybe I could help you figure out what ship would best suit them."
units.italian: "Di solito li mostriamo ai clienti alla prima visita, ma puoi prenderne uno se vuoi. Il tuo amico è interessato a comprare? Magari potrei aiutarti a capire quale nave gli si addice meglio."

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 2|	You thank her, saying that your friend does not have the funds for any of the ships and just wants some info, then head back to your ship.|1413|0
units.english: You thank her, saying that your friend does not have the funds for any of the ships and just wants some info, then head back to your ship.
units.italian: La ringrazi, dicendole che il tuo amico non ha i fondi per nessuna delle navi e vuole solo qualche informazione, poi torni alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 2|	Hopefully a small pamphlet will do for Drugub to get some ideas.|1414|0
units.english: Hopefully a small pamphlet will do for Drugub to get some ideas.
units.italian: Speriamo che un piccolo opuscolo basti a Drugub per trarre qualche idea.

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 2|Drugub is excitedly waiting for you when you return. However simple a piece of paper it may seem to you, he grabs the flyer as if it's some scroll of knowledge.|1422|0
units.english: Drugub is excitedly waiting for you when you return. However simple a piece of paper it may seem to you, he grabs the flyer as if it's some scroll of knowledge.
units.italian: Drugub ti aspetta eccitato al tuo ritorno. Per quanto semplice possa sembrarti un pezzo di carta, afferra il volantino come se fosse una pergamena di conoscenza.

units.english: Once he's finished, he hands you your payment of <payment> and spends some more time with you, asking you all the questions he can think of about the ship.
units.italian: Quando ha finito, ti consegna il tuo pagamento di <payment> e passa ancora un po' di tempo con te, facendoti tutte le domande che riesce a immaginare sulla nave.

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 2|	"Very beautiful, this 'Leviathan' is. Thinking of many ways to draw it, I already am," he says. "Maybe a flagship of one of my characters, make it I will..."|1441|0
units.english: "Very beautiful, this 'Leviathan' is. Thinking of many ways to draw it, I already am," he says. "Maybe a flagship of one of my characters, make it I will..."
units.italian: "Molto bello, questo 'Leviathan' è. Pensare a molti modi per disegnarlo, già io sto," dice. "Forse l'ammiraglia di uno dei miei personaggi, ne farò..."

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 2|	He spends some more minutes listening to you after he asks that you describe how your ship performs, thanks you again, and prepares to leave.|1442|0
units.english: He spends some more minutes listening to you after he asks that you describe how your ship performs, thanks you again, and prepares to leave.
units.italian: Passa altri minuti ad ascoltarti dopo averti chiesto di descrivere come si comporta la tua nave, ti ringrazia di nuovo e si prepara ad andarsene.

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 2|	"Oh, before I go, Captain <last>, use the name of your own ship for that 'Leviathan,' may I? Just as a small thank you."|1443|0
units.english: "Oh, before I go, Captain <last>, use the name of your own ship for that 'Leviathan,' may I? Just as a small thank you."
units.italian: "Oh, prima che vada, capitano <last>, usare il nome della vostra nave per quel 'Leviathan', posso? Solo come piccolo ringraziamento."

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 2|	"Of course! It's called <ship>."|1445|0
units.english: "Of course! It's called <ship>."
units.italian: "Ma certo! Si chiama <ship>."

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 2|	"The name is nothing special. I wouldn't even get the reference of it if I read your comic in the future, honestly."|1446|0
units.english: "The name is nothing special. I wouldn't even get the reference of it if I read your comic in the future, honestly."
units.italian: "Il nome non ha niente di speciale. Onestamente, non ne capirei nemmeno il riferimento se leggessi il tuo fumetto in futuro."

units.id: mission:Arachi Cartoonist 2|	"<ship> it is! Do it justice I will, Captain. Thanks again."|1448|0
units.english: "<ship> it is! Do it justice I will, Captain. Thanks again."
units.italian: "<ship> sia! Renderle giustizia, io lo farò, capitano. Grazie ancora."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|log|1465|0
units.english: Alitis, formerly known as Athis, is an Alpha who lives in the Coalition. Centuries ago, he stole a jump drive from an alien ship and used it to explore, but after some sort of encounter in the galactic east, he decided to give up on his former life.
units.italian: Alitis, un tempo noto come Athis, è un Alpha che vive nella Coalizione. Secoli fa rubò un motore di salto da una nave aliena e lo usò per esplorare, ma dopo una specie di incontro nell'est galattico decise di rinunciare alla sua vita precedente.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|You're window-browsing a shop in the spaceport when you catch the scuff of too quick footsteps coming toward you. Before you can glance in that direction, you're suddenly tackled into the ground by someone astonishingly human-shaped. You try to get up, but whoever attacked you pins you down, pressing your face into the ground and holding your arms behind your back to restrain you. As you struggle against your attacker you manage to catch sight of long hair and then, with a flash of concern, a glimpse of green skin - an Alpha.|1467|0
units.english: You're window-browsing a shop in the spaceport when you catch the scuff of too quick footsteps coming toward you. Before you can glance in that direction, you're suddenly tackled into the ground by someone astonishingly human-shaped. You try to get up, but whoever attacked you pins you down, pressing your face into the ground and holding your arms behind your back to restrain you. As you struggle against your attacker you manage to catch sight of long hair and then, with a flash of concern, a glimpse of green skin - an Alpha.
units.italian: Stai guardando le vetrine di un negozio nello spazioporto quando senti lo scalpiccio di passi troppo rapidi che ti vengono incontro. Prima che tu possa voltarti in quella direzione, vieni improvvisamente travolto e sbattuto a terra da qualcuno dall'aspetto sorprendentemente umano. Provi a rialzarti, ma chi ti ha attaccato ti blocca, premendoti la faccia contro il terreno e tenendoti le braccia dietro la schiena per immobilizzarti. Mentre ti dibatti contro il tuo assalitore riesci a intravedere capelli lunghi e poi, con un guizzo di preoccupazione, un accenno di pelle verde: un Alpha.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|	You are not pressed for long though. You feel the Alpha's attention shift to the side you cannot see, as an Arach swoops in with a tackle. The Alpha lets go of your arms in an attempt to block the attack, but it does not prevent the Arach from bowling them clear off of you where the two begin to wrestle in your line of sight. The Alpha is a man and, surprisingly to you, despite his strength, it doesn't take long for the Arach Heliarch to restrain your attacker. The Arach firmly pins his arms to his torso with four legs, holds his hips down with two, and uses her last pair to lever herself until she rests her entire body weight into pinning the Alpha.|1468|0
units.english: You are not pressed for long though. You feel the Alpha's attention shift to the side you cannot see, as an Arach swoops in with a tackle. The Alpha lets go of your arms in an attempt to block the attack, but it does not prevent the Arach from bowling them clear off of you where the two begin to wrestle in your line of sight. The Alpha is a man and, surprisingly to you, despite his strength, it doesn't take long for the Arach Heliarch to restrain your attacker. The Arach firmly pins his arms to his torso with four legs, holds his hips down with two, and uses her last pair to lever herself until she rests her entire body weight into pinning the Alpha.
units.italian: Ma non resti bloccato a lungo. Senti l'attenzione dell'Alpha spostarsi verso il lato che non puoi vedere, mentre un Arach piomba dentro con un placcaggio. L'Alpha lascia andare le tue braccia nel tentativo di bloccare l'attacco, ma questo non impedisce all'Arach di scaraventarlo via da te, e i due cominciano a lottare davanti ai tuoi occhi. L'Alpha è un uomo e, con tua sorpresa, nonostante la forza, non ci vuole molto perché l'Heliarch Arach blocchi il tuo assalitore. L'Arach gli blocca saldamente le braccia al torso con quattro zampe, gli tiene i fianchi a terra con due e usa l'ultimo paio per sollevarsi finché non grava su di lui con tutto il suo peso.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|	A Saryd Heliarch approaches and tells you to keep your distance before interposing himself partially between you and your assailant. He then looks at the Alpha and asks through his translator box, "What reason for attacking this person, did you have?"|1469|0
units.english: A Saryd Heliarch approaches and tells you to keep your distance before interposing himself partially between you and your assailant. He then looks at the Alpha and asks through his translator box, "What reason for attacking this person, did you have?"
units.italian: Si avvicina un Heliarch Saryd che ti dice di tenerti a distanza prima di frapporsi in parte tra te e il tuo assalitore. Poi guarda l'Alpha e chiede attraverso la sua scatola di traduzione: "Quale ragione per attaccare questa persona, avevate?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|	The Alpha is still struggling to try and get out of the Arach's grip, and you notice an intricate gold necklace which has splayed across his shoulder and onto the floor in the scuffle, jangling in the quiet every time he struggles. At this point, everyone else has cleared out of the area and is giving the scene a wide berth. As you get to your feet he ignores the Saryd's question and looks at you intensely. "You're with the Navy, aren't you? Finally figured out I was here, thought you'd finish the job?"|1470|0
units.english: The Alpha is still struggling to try and get out of the Arach's grip, and you notice an intricate gold necklace which has splayed across his shoulder and onto the floor in the scuffle, jangling in the quiet every time he struggles. At this point, everyone else has cleared out of the area and is giving the scene a wide berth. As you get to your feet he ignores the Saryd's question and looks at you intensely. "You're with the Navy, aren't you? Finally figured out I was here, thought you'd finish the job?"
units.italian: L'Alpha sta ancora lottando per cercare di liberarsi dalla presa dell'Arach, e noti una collana d'oro elaborata che si è spostata sulla sua spalla e sul pavimento nella colluttazione, tintinnando nel silenzio ogni volta che si dimena. A questo punto tutti gli altri si sono allontanati dalla zona e girano alla larga dalla scena. Mentre ti rimetti in piedi lui ignora la domanda del Saryd e ti fissa intensamente. "Sei con la Marina, vero? Finalmente avete capito che ero qui, e pensavi di finire il lavoro?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|	"No, I'm not with the Navy. You could've just asked without slamming me to the ground."|1474|0
units.english: "No, I'm not with the Navy. You could've just asked without slamming me to the ground."
units.italian: "No, non sono con la Marina. Potevi semplicemente chiedere, senza sbattermi a terra."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|	"Is that why you attacked me?"|1476|0
units.english: "Is that why you attacked me?"
units.italian: "È per questo che mi hai attaccato?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|	"I am with the Navy, but I didn't come here looking for you."|1480|0
units.english: "I am with the Navy, but I didn't come here looking for you."
units.italian: "Sono con la Marina, ma non sono venuto qui cercando te."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|	"Is that why you attacked me?"|1481|0
units.english: "Is that why you attacked me?"
units.italian: "È per questo che mi hai attaccato?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|	"And I'm supposed to believe that crap?" He lashes out, trying again to knock the Arach off of him, but the agent only tightens the grip. She opens her mandibles, getting them close to the Alpha's neck. "Alright, alright, I get it!" the Alpha shouts, stopping his attempts to break free.|1483|0
units.english: "And I'm supposed to believe that crap?" He lashes out, trying again to knock the Arach off of him, but the agent only tightens the grip. She opens her mandibles, getting them close to the Alpha's neck. "Alright, alright, I get it!" the Alpha shouts, stopping his attempts to break free.
units.italian: "E dovrei credere a questa stronzata?" Scatta, cercando di nuovo di buttare giù l'Arach, ma l'agente stringe solo la presa. Apre le mandibole, avvicinandole al collo dell'Alpha. "Va bene, va bene, ho capito!" urla l'Alpha, smettendo di provare a liberarsi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|label|1485|0
units.english: not navy
units.italian: not navy

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|	He stares at you for a moment, as if unsure if you're telling the truth. "What the hell are you doing here then? Did you just stumble onto this place?" He stops struggling, but the Arach agent doesn't loosen her grip.|1486|0
units.english: He stares at you for a moment, as if unsure if you're telling the truth. "What the hell are you doing here then? Did you just stumble onto this place?" He stops struggling, but the Arach agent doesn't loosen her grip.
units.italian: Ti fissa per un momento, come se non fosse sicuro che tu stia dicendo la verità. "E che diavolo ci fai qui, allora? Ci sei capitato per caso?" Smette di dimenarsi, ma l'agente Arach non allenta la presa.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|	The Saryd walks closer to the Alpha, stomping his hooves on the ground with each step. "Whatever your motivation was, a transgression, you have committed. Punished accordingly, you shall be," he says. "Kindly follow us to the detention facility, would you, Captain?" he asks you, but doesn't wait for an answer, as more agents arrive to escort you and the Alpha to the "detention facility."|1488|0
units.english: The Saryd walks closer to the Alpha, stomping his hooves on the ground with each step. "Whatever your motivation was, a transgression, you have committed. Punished accordingly, you shall be," he says. "Kindly follow us to the detention facility, would you, Captain?" he asks you, but doesn't wait for an answer, as more agents arrive to escort you and the Alpha to the "detention facility."
units.italian: Il Saryd si avvicina all'Alpha, battendo gli zoccoli a terra a ogni passo. "Qualunque fosse la tua motivazione, una trasgressione, tu hai commesso. Punito di conseguenza, tu sarai," dice. "Seguici gentilmente alla struttura di detenzione, vorresti, capitano?" chiede a te, ma non aspetta una risposta, mentre altri agenti arrivano per scortare te e l'Alpha alla "struttura di detenzione".

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|	On your way there, you start feeling stings on your arms and legs, and realize the Alpha's tackle left you with some bruises. "Treat those, we will, after faced trial, your aggressor has," the Saryd says as you approach your destination: a building similar to a police station. The Alpha is brought before a Kimek that you guess is in charge of the facility. He asks you to give a testimony of what happened, with the Heliarch agents confirming what you say. "Your first offense in a long time this is, Alitis," the Kimek says, after checking a computer for the Alpha's data. "Three years in seclusion, your sentence is."|1489|0
units.english: On your way there, you start feeling stings on your arms and legs, and realize the Alpha's tackle left you with some bruises. "Treat those, we will, after faced trial, your aggressor has," the Saryd says as you approach your destination: a building similar to a police station. The Alpha is brought before a Kimek that you guess is in charge of the facility. He asks you to give a testimony of what happened, with the Heliarch agents confirming what you say. "Your first offense in a long time this is, Alitis," the Kimek says, after checking a computer for the Alpha's data. "Three years in seclusion, your sentence is."
units.italian: Mentre andate, cominci a sentire delle fitte alle braccia e alle gambe, e ti rendi conto che il placcaggio dell'Alpha ti ha lasciato qualche livido. "Curare quelle, noi lo faremo, dopo che affrontato il processo, il tuo aggressore avrà," dice il Saryd mentre vi avvicinate alla destinazione: un edificio simile a un posto di polizia. L'Alpha viene portato davanti a un Kimek che supponi sia il responsabile della struttura. Ti chiede di testimoniare quello che è successo, con gli agenti Heliarchs che confermano quello che dici. "La tua prima infrazione da molto tempo questa è, Alitis," dice il Kimek, dopo aver controllato i dati dell'Alpha su un computer. "Tre anni in isolamento, la tua condanna è."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|	After the short verdict, which seems to lack much of the due process you would expect in human space, the agents bring both you and the Alpha to a lower level of the building. This floor has several empty cells kept shut by thick, tough walls of some transparent material. While the cell block does appear to go further beyond this section and around a corner, the first few cells appear to be directly opposite a modest medical space, presumably used mostly for treating any injured prisoners without leaving the secure level. At present though, all of the cells appear to be empty, and the Heliarchs simply lock him in the second cell, where accessing his would not obstruct any other doorways. The agents then ask that you wait a few minutes for a medic to arrive so that they can take care of your bruises.|1490|0
units.english: After the short verdict, which seems to lack much of the due process you would expect in human space, the agents bring both you and the Alpha to a lower level of the building. This floor has several empty cells kept shut by thick, tough walls of some transparent material. While the cell block does appear to go further beyond this section and around a corner, the first few cells appear to be directly opposite a modest medical space, presumably used mostly for treating any injured prisoners without leaving the secure level. At present though, all of the cells appear to be empty, and the Heliarchs simply lock him in the second cell, where accessing his would not obstruct any other doorways. The agents then ask that you wait a few minutes for a medic to arrive so that they can take care of your bruises.
units.italian: Dopo il breve verdetto, che sembra mancare di molto del giusto processo che ti aspetteresti nello spazio umano, gli agenti portano te e l'Alpha a un livello inferiore dell'edificio. Questo piano ha diverse celle vuote tenute chiuse da spesse e robuste pareti di un materiale trasparente. Anche se il blocco delle celle sembra proseguire oltre questa sezione e girando un angolo, le prime celle sembrano essere direttamente di fronte a uno spazio medico modesto, presumibilmente usato soprattutto per curare i prigionieri feriti senza lasciare il livello di sicurezza. Al momento, però, tutte le celle sembrano vuote, e gli Heliarchs si limitano a chiuderlo nella seconda cella, dove l'accesso alla sua non ostruisce nessun altro passaggio. Gli agenti poi chiedono di aspettare qualche minuto l'arrivo di un medico perché possano occuparsi dei tuoi lividi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|	You notice that cut into the transparent material of the walls are a series of small holes at head-height with a cover that can be slid across them, presumably to silence a prisoner if needed. By default, they appear to be left open, and the Heliarch agents have not closed the one on the Alpha's cell.|1491|0
units.english: You notice that cut into the transparent material of the walls are a series of small holes at head-height with a cover that can be slid across them, presumably to silence a prisoner if needed. By default, they appear to be left open, and the Heliarch agents have not closed the one on the Alpha's cell.
units.italian: Noti che nel materiale trasparente delle pareti sono ricavati una serie di piccoli fori all'altezza della testa, con un coperchio che può essere fatto scorrere, presumibilmente per mettere a tacere un prigioniero se necessario. Per default sembrano lasciati aperti, e gli agenti Heliarchs non hanno chiuso quello della cella dell'Alpha.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|	Your eyes shift from the holes in the wall to the Alpha to find his eyes fixated on you, not looking away or even blinking. After you stare him down for a couple of seconds, he speaks up. "What is it, are you expecting some sort of apology? I'd consider my caution to be entirely justified, so you won't get one."|1492|0
units.english: Your eyes shift from the holes in the wall to the Alpha to find his eyes fixated on you, not looking away or even blinking. After you stare him down for a couple of seconds, he speaks up. "What is it, are you expecting some sort of apology? I'd consider my caution to be entirely justified, so you won't get one."
units.italian: Il tuo sguardo passa dai fori nella parete all'Alpha, e trovi i suoi occhi fissi su di te, che non si distolgono né sbattono le palpebre. Dopo che lo fissi per un paio di secondi, lui parla. "Che c'è, ti aspetti qualche scusa? Considererei la mia prudenza del tutto giustificata, quindi non ne avrai."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|	"Who are you? How did you even get here?"|1494|0
units.english: "Who are you? How did you even get here?"
units.italian: "Chi sei? Come sei arrivato qui?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|	"What are you doing here in the Coalition?"|1495|0
units.english: "What are you doing here in the Coalition?"
units.italian: "Che ci fai qui nella Coalizione?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|	He frowns at you. "I don't owe you any answers, cur. Shut up and wait for the law to bring the frail princess some band-aids and a lollipop."|1496|0
units.english: He frowns at you. "I don't owe you any answers, cur. Shut up and wait for the law to bring the frail princess some band-aids and a lollipop."
units.italian: Ti guarda accigliato. "Non ti devo nessuna risposta, bastardo. Sta' zitto e aspetta che la legge porti alla fragile principessina dei cerotti e un lecca-lecca."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|	"Are you so busy in that empty cell that you can't answer me?"|1498|0
units.english: "Are you so busy in that empty cell that you can't answer me?"
units.italian: "Sei così impegnato in quella cella vuota da non poter rispondere?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|	"Tough talk for someone who wrestled a spider and lost."|1499|0
units.english: "Tough talk for someone who wrestled a spider and lost."
units.italian: "Parole grosse per uno che ha lottato con un ragno e ha perso."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|	He leans forward, his legs twitching as if stopped mid-tackle, and he pauses, turning to look down the hallway to where the Heliarchs went. He backs up, slowing his breathing, and then sits down. "Alright. This may be the last time in three years I can have a proper conversation, so I will entertain you. My name... is Alitis. Over a century ago my kin stumbled upon an alien civilization beyond the Far North in conflict with bands of invaders. These invaders possessed drives capable of jumping between systems without the need for hyperspace links, technology that we greatly desired, for it could put us far outside of the reach of... you." He fixates his eyes on yours, ever so slightly closing his eyelids. "We explored the far reaches of the galaxy to the east, but found no place to call home. Our only choice was to return to the Dirt Belt where we knew of an enclave of more kin, only for the Navy," he spits on the ground, then looks at you again, "to find us. We evacuated, and my kin thought it wise to return to the east, but I knew better. I stole one of the drives my kin had along with a small ship and began traveling west. That is when I discovered the Coalition, and they have provided for me a home that I have been unable to find elsewhere in the galaxy."|1500|0
units.english: He leans forward, his legs twitching as if stopped mid-tackle, and he pauses, turning to look down the hallway to where the Heliarchs went. He backs up, slowing his breathing, and then sits down. "Alright. This may be the last time in three years I can have a proper conversation, so I will entertain you. My name... is Alitis. Over a century ago my kin stumbled upon an alien civilization beyond the Far North in conflict with bands of invaders. These invaders possessed drives capable of jumping between systems without the need for hyperspace links, technology that we greatly desired, for it could put us far outside of the reach of... you." He fixates his eyes on yours, ever so slightly closing his eyelids. "We explored the far reaches of the galaxy to the east, but found no place to call home. Our only choice was to return to the Dirt Belt where we knew of an enclave of more kin, only for the Navy," he spits on the ground, then looks at you again, "to find us. We evacuated, and my kin thought it wise to return to the east, but I knew better. I stole one of the drives my kin had along with a small ship and began traveling west. That is when I discovered the Coalition, and they have provided for me a home that I have been unable to find elsewhere in the galaxy."
units.italian: Si sporge in avanti, le gambe che fremono come se fosse fermato a metà di un placcaggio, e si ferma, voltandosi a guardare lungo il corridoio dove sono andati gli Heliarchs. Indietreggia, rallentando il respiro, poi si siede. "Va bene. Questa potrebbe essere l'ultima volta in tre anni che posso avere una conversazione decente, quindi ti intratterrò. Il mio nome... è Alitis. Più di un secolo fa i miei simili si imbatterono in una civiltà aliena oltre il Nord Lontano, in conflitto con bande di invasori. Questi invasori possedevano motori capaci di saltare tra i sistemi senza bisogno di collegamenti iperspaziali, una tecnologia che desideravamo molto, perché poteva metterci ben fuori dalla portata di... voi." Fissa i suoi occhi nei tuoi, chiudendo impercettibilmente le palpebre. "Esplorammo i confini estremi della galassia a est, ma non trovammo un posto da chiamare casa. La nostra unica scelta fu tornare nella Fascia di Terra, dove sapevamo di un'enclave di altri simili, solo perché la Marina," sputa a terra, poi ti guarda di nuovo, "ci trovasse. Ci siamo evacuati, e i miei simili pensarono fosse saggio tornare a est, ma io sapevo di meglio. Rubai uno dei motori che i miei simili avevano, insieme a una piccola nave, e cominciai a viaggiare verso ovest. Fu allora che scoprii la Coalizione, e loro mi hanno offerto una casa che non sono riuscito a trovare altrove nella galassia."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|	"You 'knew better?' What do you mean?"|1502|0
units.english: "You 'knew better?' What do you mean?"
units.italian: "Tu 'sapevi di meglio'? Che vuoi dire?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|	"What, did you have a change of heart once you got here?"|1503|0
units.english: "What, did you have a change of heart once you got here?"
units.italian: "Cosa, ti sei ricreduto una volta arrivato qui?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|	He gets up in a rush. "Full of questions, aren't you?" He approaches the wall again, in slow steps. "I was among the first of my kind. Athis, I was called then. I have traveled the galaxy for many centuries and witnessed many things. I have been ambushed, cornered many times; fear was not a stranger to me, for as soulless as your kind see me, we still feel. But when I traveled to the east, someone, or... something, rather, spoke to me. A voice with an immense weight. And for the first time, I felt something more than fear. I felt dread. So when my kin decided to return to the east, I was not so inclined to return with them."|1504|0
units.english: He gets up in a rush. "Full of questions, aren't you?" He approaches the wall again, in slow steps. "I was among the first of my kind. Athis, I was called then. I have traveled the galaxy for many centuries and witnessed many things. I have been ambushed, cornered many times; fear was not a stranger to me, for as soulless as your kind see me, we still feel. But when I traveled to the east, someone, or... something, rather, spoke to me. A voice with an immense weight. And for the first time, I felt something more than fear. I felt dread. So when my kin decided to return to the east, I was not so inclined to return with them."
units.italian: Si alza di scatto. "Pieno di domande, eh?" Si avvicina di nuovo alla parete, a passi lenti. "Ero tra i primi della mia specie. Athis, mi chiamavo allora. Ho viaggiato per la galassia per molti secoli e ho visto molte cose. Sono stato vittima di imboscate, accerchiato molte volte; la paura non mi era estranea, perché per quanto senza anima la tua specie mi veda, proviamo comunque qualcosa. Ma quando viaggiai verso est, qualcuno, o... qualcosa, mi parlò. Una voce con un peso immenso. E per la prima volta sentii qualcosa di più della paura. Sentii terrore. Quindi quando i miei simili decisero di tornare a est, non fui così incline a tornare con loro."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|	"Voices in your head? Are you sure you weren't just imagining them?"|1506|0
units.english: "Voices in your head? Are you sure you weren't just imagining them?"
units.italian: "Voci nella tua testa? Sei sicuro di non essertele immaginate?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|	"What did the voice say?"|1508|0
units.english: "What did the voice say?"
units.italian: "Cos'ha detto la voce?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|	He looks away from you. "You're here now, aren't you? This means you must have a device to jump beyond links as I did. Travel to the east and find out for yourself what the voices say. Find out if it classifies you as 'disposable' as well."|1509|0
units.english: He looks away from you. "You're here now, aren't you? This means you must have a device to jump beyond links as I did. Travel to the east and find out for yourself what the voices say. Find out if it classifies you as 'disposable' as well."
units.italian: Distoglie lo sguardo da te. "Tu sei qui adesso, no? Questo significa che devi avere un dispositivo per saltare oltre i collegamenti come ho fatto io. Viaggia verso est e scopri da te cosa dicono le voci. Scopri se anche te classifica come 'usa e getta'."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|	He looks away from you. "No imaginary thing could have such an impact on me. You're here now, aren't you? This means you must have a device to jump beyond links as I did. Travel to the east and find out for yourself that the voices are real."|1512|0
units.english: He looks away from you. "No imaginary thing could have such an impact on me. You're here now, aren't you? This means you must have a device to jump beyond links as I did. Travel to the east and find out for yourself that the voices are real."
units.italian: Distoglie lo sguardo da te. "Nessuna cosa immaginaria potrebbe avere un impatto del genere su di me. Tu sei qui adesso, no? Questo significa che devi avere un dispositivo per saltare oltre i collegamenti come ho fatto io. Viaggia verso est e scopri da te che le voci sono reali."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Alpha Encounter|	The Heliarchs inform you that the medic has arrived, and bring you further down the hallway to a room where they treat your bruises. They examine you briefly, then give you a tube with a thick liquid, almost like a gel, asking that you gently apply it on your wounds. Once you're done, they tell you that the pain should wear off within a few minutes, and an agent escorts you back out. Passing by his cell again, you see Alitis still standing with his back to the hallway, looking straight at the wall. The agent brings you to your ship, and thanks you for your cooperation.|1514|0
units.english: The Heliarchs inform you that the medic has arrived, and bring you further down the hallway to a room where they treat your bruises. They examine you briefly, then give you a tube with a thick liquid, almost like a gel, asking that you gently apply it on your wounds. Once you're done, they tell you that the pain should wear off within a few minutes, and an agent escorts you back out. Passing by his cell again, you see Alitis still standing with his back to the hallway, looking straight at the wall. The agent brings you to your ship, and thanks you for your cooperation.
units.italian: Gli Heliarchs ti informano che il medico è arrivato, e ti portano più avanti lungo il corridoio in una stanza dove curano i tuoi lividi. Ti visitano brevemente, poi ti danno un tubetto con un liquido denso, quasi un gel, chiedendoti di applicarlo delicatamente sulle ferite. Quando hai finito, ti dicono che il dolore dovrebbe passare entro qualche minuto, e un agente ti scorta fuori. Passando di nuovo davanti alla sua cella, vedi Alitis ancora in piedi con le spalle al corridoio, che guarda dritto verso la parete. L'agente ti porta alla nave e ti ringrazia per la collaborazione.

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|name|1522|0
units.english: Transport Saryd Scientist
units.italian: Trasporta uno scienziato Saryd

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|description|1523|0
units.english: Starlit University on <planet> is hosting a seminar on xenology. Transport a guest speaker there by <date>. Payment is <payment>.
units.italian: La Starlit University su <planet> ospita un seminario di xenologia. Trasporta lì un relatore ospite entro <date>. Il pagamento è <payment>.

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|As you exit a restaurant in the spaceport, you notice a rumpled-looking Saryd staring at you. Attention from others is not new for you in Coalition space, as you are quite an unusual sight here. You don't pay him much mind until he begins to gallop toward you, hailing you down.|1533|0
units.english: As you exit a restaurant in the spaceport, you notice a rumpled-looking Saryd staring at you. Attention from others is not new for you in Coalition space, as you are quite an unusual sight here. You don't pay him much mind until he begins to gallop toward you, hailing you down.
units.italian: Mentre esci da un ristorante nello spazioporto, noti un Saryd dall'aria sgualcita che ti fissa. L'attenzione degli altri non è una novità per te nello spazio della Coalizione, dato che qui sei uno spettacolo piuttosto insolito. Non ci fai molto caso finché non comincia a galoppare verso di te, chiamandoti.

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Captain! Excited to finally meet you, I am. Heard of the human in our space, I have, but to see you myself, special it is."|1534|0
units.english: "Captain! Excited to finally meet you, I am. Heard of the human in our space, I have, but to see you myself, special it is."
units.italian: "Capitano! Eccitato di incontrarvi finalmente, io sono. Sentito dell'umano nel nostro spazio, io ho, ma vedere voi di persona, speciale è."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"A scientist, I am, and invited to speak at a university seminar, I have been. Be there by <date>, I must. The honor of transporting me to <planet>, will you give me?"|1535|0
units.english: "A scientist, I am, and invited to speak at a university seminar, I have been. Be there by <date>, I must. The honor of transporting me to <planet>, will you give me?"
units.italian: "Uno scienziato, io sono, e invitato a parlare a un seminario universitario, sono stato. Essere lì entro <date>, io devo. L'onore di trasportarmi su <planet>, me lo concedete?"

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"What is the seminar about?"|1537|0
units.english: "What is the seminar about?"
units.italian: "Di cosa parla il seminario?"

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Sure, I'd be glad to transport you."|1539|0
units.english: "Sure, I'd be glad to transport you."
units.italian: "Certo, sarò felice di trasportarti."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Sorry, I can't take transport jobs right now."|1541|0
units.english: "Sorry, I can't take transport jobs right now."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, al momento non posso prendere lavori di trasporto."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"A xenologist, I am. Alien cultures outside of the Coalition, I study, and the topic of the seminar, it is. Invited to give lectures on the subject, I have been. Take me there, will you?"|1544|0
units.english: "A xenologist, I am. Alien cultures outside of the Coalition, I study, and the topic of the seminar, it is. Invited to give lectures on the subject, I have been. Take me there, will you?"
units.italian: "Uno xenologo, io sono. Le culture aliene fuori dalla Coalizione, io studio, e il tema del seminario, è. Invitato a tenere lezioni sull'argomento, sono stato. Portarmi lì, volete?"

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Sure, I'd be glad to transport you."|1546|0
units.english: "Sure, I'd be glad to transport you."
units.italian: "Certo, sarò felice di trasportarti."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Sorry, I can't take transport jobs right now."|1547|0
units.english: "Sorry, I can't take transport jobs right now."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, al momento non posso prendere lavori di trasporto."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Thank you! Aelbris, my name is. To be late I do not wish, as not recorded, the event is." He soon gathers his things and boards your ship.|1550|0
units.english: "Thank you! Aelbris, my name is. To be late I do not wish, as not recorded, the event is." He soon gathers his things and boards your ship.
units.italian: "Grazie! Aelbris, il mio nome è. In ritardo non voglio essere, dato che non registrato, l'evento è." Poco dopo raccoglie le sue cose e sale sulla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|dialog|1553|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Aelbris hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Aelbris non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|During the trip, Aelbris was polite, if a bit intrusive in his questions about your homeworld. You answered as best you could, though at times you struggled to understand what was even being asked. Once you and your passenger depart from your ship, he turns around.|1558|0
units.english: During the trip, Aelbris was polite, if a bit intrusive in his questions about your homeworld. You answered as best you could, though at times you struggled to understand what was even being asked. Once you and your passenger depart from your ship, he turns around.
units.italian: Durante il viaggio Aelbris è stato cortese, seppure un po' invadente nelle domande sul tuo mondo d'origine. Hai risposto come meglio potevi, anche se a volte facevi fatica a capire cosa ti venisse chiesto. Una volta che tu e il tuo passeggero scendete dalla nave, lui si volta.

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Captain, that you must be very busy, I realize, but wondering if you could stay for the seminar, I was. You see, studying human space for years, I have been, but actually met a human, I had not. A great boon to our field to have a human guest speaker, it would be."|1559|0
units.english: "Captain, that you must be very busy, I realize, but wondering if you could stay for the seminar, I was. You see, studying human space for years, I have been, but actually met a human, I had not. A great boon to our field to have a human guest speaker, it would be."
units.italian: "Capitano, che voi dobbiate essere molto impegnato, me ne rendo conto, ma chiedermi se potevate restare per il seminario, io volevo. Vedete, studiare lo spazio umano per anni, io l'ho fatto, ma incontrare davvero un umano, non mi era capitato. Un grande vantaggio per il nostro campo avere un ospite umano, sarebbe."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"What do I have to do there?"|1561|0
units.english: "What do I have to do there?"
units.italian: "Cosa devo fare lì?"

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"I don't think that I'd be a good representative of humanity."|1563|0
units.english: "I don't think that I'd be a good representative of humanity."
units.italian: "Non credo che sarei un buon rappresentante dell'umanità."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"How do you manage to study humanity without meeting any humans?"|1565|0
units.english: "How do you manage to study humanity without meeting any humans?"
units.italian: "Come fate a studiare l'umanità senza aver mai incontrato un umano?"

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Sure, I'd be glad to."|1567|0
units.english: "Sure, I'd be glad to."
units.italian: "Certo, ne sarei felice."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Sorry, I don't have time."|1569|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't have time."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non ho tempo."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Answering some questions from the attendees, would you be comfortable with? Simple, they would be, about aspects of human society, physical structure, and the like, they would pertain to."|1572|0
units.english: "Answering some questions from the attendees, would you be comfortable with? Simple, they would be, about aspects of human society, physical structure, and the like, they would pertain to."
units.italian: "Rispondere ad alcune domande del pubblico, vi sentireste a vostro agio? Semplici, sarebbero, su aspetti della società umana, della struttura fisica e simili, riguarderebbero."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Nonsense! Travel the galaxy, you do. A most knowledgeable individual, surely you must be. Accept my offer, will you?"|1575|0
units.english: "Nonsense! Travel the galaxy, you do. A most knowledgeable individual, surely you must be. Accept my offer, will you?"
units.italian: "Sciocchezze! Viaggiate per la galassia, voi. Un individuo molto preparato, sicuramente dovete essere. Accettate la mia offerta, volete?"

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Contact with a human world, Heliarchs have. Some documents on humanity, the government there gave. Shared their knowledge with civilian researchers, the Heliarchs have, so analyze the info, we do, so that understand humans better, we may."|1578|0
units.english: "Contact with a human world, Heliarchs have. Some documents on humanity, the government there gave. Shared their knowledge with civilian researchers, the Heliarchs have, so analyze the info, we do, so that understand humans better, we may."
units.italian: "Contatti con un mondo umano, gli Heliarchs hanno avuto. Alcuni documenti sull'umanità, il governo di là ha dato. Condiviso le loro conoscenze con i ricercatori civili, gli Heliarchs hanno, quindi analizziamo le informazioni, noi, così che capire meglio gli umani, possiamo."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|label|1579|0
units.english: choose to stay
units.italian: choose to stay

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Sure, I'd be glad to."|1581|0
units.english: "Sure, I'd be glad to."
units.italian: "Certo, ne sarei felice."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Sorry, I don't have time."|1583|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't have time."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non ho tempo."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Thank you! A great honor, you have done our field of study." He motions you to follow him.|1586|0
units.english: "Thank you! A great honor, you have done our field of study." He motions you to follow him.
units.italian: "Grazie! Un grande onore, avete fatto al nostro campo di studi." Ti fa segno di seguirlo.

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	You and the Saryd take a train from the city to the base of a mountain. "Secluded, Starlit University is, so direct transportation, there is none," he explains. Instead, he leads you to a steep trail that presumably takes you to the conference. You notice that a small lift is installed along the trail, but it seems to be used exclusively by the elderly and infirm.|1587|0
units.english: You and the Saryd take a train from the city to the base of a mountain. "Secluded, Starlit University is, so direct transportation, there is none," he explains. Instead, he leads you to a steep trail that presumably takes you to the conference. You notice that a small lift is installed along the trail, but it seems to be used exclusively by the elderly and infirm.
units.italian: Tu e il Saryd prendete un treno dalla città fino alla base di una montagna. "Isolata, la Starlit University è, quindi trasporto diretto, non c'è," spiega. Invece ti guida su un sentiero ripido che presumibilmente porta alla conferenza. Noti che lungo il sentiero è installato un piccolo ascensore, ma sembra usato esclusivamente da anziani e infermi.

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	After a long hike that takes the better part of the afternoon, you approach a collection of gleaming buildings. One of them has a few scientists and students, with Heliarchs guarding the entrance.|1588|0
units.english: After a long hike that takes the better part of the afternoon, you approach a collection of gleaming buildings. One of them has a few scientists and students, with Heliarchs guarding the entrance.
units.italian: Dopo una lunga camminata che occupa buona parte del pomeriggio, ti avvicini a un gruppo di edifici scintillanti. Uno di questi ospita alcuni scienziati e studenti, con Heliarchs a guardia dell'ingresso.

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	You enter a small, dusty room where some scientists from the three Coalition species prepare their lectures. Your entrance immediately causes a stir, and several turn to look at you. Aelbris beams as he shows you to your table. You note the presence of several Heliarchs in attendance as well.|1589|0
units.english: You enter a small, dusty room where some scientists from the three Coalition species prepare their lectures. Your entrance immediately causes a stir, and several turn to look at you. Aelbris beams as he shows you to your table. You note the presence of several Heliarchs in attendance as well.
units.italian: Entri in una stanza piccola e polverosa dove alcuni scienziati delle tre specie della Coalizione preparano le loro lezioni. Il tuo ingresso provoca subito un certo trambusto, e diversi si voltano a guardarti. Aelbris raggiante ti accompagna al tuo tavolo. Noti anche la presenza di diversi Heliarchs tra il pubblico.

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Ah, work closely with the Heliarchs, we do," Aelbris explains. "Share information with them and inform them of our conclusions, so that better informed about possible threats and opportunities, they are."|1590|0
units.english: "Ah, work closely with the Heliarchs, we do," Aelbris explains. "Share information with them and inform them of our conclusions, so that better informed about possible threats and opportunities, they are."
units.italian: "Ah, lavorare a stretto contatto con gli Heliarchs, noi lo facciamo," spiega Aelbris. "Condividere informazioni con loro e informarli delle nostre conclusioni, così che meglio informati su possibili minacce e opportunità, loro siano."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Now, unplanned, your visit is, so consult with the seminar organizers, I must." He brings out a small box that projects a holograph of an Arach Heliarch once turned on. Aelbris begins a conversation with him, but you cannot hear much of it; Aelbris makes an effort to keep his voice down in order to not disturb the other guests.|1591|0
units.english: "Now, unplanned, your visit is, so consult with the seminar organizers, I must." He brings out a small box that projects a holograph of an Arach Heliarch once turned on. Aelbris begins a conversation with him, but you cannot hear much of it; Aelbris makes an effort to keep his voice down in order to not disturb the other guests.
units.italian: "Ora, non programmata, la tua visita è, quindi consultarmi con gli organizzatori del seminario, io devo." Tira fuori una piccola scatola che, una volta accesa, proietta l'ologramma di un Heliarch Arach. Aelbris comincia una conversazione con lui, ma non riesci a sentirne molto; Aelbris si sforza di tenere bassa la voce per non disturbare gli altri ospiti.

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	You wait for a while, until a Kimek walks up to the stage in front. The box's volume is much louder than normal, and you can easily hear what is being said.|1592|0
units.english: You wait for a while, until a Kimek walks up to the stage in front. The box's volume is much louder than normal, and you can easily hear what is being said.
units.italian: Aspetti per un po', finché un Kimek non sale sul palco davanti. Il volume della scatola è molto più alto del normale, e riesci a sentire facilmente quello che viene detto.

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Pleased to announce that the 103rd Xenology Seminar, generously hosted by Starlit University, is now in session, I am. Noticed as you may have, in the presence of a very... unusual guest, we are. The honor of having <first> <last> answer some questions at the end of today's seminar, we will have." The Kimek gestures to you as Aelbris sits down at your table.|1593|0
units.english: "Pleased to announce that the 103rd Xenology Seminar, generously hosted by Starlit University, is now in session, I am. Noticed as you may have, in the presence of a very... unusual guest, we are. The honor of having <first> <last> answer some questions at the end of today's seminar, we will have." The Kimek gestures to you as Aelbris sits down at your table.
units.italian: "Lieto di annunciare che il centotreesimo Seminario di Xenologia, generosamente ospitato dalla Starlit University, è ora in sessione, io sono. Come avrete notato, in presenza di un ospite molto... insolito, noi siamo. L'onore di avere <first> <last> rispondere ad alcune domande alla fine del seminario di oggi, noi avremo." Il Kimek ti indica mentre Aelbris si siede al tuo tavolo.

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	The first speaker, another Kimek, talks about human farming methods as they compare to other members of the Coalition. You see him cite information from a modified data chip that appears to contain documents from the Library of Alexandria.|1594|0
units.english: The first speaker, another Kimek, talks about human farming methods as they compare to other members of the Coalition. You see him cite information from a modified data chip that appears to contain documents from the Library of Alexandria.
units.italian: Il primo relatore, un altro Kimek, parla dei metodi agricoli umani rispetto a quelli degli altri membri della Coalizione. Lo vedi citare informazioni da un chip dati modificato che sembra contenere documenti della Biblioteca di Alessandria.

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	The seminar goes on for some time. A Saryd gives a surprisingly accurate lecture on the human body. An Arach goes into detail explaining the technological level of human ships. Once all the speakers have finished, Aelbris informs you that it is now your turn to answer their questions.|1595|0
units.english: The seminar goes on for some time. A Saryd gives a surprisingly accurate lecture on the human body. An Arach goes into detail explaining the technological level of human ships. Once all the speakers have finished, Aelbris informs you that it is now your turn to answer their questions.
units.italian: Il seminario va avanti per un po'. Un Saryd tiene una lezione sorprendentemente accurata sul corpo umano. Un Arach entra nei dettagli spiegando il livello tecnologico delle navi umane. Quando tutti i relatori hanno finito, Aelbris ti informa che ora tocca a te rispondere alle loro domande.

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Alright, let's go!"|1597|0
units.english: "Alright, let's go!"
units.italian: "Va bene, andiamo!"

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"I don't want to do this anymore."|1599|0
units.english: "I don't want to do this anymore."
units.italian: "Non voglio più farlo."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"To answer their questions, if you really don't want, I can't stop you, I suppose." Aelbris says with a sigh.|1602|0
units.english: "To answer their questions, if you really don't want, I can't stop you, I suppose." Aelbris says with a sigh.
units.italian: "Alle loro domande, se davvero non vuoi, non posso impedirtelo, suppongo." dice Aelbris con un sospiro.
