units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	As soon as you walk up to the stage, several scientists in the crowd stand up out of their chairs. The Arach Heliarch comes up to you on the stage, and explains that this is their way of asking questions. She selects a Saryd from the crowd.|1605|0
units.english: As soon as you walk up to the stage, several scientists in the crowd stand up out of their chairs. The Arach Heliarch comes up to you on the stage, and explains that this is their way of asking questions. She selects a Saryd from the crowd.
units.italian: Appena sali sul palco, diversi scienziati tra il pubblico si alzano dalle sedie. L'Heliarch Arach ti si avvicina sul palco e spiega che è il loro modo di fare domande. Sceglie un Saryd tra la folla.

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"What is the extent of contact that humans have with other aliens?"|1606|0
units.english: "What is the extent of contact that humans have with other aliens?"
units.italian: "Qual è l'estensione dei contatti che gli umani hanno con altri alieni?"

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Humans are in contact with the Hai. Some of them even live on Hai planets. They live to the north of human space, and we can visit them through a wormhole."|1608|0
units.english: "Humans are in contact with the Hai. Some of them even live on Hai planets. They live to the north of human space, and we can visit them through a wormhole."
units.italian: "Gli umani sono in contatto con gli Hai. Alcuni di loro vivono persino su pianeti Hai. Vivono a nord dello spazio umano, e possiamo visitarli attraverso un cunicolo."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"A few humans know about the Hai, but there's no official acknowledgment of their existence. They live to the north of human space, and we can visit them through a wormhole."|1612|0
units.english: "A few humans know about the Hai, but there's no official acknowledgment of their existence. They live to the north of human space, and we can visit them through a wormhole."
units.italian: "Pochi umani sanno degli Hai, ma non c'è alcun riconoscimento ufficiale della loro esistenza. Vivono a nord dello spazio umano, e possiamo visitarli attraverso un cunicolo."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Humans have official contact with the Quarg, but the Quarg don't trade technology with humanity."|1616|0
units.english: "Humans have official contact with the Quarg, but the Quarg don't trade technology with humanity."
units.italian: "Gli umani hanno contatti ufficiali con i Quarg, ma i Quarg non commerciano tecnologia con l'umanità."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Humans have official contact with the Quarg, but humans and Quarg don't really intermix."|1617|0
units.english: "Humans have official contact with the Quarg, but humans and Quarg don't really intermix."
units.italian: "Gli umani hanno contatti ufficiali con i Quarg, ma umani e Quarg non si mescolano davvero."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Humans know about the Quarg, but most people know little about them."|1618|0
units.english: "Humans know about the Quarg, but most people know little about them."
units.italian: "Gli umani sanno dei Quarg, ma la maggior parte della gente ne sa poco."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	The audience response is muted. You get the impression that you haven't told them anything they don't already know.|1619|0
units.english: The audience response is muted. You get the impression that you haven't told them anything they don't already know.
units.italian: La reazione del pubblico è tiepida. Hai l'impressione di non aver detto niente che non sapessero già.

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	Several members of the audience are delighted. "Unknown to us, this species is," says the Heliarch. "That you have made contact with them despite the Quarg, good news it is."|1624|0
units.english: Several members of the audience are delighted. "Unknown to us, this species is," says the Heliarch. "That you have made contact with them despite the Quarg, good news it is."
units.italian: Diversi membri del pubblico sono entusiasti. "Sconosciuta a noi, questa specie è," dice l'Heliarch. "Che abbiate preso contatto con loro nonostante i Quarg, una buona notizia è."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	Several members of the audience are delighted. "Ah, the Hai, we have heard of," says the Heliarch. "That you have made contact with them despite the Quarg, good news it is."|1627|0
units.english: Several members of the audience are delighted. "Ah, the Hai, we have heard of," says the Heliarch. "That you have made contact with them despite the Quarg, good news it is."
units.italian: Diversi membri del pubblico sono entusiasti. "Ah, gli Hai, ne abbiamo sentito parlare," dice l'Heliarch. "Che abbiate preso contatto con loro nonostante i Quarg, una buona notizia è."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Tell us more of them, could you?" asks another scientist.|1630|0
units.english: "Tell us more of them, could you?" asks another scientist.
units.italian: "Raccontarci di più su di loro, potreste?" chiede un altro scienziato.

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	As you open your mouth to speak, the Heliarch cuts you off. "Enough questions on the Hai, we have." The crowd looks disappointed at this development.|1631|0
units.english: As you open your mouth to speak, the Heliarch cuts you off. "Enough questions on the Hai, we have." The crowd looks disappointed at this development.
units.italian: Mentre apri la bocca per parlare, l'Heliarch ti interrompe. "Basta domande sugli Hai, ne abbiamo." La folla sembra delusa da questo sviluppo.

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|label|1632|0
units.english: next question
units.italian: next question

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	The Arach selects another, this time a Kimek. "All of human space, united politically is it?"|1633|0
units.english: The Arach selects another, this time a Kimek. "All of human space, united politically is it?"
units.italian: L'Arach ne sceglie un altro, questa volta un Kimek. "Tutto lo spazio umano, politicamente unito è?"

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"No, human space is split between the Republic in the north and the Free Worlds in the south."|1635|0
units.english: "No, human space is split between the Republic in the north and the Free Worlds in the south."
units.italian: "No, lo spazio umano è diviso tra la Repubblica a nord e i Mondi Liberi a sud."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"No, human space is split between the Republic in the west, the Free Worlds in the south, and the Syndicate in the east. The Syndicate is technically part of the Republic, but they have a lot of autonomy."|1639|0
units.english: "No, human space is split between the Republic in the west, the Free Worlds in the south, and the Syndicate in the east. The Syndicate is technically part of the Republic, but they have a lot of autonomy."
units.italian: "No, lo spazio umano è diviso tra la Repubblica a ovest, i Mondi Liberi a sud e il Sindacato a est. Il Sindacato fa tecnicamente parte della Repubblica, ma gode di molta autonomia."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Yes, all of human space is united under the Republic."|1643|0
units.english: "Yes, all of human space is united under the Republic."
units.italian: "Sì, tutto lo spazio umano è unito sotto la Repubblica."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Yes, but there are internal subdivisions: the Free Worlds in the south, the Republic in the north, and the Syndicate in the east."|1649|0
units.english: "Yes, but there are internal subdivisions: the Free Worlds in the south, the Republic in the north, and the Syndicate in the east."
units.italian: "Sì, ma ci sono suddivisioni interne: i Mondi Liberi a sud, la Repubblica a nord e il Sindacato a est."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"No. Technically all of human space is under the Republic, but the Syndicate has significant autonomy."|1652|0
units.english: "No. Technically all of human space is under the Republic, but the Syndicate has significant autonomy."
units.italian: "No. Tecnicamente tutto lo spazio umano è sotto la Repubblica, ma il Sindacato ha un'autonomia significativa."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"No. Technically all of human space is under the Republic, but the Free Worlds and Syndicate have significant autonomy."|1655|0
units.english: "No. Technically all of human space is under the Republic, but the Free Worlds and Syndicate have significant autonomy."
units.italian: "No. Tecnicamente tutto lo spazio umano è sotto la Repubblica, ma i Mondi Liberi e il Sindacato hanno un'autonomia significativa."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	As you answer the question, your translator begins to cut out. Repeating your answer does no good, as it continues to fizzle out as you talk. You look over to the Heliarch, who eyes the curious Kimek with suspicion. "Apologize for the malfunction, I must," says the Heliarch. "The next question, answer it please."|1658|0
units.english: As you answer the question, your translator begins to cut out. Repeating your answer does no good, as it continues to fizzle out as you talk. You look over to the Heliarch, who eyes the curious Kimek with suspicion. "Apologize for the malfunction, I must," says the Heliarch. "The next question, answer it please."
units.italian: Mentre rispondi alla domanda, il tuo traduttore comincia a cedere. Ripetere la risposta non serve, perché continua a sfrigolare mentre parli. Guardi l'Heliarch, che osserva con sospetto il Kimek incuriosito. "Scusarmi per il malfunzionamento, devo," dice l'Heliarch. "La prossima domanda, rispondete, per favore."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	Upon finishing your sentence, several in the crowd begin to write down notes on datapads. It appears that information on human government is new to them.|1661|0
units.english: Upon finishing your sentence, several in the crowd begin to write down notes on datapads. It appears that information on human government is new to them.
units.italian: Appena finisci la frase, diversi tra il pubblico cominciano a prendere appunti sui datapad. Sembra che le informazioni sul governo umano siano una novità per loro.

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|label|1662|0
units.english: question three
units.italian: question three

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	The Arach picks another Kimek. "Piracy in human space, how big of a problem is it?"|1663|0
units.english: The Arach picks another Kimek. "Piracy in human space, how big of a problem is it?"
units.italian: L'Arach sceglie un altro Kimek. "La pirateria nello spazio umano, quanto è un problema serio?"

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"There are entire pirate planets on the fringes of human space where warlords and criminals rule."|1665|0
units.english: "There are entire pirate planets on the fringes of human space where warlords and criminals rule."
units.italian: "Ci sono interi pianeti pirata ai margini dello spazio umano, dove comandano signori della guerra e criminali."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Piracy was a big problem in the past, but now it's a relatively minor issue."|1666|0
units.english: "Piracy was a big problem in the past, but now it's a relatively minor issue."
units.italian: "La pirateria era un problema serio in passato, ma ora è una questione relativamente secondaria."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"There are many independent worlds that are not ruled by one singular government. Some groups there support piracy, but others are peaceful."|1667|0
units.english: "There are many independent worlds that are not ruled by one singular government. Some groups there support piracy, but others are peaceful."
units.italian: "Ci sono molti mondi indipendenti che non sono governati da un unico governo. Alcuni gruppi lì sostengono la pirateria, ma altri sono pacifici."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Stamped out, may lawlessness soon be," says the Heliarch in a solemn tone of voice. She picks a Saryd for the next question.|1669|0
units.english: "Stamped out, may lawlessness soon be," says the Heliarch in a solemn tone of voice. She picks a Saryd for the next question.
units.italian: "Debellata, la mancanza di legge presto sia," dice l'Heliarch in tono solenne. Sceglie un Saryd per la domanda successiva.

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|label|1671|0
units.english: pirate good
units.italian: pirate good

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	Your microphone starts to fizzle out as you attempt to answer. The Heliarch's eight eyes are all on you, and you sense that it might not be a good idea to finish your sentence. The Heliarch selects a Saryd for the next question.|1672|0
units.english: Your microphone starts to fizzle out as you attempt to answer. The Heliarch's eight eyes are all on you, and you sense that it might not be a good idea to finish your sentence. The Heliarch selects a Saryd for the next question.
units.italian: Il tuo microfono comincia a sfrigolare mentre provi a rispondere. Gli otto occhi dell'Heliarch sono tutti su di te, e intuisci che forse non è una buona idea finire la frase. L'Heliarch sceglie un Saryd per la domanda successiva.

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|label|1673|0
units.english: question four
units.italian: question four

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"A fairly comprehensive map of human space, we have." The Saryd brings out a star map of the galactic south. "But of the core, we know not. Inform us of the galaxy, can you?"|1674|0
units.english: "A fairly comprehensive map of human space, we have." The Saryd brings out a star map of the galactic south. "But of the core, we know not. Inform us of the galaxy, can you?"
units.italian: "Una mappa abbastanza completa dello spazio umano, noi abbiamo." Il Saryd tira fuori una mappa stellare del sud galattico. "Ma del nucleo, non sappiamo. Informarci sulla galassia, potete?"

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	(Tell them about the Korath.)|1676|0
units.english: (Tell them about the Korath.)
units.italian: (Parla loro dei Korath.)

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	(Don't tell them about the Korath.)|1682|0
units.english: (Don't tell them about the Korath.)
units.italian: (Non parlare loro dei Korath.)

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Sorry, I don't know what's there any more than you do."|1687|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't know what's there any more than you do."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non so cosa ci sia là più di quanto lo sappiate voi."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Sorry, I don't know what's there any more than you do."|1691|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't know what's there any more than you do."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non so cosa ci sia là più di quanto lo sappiate voi."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	The Saryd walks away, disappointed.|1696|0
units.english: The Saryd walks away, disappointed.
units.italian: Il Saryd si allontana, deluso.

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"I've met an alien species there called the Korath," you say. "They're reptilian creatures. What's left of their planets has been ruined by infighting. The Kor Sestor and Kor Mereti have been fighting a civil war using autonomous ships. The Kor Efreti have stayed out of the civil war, living under the Quarg's protection. The Korath Exiles have been banished to the Core by the Drak for refusing to give up their ability to manufacture jump drives. They are now raiding humanity for supplies."|1699|0
units.english: "I've met an alien species there called the Korath," you say. "They're reptilian creatures. What's left of their planets has been ruined by infighting. The Kor Sestor and Kor Mereti have been fighting a civil war using autonomous ships. The Kor Efreti have stayed out of the civil war, living under the Quarg's protection. The Korath Exiles have been banished to the Core by the Drak for refusing to give up their ability to manufacture jump drives. They are now raiding humanity for supplies."
units.italian: "Ho incontrato lì una specie aliena chiamata Korath," dici. "Sono creature rettiliche. Quello che resta dei loro pianeti è stato rovinato dalle lotte intestine. I Kor Sestor e i Kor Mereti stanno combattendo una guerra civile con navi autonome. I Kor Efreti sono rimasti fuori dalla guerra civile, vivendo sotto la protezione dei Quarg. I Korath Esuli sono stati confinati nel Nucleo dai Drak per essersi rifiutati di rinunciare alla capacità di produrre motori di salto. Ora saccheggiano l'umanità per rifornirsi."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	The crowd shows considerable interest at this last part. "Knowledge of the jump drive, a species besides the Quarg possesses? Great news, this is! Our struggle against the Quarg, we do not take up alone. Possess jump drives, do any other species?" The Heliarch does not seem to mind you answering another question.|1700|0
units.english: The crowd shows considerable interest at this last part. "Knowledge of the jump drive, a species besides the Quarg possesses? Great news, this is! Our struggle against the Quarg, we do not take up alone. Possess jump drives, do any other species?" The Heliarch does not seem to mind you answering another question.
units.italian: Il pubblico mostra un interesse considerevole per quest'ultima parte. "La conoscenza del motore di salto, una specie oltre ai Quarg la possiede? Una grande notizia, questa è! La nostra lotta contro i Quarg, non la affrontiamo da soli. Possedere motori di salto, qualche altra specie lo fa?" All'Heliarch non sembra dispiacere che tu risponda a un'altra domanda.

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"There are aliens to the north of human space called the Hai. Some of them steal from the normal Hai, and try to get their hands on jump drives any way they can."|1702|0
units.english: "There are aliens to the north of human space called the Hai. Some of them steal from the normal Hai, and try to get their hands on jump drives any way they can."
units.italian: "A nord dello spazio umano ci sono alieni chiamati Hai. Alcuni di loro derubano i normali Hai e cercano di procurarsi i motori di salto in ogni modo possibile."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"There is a faction among the Hai, the Unfettered. They steal from the normal Hai, and try to get their hands on jump drives any way they can."|1709|0
units.english: "There is a faction among the Hai, the Unfettered. They steal from the normal Hai, and try to get their hands on jump drives any way they can."
units.italian: "C'è una fazione tra gli Hai, gli Unfettered. Derubano i normali Hai e cercano di procurarsi i motori di salto in ogni modo possibile."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Sorry, I don't know of any other species that does."|1716|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't know of any other species that does."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non conosco nessun'altra specie che lo faccia."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	The Heliarch speaks up against the murmurs of the crowd. "Driven to such desperation, it is unfortunate that our allies against the Quarg are. Powerful like the Coalition, hopefully one day they will be."|1719|0
units.english: The Heliarch speaks up against the murmurs of the crowd. "Driven to such desperation, it is unfortunate that our allies against the Quarg are. Powerful like the Coalition, hopefully one day they will be."
units.italian: L'Heliarch alza la voce sopra il mormorio della folla. "Spinti a una tale disperazione, purtroppo i nostri alleati contro i Quarg sono. Forti come la Coalizione, un giorno speriamo che diventino."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|label|1721|0
units.english: know unfettered
units.italian: know unfettered

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	Several members of the audience are delighted. "Unknown to us, this species is," says the Heliarch. "Powerful in their fight against the Quarg, may they become."|1722|0
units.english: Several members of the audience are delighted. "Unknown to us, this species is," says the Heliarch. "Powerful in their fight against the Quarg, may they become."
units.italian: Diversi membri del pubblico sono entusiasti. "Sconosciuta a noi, questa specie è," dice l'Heliarch. "Forti nella loro lotta contro i Quarg, che diventino."

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	The crowd's mood dampens a bit, but everyone is still quite exuberant as you leave the building. It is now night, and your eyes take a moment to adjust from the lecture hall's bright lights. Aelbris meets up with you outside, bubbling with excitement.|1725|0
units.english: The crowd's mood dampens a bit, but everyone is still quite exuberant as you leave the building. It is now night, and your eyes take a moment to adjust from the lecture hall's bright lights. Aelbris meets up with you outside, bubbling with excitement.
units.italian: L'umore della folla si raffredda un po', ma tutti sono ancora piuttosto euforici mentre lasci l'edificio. Ora è notte, e ai tuoi occhi serve un momento per adattarsi alle luci brillanti dell'aula. Aelbris ti raggiunge fuori, traboccante di eccitazione.

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	Upon the announcement of the interview's end, the crowd begins to leave. The mood is exuberant as you exit the building. It is now night, and your eyes take a moment to adjust from the lecture hall's bright lights. Aelbris meets up with you outside, bubbling with excitement.|1728|0
units.english: Upon the announcement of the interview's end, the crowd begins to leave. The mood is exuberant as you exit the building. It is now night, and your eyes take a moment to adjust from the lecture hall's bright lights. Aelbris meets up with you outside, bubbling with excitement.
units.italian: All'annuncio della fine dell'intervista, il pubblico comincia a uscire. L'umore è euforico mentre lasci l'edificio. Ora è notte, e ai tuoi occhi serve un momento per adattarsi alle luci brillanti dell'aula. Aelbris ti raggiunge fuori, traboccante di eccitazione.

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	"Thank you, captain! Expanded our knowledge greatly, you have." He leans in, quieter this time. "Strict with knowledge of humans, the Heliarchs are. Unbiased sources of information, rare they are. Hope to see you again, I do. Safe travels!"|1730|0
units.english: "Thank you, captain! Expanded our knowledge greatly, you have." He leans in, quieter this time. "Strict with knowledge of humans, the Heliarchs are. Unbiased sources of information, rare they are. Hope to see you again, I do. Safe travels!"
units.italian: "Grazie, capitano! Ampliato molto la nostra conoscenza, voi avete." Si avvicina, questa volta più piano. "Severi con le conoscenze sugli umani, gli Heliarchs sono. Fonti imparziali di informazione, rare sono. Sperare di rivedervi, io spero. Buon viaggio!"

units.id: mission:Saryd University Lecture|	After he shakes your hand, you say your goodbyes and board your ship.|1731|0
units.english: After he shakes your hand, you say your goodbyes and board your ship.
units.italian: Dopo che ti stringe la mano, vi salutate e sali sulla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 1|name|1738|0
units.english: Shrine of the World Shaper
units.italian: Santuario del Modellatore del Mondo

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 1|description|1739|0
units.english: Bring Vellorae to <destination>, where she will begin her mourning pilgrimage for her late husband.
units.italian: Porta Vellorae su <destination>, dove inizierà il suo pellegrinaggio di lutto per il marito defunto.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 1|Shortly after entering the spaceport, you catch the attention of a Saryd lady with gray, braided hair that reaches to her shoulders dragging along a single suitcase. "Hello, Captain. Taking new passengers, are you?" she asks. She shows you a piece of jewelry on her hand, a small bronze bangle with a diamond at the center. "Vellorae, my name is, and in need of a transport for a pilgrimage, I am."|1747|0
units.english: Shortly after entering the spaceport, you catch the attention of a Saryd lady with gray, braided hair that reaches to her shoulders dragging along a single suitcase. "Hello, Captain. Taking new passengers, are you?" she asks. She shows you a piece of jewelry on her hand, a small bronze bangle with a diamond at the center. "Vellorae, my name is, and in need of a transport for a pilgrimage, I am."
units.italian: Poco dopo essere entrato nello spazioporto, attiri l'attenzione di una signora Saryd con capelli grigi intrecciati che le arrivano alle spalle, che trascina una sola valigia. "Salve, capitano. Nuovi passeggeri, prendete?" chiede. Ti mostra un gioiello sulla mano, un piccolo bracciale di bronzo con un diamante al centro. "Vellorae, mi chiamo, e alla ricerca di un trasporto per un pellegrinaggio, io sono."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 1|	"Pilgrimage? What do you mean?"|1749|0
units.english: "Pilgrimage? What do you mean?"
units.italian: "Pellegrinaggio? Cosa intendi?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 1|	"Are you offering to pay me with that? I only take credits."|1750|0
units.english: "Are you offering to pay me with that? I only take credits."
units.italian: "Mi stai offrendo di pagarmi con quello? Accetto solo crediti."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 1|	"Sorry, I'm not looking to take any jobs right now."|1751|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not looking to take any jobs right now."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, al momento non cerco lavori."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 1|	She gazes at the bangle, clenching her hand as she raises it closer to her face. "The remains of my late husband, Adfices, this is. Passed away recently, he has, and visit certain sites of worship, I want to, so that wish him a safe journey, I may."|1753|0
units.english: She gazes at the bangle, clenching her hand as she raises it closer to her face. "The remains of my late husband, Adfices, this is. Passed away recently, he has, and visit certain sites of worship, I want to, so that wish him a safe journey, I may."
units.italian: Guarda il bracciale, stringendo la mano mentre lo alza vicino al viso. "I resti di mio marito defunto, Adfices, questo è. Morto di recente, lui è, e visitare alcuni luoghi di culto, io voglio, così che augurargli un viaggio sereno, io possa."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 1|	"You turned your husband into jewelry?"|1755|0
units.english: "You turned your husband into jewelry?"
units.italian: "Hai trasformato tuo marito in un gioiello?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 1|	"I'm sorry for your loss. I'd be glad to help; could you tell me where you wish to go?"|1756|0
units.english: "I'm sorry for your loss. I'd be glad to help; could you tell me where you wish to go?"
units.italian: "Mi dispiace per la tua perdita. Sarei felice di aiutarti; puoi dirmi dove vuoi andare?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 1|	"My condolences, but I'm not looking to take more jobs right now."|1758|0
units.english: "My condolences, but I'm not looking to take more jobs right now."
units.italian: "Le mie condoglianze, ma al momento non cerco altri lavori."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 1|	"A common practice, in Saryd families it is. Made out of cremation ashes, and much better at preserving memories of loved ones, these gemstones are." She explains. "Since developed, the technique was, practiced by nearly all who could afford it, it has been. To have the rivers and fields share our sorrow, we wish not. So nearly unheard of nowadays, Saryd burials are."|1760|0
units.english: "A common practice, in Saryd families it is. Made out of cremation ashes, and much better at preserving memories of loved ones, these gemstones are." She explains. "Since developed, the technique was, practiced by nearly all who could afford it, it has been. To have the rivers and fields share our sorrow, we wish not. So nearly unheard of nowadays, Saryd burials are."
units.italian: "Una pratica comune, nelle famiglie Saryd lo è. Ricavate dalle ceneri della cremazione, e molto migliori nel conservare i ricordi delle persone care, queste gemme sono." Spiega. "Da quando sviluppata, la tecnica fu, praticata da quasi tutti quelli che potevano permettersela, è stata. Che i fiumi e i campi condividano il nostro dolore, noi non vogliamo. Quindi quasi sconosciute oggigiorno, le sepolture Saryd sono."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 1|	"Well, I'd be glad to help you. Could you tell me where you wish to go?"|1762|0
units.english: "Well, I'd be glad to help you. Could you tell me where you wish to go?"
units.italian: "Beh, sarei felice di aiutarti. Puoi dirmi dove vuoi andare?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 1|	"I see. Well, I hope everything goes well, but I can't help you. I'm not looking for any jobs right now."|1763|0
units.english: "I see. Well, I hope everything goes well, but I can't help you. I'm not looking for any jobs right now."
units.italian: "Capisco. Beh, spero che vada tutto bene, ma non posso aiutarti. Al momento non cerco lavori."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 1|	"Thank you, Captain. Five different sites, I wish to visit, and traditionally the first of them, the Shrine of Aul Kell is. On <destination>, it is. Once there we are, easy to find in the capital, it should be."|1766|0
units.english: "Thank you, Captain. Five different sites, I wish to visit, and traditionally the first of them, the Shrine of Aul Kell is. On <destination>, it is. Once there we are, easy to find in the capital, it should be."
units.italian: "Grazie, capitano. Cinque luoghi diversi, vorrei visitare, e tradizionalmente il primo di essi, il Santuario di Aul Kell è. Su <destination>, si trova. Una volta lì, facile da trovare nella capitale, dovrebbe essere."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 1|	You show her to your ship, helping her settle in her bunk. Once you're done, you set a course for <planet>.|1767|0
units.english: You show her to your ship, helping her settle in her bunk. Once you're done, you set a course for <planet>.
units.italian: La accompagni alla tua nave e l'aiuti a sistemarsi nella cuccetta. Quando hai finito, imposti la rotta per <planet>.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 1|dialog|1770|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Vellorae hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Vellorae non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 2|name|1777|0
units.english: Caretaker's Blessing
units.italian: La benedizione della Custode

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 2|description|1778|0
units.english: Bring Vellorae to <destination> so that she may continue her mourning pilgrimage for her late husband.
units.italian: Porta Vellorae su <destination> così che possa proseguire il suo pellegrinaggio di lutto per il marito defunto.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 2|Once you land on <origin>, Vellorae hands you 34,500 credits, and checks with a local tour line for the easiest path to the shrine. "Kindly wait for me, would you, Captain? Take a few hours, I might." She says. "Of course, if to come with me, you wish, happy to have your company, I would be."|1786|0
units.english: Once you land on <origin>, Vellorae hands you 34,500 credits, and checks with a local tour line for the easiest path to the shrine. "Kindly wait for me, would you, Captain? Take a few hours, I might." She says. "Of course, if to come with me, you wish, happy to have your company, I would be."
units.italian: Una volta atterrato su <origin>, Vellorae ti consegna 34.500 crediti e si informa presso una linea di escursioni locale sul percorso più facile per il santuario. "Aspettarmi con gentilezza, vorresti, capitano? Qualche ora, potrei metterci." Dice. "Certo, se venire con me, tu vuoi, felice di avere la tua compagnia, io sarei."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 2|	"If you're okay with me going, I'd be glad to accompany you."|1788|0
units.english: "If you're okay with me going, I'd be glad to accompany you."
units.italian: "Se per te va bene che venga, sarei felice di accompagnarti."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 2|	"Sorry, I'm not in the mood for a mourning ritual."|1789|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not in the mood for a mourning ritual."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non ho voglia di un rituale di lutto."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 2|	Together you follow the streets out of the spaceport city and into a park filled with several different forms of trees twisting upon themselves; some reach far up to the skies while others anchor most of their branches into the ground. The trail brings you to a large clearing, where dozens of Saryds are gathered by a circle of tall, rocky pillars with an altar at the center. Many of the Saryds there are dressed in delicate fabrics of dark greens or ocher colors. Some of them are grouped into pairs that seem to be young couples, while others appear to simply be passing visitors to the shrine.|1791|0
units.english: Together you follow the streets out of the spaceport city and into a park filled with several different forms of trees twisting upon themselves; some reach far up to the skies while others anchor most of their branches into the ground. The trail brings you to a large clearing, where dozens of Saryds are gathered by a circle of tall, rocky pillars with an altar at the center. Many of the Saryds there are dressed in delicate fabrics of dark greens or ocher colors. Some of them are grouped into pairs that seem to be young couples, while others appear to simply be passing visitors to the shrine.
units.italian: Insieme seguite le strade fuori dalla città dello spazioporto ed entrate in un parco pieno di alberi di forme diverse che si torcono su se stessi; alcuni si alzano fino al cielo, altri ancorano gran parte dei rami nel terreno. Il sentiero vi porta a una grande radura, dove decine di Saryd sono radunati intorno a un cerchio di pilastri rocciosi e alti con un altare al centro. Molti dei Saryd lì sono vestiti con tessuti delicati di verdi scuri o colori ocra. Alcuni sono raggruppati in coppie che sembrano giovani sposi, mentre altri sembrano semplici visitatori di passaggio al santuario.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 2|	Once the sun peeks over the tree tops and into the clearing, the visitors move away from the pillars and the altar while the couples line up and walk to it one at a time. There they remain for a few minutes, speaking to one another, before moving aside for the next pair. "Exchanging their vows, they are," Vellorae explains. "Our most popular wedding locations, the shrines here on the capital are."|1792|0
units.english: Once the sun peeks over the tree tops and into the clearing, the visitors move away from the pillars and the altar while the couples line up and walk to it one at a time. There they remain for a few minutes, speaking to one another, before moving aside for the next pair. "Exchanging their vows, they are," Vellorae explains. "Our most popular wedding locations, the shrines here on the capital are."
units.italian: Quando il sole fa capolino tra le cime degli alberi e nella radura, i visitatori si allontanano dai pilastri e dall'altare, mentre le coppie si mettono in fila e vi si avvicinano una alla volta. Restano lì per qualche minuto, parlando tra loro, prima di farsi da parte per la coppia successiva. "Si scambiano i voti, loro," spiega Vellorae. "I luoghi di nozze più popolari, i santuari qui nella capitale sono."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 2|	"I thought this was a shrine for mourning the dead?"|1794|0
units.english: "I thought this was a shrine for mourning the dead?"
units.italian: "Pensavo che questo fosse un santuario per il lutto dei morti?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 2|	"Popular? In the middle of the woods, by some rocks?"|1796|0
units.english: "Popular? In the middle of the woods, by some rocks?"
units.italian: "Popolari? In mezzo al bosco, vicino a qualche roccia?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 2|	She looks at you in confusion, then chuckles. "The creator of all forests, Aul Kell is, so naturally inside forests, his shrines are. Odd, I suppose they may look, to one outside our culture."|1797|0
units.english: She looks at you in confusion, then chuckles. "The creator of all forests, Aul Kell is, so naturally inside forests, his shrines are. Odd, I suppose they may look, to one outside our culture."
units.italian: Ti guarda confusa, poi ridacchia. "Il creatore di tutte le foreste, Aul Kell è, quindi naturalmente dentro le foreste, i suoi santuari sono. Strani, suppongo che possano sembrare, a chi è fuori dalla nostra cultura."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 2|	"Attributed with the gift of sunlight, Aul Kell is. As such, seek his blessings in the shrines, for many occasions we do. Only some of them, mourning and espousals are."|1800|0
units.english: "Attributed with the gift of sunlight, Aul Kell is. As such, seek his blessings in the shrines, for many occasions we do. Only some of them, mourning and espousals are."
units.italian: "Associato al dono della luce solare, Aul Kell è. Per questo, le sue benedizioni nei santuari, per molte occasioni noi cerchiamo. Solo alcune di esse, il lutto e le nozze sono."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 2|	The couples keep exchanging their vows until just before midday, when the sun is nearly over the central altar. At this point, the Saryds all look around the clearing, making space for Vellorae as they see her approaching the shrine. She places the bangle atop the altar so it catches the sun's light, reflecting it throughout the clearing. Vellorae then begins walking around the altar, repeatedly circling it as the sun climbs higher, until it finally reaches its peak and the sun's reflection on the gem is strongest. At this point, she approaches the altar again and covers the bangle with her hands. She remains there silently for a moment, and then she retrieves the bangle and leaves the shrine. As she walks past, the other Saryds give her sympathetic looks, and one of the younger ones even approaches to offer her condolences before Vellorae approaches you again.|1802|0
units.english: The couples keep exchanging their vows until just before midday, when the sun is nearly over the central altar. At this point, the Saryds all look around the clearing, making space for Vellorae as they see her approaching the shrine. She places the bangle atop the altar so it catches the sun's light, reflecting it throughout the clearing. Vellorae then begins walking around the altar, repeatedly circling it as the sun climbs higher, until it finally reaches its peak and the sun's reflection on the gem is strongest. At this point, she approaches the altar again and covers the bangle with her hands. She remains there silently for a moment, and then she retrieves the bangle and leaves the shrine. As she walks past, the other Saryds give her sympathetic looks, and one of the younger ones even approaches to offer her condolences before Vellorae approaches you again.
units.italian: Le coppie continuano a scambiarsi i voti fino a poco prima di mezzogiorno, quando il sole è quasi sopra l'altare centrale. A quel punto, i Saryd si guardano intorno nella radura, facendosi spazio per Vellorae quando la vedono avvicinarsi al santuario. Lei posa il bracciale sull'altare in modo che catturi la luce del sole, riflettendola in tutta la radura. Vellorae comincia allora a camminare intorno all'altare, girandoci attorno più volte mentre il sole sale, finché non raggiunge il culmine e il riflesso del sole sulla gemma è più forte. A quel punto si avvicina di nuovo all'altare e copre il bracciale con le mani. Resta lì in silenzio per un momento, poi recupera il bracciale e lascia il santuario. Mentre passa, gli altri Saryd le rivolgono sguardi di compassione, e uno dei più giovani si avvicina persino a porgere le condoglianze prima che Vellorae torni da te.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 2|	"Finished I am, Captain. Back to the ship, we may go," she says once she's beside you. You two head back; this time you pass by a few more Saryds on the trail and return to your ship.|1803|0
units.english: "Finished I am, Captain. Back to the ship, we may go," she says once she's beside you. You two head back; this time you pass by a few more Saryds on the trail and return to your ship.
units.italian: "Ho finito, capitano. Alla nave, possiamo tornare," dice quando ti è accanto. Tornate indietro; questa volta incontrate altri Saryd sul sentiero e raggiungete la nave.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 2|	You wait for a few hours by the spaceport city until Vellorae returns about an hour after noon.|1806|0
units.english: You wait for a few hours by the spaceport city until Vellorae returns about an hour after noon.
units.italian: Aspetti per qualche ora vicino alla città dello spazioporto finché Vellorae non torna circa un'ora dopo mezzogiorno.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 2|	"<destination>, the next stop is. To give Adfices Velaulra's Blessing, I wish," she says, heading into her bunk as you prepare for the next trip.|1808|0
units.english: "<destination>, the next stop is. To give Adfices Velaulra's Blessing, I wish," she says, heading into her bunk as you prepare for the next trip.
units.italian: "<destination>, la prossima tappa è. Dare ad Adfices la Benedizione di Velaulra, io voglio," dice, entrando nella sua cuccetta mentre ti prepari al viaggio successivo.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 2|dialog|1811|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Vellorae hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Vellorae non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 3|name|1818|0
units.english: Visit the Witch of Dusk
units.italian: In visita alla Strega del Crepuscolo

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 3|description|1819|0
units.english: Bring Vellorae to <destination> so that she may continue her mourning pilgrimage for her late husband.
units.italian: Porta Vellorae su <destination> così che possa proseguire il suo pellegrinaggio di lutto per il marito defunto.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 3|Vellorae directs you to a part of the planet cut by a long, thin river, pays you 49,300 credits once you've landed at one of the available hangars in a larger village, and sets out for a marble rotunda by the river banks.|1827|0
units.english: Vellorae directs you to a part of the planet cut by a long, thin river, pays you 49,300 credits once you've landed at one of the available hangars in a larger village, and sets out for a marble rotunda by the river banks.
units.italian: Vellorae ti guida in una parte del pianeta tagliata da un fiume lungo e sottile, ti paga 49.300 crediti una volta che sei atterrato in uno degli hangar disponibili in un villaggio più grande, e si incammina verso una rotonda di marmo sulla riva del fiume.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 3|	Following her there, you see some Saryd mothers playing with their children. Others hold young infants or carefully bathe them in the waters. As the two of you step into the rotunda, you notice the painting on the ceiling: a Saryd woman laying in a field, watching over several children playing around her.|1828|0
units.english: Following her there, you see some Saryd mothers playing with their children. Others hold young infants or carefully bathe them in the waters. As the two of you step into the rotunda, you notice the painting on the ceiling: a Saryd woman laying in a field, watching over several children playing around her.
units.italian: Seguendola, vedi alcune madri Saryd che giocano con i loro bambini. Altre tengono in braccio neonati o li lavano con cura nelle acque. Mentre entrate nella rotonda, noti il dipinto sul soffitto: una donna Saryd distesa in un campo, che veglia su diversi bambini che giocano intorno a lei.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 3|	Vellorae turns to you, removing the bangle and holding it in both hands as she presents it to you. "Join me for a silent prayer, could you, Captain? Wish to disturb one of the young mothers here, I do not."|1829|0
units.english: Vellorae turns to you, removing the bangle and holding it in both hands as she presents it to you. "Join me for a silent prayer, could you, Captain? Wish to disturb one of the young mothers here, I do not."
units.italian: Vellorae si volta verso di te, toglie il bracciale e lo tiene in entrambe le mani mentre te lo presenta. "Unirti a me per una preghiera silenziosa, potresti, capitano? Disturbare una delle giovani madri qui, io non voglio."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 3|	"If this place is a shrine, what's with all the kids playing around as if it was a park?"|1831|0
units.english: "If this place is a shrine, what's with all the kids playing around as if it was a park?"
units.italian: "Se questo posto è un santuario, che ci fanno tutti quei bambini che giocano come se fosse un parco?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 3|	"Sorry, I'm not one for prayers."|1832|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not one for prayers."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non sono tipo da preghiere."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 3|	"Of course. What do I have to do?"|1834|0
units.english: "Of course. What do I have to do?"
units.italian: "Certo. Cosa devo fare?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 3|	"A deity of life and plenty, Velaulra is, and as the greatest bounty of all, life is, strong ties with newborn children, she has. Common places for mothers to bond with their young ones, her shrines are." Vellorae explains. "In my case, here to thank her for Adfices' life, and all plenty there was in it, I am. Take my hands for a prayer, would you?"|1836|0
units.english: "A deity of life and plenty, Velaulra is, and as the greatest bounty of all, life is, strong ties with newborn children, she has. Common places for mothers to bond with their young ones, her shrines are." Vellorae explains. "In my case, here to thank her for Adfices' life, and all plenty there was in it, I am. Take my hands for a prayer, would you?"
units.italian: "Una divinità della vita e dell'abbondanza, Velaulra è, e dato che il dono più grande di tutti, la vita è, forti legami con i bambini appena nati, lei ha. Luoghi comuni dove le madri si legano ai loro piccoli, i suoi santuari sono." Spiega Vellorae. "Nel mio caso, qui per ringraziarla per la vita di Adfices, e per tutta l'abbondanza che c'è stata, io sono. Prendermi le mani per una preghiera, vorresti?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 3|	"I know this is important for you, but I'm not one for prayers. Sorry."|1838|0
units.english: "I know this is important for you, but I'm not one for prayers. Sorry."
units.italian: "So che questo è importante per te, ma non sono tipo da preghiere. Mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 3|	"I don't fully understand this, but I'd be glad to. What do I have to do?"|1839|0
units.english: "I don't fully understand this, but I'd be glad to. What do I have to do?"
units.italian: "Non capisco del tutto, ma sarei felice di farlo. Cosa devo fare?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 3|label|1841|0
units.english: no prayer
units.italian: no prayer

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 3|	"I see. That's fine, understand it, I do." She holds the bangle in one hand, covering it with the other, and closes her eyes for just under a minute while standing there in silence.|1842|0
units.english: "I see. That's fine, understand it, I do." She holds the bangle in one hand, covering it with the other, and closes her eyes for just under a minute while standing there in silence.
units.italian: "Capisco. Va bene, lo capisco, io." Tiene il bracciale in una mano, lo copre con l'altra e chiude gli occhi per poco meno di un minuto, restando lì in silenzio.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 3|	"Just over mine, place yours." She gestures with her hands, and you both place them over the bangle. She closes her eyes as you do the same. You both stand still like that for just under a minute until you feel her move away.|1845|0
units.english: "Just over mine, place yours." She gestures with her hands, and you both place them over the bangle. She closes her eyes as you do the same. You both stand still like that for just under a minute until you feel her move away.
units.italian: "Sopra le mie, metti le tue." Fa un gesto con le mani, e le mettete entrambi sopra il bracciale. Lei chiude gli occhi e tu fai lo stesso. Restate fermi così per poco meno di un minuto, finché non la senti allontanarsi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 3|	After the prayer, Vellorae leaves the rotunda and heads to the river bank, where she lays close to the waters and lowers the bangle to start washing it in the current in a slow and clearly ceremonial manner. The Saryd children watch her curiously, some edging closer before being stopped by their mothers. Once Vellorae is done, she places the bangle, still wet from the river, on her hand again and tells you that she's done at this shrine.|1847|0
units.english: After the prayer, Vellorae leaves the rotunda and heads to the river bank, where she lays close to the waters and lowers the bangle to start washing it in the current in a slow and clearly ceremonial manner. The Saryd children watch her curiously, some edging closer before being stopped by their mothers. Once Vellorae is done, she places the bangle, still wet from the river, on her hand again and tells you that she's done at this shrine.
units.italian: Dopo la preghiera, Vellorae lascia la rotonda e va verso la riva del fiume, dove si stende vicino all'acqua e abbassa il bracciale per cominciare a lavarlo nella corrente in modo lento e chiaramente cerimoniale. I bambini Saryd la guardano curiosi, alcuni si avvicinano prima di essere fermati dalle madri. Quando Vellorae ha finito, rimette il bracciale, ancora bagnato di fiume, sulla mano e ti dice che ha finito in questo santuario.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 3|	You head back to your ship, where she tells you she'd like to stop at <destination> next. "Visit Magl Ina next, I must." She heads to her bunk, and you go to your cockpit to set course for <planet>.|1848|0
units.english: You head back to your ship, where she tells you she'd like to stop at <destination> next. "Visit Magl Ina next, I must." She heads to her bunk, and you go to your cockpit to set course for <planet>.
units.italian: Tornate alla nave, dove ti dice che vorrebbe fermarsi dopo su <destination>. "Visitare Magl Ina adesso, io devo." Va nella sua cuccetta, e tu vai in cabina di pilotaggio a impostare la rotta per <planet>.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 3|dialog|1851|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Vellorae hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Vellorae non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 4|name|1858|0
units.english: Master Hunter's Path
units.italian: Il sentiero del Maestro Cacciatore

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 4|description|1859|0
units.english: Bring Vellorae to <destination> so that she may continue her mourning pilgrimage for her late husband.
units.italian: Porta Vellorae su <destination> così che possa proseguire il suo pellegrinaggio di lutto per il marito defunto.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 4|<origin>'s spaceport searchlights guide you to the hangars in the middle of a thunderstorm, and Vellorae says she'll wait it out inside your ship as she pays you 45,500 credits. "At her shrine only after dusk, Magl Ina is anyway, so in a hurry, I am not." The storm lasts halfway into the evening, and once the light reaching through the layers of fog starts to dim, you open your ship's hatch for Vellorae to head out.|1867|0
units.english: <origin>'s spaceport searchlights guide you to the hangars in the middle of a thunderstorm, and Vellorae says she'll wait it out inside your ship as she pays you 45,500 credits. "At her shrine only after dusk, Magl Ina is anyway, so in a hurry, I am not." The storm lasts halfway into the evening, and once the light reaching through the layers of fog starts to dim, you open your ship's hatch for Vellorae to head out.
units.italian: I riflettori dello spazioporto di <origin> ti guidano agli hangar in mezzo a un temporale, e Vellorae dice che aspetterà la fine dentro la tua nave mentre ti paga 45.500 crediti. "Al suo santuario solo dopo il tramonto, Magl Ina è comunque, quindi di fretta, io non sono." Il temporale dura fino a metà serata, e quando la luce che filtra attraverso gli strati di nebbia comincia a calare, apri il portello della nave perché Vellorae esca.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 4|	You accompany her across the murky spaceport, until you find a local Saryd for her to talk to. Vellorae asks him if he would guide the two of you to the shrine. "To a site of worship, why is this human going?" he asks, while eyeing you somewhat suspiciously.|1868|0
units.english: You accompany her across the murky spaceport, until you find a local Saryd for her to talk to. Vellorae asks him if he would guide the two of you to the shrine. "To a site of worship, why is this human going?" he asks, while eyeing you somewhat suspiciously.
units.italian: La accompagni attraverso lo spazioporto nebbioso, finché non trovate un Saryd del posto con cui parlare. Vellorae gli chiede se può guidarvi al santuario. "A un luogo di culto, perché va questo umano?" chiede, guardandoti con una certa diffidenza.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 4|	"On a pilgrimage to mourn my late husband, I am." Vellorae says. "Helping me with traveling to each shrine, Captain <last> is."|1869|0
units.english: "On a pilgrimage to mourn my late husband, I am." Vellorae says. "Helping me with traveling to each shrine, Captain <last> is."
units.italian: "In pellegrinaggio per piangere mio marito defunto, io sono." dice Vellorae. "Aiutarmi a viaggiare verso ogni santuario, il capitano <last> lo sta facendo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 4|	"But, to the shrine, must the Captain go?" He asks. "Help you with mourning there, a human cannot."|1870|0
units.english: "But, to the shrine, must the Captain go?" He asks. "Help you with mourning there, a human cannot."
units.italian: "Ma al santuario, il capitano deve venire?" Chiede. "Aiutarvi con il lutto lì, un umano non può."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 4|	"Helping me in this journey, the kind Captain has been, so mind it, I do not. Like to come with me to the shrine, would you, Captain?"|1871|0
units.english: "Helping me in this journey, the kind Captain has been, so mind it, I do not. Like to come with me to the shrine, would you, Captain?"
units.italian: "Aiutandomi in questo viaggio, il gentile capitano lo ha fatto, quindi non mi importa. Venire con me al santuario, vorreste, capitano?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 4|	"If it's alright for me to go, I'd love to."|1873|0
units.english: "If it's alright for me to go, I'd love to."
units.italian: "Se per me va bene andare, mi piacerebbe molto."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 4|	"I don't want to disturb anyone, so I'll stay by the ship and wait for you."|1874|0
units.english: "I don't want to disturb anyone, so I'll stay by the ship and wait for you."
units.italian: "Non voglio disturbare nessuno, quindi resto vicino alla nave ad aspettarti."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 4|	"Wonderful!" she cheers, tapping her frontal hooves lightly on the ground. "Now, guide us to the shrine, would you, young dear?" she asks the local Saryd, who turns around and gestures for you to follow.|1876|0
units.english: "Wonderful!" she cheers, tapping her frontal hooves lightly on the ground. "Now, guide us to the shrine, would you, young dear?" she asks the local Saryd, who turns around and gestures for you to follow.
units.italian: "Meraviglioso!" esulta, battendo leggermente gli zoccoli anteriori sul terreno. "Ora, guidaci al santuario, vorresti, caro ragazzo?" chiede al Saryd del posto, che si volta e ti fa cenno di seguirlo.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 4|	You stick close to Vellorae as the two of you try to keep the local Saryd in sight. The task is difficult as he nearly vanishes into the fog whenever he gets too far ahead, only for his silhouette to become clearer again after he waits for you to catch up. After many minutes, you feel the ground beneath your shoes shift from the solid spaceport platform to gravel to wet patches of the planet's mossy "grass." Finally you reach a minuscule lake, or perhaps a very large puddle, in the middle of a mossy field surrounded by toppled and hollowed out tree trunks.|1877|0
units.english: You stick close to Vellorae as the two of you try to keep the local Saryd in sight. The task is difficult as he nearly vanishes into the fog whenever he gets too far ahead, only for his silhouette to become clearer again after he waits for you to catch up. After many minutes, you feel the ground beneath your shoes shift from the solid spaceport platform to gravel to wet patches of the planet's mossy "grass." Finally you reach a minuscule lake, or perhaps a very large puddle, in the middle of a mossy field surrounded by toppled and hollowed out tree trunks.
units.italian: Resti vicino a Vellorae mentre cercate di tenere d'occhio il Saryd del posto. L'impresa è difficile, perché quasi svanisce nella nebbia ogni volta che si allontana troppo, e la sua sagoma torna più nitida solo dopo che si ferma ad aspettare che lo raggiungiate. Dopo molti minuti, senti il terreno sotto le scarpe cambiare dalla solida piattaforma dello spazioporto a ghiaia e poi a chiazze bagnate dell'"erba" muschiata del pianeta. Alla fine raggiungete un laghetto minuscolo, o forse una pozzanghera molto grande, in mezzo a un campo muschioso circondato da tronchi d'albero abbattuti e svuotati.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 4|	As the two of you approach the water, the local Saryd warns you not to touch it. Vellorae looks at it as if gazing into a mirror, or perhaps she is just trying to make out the reflection of the moon, scattered and vague through the layers of mist. She then moves to one of the tree trunks, and placing the bangle inside it as she lays on the ground facing the water, lays both her hands reverently on the trunk. She spends nearly an hour in this position, during which the chill of the fog slowly seeps through your coat and into your bones. Vellorae and the Saryd who guided you don't seem particularly bothered by it, but she is quick to finish once she looks over and notices you shivering. She picks the bangle up from the trunk and stands, and then asks the other Saryd to guide you two back to the spaceport.|1878|0
units.english: As the two of you approach the water, the local Saryd warns you not to touch it. Vellorae looks at it as if gazing into a mirror, or perhaps she is just trying to make out the reflection of the moon, scattered and vague through the layers of mist. She then moves to one of the tree trunks, and placing the bangle inside it as she lays on the ground facing the water, lays both her hands reverently on the trunk. She spends nearly an hour in this position, during which the chill of the fog slowly seeps through your coat and into your bones. Vellorae and the Saryd who guided you don't seem particularly bothered by it, but she is quick to finish once she looks over and notices you shivering. She picks the bangle up from the trunk and stands, and then asks the other Saryd to guide you two back to the spaceport.
units.italian: Mentre vi avvicinate all'acqua, il Saryd del posto vi avverte di non toccarla. Vellorae la guarda come se si specchiasse, o forse sta solo cercando di distinguere il riflesso della luna, sparso e vago tra gli strati di foschia. Poi si sposta verso uno dei tronchi e, posando il bracciale al suo interno mentre si sdraia a terra rivolta verso l'acqua, appoggia entrambe le mani sul tronco con reverenza. Resta in quella posizione quasi un'ora, durante la quale il gelo della nebbia ti filtra lentamente attraverso il cappotto fino alle ossa. Vellorae e il Saryd che vi ha guidati non sembrano particolarmente infastiditi, ma lei si affretta a finire quando si volta e ti vede rabbrividire. Riprende il bracciale dal tronco e si alza, poi chiede all'altro Saryd di riaccompagnarvi allo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 4|	"For taking so long, terribly sorry I am, Captain <last>," she says on the way back. "Lost in prayer I was, not even consider how uncomfortable the cold must've been for you, I did."|1879|0
units.english: "For taking so long, terribly sorry I am, Captain <last>," she says on the way back. "Lost in prayer I was, not even consider how uncomfortable the cold must've been for you, I did."
units.italian: "Per averci messo tanto, terribilmente dispiaciuta sono, capitano <last>," dice sulla via del ritorno. "Persa nella preghiera ero, non ho nemmeno considerato quanto il freddo dovesse essere sgradevole per voi."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 4|	"Don't worry, wasn't too bad. Seems you were really involved in praying."|1881|0
units.english: "Don't worry, wasn't too bad. Seems you were really involved in praying."
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti, non è stato poi così male. Sembravi davvero assorta nella preghiera."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 4|	"Why did this one take so long? Is there something special about the shrine's deity?"|1882|0
units.english: "Why did this one take so long? Is there something special about the shrine's deity?"
units.italian: "Perché questo ci ha messo tanto? C'è qualcosa di speciale nella divinità del santuario?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 4|	"The hunter bird of nightfall and omens, Magl Ina is. When mourning someone dear, one is, ask it for forgiveness for their wrongdoings, they must."|1883|0
units.english: "The hunter bird of nightfall and omens, Magl Ina is. When mourning someone dear, one is, ask it for forgiveness for their wrongdoings, they must."
units.italian: "L'uccello cacciatore del crepuscolo e dei presagi, Magl Ina è. Quando in lutto per qualcuno di caro si è, chiedergli perdono per le proprie colpe, si deve."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 4|	You follow the Saryd back to the gravel path and then to the spaceport grounds, where Vellorae thanks him for guiding the two of you to the shrine. He offers his condolences and wishes her a safe journey to the next shrine. He soon disappears into the fog again, and you and Vellorae head back to your ship.|1884|0
units.english: You follow the Saryd back to the gravel path and then to the spaceport grounds, where Vellorae thanks him for guiding the two of you to the shrine. He offers his condolences and wishes her a safe journey to the next shrine. He soon disappears into the fog again, and you and Vellorae head back to your ship.
units.italian: Segui il Saryd di nuovo sul sentiero di ghiaia e poi nel recinto dello spazioporto, dove Vellorae lo ringrazia per avervi guidati al santuario. Lui le porge le condoglianze e le augura buon viaggio verso il santuario successivo. Svanisce presto di nuovo nella nebbia, e tu e Vellorae tornate alla nave.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 4|label|1886|0
units.english: not go
units.italian: not go

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 4|	She sighs briefly, and agrees to meet with you later, following the Saryd local deep into the fog stretching out of the city. You head inside your ship, waiting for a few hours until you hear a voice just outside your hatch. You let Vellorae in once you realize that it's hers.|1887|0
units.english: She sighs briefly, and agrees to meet with you later, following the Saryd local deep into the fog stretching out of the city. You head inside your ship, waiting for a few hours until you hear a voice just outside your hatch. You let Vellorae in once you realize that it's hers.
units.italian: Sospira brevemente e accetta di vederti più tardi, seguendo il Saryd del posto nella nebbia che si estende fuori dalla città. Entri nella nave e aspetti qualche ora finché non senti una voce appena fuori dal portello. Fai entrare Vellorae quando ti rendi conto che è la sua.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 4|	"To <destination>, we must go now. The Path of Lor Ie Vees, I must take," she says, heading to her bunk to rest.|1889|0
units.english: "To <destination>, we must go now. The Path of Lor Ie Vees, I must take," she says, heading to her bunk to rest.
units.italian: "Su <destination>, dobbiamo andare ora. Il Sentiero di Lor Ie Vees, devo percorrere," dice, dirigendosi alla cuccetta per riposare.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 4|dialog|1892|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Vellorae hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Vellorae non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|name|1899|0
units.english: Woodland Thing
units.italian: Cosa del bosco

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|description|1900|0
units.english: Bring Vellorae to <destination>, where she will finish her mourning pilgrimage.
units.italian: Porta Vellorae su <destination>, dove concluderà il suo pellegrinaggio di lutto.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|Vellorae hands you 69,700 credits as you land, and says she'll head to the "path" once the sun sets. "Come to this world for our honeymoon, Adfices and I did, and visited the path, we had. Know its starting point, I already do."|1908|0
units.english: Vellorae hands you 69,700 credits as you land, and says she'll head to the "path" once the sun sets. "Come to this world for our honeymoon, Adfices and I did, and visited the path, we had. Know its starting point, I already do."
units.italian: Vellorae ti consegna 69.700 crediti appena atterrate, e dice che andrà al "sentiero" quando il sole tramonterà. "Venire su questo mondo per la nostra luna di miele, Adfices ed io lo abbiamo fatto, e visitato il sentiero, noi lo avevamo. Conosco già il punto di partenza, io."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	She tells you she'll pass the time until then by visiting local shops, asking if you'd like to come with her.|1909|0
units.english: She tells you she'll pass the time until then by visiting local shops, asking if you'd like to come with her.
units.italian: Ti dice che passerà il tempo fino ad allora visitando i negozi del posto, e ti chiede se vuoi andare con lei.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	(Go along with her.)|1911|0
units.english: (Go along with her.)
units.italian: (Vai con lei.)

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	(Stay in my ship.)|1912|0
units.english: (Stay in my ship.)
units.italian: (Resta nella mia nave.)

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	She takes you around the spaceport city, touring some clothing shops and bringing you to parks she had visited with her husband. Shortly after noon you two enter a restaurant, where she insists on paying for your meal. You tour the city with her for a while longer and, just before the sun sets, reach the forest at the base of the mountain on top of which Starlit University is located.|1914|0
units.english: She takes you around the spaceport city, touring some clothing shops and bringing you to parks she had visited with her husband. Shortly after noon you two enter a restaurant, where she insists on paying for your meal. You tour the city with her for a while longer and, just before the sun sets, reach the forest at the base of the mountain on top of which Starlit University is located.
units.italian: Ti porta in giro per la città dello spazioporto, visitando alcuni negozi di abbigliamento e portandoti nei parchi che aveva visitato con suo marito. Poco dopo mezzogiorno entrate in un ristorante, dove insiste per pagarti il pasto. Giri ancora un po' la città con lei e, poco prima del tramonto, raggiungete la foresta alla base della montagna sulla cui cima si trova la Starlit University.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	Once night falls, many lights start to appear inside the forest, and Vellorae beckons you to follow her in. "Stick close, you should. Difficult to navigate the path, for other species it often is." As you walk down a trail with her, you approach one of the lights to see that it's a bonfire on a platform in a miniature clearing, at what you hope is a safe distance from the trees around it. Continuing to the next light, Vellorae clutches the bangle in her hands the entire time, humming some guttural, almost tribal chant. As you pass by another fire, a short burst of flames gets closer to some nearby shrubs, but thankfully is put out before it can cause any harm. It is extinguished with an odd, large, fabric net on a pole by a cloaked Saryd who seemed to materialize from the trees near the fire.|1915|0
units.english: Once night falls, many lights start to appear inside the forest, and Vellorae beckons you to follow her in. "Stick close, you should. Difficult to navigate the path, for other species it often is." As you walk down a trail with her, you approach one of the lights to see that it's a bonfire on a platform in a miniature clearing, at what you hope is a safe distance from the trees around it. Continuing to the next light, Vellorae clutches the bangle in her hands the entire time, humming some guttural, almost tribal chant. As you pass by another fire, a short burst of flames gets closer to some nearby shrubs, but thankfully is put out before it can cause any harm. It is extinguished with an odd, large, fabric net on a pole by a cloaked Saryd who seemed to materialize from the trees near the fire.
units.italian: Quando scende la notte, molte luci cominciano ad apparire dentro la foresta, e Vellorae ti fa cenno di seguirla. "Restarmi vicino, dovresti. Difficile orientarsi sul sentiero, per le altre specie spesso è." Mentre camminate lungo un sentiero con lei, ti avvicini a una delle luci e vedi che è un falò su una piattaforma in una radura in miniatura, a quella che speri sia una distanza sicura dagli alberi intorno. Proseguendo verso la luce successiva, Vellorae stringe il bracciale tra le mani per tutto il tempo, canticchiando un canto gutturale, quasi tribale. Mentre passate accanto a un altro fuoco, un breve getto di fiamme si avvicina ad alcuni cespugli lì vicino, ma per fortuna viene spento prima che possa fare danni. È spento con un bizzarro e grande retino di tessuto su un palo, da un Saryd incappucciato che sembra essersi materializzato dagli alberi vicino al fuoco.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	"Take care to not damage the forest with the path's fires, we must, so volunteer for keeping the flames, many of the local students do." Vellorae tells you. "When visiting here, Adfices and I were, wondered if any extra credits, the task granted, but apparently only out of a respect for Lor Ie Vees, the students do it."|1916|0
units.english: "Take care to not damage the forest with the path's fires, we must, so volunteer for keeping the flames, many of the local students do." Vellorae tells you. "When visiting here, Adfices and I were, wondered if any extra credits, the task granted, but apparently only out of a respect for Lor Ie Vees, the students do it."
units.italian: "Fare attenzione a non danneggiare la foresta con i fuochi del sentiero, noi dobbiamo, quindi offrirsi volontari per sorvegliare le fiamme, molti degli studenti del posto lo fanno." Ti dice Vellorae. "Quando venivamo qui, Adfices ed io, ci chiedevamo se il compito desse crediti extra, ma a quanto pare solo per rispetto di Lor Ie Vees, gli studenti lo fanno."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	"Why? Is that some god of knowledge?"|1918|0
units.english: "Why? Is that some god of knowledge?"
units.italian: "Perché? È una specie di dio della conoscenza?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	"Maybe they like being on good terms with the divine in hopes of doing well in tests?"|1920|0
units.english: "Maybe they like being on good terms with the divine in hopes of doing well in tests?"
units.italian: "Magari gli piace essere in buoni rapporti col divino sperando di andare bene agli esami?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	She stops for a second to laugh. "The case, that might be." She looks around, seeing if someone else caught her breaking the serene, humming chant.|1921|0
units.english: She stops for a second to laugh. "The case, that might be." She looks around, seeing if someone else caught her breaking the serene, humming chant.
units.italian: Si ferma un secondo a ridere. "Può essere, questo." Si guarda intorno, per vedere se qualcun altro l'ha colta a rompere il canto sereno e mormorato.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	"Taught the first Saryds how to hunt, he did. To pursue knowledge, and overcome challenges, his teachings are." She explains. "Seek communion with him, not only students, but all going through a difficult period, should."|1923|0
units.english: "Taught the first Saryds how to hunt, he did. To pursue knowledge, and overcome challenges, his teachings are." She explains. "Seek communion with him, not only students, but all going through a difficult period, should."
units.italian: "Insegnò ai primi Saryd come cacciare, lui lo fece. Perseguire la conoscenza e superare le sfide, i suoi insegnamenti sono." Spiega. "Cercare la comunione con lui, non solo gli studenti, ma tutti quelli che attraversano un periodo difficile, dovrebbero."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	You continue to follow her closely through the forest, regularly passing more bonfires, until you see multiple lights in the distance and realize it is the edge of the forest leading back into the city. Only as you step out of the woods do you notice that you're back where the path started, even though you were certain you had kept to only one side of the mountain.|1924|0
units.english: You continue to follow her closely through the forest, regularly passing more bonfires, until you see multiple lights in the distance and realize it is the edge of the forest leading back into the city. Only as you step out of the woods do you notice that you're back where the path started, even though you were certain you had kept to only one side of the mountain.
units.italian: Continui a seguirla da vicino attraverso la foresta, passando regolarmente accanto ad altri falò, finché non vedi più luci in lontananza e ti rendi conto che è il margine della foresta che riporta in città. Solo quando esci dal bosco noti di essere tornato dove il sentiero era iniziato, anche se eri certo di esserti tenuto su un solo lato della montagna.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	Vellorae takes a final look at the path, where only a few of the bonfires' lights are still visible through the dense groupings of pine trees. She tells you she's ready to leave, and you bring her back to your ship.|1925|0
units.english: Vellorae takes a final look at the path, where only a few of the bonfires' lights are still visible through the dense groupings of pine trees. She tells you she's ready to leave, and you bring her back to your ship.
units.italian: Vellorae dà un ultimo sguardo al sentiero, dove solo alcune luci dei falò sono ancora visibili attraverso i fitti gruppi di pini. Ti dice che è pronta ad andare, e la riporti alla nave.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|label|1927|0
units.english: not go
units.italian: not go

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	She says she'll be back at night and leaves. You watch a few transmissions from the planet, most of them in some way related to Starlit University. One is what you guess is a Saryd comedy movie, something about one who cut down trees in order to make scarves but came to regret it later. You try and follow along, but subtitles for the transmissions only come in Kimek or Arach. A few hours into the night, you leave your ship to wait for Vellorae, who arrives shortly after.|1928|0
units.english: She says she'll be back at night and leaves. You watch a few transmissions from the planet, most of them in some way related to Starlit University. One is what you guess is a Saryd comedy movie, something about one who cut down trees in order to make scarves but came to regret it later. You try and follow along, but subtitles for the transmissions only come in Kimek or Arach. A few hours into the night, you leave your ship to wait for Vellorae, who arrives shortly after.
units.italian: Dice che tornerà stanotte e se ne va. Guardi alcune trasmissioni dal pianeta, la maggior parte in qualche modo legate alla Starlit University. Una è quello che supponi sia un film comico Saryd, qualcosa su uno che abbatteva alberi per fare sciarpe ma poi se ne pentì. Provi a seguirlo, ma i sottotitoli delle trasmissioni esistono solo in Kimek o Arach. Qualche ora dopo l'inizio della notte, esci dalla nave ad aspettare Vellorae, che arriva poco dopo.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	She heads to her bunk, saying she'll rest for the trip. It hits you that she hasn't told you her next destination yet, so you knock on her door to ask.|1930|0
units.english: She heads to her bunk, saying she'll rest for the trip. It hits you that she hasn't told you her next destination yet, so you knock on her door to ask.
units.italian: Va nella sua cuccetta, dicendo che riposerà per il viaggio. Ti rendi conto che non ti ha ancora detto la prossima destinazione, quindi bussi alla sua porta per chiedere.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	"Yes, Captain? Anything wrong, is- Ah! Forgot to tell you the next destination, I have!" You nod, and she looks at her bangle, brushing a hand on its gem. "Yes, the last shrine, the next one is... the next one..."|1931|0
units.english: "Yes, Captain? Anything wrong, is- Ah! Forgot to tell you the next destination, I have!" You nod, and she looks at her bangle, brushing a hand on its gem. "Yes, the last shrine, the next one is... the next one..."
units.italian: "Sì, capitano? Qualcosa non va, c'è- Ah! Dimenticato di dirvi la prossima destinazione, io ho!" Annuisci, e lei guarda il bracciale, sfiorando la gemma con una mano. "Sì, l'ultimo santuario, il prossimo è... il prossimo è..."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	"Are you alright?"|1933|0
units.english: "Are you alright?"
units.italian: "Stai bene?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	"Is something wrong with the next shrine?"|1934|0
units.english: "Is something wrong with the next shrine?"
units.italian: "C'è qualcosa che non va nel prossimo santuario?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	She ignores your question, fixated on the bangle for a few moments. "<planet>. To <destination>, we must go." She finally says, before going back to her room.|1935|0
