units.english: She ignores your question, fixated on the bangle for a few moments. "<planet>. To <destination>, we must go." She finally says, before going back to her room.
units.italian: Ignora la tua domanda, fissando il bracciale per qualche istante. "<planet>. Su <destination>, dobbiamo andare." Dice infine, prima di tornare nella sua stanza.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|dialog|1938|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Vellorae hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Vellorae non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|Vellorae hands you <payment> once you land, and asks, "Come with me for this last bit, could you, Captain <last>?"|1943|0
units.english: Vellorae hands you <payment> once you land, and asks, "Come with me for this last bit, could you, Captain <last>?"
units.italian: Vellorae ti consegna <payment> appena atterrate, e chiede: "Venire con me per quest'ultimo pezzo, potresti, capitano <last>?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	"Sure. Where are we going?"|1945|0
units.english: "Sure. Where are we going?"
units.italian: "Certo. Dove andiamo?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	"I'll pass. I'm not up for it right now."|1947|0
units.english: "I'll pass. I'm not up for it right now."
units.italian: "Passo. Non me la sento proprio adesso."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	Her eyes go to the bangle, travel around the room, and then fixate on your again. "Please, Captain? I know that agreed to follow me to the shrines for the job, you didn't, but alone there, I do not wish to be."|1948|0
units.english: Her eyes go to the bangle, travel around the room, and then fixate on your again. "Please, Captain? I know that agreed to follow me to the shrines for the job, you didn't, but alone there, I do not wish to be."
units.italian: I suoi occhi vanno al bracciale, girano per la stanza e poi si fissano di nuovo su di te. "Per favore, capitano? So che accettare di seguirmi ai santuari per il lavoro, voi non l'avete fatto, ma sola lì, io non voglio essere."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	"Alright, if it'll help you relax I'll go with you."|1950|0
units.english: "Alright, if it'll help you relax I'll go with you."
units.italian: "Va bene, se ti aiuta a stare più tranquilla vengo con te."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	"Sorry, but I'd rather rest in the ship."|1952|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'd rather rest in the ship."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma preferirei riposare nella nave."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	She takes a step back, looking down to the bangle again. "Alright. Yes, your responsibility, this is not. Meet you in the spaceport later, I shall."|1953|0
units.english: She takes a step back, looking down to the bangle again. "Alright. Yes, your responsibility, this is not. Meet you in the spaceport later, I shall."
units.italian: Fa un passo indietro, guardando di nuovo il bracciale. "Va bene. Sì, questa non è una vostra responsabilità. Ci vediamo più tardi allo spazioporto, io verrò."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	You open the hatch for her, and she heads to one of the Saryds nearby and begins to talk to them. A few seconds into the conversation, they tense up, crossing their arms and swiping them down as if refusing something, then running off. She tries again with some of the other Saryds, but continues to be rejected. She looks back at your ship dejectedly, then starts eyeing the other ships docked nearby before heading toward a Kimek Thorn that has just landed. As she talks to the captain, the Kimek seems confused, but after a moment he briefly re-enters their ship, returning in a puffy coat to follow Vellorae to the railway hub.|1954|0
units.english: You open the hatch for her, and she heads to one of the Saryds nearby and begins to talk to them. A few seconds into the conversation, they tense up, crossing their arms and swiping them down as if refusing something, then running off. She tries again with some of the other Saryds, but continues to be rejected. She looks back at your ship dejectedly, then starts eyeing the other ships docked nearby before heading toward a Kimek Thorn that has just landed. As she talks to the captain, the Kimek seems confused, but after a moment he briefly re-enters their ship, returning in a puffy coat to follow Vellorae to the railway hub.
units.italian: Le apri il portello, e lei si dirige verso uno dei Saryd lì vicino e comincia a parlargli. Dopo qualche secondo di conversazione, lui si irrigidisce, incrocia le braccia e le abbassa di scatto come per rifiutare qualcosa, poi se ne va di corsa. Lei ci riprova con altri Saryd, ma continua a essere rifiutata. Guarda di nuovo verso la tua nave con aria scoraggiata, poi comincia a esaminare le altre navi attraccate lì vicino prima di dirigersi verso un Kimek Thorn appena atterrato. Mentre parla al capitano, il Kimek sembra confuso, ma dopo un momento rientra brevemente nella loro nave e torna con un cappotto gonfio per seguire Vellorae al nodo ferroviario.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	Long after the sun has set, the Kimek returns, rushing to their ship while trying to shake off the cold. You ask them about Vellorae, and they tell you she headed for the spaceport to "clear her head."|1955|0
units.english: Long after the sun has set, the Kimek returns, rushing to their ship while trying to shake off the cold. You ask them about Vellorae, and they tell you she headed for the spaceport to "clear her head."
units.italian: Molto dopo il tramonto, il Kimek torna, correndo verso la loro nave e cercando di scrollarsi di dosso il freddo. Gli chiedi di Vellorae, e ti dice che si è diretta allo spazioporto per "schiarirsi la testa."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	She takes a long, deep breath. "Thank you, Captain. Far outside the village, the site is. Come, show you the way there, I will." You leave your ship, follow her to the railway hub, and board one of trains that appears to be one of the oldest and most simple. It lacks seats for non-Saryds, so you are forced to hold tight to what handrails you can reach.|1960|0
units.english: She takes a long, deep breath. "Thank you, Captain. Far outside the village, the site is. Come, show you the way there, I will." You leave your ship, follow her to the railway hub, and board one of trains that appears to be one of the oldest and most simple. It lacks seats for non-Saryds, so you are forced to hold tight to what handrails you can reach.
units.italian: Fa un respiro lungo e profondo. "Grazie, capitano. Ben fuori dal villaggio, il sito è. Venite, vi mostrerò la strada." Lasci la nave, la segui al nodo ferroviario e sali su uno dei treni, che sembra uno dei più vecchi e semplici. Non ha posti per chi non è Saryd, quindi sei costretto a tenerti stretto ai corrimano che riesci a raggiungere.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	You remain on the train until the very last stop, when the sun is already starting to set. As you depart, you see a rural village with just a few dozen buildings and a simple dirt road, where a couple workers battle the snow and ice to keep it clear and easy to traverse. You follow Vellorae down the road, and once you reach a rocky pillar with a hole carved through it, she turns to the forest, heading out on a thin, straight trail. Looking behind you, you see the setting sun fitting inside the pillar's opening.|1961|0
units.english: You remain on the train until the very last stop, when the sun is already starting to set. As you depart, you see a rural village with just a few dozen buildings and a simple dirt road, where a couple workers battle the snow and ice to keep it clear and easy to traverse. You follow Vellorae down the road, and once you reach a rocky pillar with a hole carved through it, she turns to the forest, heading out on a thin, straight trail. Looking behind you, you see the setting sun fitting inside the pillar's opening.
units.italian: Resti sul treno fino all'ultima fermata, quando il sole sta già cominciando a tramontare. Mentre scendi, vedi un villaggio rurale con appena qualche dozzina di edifici e una semplice strada sterrata, dove un paio di operai combattono con neve e ghiaccio per tenerla libera e facile da percorrere. Segui Vellorae lungo la strada e, quando raggiungete un pilastro roccioso con un buco scavato attraverso, lei si volta verso la foresta e imbocca un sentiero sottile e dritto. Guardandoti alle spalle, vedi il sole al tramonto che si incastra nell'apertura del pilastro.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	As you follow Vellorae down the trail, you see the trees gradually show more and more signs of a forest fire, with darker, damaged barks, increasingly ashy soil, and many fallen, decomposing portions of the forest. The trail ends abruptly at a large scar scorched through the forest. The piles of ash still present below your feet almost resemble the rest of the planet's otherwise snowy ground, but somehow are kept from mixing with the snow. Whether deliberately cleared by more workers or some other force, you cannot tell. Near the center of the scar you see a small mound with an opening in the side, almost like a "shack" made out of the charred tree trunks and rocks. A faint light comes from within it.|1962|0
units.english: As you follow Vellorae down the trail, you see the trees gradually show more and more signs of a forest fire, with darker, damaged barks, increasingly ashy soil, and many fallen, decomposing portions of the forest. The trail ends abruptly at a large scar scorched through the forest. The piles of ash still present below your feet almost resemble the rest of the planet's otherwise snowy ground, but somehow are kept from mixing with the snow. Whether deliberately cleared by more workers or some other force, you cannot tell. Near the center of the scar you see a small mound with an opening in the side, almost like a "shack" made out of the charred tree trunks and rocks. A faint light comes from within it.
units.italian: Mentre segui Vellorae lungo il sentiero, vedi che gli alberi mostrano sempre più segni di un incendio boschivo, con cortecce più scure e danneggiate, terreno sempre più cinereo e molte parti della foresta cadute e in decomposizione. Il sentiero finisce bruscamente contro una grande cicatrice bruciata nella foresta. I mucchi di cenere ancora presenti sotto i tuoi piedi somigliano quasi al resto del terreno innevato del pianeta, ma in qualche modo restano separati dalla neve. Che siano stati ripuliti di proposito da altri operai o da qualche altra forza, non sapresti dirlo. Vicino al centro della cicatrice vedi un piccolo tumulo con un'apertura sul lato, quasi una "baracca" fatta di tronchi carbonizzati e rocce. Una luce fioca viene dall'interno.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	While you're looking at the mound, Vellorae grabs your hand and starts hesitantly pulling you toward it. Inside, the fading sunlight behind you contrasts with the source of the light within, a small pyre in the middle of the "shack" which has only a few lone flames dancing on the embers. Vellorae lays down in front of it, removes her bangle, and places it in the flames for a brief moment before snatching it up and standing again. Once on her feet, she grabs your hand again, tugging you along as she hurries back to the edge of the scorched clearing.|1963|0
units.english: While you're looking at the mound, Vellorae grabs your hand and starts hesitantly pulling you toward it. Inside, the fading sunlight behind you contrasts with the source of the light within, a small pyre in the middle of the "shack" which has only a few lone flames dancing on the embers. Vellorae lays down in front of it, removes her bangle, and places it in the flames for a brief moment before snatching it up and standing again. Once on her feet, she grabs your hand again, tugging you along as she hurries back to the edge of the scorched clearing.
units.italian: Mentre guardi il tumulo, Vellorae ti afferra la mano e comincia a tirarti verso di esso con esitazione. Dentro, la luce del sole che sta calando alle tue spalle contrasta con la fonte di luce interna, un piccolo rogo al centro della "baracca" su cui danzano solo poche fiamme solitarie sulle braci. Vellorae si sdraia davanti, toglie il bracciale e lo mette nelle fiamme per un breve momento prima di riprenderlo e rialzarsi. Una volta in piedi, ti afferra di nuovo la mano e ti tira con sé mentre si affretta verso il bordo della radura bruciata.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	She seems to settle again once you have reached the trail, letting go of your hand and slowing her pace.|1964|0
units.english: She seems to settle again once you have reached the trail, letting go of your hand and slowing her pace.
units.italian: Sembra calmarsi quando raggiungete il sentiero, lasciandoti la mano e rallentando il passo.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	"What was that about? What got you so agitated?"|1966|0
units.english: "What was that about? What got you so agitated?"
units.italian: "Che cosa era? Cosa ti ha agitata così?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	(Stay quiet.)|1967|0
units.english: (Stay quiet.)
units.italian: (Resta in silenzio.)

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	She doesn't answer your question, instead simply continuing down the trail. Once you pass the rocky pillar and are back on the proper road again, she finally speaks up. "That... to gift us sunlight, stole the eyes of Ensu Uri, Aul Kell did. Broken apart, It was, and of the light from Its eyes, only specks remained. But finished, It was not, so to implore Adfices is kept safe from It, this was."|1969|0
units.english: She doesn't answer your question, instead simply continuing down the trail. Once you pass the rocky pillar and are back on the proper road again, she finally speaks up. "That... to gift us sunlight, stole the eyes of Ensu Uri, Aul Kell did. Broken apart, It was, and of the light from Its eyes, only specks remained. But finished, It was not, so to implore Adfices is kept safe from It, this was."
units.italian: Non risponde alla tua domanda, limitandosi a proseguire lungo il sentiero. Quando superate il pilastro roccioso e siete di nuovo sulla strada giusta, parla finalmente. "Quello... per donarci la luce del sole, rubò gli occhi di Ensu Uri, Aul Kell lo fece. Spezzato, Esso fu, e della luce dei Suoi occhi, solo frammenti rimasero. Ma finito, Esso non era, quindi implorare che Adfices sia al riparo da Esso, questo era."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 5|	The two of you head back to the village and take the old train back to the railway hub. "Wait for you in the spaceport I will, Captain," Vellorae says. "Clear my head before heading back home, I must."|1971|0
units.english: The two of you head back to the village and take the old train back to the railway hub. "Wait for you in the spaceport I will, Captain," Vellorae says. "Clear my head before heading back home, I must."
units.italian: Tornate al villaggio e prendete il vecchio treno per il nodo ferroviario. "Aspettarvi allo spazioporto, io lo farò, capitano," dice Vellorae. "Schiarirmi la testa prima di tornare a casa, io devo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 6|name|1974|0
units.english: Pilgrimage's End
units.italian: Fine del pellegrinaggio

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 6|description|1975|0
units.english: Bring Vellorae back to her home on <destination>.
units.italian: Riporta Vellorae a casa sua su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 6|You find Vellorae in a snack shop, finishing up a hot drink. "Apologize for the wait I must, Captain. Ready to leave, I was not."|1983|0
units.english: You find Vellorae in a snack shop, finishing up a hot drink. "Apologize for the wait I must, Captain. Ready to leave, I was not."
units.italian: Trovi Vellorae in una tavola calda, che sta finendo una bevanda calda. "Scusarmi per l'attesa, io devo, capitano. Pronta a partire, io non ero."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 6|	"Thought you'd be feeling better than this. You've finally finished your pilgrimage, after all."|1985|0
units.english: "Thought you'd be feeling better than this. You've finally finished your pilgrimage, after all."
units.italian: "Pensavo che ti sentissi meglio di così. Dopotutto hai appena finito il tuo pellegrinaggio."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 6|	"I get it. Sometimes I also need a drink to help me think things over."|1987|0
units.english: "I get it. Sometimes I also need a drink to help me think things over."
units.italian: "Lo capisco. A volte anch'io ho bisogno di bere qualcosa per riflettere."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 6|	She chuckles. "A herbal tea, this is. Help me calm down and rest on the way back home, it will."|1988|0
units.english: She chuckles. "A herbal tea, this is. Help me calm down and rest on the way back home, it will."
units.italian: Ridacchia. "Una tisana, questa è. Mi aiuterà a calmarmi e a riposare sulla via di casa."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 6|	"Yes, relieved I feel, that able to do this, I was. Just... still coming to terms with everything, I am."|1991|0
units.english: "Yes, relieved I feel, that able to do this, I was. Just... still coming to terms with everything, I am."
units.italian: "Sì, sollevata mi sento, che capace di farlo, io fossi. Solo... ancora venendo a patti con tutto, io sto."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 6|	She finishes the drink and gets up to pay for her order, following you to your ship afterwards. "Ready to head back home, I am," she tells you, heading into her bunk as you prepare the course for <destination>.|1993|0
units.english: She finishes the drink and gets up to pay for her order, following you to your ship afterwards. "Ready to head back home, I am," she tells you, heading into her bunk as you prepare the course for <destination>.
units.italian: Finisce la bevanda e si alza per pagare l'ordinazione, poi ti segue alla nave. "Pronta a tornare a casa, io sono," ti dice, entrando nella sua cuccetta mentre prepari la rotta per <destination>.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 6|dialog|1996|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Vellorae hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Vellorae non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 6|Once she leaves your ship, Vellorae gives you your payment of <payment>, and takes your hands in hers. "Deeply grateful I am, for having accompanied me in this journey, Captain <last>. Sure that grateful for your help, Adfices also is."|2001|0
units.english: Once she leaves your ship, Vellorae gives you your payment of <payment>, and takes your hands in hers. "Deeply grateful I am, for having accompanied me in this journey, Captain <last>. Sure that grateful for your help, Adfices also is."
units.italian: Appena lascia la tua nave, Vellorae ti dà il pagamento di <payment> e ti prende le mani nelle sue. "Profondamente grata io sono, per avermi accompagnata in questo viaggio, capitano <last>. Sicura che grato per il vostro aiuto, anche Adfices lo sia."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Pilgrimage 6|	She lets go of your hands, wishes you the best in your travels, and then turns and leaves for her home.|2002|0
units.english: She lets go of your hands, wishes you the best in your travels, and then turns and leaves for her home.
units.italian: Ti lascia le mani, ti augura il meglio nei tuoi viaggi, poi si volta e se ne va verso casa sua.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr|name|2008|0
units.english: Council of Ahr
units.italian: Consiglio di Ahr

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr|description|2009|0
units.english: Bring the representatives of houses Ablomab, Bebliss, and Chamgar to <destination> by <date>, so that they may participate in the Council of Ahr.
units.italian: Porta i rappresentanti delle case Ablomab, Bebliss e Chamgar su <destination> entro <date>, così che possano partecipare al Consiglio di Ahr.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr|Shortly after you enter the spaceport, an Arach in a sturdy, red uniform, with golden "pauldrons" on each of his legs' joints, approaches you. "Greetings, Captain <last>," he says. "Interested in taking up some transport jobs, are you? Very well paid, you would be."|2023|0
units.english: Shortly after you enter the spaceport, an Arach in a sturdy, red uniform, with golden "pauldrons" on each of his legs' joints, approaches you. "Greetings, Captain <last>," he says. "Interested in taking up some transport jobs, are you? Very well paid, you would be."
units.italian: Poco dopo che entri nello spazioporto, un Arach in un'uniforme robusta e rossa, con "spallacci" dorati sulle articolazioni di ciascuna zampa, ti si avvicina. "Salve, capitano <last>," dice. "Interessato a prendere qualche lavoro di trasporto, siete? Molto ben pagato, sareste."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr|	"What are the jobs about?"|2025|0
units.english: "What are the jobs about?"
units.italian: "Di cosa si tratta?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr|	"Paid how well, exactly?"|2026|0
units.english: "Paid how well, exactly?"
units.italian: "Pagato quanto bene, esattamente?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr|	"Sorry, I'm not looking for that type of job right now."|2027|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not looking for that type of job right now."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, al momento non cerco quel tipo di lavoro."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr|	"Happening soon, the Council of Ahr is. Gather on the capital, all Arach houses do. Discuss matters related to Arach space, they will, alongside my lieges of the royal family. Paid <payment>, you would be, if to <destination> by <date>, the remaining representatives of the houses, you brought."|2029|0
units.english: "Happening soon, the Council of Ahr is. Gather on the capital, all Arach houses do. Discuss matters related to Arach space, they will, alongside my lieges of the royal family. Paid <payment>, you would be, if to <destination> by <date>, the remaining representatives of the houses, you brought."
units.italian: "Imminente, il Consiglio di Ahr è. Radunarsi nella capitale, tutte le case Arach lo fanno. Discutere questioni relative allo spazio Arach, loro lo faranno, insieme ai miei signori della famiglia reale. Pagato <payment>, voi sareste, se su <destination> entro <date>, i rappresentanti rimanenti delle case, voi portaste."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr|	"Sounds simple enough. Who are these representatives?"|2031|0
units.english: "Sounds simple enough. Who are these representatives?"
units.italian: "Sembra abbastanza semplice. Chi sono questi rappresentanti?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr|	"Can you tell me more about the Council?"|2033|0
units.english: "Can you tell me more about the Council?"
units.italian: "Puoi dirmi di più sul Consiglio?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr|	"That sounds like it might take a while, and I'm rather busy, so I'll pass."|2034|0
units.english: "That sounds like it might take a while, and I'm rather busy, so I'll pass."
units.italian: "Mi sembra che potrebbe volerci un po', e sono piuttosto impegnato, quindi passo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr|	"Of course. A few centuries after leaving our home planet, entangled in petty wars, the more prominent houses were. Fearing for the fate of their subjects, called for the first Council, the royal family at the time did. A more civil way to solve disputes, it became, and though war still, many of the houses did, far less frequent, the conflicts were. Now that at peace we are, merely a traditional meeting, it is, taking place every few years, so that discuss how to improve the conditions of Arach space, the houses may."|2036|0
units.english: "Of course. A few centuries after leaving our home planet, entangled in petty wars, the more prominent houses were. Fearing for the fate of their subjects, called for the first Council, the royal family at the time did. A more civil way to solve disputes, it became, and though war still, many of the houses did, far less frequent, the conflicts were. Now that at peace we are, merely a traditional meeting, it is, taking place every few years, so that discuss how to improve the conditions of Arach space, the houses may."
units.italian: "Certo. Pochi secoli dopo aver lasciato il nostro pianeta d'origine, impelagate in guerre futili, le case più importanti erano. Temendo per il destino dei loro sudditi, indisse il primo Consiglio, la famiglia reale dell'epoca lo fece. Un modo più civile di risolvere le dispute, divenne, e anche se molte case facevano ancora la guerra, molto meno frequenti, i conflitti erano. Ora che in pace siamo, solo un incontro tradizionale, esso è, che si tiene ogni pochi anni, così che discutere come migliorare le condizioni dello spazio Arach, le case possano."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr|	He shows you a data pad, pointing to three symbols on the screen as he names the houses from left to right. "Issues with her other transport, the representative of House Bebliss had, so waiting on Stronghold of Flugbu, she still is. Word that House Chamgar is ready for the Council, I just received, and on Hammer of Debrugt, their member is. Spare some time for the Council, House Ablomab finally can, and waiting for you on Delve of Bloptab, their envoy is.|2039|0
units.english: He shows you a data pad, pointing to three symbols on the screen as he names the houses from left to right. "Issues with her other transport, the representative of House Bebliss had, so waiting on Stronghold of Flugbu, she still is. Word that House Chamgar is ready for the Council, I just received, and on Hammer of Debrugt, their member is. Spare some time for the Council, House Ablomab finally can, and waiting for you on Delve of Bloptab, their envoy is.
units.italian: Ti mostra un datapad, indicando tre simboli sullo schermo mentre nomina le case da sinistra a destra. "Problemi con il suo altro trasporto, la rappresentante della Casa Bebliss ha avuto, quindi ancora in attesa su Stronghold of Flugbu, lei è. Notizia che la Casa Chamgar è pronta per il Consiglio, appena ricevuta, e su Hammer of Debrugt, il loro membro è. Tempo da dedicare al Consiglio, la Casa Ablomab finalmente può, e in attesa di te su Delve of Bloptab, il loro inviato è.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr|	"Receive your payment, you will, once on <planet>, the three representatives are. I shall inform the houses that expect you, they should. Thankful for your assistance, the royal family is."|2040|0
units.english: "Receive your payment, you will, once on <planet>, the three representatives are. I shall inform the houses that expect you, they should. Thankful for your assistance, the royal family is."
units.italian: "Ricevere il vostro pagamento, voi lo farete, una volta su <planet>, i tre rappresentanti siano. Informerò le case che vi aspettano, loro dovrebbero. Grata per il vostro aiuto, la famiglia reale è."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr|	He briefly bows his head while stretching his legs in some sort of salute, then disappears into the spaceport. Once you're at your ship, you place markers on <stopovers>, where the representatives are waiting.|2041|0
units.english: He briefly bows his head while stretching his legs in some sort of salute, then disappears into the spaceport. Once you're at your ship, you place markers on <stopovers>, where the representatives are waiting.
units.italian: China brevemente il capo mentre distende le zampe in una specie di saluto, poi sparisce nello spazioporto. Una volta sulla tua nave, piazzi dei segnalini su <stopovers>, dove i rappresentanti stanno aspettando.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Ablomab|blocked|2060|0
units.english: You have reached <origin>, but you need <capacity> in order to take on the next mission. Return here when you have the required space free.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <origin>, ma ti serve <capacity> per poter accettare la missione successiva. Torna qui quando avrai lo spazio libero necessario.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Ablomab|You land on <origin> to find that House Ablomab's representative had to oversee an "emergency meltdown drill" on the neighboring planet, Bloptab's Furnace. His interplanetary shuttle still hasn't arrived, so you're left to wait for him on the spaceport.|2067|0
units.english: You land on <origin> to find that House Ablomab's representative had to oversee an "emergency meltdown drill" on the neighboring planet, Bloptab's Furnace. His interplanetary shuttle still hasn't arrived, so you're left to wait for him on the spaceport.
units.italian: Atterri su <origin> e scopri che il rappresentante della Casa Ablomab ha dovuto sovrintendere a un "esercitazione di emergenza per il collasso del reattore" sul pianeta vicino, la Fornace di Bloptab. La sua navetta interplanetaria non è ancora arrivata, quindi non ti resta che aspettarlo allo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Ablomab|	He finally arrives some hours after sunset, dragging along a heavy suitcase and barely holding on to what must be the Arach equivalent of coffee. As you help him with the heavy luggage, he introduces himself as Dubug. "Sorry about the wait, I am. Replace a coworker on the meltdown drill, I had to. A routine task, it is, but also routine, the Council is, so care much for the delay, the house did not. Show me to my room, could you?"|2068|0
units.english: He finally arrives some hours after sunset, dragging along a heavy suitcase and barely holding on to what must be the Arach equivalent of coffee. As you help him with the heavy luggage, he introduces himself as Dubug. "Sorry about the wait, I am. Replace a coworker on the meltdown drill, I had to. A routine task, it is, but also routine, the Council is, so care much for the delay, the house did not. Show me to my room, could you?"
units.italian: Arriva finalmente qualche ora dopo il tramonto, trascinando una valigia pesante e reggendosi a malapena a quello che deve essere l'equivalente Arach del caffè. Mentre lo aiuti con il bagaglio pesante, si presenta come Dubug. "Scusarmi per l'attesa, io devo. Sostituire un collega all'esercitazione sul collasso del reattore, io ho dovuto. Un compito di routine, è, ma anche di routine, il Consiglio è, quindi importarsi del ritardo, la casa non se n'è. Mostrarmi la mia stanza, potresti?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Ablomab|	While you're both walking to your ship, he finishes his drink, but it doesn't seem to help him keep his eyes open; you have to help him avoid bumping into either the other Arachi here or the spaceport decorations. Although he doesn't seem very talkative, it might help his focus to get a conversation going.|2069|0
units.english: While you're both walking to your ship, he finishes his drink, but it doesn't seem to help him keep his eyes open; you have to help him avoid bumping into either the other Arachi here or the spaceport decorations. Although he doesn't seem very talkative, it might help his focus to get a conversation going.
units.italian: Mentre camminate verso la nave, finisce la bevanda, ma non sembra aiutarlo a tenere gli occhi aperti; devi aiutarlo a evitare di sbattere contro gli altri Arachi qui o contro le decorazioni dello spazioporto. Anche se non sembra molto loquace, avviare una conversazione potrebbe aiutarlo a concentrarsi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Ablomab|	"So, what can you tell me about house Ablomab?"|2071|0
units.english: "So, what can you tell me about house Ablomab?"
units.italian: "Allora, cosa puoi dirmi della Casa Ablomab?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Ablomab|	"Is it difficult having to deal with all the other houses in the Council?"|2073|0
units.english: "Is it difficult having to deal with all the other houses in the Council?"
units.italian: "È difficile dover trattare con tutte le altre case nel Consiglio?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Ablomab|	"This Council is hosted by a royal family, right? What can you tell me about them?"|2075|0
units.english: "This Council is hosted by a royal family, right? What can you tell me about them?"
units.italian: "Questo Consiglio è ospitato da una famiglia reale, giusto? Cosa puoi dirmi di loro?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Ablomab|	"The ninth house? Not much to say, there is. Agreed as the 'royals' they were, in ancient times. Never much power, they had, merely a figure of stability, made to assure peace on Ahr. Host the Council, they do, but a tradition it is. Otherwise, mostly to themselves, they keep."|2076|0
units.english: "The ninth house? Not much to say, there is. Agreed as the 'royals' they were, in ancient times. Never much power, they had, merely a figure of stability, made to assure peace on Ahr. Host the Council, they do, but a tradition it is. Otherwise, mostly to themselves, they keep."
units.italian: "La nona casa? Non molto da dire, c'è. D'accordo che fossero i 'reali', lo furono, in tempi antichi. Mai molto potere, hanno avuto, solo un simbolo di stabilità, creato per assicurare la pace su Ahr. Ospitare il Consiglio, loro lo fanno, ma una tradizione è. Per il resto, per lo più per conto loro, se ne stanno."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Ablomab|	He grunts lightly. "The deepest mines and biggest smelters in all the Coalition, we have. Overseeing construction, assuring ore purity, testing the quality of alloys, our most common responsibilities are. In order, everything must be, so that met, the quotas for house Mallob's and the Heliarchs' ships are."|2079|0
units.english: He grunts lightly. "The deepest mines and biggest smelters in all the Coalition, we have. Overseeing construction, assuring ore purity, testing the quality of alloys, our most common responsibilities are. In order, everything must be, so that met, the quotas for house Mallob's and the Heliarchs' ships are."
units.italian: Sbuffa leggermente. "Le miniere più profonde e le fonderie più grandi di tutta la Coalizione, noi le abbiamo. Sovrintendere alle costruzioni, assicurare la purezza del minerale, testare la qualità delle leghe, le nostre responsabilità più comuni sono. In ordine, tutto deve essere, così che rispettate, le quote per le navi della Casa Mallob e degli Heliarchs siano."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Ablomab|	"Started out as noble families from Ahr, most of the houses did. When first mapped out, Arach space was, carved their own portions, the houses did, and naturally for more systems, many fought. Now at ease with each other, the houses are, and ceased, the territorial disputes have." He sighs. "For the most part."|2082|0
units.english: "Started out as noble families from Ahr, most of the houses did. When first mapped out, Arach space was, carved their own portions, the houses did, and naturally for more systems, many fought. Now at ease with each other, the houses are, and ceased, the territorial disputes have." He sighs. "For the most part."
units.italian: "Nate come famiglie nobili di Ahr, la maggior parte delle case lo ha fatto. Quando mappato per la prima volta, lo spazio Arach fu, ritagliarsi le proprie porzioni, le case lo fecero, e naturalmente per più sistemi, molte combatterono. Ora in pace tra loro, le case sono, e cessate, le dispute territoriali sono." Sospira. "Per la maggior parte."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Ablomab|	Dubug makes it to your ship still awake, but doesn't care to answer when you ask if he needs help unpacking his luggage. Instead, he lays on the bed and asks that you wake him up once you arrive on <planet>.|2084|0
units.english: Dubug makes it to your ship still awake, but doesn't care to answer when you ask if he needs help unpacking his luggage. Instead, he lays on the bed and asks that you wake him up once you arrive on <planet>.
units.italian: Dubug arriva alla tua nave ancora sveglio, ma non si cura di rispondere quando gli chiedi se ha bisogno di aiuto a disfare i bagagli. Invece, si sdraia sul letto e ti chiede di svegliarlo quando arrivate su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Ablomab|dialog|2087|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Dubug hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Dubug non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Ablomab|Having rested during the trip here, Dubug stretches his legs once he steps off your ship. "All the reports from my house, I've brought, so prepared for the Council, I am," he says, checking his suitcase one more time. "Well then, go I must. Goodbye, Captain <last>. Thankful for the calm trip, I am. A good break from routine, it was."|2090|0
units.english: Having rested during the trip here, Dubug stretches his legs once he steps off your ship. "All the reports from my house, I've brought, so prepared for the Council, I am," he says, checking his suitcase one more time. "Well then, go I must. Goodbye, Captain <last>. Thankful for the calm trip, I am. A good break from routine, it was."
units.italian: Avendo riposato durante il viaggio fin qui, Dubug si stira le zampe quando scende dalla tua nave. "Tutti i rapporti della mia casa, li ho portati, quindi pronto per il Consiglio, io sono," dice, controllando ancora una volta la valigia. "Beh, allora andare devo. Addio, capitano <last>. Grato per il viaggio tranquillo, io sono. Una bella pausa dalla routine, è stata."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Bebliss|blocked|2096|0
units.english: You have reached <origin>, but you need <capacity> in order to take on the next mission. Return here when you have the required space free.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <origin>, ma ti serve <capacity> per poter accettare la missione successiva. Torna qui quando avrai lo spazio libero necessario.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Bebliss|Once your ship has landed, you receive a message from House Bebliss, directing you to a large hotel in the spaceport city. The security guards don't let you in, so you wait for the representative to come out. About half an hour of waiting later, an elevator nearby opens and many Arachi come out, most of them in formal uniforms and carrying various bags of luggage. An older Arach stands out from the rest on account of being even more formally dressed.|2103|0
units.english: Once your ship has landed, you receive a message from House Bebliss, directing you to a large hotel in the spaceport city. The security guards don't let you in, so you wait for the representative to come out. About half an hour of waiting later, an elevator nearby opens and many Arachi come out, most of them in formal uniforms and carrying various bags of luggage. An older Arach stands out from the rest on account of being even more formally dressed.
units.italian: Appena la tua nave atterra, ricevi un messaggio dalla Casa Bebliss, che ti indirizza a un grande albergo nella città dello spazioporto. Le guardie di sicurezza non ti lasciano entrare, quindi aspetti che la rappresentante esca. Dopo circa mezz'ora di attesa, un ascensore lì vicino si apre e ne escono molti Arachi, la maggior parte in uniformi formali e con varie borse al seguito. Un Arach anziano si distingue dagli altri per essere vestito in modo ancora più formale.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Bebliss|	"My transport to the Council you are, correct?" She asks, and you confirm. "Splendid. Lady Plubat, I am, Captain. Pleased that transport the will of House Bebliss, such an exquisite captain shall. Finally right, those arranging the transport to the Council have gotten it."|2104|0
units.english: "My transport to the Council you are, correct?" She asks, and you confirm. "Splendid. Lady Plubat, I am, Captain. Pleased that transport the will of House Bebliss, such an exquisite captain shall. Finally right, those arranging the transport to the Council have gotten it."
units.italian: "Il mio trasporto al Consiglio, voi siete, giusto?" Chiede, e tu confermi. "Splendido. Lady Plubat, io sono, capitano. Lieta che a trasportare la volontà della Casa Bebliss, un capitano così squisito sarà. Finalmente bene, quelli che organizzano il trasporto al Consiglio hanno fatto."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Bebliss|	She asks you to lead the way to your ship as the other uniformed Arachi follow the two of you, carrying her luggage. "Told, I was, about which representatives tasked with transporting, you were. Bebliss excepted, not the most... intriguing company, they are, so grateful that you're transporting at least one proper guest, you should be."|2105|0
units.english: She asks you to lead the way to your ship as the other uniformed Arachi follow the two of you, carrying her luggage. "Told, I was, about which representatives tasked with transporting, you were. Bebliss excepted, not the most... intriguing company, they are, so grateful that you're transporting at least one proper guest, you should be."
units.italian: Ti chiede di farle strada verso la tua nave mentre gli altri Arachi in uniforme vi seguono portando i suoi bagagli. "Detto, mi è stato, quali rappresentanti incaricati del trasporto, voi eravate. Bebliss a parte, non la compagnia più... intrigante, loro sono, quindi grato che almeno un ospite degno stiate trasportando, voi dovreste essere."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Bebliss|	"Looks like you hold your house in very high regards."|2107|0
units.english: "Looks like you hold your house in very high regards."
units.italian: "Sembra che teniate molto alla vostra casa."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Bebliss|	"You don't seem very excited for the Council. Is there something wrong with the other houses?"|2109|0
units.english: "You don't seem very excited for the Council. Is there something wrong with the other houses?"
units.italian: "Non sembrate molto entusiasta del Consiglio. C'è qualcosa che non va nelle altre case?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Bebliss|	"Is there anything I should know about the hosts of the Council? I heard they were royalty."|2111|0
units.english: "Is there anything I should know about the hosts of the Council? I heard they were royalty."
units.italian: "C'è qualcosa che dovrei sapere sugli ospiti del Consiglio? Ho sentito che sono di sangue reale."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Bebliss|	"The Oberegts? Well, for one, one of the few houses to honor their noble lineage, they are. Elected as a figurehead, in ancient times they were. Never more than that, they have been, lacking real power and focusing only on Ahr, though contributed much to our understanding of medicine, they have. A figurehead, they are, but a good one, and as such some degree of respect, I must grant them."|2112|0
units.english: "The Oberegts? Well, for one, one of the few houses to honor their noble lineage, they are. Elected as a figurehead, in ancient times they were. Never more than that, they have been, lacking real power and focusing only on Ahr, though contributed much to our understanding of medicine, they have. A figurehead, they are, but a good one, and as such some degree of respect, I must grant them."
units.italian: "Gli Oberegt? Beh, tanto per cominciare, una delle poche case a onorare la propria discendenza nobile, loro sono. Eletti come simbolo, in tempi antichi lo furono. Mai più di questo, sono stati, senza vero potere e concentrati solo su Ahr, anche se molto hanno contribuito alla nostra comprensione della medicina. Un simbolo, loro sono, ma un buon simbolo, e come tale un certo rispetto, devo concederglielo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Bebliss|	"Keep the Coalition together, House Bebliss does. What makes communication from one system to another possible, our efforts are. Other than the obvious importance of our work, one of the few houses that kept their noble bloodline pure, and who kept their original emblems, we are. Prejudice against those the other houses mixed with, I have not, but greatly value tradition, we do, and broken tradition, they have, in marrying commoners or... those of other species."|2115|0
units.english: "Keep the Coalition together, House Bebliss does. What makes communication from one system to another possible, our efforts are. Other than the obvious importance of our work, one of the few houses that kept their noble bloodline pure, and who kept their original emblems, we are. Prejudice against those the other houses mixed with, I have not, but greatly value tradition, we do, and broken tradition, they have, in marrying commoners or... those of other species."
units.italian: "Tenere unita la Coalizione, la Casa Bebliss lo fa. Ciò che rende possibile la comunicazione da un sistema all'altro, i nostri sforzi sono. Oltre all'ovvia importanza del nostro lavoro, una delle poche case che ha mantenuto puro il sangue nobile e che ha conservato i propri emblemi originali, noi siamo. Pregiudizi contro quelli con cui le altre case si sono mescolate, non ne ho, ma teniamo molto alla tradizione, noi sì, e loro l'hanno infranta, sposando gente comune o... individui di altre specie."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Bebliss|	"Drifted away from our old ways, most of them have. Take Mallob and Garbarag: barely houses anymore, they are. Fully transitioned into corporations, they have. Claim noble heritage, Debdo does, but in fact a splinter group of our own house, they are, the traitorous offshoots. The worst of them all, however, House Chamgar is. Lunatics clinging on to an ancient rivalry, they are, liars and revisionists who to tarnish our image, wish. Declare war on us, they would, if subjected to the Heliarch government, our houses were not."|2118|0
units.english: "Drifted away from our old ways, most of them have. Take Mallob and Garbarag: barely houses anymore, they are. Fully transitioned into corporations, they have. Claim noble heritage, Debdo does, but in fact a splinter group of our own house, they are, the traitorous offshoots. The worst of them all, however, House Chamgar is. Lunatics clinging on to an ancient rivalry, they are, liars and revisionists who to tarnish our image, wish. Declare war on us, they would, if subjected to the Heliarch government, our houses were not."
units.italian: "Allontanate dal nostro vecchio modo la maggior parte di loro si è. Prendi Mallob e Garbarag: a malapena case, ormai sono. Trasformate del tutto in aziende, si sono. Rivendicare discendenza nobile, Debdo lo fa, ma in realtà un gruppo scissionista della nostra stessa casa, loro sono, i rami traditori. La peggiore di tutte, però, la Casa Chamgar è. Pazzi aggrappati a un'antica rivalità, loro sono, bugiardi e revisionisti che vogliono macchiare la nostra immagine. Dichiararci guerra, lo farebbero, se sottoposte al governo Heliarch, le nostre case non fossero."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Bebliss|	Once you make it to your ship, she has the Arach butlers tidy up her room, then dismisses them. She tells you she will call for you should she need anything then closes the door to her room.|2120|0
units.english: Once you make it to your ship, she has the Arach butlers tidy up her room, then dismisses them. She tells you she will call for you should she need anything then closes the door to her room.
units.italian: Quando arrivate alla nave, fa rassettare la sua stanza dai maggiordomi Arach, poi li congeda. Ti dice che ti chiamerà se avrà bisogno di qualcosa, poi chiude la porta della sua stanza.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Bebliss|dialog|2123|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Lady Plubat hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Lady Plubat non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Bebliss|You land to find a group of Arachi in uniform waiting nearby, ready to carry Plubat's baggage from your ship. "A delightful flight it was, Captain. Hope that you are picked again to transport me in the future, I do," she says, bidding you farewell and leaving for a nearby transport shuttle.|2128|0
units.english: You land to find a group of Arachi in uniform waiting nearby, ready to carry Plubat's baggage from your ship. "A delightful flight it was, Captain. Hope that you are picked again to transport me in the future, I do," she says, bidding you farewell and leaving for a nearby transport shuttle.
units.italian: Atterri e trovi un gruppo di Arachi in uniforme che aspetta lì vicino, pronti a portare i bagagli di Plubat giù dalla nave. "Un volo delizioso, capitano. Spero che vi sceglieranno di nuovo per trasportarmi in futuro, io lo spero," dice, salutandoti e andando verso una navetta di trasporto vicina.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Bebliss|Lady Plubat rushes out of your ship to meet a group of Arachi in uniform, some of which carry her baggage from your ship, while others surround her as if expecting House Chamgar's Plubat to try and stir up a discussion. Once all her bags are out, they escort her to a nearby transport shuttle.|2131|0
units.english: Lady Plubat rushes out of your ship to meet a group of Arachi in uniform, some of which carry her baggage from your ship, while others surround her as if expecting House Chamgar's Plubat to try and stir up a discussion. Once all her bags are out, they escort her to a nearby transport shuttle.
units.italian: Lady Plubat si precipita fuori dalla tua nave per incontrare un gruppo di Arachi in uniforme, alcuni dei quali portano i suoi bagagli giù dalla nave, mentre altri la circondano come se si aspettassero che il Plubat della Casa Chamgar provi ad attaccare discorso. Una volta che tutte le sue borse sono fuori, la scortano a una navetta di trasporto vicina.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Chamgar|blocked|2137|0
units.english: You have reached <origin>, but you need <capacity> in order to take on the next mission. Return here when you have the required space free.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <origin>, ma ti serve <capacity> per poter accettare la missione successiva. Torna qui quando avrai lo spazio libero necessario.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Chamgar|You can barely step off your ship before House Chamgar's representative greets you. "Honored that transporting me, such an esteemed pilot is, Captain <last>. Certain, I am, that honored you also are. An important task it is, to transport one from the great House Chamgar. Plubat, my name is, and as time we still have, show you our installations I must."|2144|0
units.english: You can barely step off your ship before House Chamgar's representative greets you. "Honored that transporting me, such an esteemed pilot is, Captain <last>. Certain, I am, that honored you also are. An important task it is, to transport one from the great House Chamgar. Plubat, my name is, and as time we still have, show you our installations I must."
units.italian: Riesci a malapena a scendere dalla nave prima che il rappresentante della Casa Chamgar ti saluti. "Onorato che a trasportarmi, un pilota così stimato sia, capitano <last>. Certo, io sono, che onorato lo siate anche voi. Un compito importante è, trasportare uno della grande Casa Chamgar. Plubat, il mio nome è, e dato che tempo abbiamo ancora, mostrarvi le nostre installazioni, io devo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Chamgar|	He drags you around the eccentric spaceport, bringing you to odd exhibits where some pieces of technology are being constructed or repaired, going on about House Chamgar's advances. The tour goes on for some hours as you pretend to be impressed by what he calls "the newest prototypes" (most of which look like standard Coalition technology). Only after he drags you around again, stopping at a nearby hotel where he picks up his luggage, do you finally get him to follow you to your ship.|2145|0
units.english: He drags you around the eccentric spaceport, bringing you to odd exhibits where some pieces of technology are being constructed or repaired, going on about House Chamgar's advances. The tour goes on for some hours as you pretend to be impressed by what he calls "the newest prototypes" (most of which look like standard Coalition technology). Only after he drags you around again, stopping at a nearby hotel where he picks up his luggage, do you finally get him to follow you to your ship.
units.italian: Ti trascina per lo spazioporto eccentrico, portandoti a strane esposizioni dove alcune parti di tecnologia vengono costruite o riparate, e parlando senza sosta dei progressi della Casa Chamgar. Il giro va avanti per qualche ora mentre tu fingi di essere impressionato da quelli che lui chiama "i prototipi più recenti" (la maggior parte dei quali sembra tecnologia standard della Coalizione). Solo dopo che ti trascina di nuovo in giro, fermandosi a un albergo vicino dove ritira i bagagli, riesci finalmente a farlo seguire alla nave.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Chamgar|	It doesn't take long for him to get started again. "Now, Captain <last>, time for a full tour of our spaceport facilities, today we don't have; to the Council, we must go, but happy to answer your many questions about our great house, I am. Wondering how we invented our repair modules, are you? Or maybe by our special alloys, intrigued you are?"|2146|0
units.english: It doesn't take long for him to get started again. "Now, Captain <last>, time for a full tour of our spaceport facilities, today we don't have; to the Council, we must go, but happy to answer your many questions about our great house, I am. Wondering how we invented our repair modules, are you? Or maybe by our special alloys, intrigued you are?"
units.italian: Non ci vuole molto perché ricominci. "Ora, capitano <last>, il tempo per un giro completo delle nostre strutture dello spazioporto, oggi non lo abbiamo; al Consiglio, dobbiamo andare, ma felice di rispondere alle vostre molte domande sulla nostra grande casa, io sono. Vi chiedete come abbiamo inventato i nostri moduli di riparazione, vero? O magari dalle nostre leghe speciali, incuriosito voi siete?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Chamgar|	"Well, why don't you tell me a bit about your house?"|2148|0
units.english: "Well, why don't you tell me a bit about your house?"
units.italian: "Beh, perché non mi racconti qualcosa della tua casa?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Chamgar|	"How about you tell me about the other houses that are going to the Council?"|2150|0
units.english: "How about you tell me about the other houses that are going to the Council?"
units.italian: "Che ne dici di parlarmi delle altre case che andranno al Consiglio?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Chamgar|	"Actually, I'm curious about the hosts of the Council."|2152|0
units.english: "Actually, I'm curious about the hosts of the Council."
units.italian: "In realtà, sono curioso di sapere degli ospiti del Consiglio."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Chamgar|	He stops dead in his tracks. "The royals? Well, not much to say, there is. Chosen as such on a primitive Ahr, only symbolic, their role is. Never held any ambition, they have, remaining the weakest house since formed. Assured stability on the capital, they have, and in good relations with us, they are, for recognize our value, they do, so bad, they are not, only uninteresting."|2153|0
units.english: He stops dead in his tracks. "The royals? Well, not much to say, there is. Chosen as such on a primitive Ahr, only symbolic, their role is. Never held any ambition, they have, remaining the weakest house since formed. Assured stability on the capital, they have, and in good relations with us, they are, for recognize our value, they do, so bad, they are not, only uninteresting."
units.italian: Si ferma di colpo. "I reali? Beh, non molto da dire, c'è. Scelti come tali su un'Ahr primitiva, solo simbolico, il loro ruolo è. Mai avuto ambizioni, hanno, restando la casa più debole da quando si è formata. Assicurata la stabilità nella capitale, loro l'hanno, e in buoni rapporti con noi, loro sono, perché riconoscono il nostro valore, quindi cattivi non sono, solo poco interessanti."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Chamgar|	You can barely finish your question, as he begins what is undoubtedly a rehearsed speech. "The greatest Arach warriors of old, we were, and always at the forefront of scientific progress and creative inventions. For the brilliant breakthrough that were our repair modules, persecuted by the Quarg, we were, but here, in this system, on this planet, held a chokepoint, we did. Guarded Arach space from them, for centuries we had to, until banished with the help of our Saryd and Kimek friends, they were."|2156|0
units.english: You can barely finish your question, as he begins what is undoubtedly a rehearsed speech. "The greatest Arach warriors of old, we were, and always at the forefront of scientific progress and creative inventions. For the brilliant breakthrough that were our repair modules, persecuted by the Quarg, we were, but here, in this system, on this planet, held a chokepoint, we did. Guarded Arach space from them, for centuries we had to, until banished with the help of our Saryd and Kimek friends, they were."
units.italian: Riesci a malapena a finire la domanda, perché lui comincia quello che è senza dubbio un discorso imparato a memoria. "I più grandi guerrieri Arach dell'antichità, noi eravamo, e sempre all'avanguardia del progresso scientifico e delle invenzioni creative. Per la brillante scoperta che furono i nostri moduli di riparazione, perseguitati dai Quarg, noi fummo, ma qui, in questo sistema, su questo pianeta, controllavamo un collo di bottiglia, noi lo facevamo. Difendere lo spazio Arach da loro, per secoli abbiamo dovuto, finché banditi con l'aiuto dei nostri amici Saryd e Kimek, loro furono."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Chamgar|	"Alright, most of them are. Amicable relations with nearly all houses, we maintain. Except with the scum from Bebliss, lying, treacherous snakes they are. Conspiring against the government, helping rebels they are! 'Their' world, Stronghold of Flugbu is not, stolen from us, it was. Heed my warning, Captain: trust them, you should not, preferable to trust a Quarg, it is."|2159|0
units.english: "Alright, most of them are. Amicable relations with nearly all houses, we maintain. Except with the scum from Bebliss, lying, treacherous snakes they are. Conspiring against the government, helping rebels they are! 'Their' world, Stronghold of Flugbu is not, stolen from us, it was. Heed my warning, Captain: trust them, you should not, preferable to trust a Quarg, it is."
units.italian: "Va bene, la maggior parte di loro lo è. Rapporti amichevoli con quasi tutte le case, manteniamo. Tranne con la feccia di Bebliss, serpenti bugiardi e traditori che sono. Cospirano contro il governo, aiutano i ribelli! 'Il loro' mondo, Stronghold of Flugbu non è, rubato a noi, è stato. Ascoltate il mio avvertimento, capitano: fidarvi di loro, non dovreste, preferibile fidarsi di un Quarg, è."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Chamgar|	He seems ready to have you ask another question, but as you reach your ship, he picks up a call on a communication device and signals for you to show him to his room. He then says that he must handle some business, and that he'll talk to you again later.|2161|0
units.english: He seems ready to have you ask another question, but as you reach your ship, he picks up a call on a communication device and signals for you to show him to his room. He then says that he must handle some business, and that he'll talk to you again later.
units.italian: Sembra pronto a farti fare un'altra domanda, ma quando raggiungete la nave risponde a una chiamata su un dispositivo di comunicazione e ti fa cenno di mostrargli la sua stanza. Poi dice che deve sbrigare alcune faccende, e che ti parlerà di nuovo più tardi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Chamgar|dialog|2164|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Plubat hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Plubat non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Chamgar|"Captain <last>! A pleasurable experience for the both of us, this has been, but sadly short, the trip from my home to <planet> is, so part ways, we must," Plubat says as he prepares to leave your ship. "To finish the tour of our facilities, I'm sure you want, so once over, the Council is, ask for me there, and guide you again, I shall."|2169|0
units.english: "Captain <last>! A pleasurable experience for the both of us, this has been, but sadly short, the trip from my home to <planet> is, so part ways, we must," Plubat says as he prepares to leave your ship. "To finish the tour of our facilities, I'm sure you want, so once over, the Council is, ask for me there, and guide you again, I shall."
units.italian: "Capitano <last>! Un'esperienza piacevole per entrambi, questa è stata, ma purtroppo breve, il viaggio da casa mia a <planet> è, quindi separarci, dobbiamo," dice Plubat mentre si prepara a lasciare la nave. "Finire il giro delle nostre strutture, sono sicuro che vogliate, quindi una volta finito il Consiglio, cercatemi lì, e guidarvi di nuovo, io lo farò."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Chamgar|House Chamgar's representative, Plubat, stays close to you while firmly clinging to his luggage, as his colleague from house Bebliss, Lady Plubat, has her bags brought out of your ship by some nearby Arachi in uniform. "Telling you I am, Captain, trusted, she should not be. Checked your ship, have you? All in place, your belongings are? Careful with her types, you must be," he says. After the Bebliss butlers are done, Plubat scoffs something at Lady Plubat one last time, then leaves your ship.|2172|0
units.english: House Chamgar's representative, Plubat, stays close to you while firmly clinging to his luggage, as his colleague from house Bebliss, Lady Plubat, has her bags brought out of your ship by some nearby Arachi in uniform. "Telling you I am, Captain, trusted, she should not be. Checked your ship, have you? All in place, your belongings are? Careful with her types, you must be," he says. After the Bebliss butlers are done, Plubat scoffs something at Lady Plubat one last time, then leaves your ship.
units.italian: Il rappresentante della Casa Chamgar, Plubat, resta vicino a te stringendo saldamente il bagaglio, mentre la sua collega della Casa Bebliss, Lady Plubat, fa portare le sue borse fuori dalla nave da alcuni Arachi in uniforme lì vicino. "Ve lo sto dicendo, capitano, di lei non dovreste fidarvi. Controllato la nave, avete? Tutto a posto, le vostre cose sono? Attento ai tipi come lei, dovete essere," dice. Dopo che i maggiordomi di Bebliss hanno finito, Plubat sibila qualcosa a Lady Plubat un'ultima volta, poi lascia la nave.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Drama|After departing from <origin>, you start hearing some shouting from outside your cockpit, so you leave to check up on your passengers. Plubat, from House Chamgar, is banging one leg against the door to the room of Plubat, from House Bebliss. "Captain! Good thing that here, you are," he says. "Sent an envoy to mock me, that damned house Bebliss has! Copying my name, she is!"|2190|0
units.english: After departing from <origin>, you start hearing some shouting from outside your cockpit, so you leave to check up on your passengers. Plubat, from House Chamgar, is banging one leg against the door to the room of Plubat, from House Bebliss. "Captain! Good thing that here, you are," he says. "Sent an envoy to mock me, that damned house Bebliss has! Copying my name, she is!"
units.italian: Dopo la partenza da <origin>, cominci a sentire delle urla fuori dalla cabina di pilotaggio, quindi esci a controllare i passeggeri. Plubat, della Casa Chamgar, sta battendo una zampa contro la porta della stanza di Plubat, della Casa Bebliss. "Capitano! Una fortuna che qui, voi siate," dice. "Mandato un inviato per deridermi, quella dannata Casa Bebliss lo ha fatto! Copiare il mio nome, lei lo sta facendo!"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Drama|	Plubat, from House Bebliss, opens the door to her room to respond. "Nonsense that is, Captain. Look at us, several decades older, I am, so copying you, how could I be? The offending party here, house Chamgar is."|2191|0
units.english: Plubat, from House Bebliss, opens the door to her room to respond. "Nonsense that is, Captain. Look at us, several decades older, I am, so copying you, how could I be? The offending party here, house Chamgar is."
units.italian: Plubat, della Casa Bebliss, apre la porta della sua stanza per rispondere. "Sciocchezze, queste sono, capitano. Guardateci, qualche decennio più vecchia, io sono, quindi copiarvi, come potrei? La parte offensiva qui, la Casa Chamgar è."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Drama|	"Changed your name for this mockery, you could have. Know of your house's grudge against us, I do," he replies.|2192|0
units.english: "Changed your name for this mockery, you could have. Know of your house's grudge against us, I do," he replies.
units.italian: "Cambiato il nome per questa presa in giro, avreste potuto. Conoscere il rancore della vostra casa contro di noi, io lo conosco," risponde lui.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Drama|	"Absurd, childish, that is. The one to start mocking me, you were," she says. "Captain <last>, urge you to make haste for Ahr, I must. Put up with this buffoon for much longer, I cannot."|2193|0
units.english: "Absurd, childish, that is. The one to start mocking me, you were," she says. "Captain <last>, urge you to make haste for Ahr, I must. Put up with this buffoon for much longer, I cannot."
units.italian: "Assurdo, infantile, questo è. Quello che ha cominciato a deridermi, voi siete stati," dice. "Capitano <last>, esortarvi a fare in fretta per Ahr, io devo. Sopportare questo buffone ancora a lungo, io non posso."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Drama|	Lady Plubat closes the door to her room again, and you convince house Chamgar's representative to also go back to his room. You return to your cockpit, hoping that's the last of that.|2194|0
units.english: Lady Plubat closes the door to her room again, and you convince house Chamgar's representative to also go back to his room. You return to your cockpit, hoping that's the last of that.
units.italian: Lady Plubat richiude la porta della sua stanza, e tu convinci il rappresentante della Casa Chamgar a tornare anche lui nella sua. Torni in cabina di pilotaggio, sperando che sia stata l'ultima volta.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: Drama|dialog|2196|0
units.english: In spite of your best attempts to keep them away from each other, Plubat and Plubat have been brief on their breaks from insulting one another. However, once you enter this system, they head back to their rooms on their own without you needing to leave the cockpit to interfere. Being so close to their destination, you hope they won't give you any more headaches.
units.italian: Nonostante i tuoi migliori tentativi di tenerli lontani, Plubat e Plubat sono stati brevi nelle loro pause dall'insultarsi a vicenda. Tuttavia, una volta entrati in questo sistema, tornano nelle loro stanze da soli senza che tu debba lasciare la cabina per intervenire. Essendo così vicini alla destinazione, speri che non ti diano altri mal di testa.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: On Complete|A few minutes after the final representative leaves your ship, you receive your payment of 4,500,000 credits. It comes with a message from the royal family, with the symbols of all Arach houses on it. You recognize most from advertisements or offices on some planets, but it's your first time seeing the center one. You imagine it's the emblem of the royal family.|2206|0
units.context: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: On Complete
units.english: A few minutes after the final representative leaves your ship, you receive your payment of 4,500,000 credits. It comes with a message from the royal family, with the symbols of all Arach houses on it. You recognize most from advertisements or offices on some planets, but it's your first time seeing the center one. You imagine it's the emblem of the royal family.
units.italian: Qualche minuto dopo che l'ultimo rappresentante lascia la tua nave, ricevi il pagamento di 4.500.000 crediti. Arriva con un messaggio della famiglia reale, con i simboli di tutte le case Arach sopra. Riconosci la maggior parte da pubblicità o uffici su alcuni pianeti, ma è la prima volta che vedi quello centrale. Immagini che sia l'emblema della famiglia reale.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: On Complete|	"Greetings, Captain <last>. As the hosts of the Council of Ahr, thank you for your assistance we do. Although certain we are that, to you, appear mundane such kinds of jobs can, difficult, at times it is, to arrange for appropriate transportation for our compatriots from all great houses, so know that deeply grateful for your cooperation, House Oberegt is."|2208|0
units.context: mission:Coalition: Council of Ahr: On Complete
units.english: "Greetings, Captain <last>. As the hosts of the Council of Ahr, thank you for your assistance we do. Although certain we are that, to you, appear mundane such kinds of jobs can, difficult, at times it is, to arrange for appropriate transportation for our compatriots from all great houses, so know that deeply grateful for your cooperation, House Oberegt is."
units.italian: "Salve, capitano <last>. Come ospiti del Consiglio di Ahr, ringraziarvi per il vostro aiuto, noi lo facciamo. Anche se certi siamo che, a voi, banali possano sembrare questo tipo di lavori, difficile, a volte, è organizzare un trasporto adeguato per i nostri compatrioti di tutte le grandi case, quindi sappiate che profondamente grata per la vostra collaborazione, la Casa Oberegt è."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 1|name|2214|0
units.english: Underwater Delivery
units.italian: Consegna sottomarina

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 1|description|2215|0
units.english: Bring Apri'ie to <destination>, where five new deep-sea submarines are waiting to be brought to Second Cerulean.
units.italian: Porta Apri'ie su <destination>, dove cinque nuovi sottomarini d'alto mare aspettano di essere portati su Second Cerulean.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 1|You notice a Kimek anxiously glancing at the docks from the front of an office building. Once he notices you, he scurries closer. "Say, Captain, willing to do me a service, are you? Transport off-world, I need."|2226|0
units.english: You notice a Kimek anxiously glancing at the docks from the front of an office building. Once he notices you, he scurries closer. "Say, Captain, willing to do me a service, are you? Transport off-world, I need."
units.italian: Noti un Kimek che lancia occhiate nervose ai moli dalla facciata di un edificio per uffici. Appena ti nota, si avvicina di corsa. "Dica, capitano, disposto a farmi un servizio, lei è? Trasporto fuori dal pianeta, mi serve."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 1|	"Where do you want to go?"|2228|0
units.english: "Where do you want to go?"
units.italian: "Dove vuoi andare?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 1|	"I'm not looking for transport jobs right now, sorry."|2229|0
units.english: "I'm not looking for transport jobs right now, sorry."
units.italian: "Al momento non cerco lavori di trasporto, mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 1|	"A prestigious research group from Second Cerulean, I represent, and looking to expand our deep-sea expeditions, we are. For that, just settled the acquisition of five new submarines, my superiors have," he says. "To pick them up from <planet>, I was selected, so transported there, I must be. Permitted to pay you <payment> for the service, I am."|2231|0
units.english: "A prestigious research group from Second Cerulean, I represent, and looking to expand our deep-sea expeditions, we are. For that, just settled the acquisition of five new submarines, my superiors have," he says. "To pick them up from <planet>, I was selected, so transported there, I must be. Permitted to pay you <payment> for the service, I am."
units.italian: "Un prestigioso gruppo di ricerca di Second Cerulean, io rappresento, e cerchiamo di ampliare le nostre spedizioni in alto mare. Per questo, appena concluso l'acquisto di cinque nuovi sottomarini, i miei superiori lo hanno," dice. "Per ritirarli da <planet>, io sono stato scelto, quindi trasportato lì, io devo essere. Autorizzato a pagarvi <payment> per il servizio, io sono."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 1|	"Alright, I'll show you to my ship."|2233|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll show you to my ship."
units.italian: "Va bene, ti accompagno alla mia nave."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 1|	"Why weren't they built on Second Cerulean in the first place?"|2235|0
units.english: "Why weren't they built on Second Cerulean in the first place?"
units.italian: "Perché non li hanno costruiti direttamente su Second Cerulean?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 1|	"Sorry, I'm not headed that way."|2236|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not headed that way."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non vado in quella direzione."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 1|	"No facilities for such construction, Second Cerulean has," he explains. "Remain mostly untouched, the planet must. Build more than simple research stations on it, we cannot. But in need of sturdier subs, we are, so held a competition to determine what company was to build them, my group did. In my opinion, honestly, not needed such a process was. Obvious that House Mallob would win, it was. Unrivaled in hull integrity, they are."|2238|0
units.english: "No facilities for such construction, Second Cerulean has," he explains. "Remain mostly untouched, the planet must. Build more than simple research stations on it, we cannot. But in need of sturdier subs, we are, so held a competition to determine what company was to build them, my group did. In my opinion, honestly, not needed such a process was. Obvious that House Mallob would win, it was. Unrivaled in hull integrity, they are."
units.italian: "Nessuna struttura per costruzioni del genere, Second Cerulean ha," spiega. "Restare per lo più intatto, il pianeta deve. Costruire più che semplici stazioni di ricerca su di esso, noi non possiamo. Ma bisognosi di sottomarini più robusti, noi siamo, quindi abbiamo indetto una gara per stabilire quale azienda dovesse costruirli, il mio gruppo lo ha fatto. Secondo me, onestamente, non serviva un processo del genere. Ovvio che la Casa Mallob avrebbe vinto, era. Senza rivali nell'integrità dello scafo, loro sono."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 1|	"I see. Well, I'd love to help you. Let me show you to my ship."|2240|0
units.english: "I see. Well, I'd love to help you. Let me show you to my ship."
units.italian: "Capisco. Beh, sarei felice di aiutarti. Lascia che ti accompagni alla mia nave."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 1|	"What's so special about this planet that you can't do it there? One shipyard shouldn't be too invasive."|2242|0
units.english: "What's so special about this planet that you can't do it there? One shipyard shouldn't be too invasive."
units.italian: "Cosa ha di così speciale questo pianeta da non poterlo fare lì? Un cantiere non dovrebbe essere troppo invasivo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 1|	"Well, I wish you luck, but I'm not headed that way, sorry."|2243|0
units.english: "Well, I wish you luck, but I'm not headed that way, sorry."
units.italian: "Beh, ti auguro buona fortuna, ma non vado in quella direzione, mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 1|	He thinks for a while, formulating a response. "Centuries ago, when built there, our outpost was, being worried that trouble the delicate, unique food chains there, further expansion would, prohibited all from settling, and us from constructing any more than the necessary structures, the government did. Enough data, we've gathered, that managed to convince them to allow us some extra exploration vessels, we have. More invasive, the studies with them will be, but enough about the fauna and flora, we now know, that avoid any major complications, we can."|2245|0
units.english: He thinks for a while, formulating a response. "Centuries ago, when built there, our outpost was, being worried that trouble the delicate, unique food chains there, further expansion would, prohibited all from settling, and us from constructing any more than the necessary structures, the government did. Enough data, we've gathered, that managed to convince them to allow us some extra exploration vessels, we have. More invasive, the studies with them will be, but enough about the fauna and flora, we now know, that avoid any major complications, we can."
units.italian: Ci pensa un po', formulando una risposta. "Secoli fa, quando costruito lì, il nostro avamposto fu, preoccupato che problemi alle delicate e uniche catene alimentari lì, un'ulteriore espansione avrebbe causato, proibito a tutti di stabilirsi, e a noi di costruire più delle strutture necessarie, il governo lo fece. Dati sufficienti, abbiamo raccolto, che siamo riusciti a convincerli a concederci qualche nave di esplorazione in più, noi lo abbiamo. Più invasive, gli studi con esse saranno, ma abbastanza sulla fauna e la flora, ora sappiamo, che evitare qualsiasi complicazione grave, noi possiamo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 1|	"Seems like a lot of bureaucracy just for some research. Anyway, I'd be glad to help, let's head to my ship."|2247|0
units.english: "Seems like a lot of bureaucracy just for some research. Anyway, I'd be glad to help, let's head to my ship."
units.italian: "Sembra un sacco di burocrazia solo per un po' di ricerca. Comunque, sarei felice di aiutarti, andiamo alla mia nave."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 1|	"If the planet's native life is all underwater, how would a shipyard pose any risk? It's not like you'd build it underwater."|2249|0
units.english: "If the planet's native life is all underwater, how would a shipyard pose any risk? It's not like you'd build it underwater."
units.italian: "Se la vita nativa del pianeta è tutta sott'acqua, che rischio porrebbe un cantiere? Non è che lo costruireste sott'acqua."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 1|	"That sounds overly complicated. I wish you luck in getting it all set, but I'm not headed there, so I can't help you."|2250|0
