units.english: "That sounds overly complicated. I wish you luck in getting it all set, but I'm not headed there, so I can't help you."
units.italian: "Mi sembra eccessivamente complicato. Ti auguro buona fortuna a sistemare tutto, ma non vado lì, quindi non posso aiutarti."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 1|	Like a bush in the wind, his body shivers wildly at what you said. "No, built underwater, nothing would be. Obvious that is. But, still, make the rules, I do not, Captain. Simply following them, I am."|2252|0
units.english: Like a bush in the wind, his body shivers wildly at what you said. "No, built underwater, nothing would be. Obvious that is. But, still, make the rules, I do not, Captain. Simply following them, I am."
units.italian: Come un cespuglio al vento, il suo corpo trema convulsamente per quello che hai detto. "No, costruito sott'acqua, niente sarebbe. Ovvio che è. Ma, comunque, fare le regole, io non lo faccio, capitano. Semplicemente seguirle, io sto."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 1|	"I see. Well, I'd love to help you. Let me show you to my ship."|2254|0
units.english: "I see. Well, I'd love to help you. Let me show you to my ship."
units.italian: "Capisco. Beh, sarei felice di aiutarti. Lascia che ti accompagni alla mia nave."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 1|	"Well, I'm not really interested in this, sorry."|2255|0
units.english: "Well, I'm not really interested in this, sorry."
units.italian: "Beh, non mi interessa molto, mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 1|	"Very good. Thank you, Captain. Called Apri'ie, and a member of the Pale Waters research center, I am. A wonderful trip, may we have." You bring him to your ship and help him settle what little luggage he has in his room.|2258|0
units.english: "Very good. Thank you, Captain. Called Apri'ie, and a member of the Pale Waters research center, I am. A wonderful trip, may we have." You bring him to your ship and help him settle what little luggage he has in his room.
units.italian: "Molto bene. Grazie, capitano. Apri'ie mi chiamo, e membro del centro di ricerca Acque Pallide, io sono. Un viaggio meraviglioso, che possiamo avere." Lo porti alla nave e lo aiuti a sistemare il poco bagaglio che ha nella sua stanza.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 1|dialog|2261|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Apri'ie hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Apri'ie non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 1|Apri'ie has you land by one of House Mallob's offices, which looks like a mix of a skyscraper and a warehouse, and hands you <payment>.|2266|0
units.english: Apri'ie has you land by one of House Mallob's offices, which looks like a mix of a skyscraper and a warehouse, and hands you <payment>.
units.italian: Apri'ie ti fa atterrare vicino a uno degli uffici della Casa Mallob, che sembra un misto tra un grattacielo e un magazzino, e ti consegna <payment>.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 1|	"Thank you for the assistance, Captain <last>. Meet with House Mallob's executives, I must, but if to continue helping, you wish, meet you in the spaceport, I will. The proper transportation of the submarines, the next step is, so if interested, you are, free up space for them, you must." He pauses, as if counting the total weight. "About 60 tons, they should take up. At any rate, talk more in detail in the spaceport, we may." He picks up his belongings and heads for the office, disappearing into the building.|2267|0
units.english: "Thank you for the assistance, Captain <last>. Meet with House Mallob's executives, I must, but if to continue helping, you wish, meet you in the spaceport, I will. The proper transportation of the submarines, the next step is, so if interested, you are, free up space for them, you must." He pauses, as if counting the total weight. "About 60 tons, they should take up. At any rate, talk more in detail in the spaceport, we may." He picks up his belongings and heads for the office, disappearing into the building.
units.italian: "Grazie per l'assistenza, capitano <last>. Incontrarmi con i dirigenti della Casa Mallob, io devo, ma se continuare ad aiutare, voi volete, incontrarvi allo spazioporto, io lo farò. Il trasporto adeguato dei sottomarini, il prossimo passo è, quindi se interessati, voi siete, liberare spazio per loro, voi dovete." Fa una pausa, come se stesse contando il peso totale. "Circa 60 tonnellate, dovrebbero occupare. In ogni caso, parlare più in dettaglio allo spazioporto, noi potremo." Prende le sue cose e si dirige verso l'ufficio, sparendo nell'edificio.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 2|name|2270|0
units.english: Pressurized Stress Test
units.italian: Prova di stress in pressione

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 2|description|2271|0
units.english: Bring Apri'ie and the <cargo> to <destination>, where the submarines will be subjected to some final high-pressure stress tests.
units.italian: Porta Apri'ie e <cargo> su <destination>, dove i sottomarini saranno sottoposti ad alcune prove finali di stress ad alta pressione.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 2|blocked|2274|0
units.english: You need <capacity> to help Apri'ie move the submarines. Return here when you have the required space free.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> per aiutare Apri'ie a spostare i sottomarini. Torna qui quando avrai lo spazio libero necessario.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 2|After spending some time in the spaceport, you begin to ask around for Apri'ie and are directed to a small office of House Mallob. There, a manager briefly looks into their systems and informs you that Apri'ie hasn't left his meeting yet, and so you take a seat in the spaceport, occasionally getting up to check back at the entrance of the office he entered. After some hours, you finally see him exit, accompanied by a Saryd speaking on a communication device as they glance at a data pad.|2281|0
units.english: After spending some time in the spaceport, you begin to ask around for Apri'ie and are directed to a small office of House Mallob. There, a manager briefly looks into their systems and informs you that Apri'ie hasn't left his meeting yet, and so you take a seat in the spaceport, occasionally getting up to check back at the entrance of the office he entered. After some hours, you finally see him exit, accompanied by a Saryd speaking on a communication device as they glance at a data pad.
units.italian: Dopo aver passato un po' di tempo allo spazioporto, cominci a chiedere di Apri'ie e vieni indirizzato a un piccolo ufficio della Casa Mallob. Lì un dirigente dà un'occhiata ai loro sistemi e ti informa che Apri'ie non è ancora uscito dalla riunione, quindi ti siedi allo spazioporto, alzandoti ogni tanto per controllare di nuovo l'ingresso dell'ufficio in cui è entrato. Dopo alcune ore, lo vedi finalmente uscire, accompagnato da un Saryd che parla a un dispositivo di comunicazione mentre guarda un datapad.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 2|	"Captain <last>! Glad that you are interested in assisting us further, I am. Prepared to have the submarines loaded into your cargo hold, are you?" Apri'ie asks. "Ready to conduct some final stress tests, colleagues of mine on <planet> are."|2282|0
units.english: "Captain <last>! Glad that you are interested in assisting us further, I am. Prepared to have the submarines loaded into your cargo hold, are you?" Apri'ie asks. "Ready to conduct some final stress tests, colleagues of mine on <planet> are."
units.italian: "Capitano <last>! Contento che interessato ad assisterci ulteriormente, voi siate, io sono. Pronto a far caricare i sottomarini nella vostra stiva, voi siete?" chiede Apri'ie. "Pronti a condurre alcune prove di stress finali, i miei colleghi su <planet> sono."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 2|	"Sure thing, I've set aside the space for them."|2284|0
units.english: "Sure thing, I've set aside the space for them."
units.italian: "Certo, ho tenuto da parte lo spazio per loro."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 2|	"What sort of testing are you going to do?"|2286|0
units.english: "What sort of testing are you going to do?"
units.italian: "Che tipo di prove farete?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 2|	"Capable of enduring rapid shifts in pressure, the subs must be, so take quick, deep dives in the oceans of <planet>, and then resurface just as quickly, they will," he says. "Performed their own tests, House Mallob has, so most assuredly ready to go, the vessels are, but just as a formality, perform these tests, we must."|2287|0
units.english: "Capable of enduring rapid shifts in pressure, the subs must be, so take quick, deep dives in the oceans of <planet>, and then resurface just as quickly, they will," he says. "Performed their own tests, House Mallob has, so most assuredly ready to go, the vessels are, but just as a formality, perform these tests, we must."
units.italian: "Capaci di sopportare rapidi cambi di pressione, i sottomarini devono essere, quindi immersioni rapide e profonde negli oceani di <planet>, e poi riemergere altrettanto rapidamente, loro lo faranno," dice. "Fatte le loro prove, la Casa Mallob le ha, quindi quasi certamente pronti a partire, i mezzi sono, ma solo per formalità, eseguire queste prove, noi dobbiamo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 2|	"I see. Well, I'm ready to go, so you can have the submarines brought to my ship."|2289|0
units.english: "I see. Well, I'm ready to go, so you can have the submarines brought to my ship."
units.italian: "Capisco. Beh, sono pronto a partire, quindi puoi far portare i sottomarini alla mia nave."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 2|	"Why not just do those tests on Second Cerulean right away?"|2291|0
units.english: "Why not just do those tests on Second Cerulean right away?"
units.italian: "Perché non fare subito quelle prove su Second Cerulean?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 2|	"Upsetting or startling the local fauna, as well as any structural damage, we wish to avoid, so wait until after the tests, we will, before deploying them in that planet's waters."|2292|0
units.english: "Upsetting or startling the local fauna, as well as any structural damage, we wish to avoid, so wait until after the tests, we will, before deploying them in that planet's waters."
units.italian: "Infastidire o spaventare la fauna locale, così come qualsiasi danno strutturale, vogliamo evitare, quindi aspettare dopo le prove, noi lo faremo, prima di schierarli nelle acque di quel pianeta."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 2|	"Let's get on with it then. My ship is ready to carry the subs."|2294|0
units.english: "Let's get on with it then. My ship is ready to carry the subs."
units.italian: "Procediamo allora. La mia nave è pronta a trasportare i sottomarini."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 2|	"Structural damage?"|2296|0
units.english: "Structural damage?"
units.italian: "Danno strutturale?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 2|	He stares at you blankly for a moment. "Delicately arranged, the glaciers there are. Resting on them, some of our monitoring equipment is. Avoid any damage to them caused by an unforeseen malfunction, we must."|2297|0
units.english: He stares at you blankly for a moment. "Delicately arranged, the glaciers there are. Resting on them, some of our monitoring equipment is. Avoid any damage to them caused by an unforeseen malfunction, we must."
units.italian: Ti fissa senza capire per un momento. "Disposti con delicatezza, i ghiacciai lì sono. Appoggiata su di essi, parte della nostra attrezzatura di monitoraggio è. Evitare qualsiasi danno a loro causato da un malfunzionamento imprevisto, noi dobbiamo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 2|	The Saryd issues a command on the data pad and turns off the communication device and accompanies you and Apri'ie to your ship as the cargo is loaded.|2299|0
units.english: The Saryd issues a command on the data pad and turns off the communication device and accompanies you and Apri'ie to your ship as the cargo is loaded.
units.italian: Il Saryd impartisce un comando sul datapad, spegne il dispositivo di comunicazione e vi accompagna, te e Apri'ie, alla nave mentre il carico viene imbarcato.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 2|	There are five submarines in total, strapped to large, sturdy sleds, which are slowly pushed up the ramp to your cargo hold. The subs themselves are somewhat oval in shape but flat on the top and bottom, with retractable mechanical arms on their sides. After the last sub is safely in your cargo hold, Apri'ie heads into your ship and you set a route for <destination>.|2300|0
units.english: There are five submarines in total, strapped to large, sturdy sleds, which are slowly pushed up the ramp to your cargo hold. The subs themselves are somewhat oval in shape but flat on the top and bottom, with retractable mechanical arms on their sides. After the last sub is safely in your cargo hold, Apri'ie heads into your ship and you set a route for <destination>.
units.italian: Ci sono cinque sottomarini in tutto, legati a grandi e robuste slitte, che vengono spinte lentamente su per la rampa fino alla stiva. I sottomarini stessi sono di forma più o meno ovale ma piatti in cima e in fondo, con bracci meccanici retrattili sui lati. Dopo che l'ultimo sottomarino è al sicuro nella stiva, Apri'ie entra nella nave e tu imposti la rotta per <destination>.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 2|dialog|2303|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Apri'ie and the unmanned submarines hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Apri'ie e i sottomarini senza equipaggio non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 2|As the workers unload the submarines from your cargo, Apri'ie approaches you, handing you <payment>. "Oversee the stress test I must, so meet you in the spaceport again, I will. If interested in seeing the test you are, however, come with me, you may."|2308|0
units.english: As the workers unload the submarines from your cargo, Apri'ie approaches you, handing you <payment>. "Oversee the stress test I must, so meet you in the spaceport again, I will. If interested in seeing the test you are, however, come with me, you may."
units.italian: Mentre gli operai scaricano i sottomarini dalla stiva, Apri'ie ti si avvicina e ti consegna <payment>. "Sovrintendere alla prova di stress, io devo, quindi incontrarvi di nuovo allo spazioporto, io lo farò. Se interessati a vedere la prova, però, venite con me, voi potete."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 2|	"Sure, why not? Probably beats waiting around and checking shops over and over."|2310|0
units.english: "Sure, why not? Probably beats waiting around and checking shops over and over."
units.italian: "Certo, perché no? Meglio che aspettare in giro e controllare i negozi all'infinito."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 2|	"Thanks for the invitation, but I'm not really interested."|2311|0
units.english: "Thanks for the invitation, but I'm not really interested."
units.italian: "Grazie dell'invito, ma non mi interessa molto."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 2|	After all the submarines are out of your cargo hold, they're placed atop trucks with heavy tracks instead of wheels. You and Apri'ie board one of the trucks and begin a trip down to the shore below, reaching a small commercial port with a large set of docks. Once there, Apri'ie introduces you to some of his colleagues who are already waiting to begin the tests. The subs are activated before they are off the trucks, and some of the Kimek begin to test basic functions.|2313|0
units.english: After all the submarines are out of your cargo hold, they're placed atop trucks with heavy tracks instead of wheels. You and Apri'ie board one of the trucks and begin a trip down to the shore below, reaching a small commercial port with a large set of docks. Once there, Apri'ie introduces you to some of his colleagues who are already waiting to begin the tests. The subs are activated before they are off the trucks, and some of the Kimek begin to test basic functions.
units.italian: Dopo che tutti i sottomarini sono fuori dalla stiva, vengono sistemati su camion con pesanti cingoli invece che ruote. Tu e Apri'ie salite su uno dei camion e cominciate un viaggio giù verso la costa, raggiungendo un piccolo porto commerciale con una grande serie di moli. Una volta lì, Apri'ie ti presenta alcuni suoi colleghi che stanno già aspettando di cominciare le prove. I sottomarini vengono attivati prima di scendere dai camion, e alcuni dei Kimek cominciano a testare le funzioni di base.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 2|	Once they're all in the water, everyone boards a sturdy barge which follows the submarines several kilometers off the coast until you can no longer see the shore. At this point they stop, and one of the submarines submerges, resurfacing in about twenty minutes. The Kimek make sure the sub suffered no damage, and proceed to test the other ones. After each one has made the trip to the bottom and back several times, the submarines and the barge head back to the docks.|2314|0
units.english: Once they're all in the water, everyone boards a sturdy barge which follows the submarines several kilometers off the coast until you can no longer see the shore. At this point they stop, and one of the submarines submerges, resurfacing in about twenty minutes. The Kimek make sure the sub suffered no damage, and proceed to test the other ones. After each one has made the trip to the bottom and back several times, the submarines and the barge head back to the docks.
units.italian: Una volta che sono tutti in acqua, tutti salgono su una robusta chiatta che segue i sottomarini per diversi chilometri al largo finché non riesci più a vedere la costa. A quel punto si fermano, e uno dei sottomarini si immerge, riemergendo in circa venti minuti. I Kimek si assicurano che il sottomarino non abbia subito danni, e passano a provare gli altri. Dopo che ognuno ha fatto il viaggio fino al fondo e ritorno più volte, i sottomarini e la chiatta tornano ai moli.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 2|	The subs are once again put on the trucks, and you begin the trip back to the spaceport city. Once you've arrived, Apri'ie's colleagues ask him to come with them to discuss something in private, and he tells you he will meet you back on the spaceport.|2315|0
units.english: The subs are once again put on the trucks, and you begin the trip back to the spaceport city. Once you've arrived, Apri'ie's colleagues ask him to come with them to discuss something in private, and he tells you he will meet you back on the spaceport.
units.italian: I sottomarini vengono di nuovo messi sui camion, e cominciate il viaggio di ritorno verso la città dello spazioporto. Una volta arrivati, i colleghi di Apri'ie gli chiedono di andare con loro a discutere qualcosa in privato, e lui ti dice che ti incontrerà di nuovo allo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 2|	"Then in the spaceport, meet you I will," he says. After all the submarines are out of your cargo hold, they're placed atop large truck-like vehicles, but with the wheels in a system of continuous tracks. Apri'ie boards one of the trucks, and they start making their way down to the shore below. From there, they follow the water out of the fjord to someplace where the submarines can dive deeper.|2318|0
units.english: "Then in the spaceport, meet you I will," he says. After all the submarines are out of your cargo hold, they're placed atop large truck-like vehicles, but with the wheels in a system of continuous tracks. Apri'ie boards one of the trucks, and they start making their way down to the shore below. From there, they follow the water out of the fjord to someplace where the submarines can dive deeper.
units.italian: "Allora allo spazioporto, ci vediamo," dice. Dopo che tutti i sottomarini sono fuori dalla stiva, vengono sistemati su grandi veicoli simili a camion, ma con le ruote in un sistema di cingoli continui. Apri'ie sale su uno dei camion, e cominciano a scendere verso la costa sottostante. Da lì, seguono l'acqua fuori dal fiordo fino a un punto dove i sottomarini possono immergersi più in profondità.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 3|name|2321|0
units.english: Tectonic Stress Test
units.italian: Prova di stress tettonico

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 3|description|2322|0
units.english: Bring Apri'ie and the <cargo> to <destination>, where the submarines will be subjected to more stress tests to assess their repair functions.
units.italian: Porta Apri'ie e <cargo> su <destination>, dove i sottomarini saranno sottoposti ad altre prove di stress per valutare le loro funzioni di riparazione.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 3|blocked|2325|0
units.english: You need <capacity> to take the next mission. Return here when you have the required space free.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> per accettare la missione successiva. Torna qui quando avrai lo spazio libero necessario.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 3|Apri'ie comes to the spaceport followed by one of his colleagues. "Have to perform one more test, we will, Captain. To assess the subs' repair abilities in hazardous environments, Pale Waters wants, so a quick stop at <destination>, we must make."|2332|0
units.english: Apri'ie comes to the spaceport followed by one of his colleagues. "Have to perform one more test, we will, Captain. To assess the subs' repair abilities in hazardous environments, Pale Waters wants, so a quick stop at <destination>, we must make."
units.italian: Apri'ie arriva allo spazioporto seguito da uno dei suoi colleghi. "Dobbiamo fare un'altra prova, capitano. Valutare le capacità di riparazione dei sottomarini in ambienti pericolosi, Acque Pallide vuole, quindi una sosta veloce su <destination>, noi dobbiamo fare."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 3|	"Alright, we'll head there next then."|2334|0
units.english: "Alright, we'll head there next then."
units.italian: "Va bene, andremo lì dopo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 3|	"Assess their 'repair' abilities? What do you mean?"|2336|0
units.english: "Assess their 'repair' abilities? What do you mean?"
units.italian: "Valutare le loro capacità di 'riparazione'? Cosa intendete?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 3|	"Equipped with welders, the arms of the submarines are, so that if greatly damaged deep underwater, one of them is, repaired by the others, it can be," he explains. "Unstable tectonics, <planet> has, so a test repair during one of the nightly tremors, we will conduct. That way, assess their abilities without bothering Second Cerulean's fauna, we can."|2337|0
units.english: "Equipped with welders, the arms of the submarines are, so that if greatly damaged deep underwater, one of them is, repaired by the others, it can be," he explains. "Unstable tectonics, <planet> has, so a test repair during one of the nightly tremors, we will conduct. That way, assess their abilities without bothering Second Cerulean's fauna, we can."
units.italian: "Dotati di saldatrici, i bracci dei sottomarini sono, così che se gravemente danneggiato in profondità, uno di loro è, riparato dagli altri, può essere," spiega. "Tettonica instabile, <planet> ha, quindi una riparazione di prova durante uno dei tremori notturni, noi condurremo. Così, valutare le loro capacità senza disturbare la fauna di Second Cerulean, noi possiamo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 3|	"Sounds like you thought of everything for these subs. Let's head there next then."|2339|0
units.english: "Sounds like you thought of everything for these subs. Let's head there next then."
units.italian: "Sembra che abbiate pensato a tutto per questi sottomarini. Andiamo lì dopo, allora."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 3|	"Why do you need to test under such conditions? Does Second Cerulean have trouble with tectonics too?"|2341|0
units.english: "Why do you need to test under such conditions? Does Second Cerulean have trouble with tectonics too?"
units.italian: "Perché dovete provare in condizioni del genere? Anche Second Cerulean ha problemi con la tettonica?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 3|	"No, no. But, preparing for any eventuality, we are," he answers. "Should the planet's plates grow unstable, or some other troubling factor come up, prepared for it, the subs must be."|2342|0
units.english: "No, no. But, preparing for any eventuality, we are," he answers. "Should the planet's plates grow unstable, or some other troubling factor come up, prepared for it, the subs must be."
units.italian: "No, no. Ma prepararci a ogni eventualità, noi lo facciamo," risponde. "Se le placche del pianeta diventassero instabili, o emergesse qualche altro fattore preoccupante, pronti anche a questo, i sottomarini devono essere."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 3|	His colleague speaks up. "Headed to <planet>, another team from the research center has. Return to Second Cerulean with the data we have collected, I and the others will. Prepared the subs for your cargo, we already have."|2344|0
units.english: His colleague speaks up. "Headed to <planet>, another team from the research center has. Return to Second Cerulean with the data we have collected, I and the others will. Prepared the subs for your cargo, we already have."
units.italian: Il suo collega prende la parola. "Diretti a <planet>, un'altra squadra del centro di ricerca lo è. Tornare a Second Cerulean con i dati che abbiamo raccolto, io e gli altri lo faremo. Preparati i sottomarini per la vostra stiva, noi li abbiamo già."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 3|	You follow him back to your ship and see that the submarines are ready on the giant sleds again. After they're brought into your hold, Apri'ie's colleagues say goodbye to him, and he enters your ship once more.|2345|0
units.english: You follow him back to your ship and see that the submarines are ready on the giant sleds again. After they're brought into your hold, Apri'ie's colleagues say goodbye to him, and he enters your ship once more.
units.italian: Lo segui di nuovo alla nave e vedi che i sottomarini sono di nuovo pronti sulle slitte giganti. Dopo che sono stati portati nella stiva, i colleghi di Apri'ie si congedano da lui, e lui entra di nuovo nella nave.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 3|dialog|2348|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Apri'ie and the unmanned submarines hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Apri'ie e i sottomarini senza equipaggio non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 4|name|2355|0
units.english: Deliver the Submarines
units.italian: Consegna i sottomarini

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 4|description|2356|0
units.english: Head to <destination> with Apri'ie and the <cargo>, where the Pale Waters research center will use the new subs to conduct deep-sea expeditions.
units.italian: Dirigiti su <destination> con Apri'ie e <cargo>, dove il centro di ricerca Acque Pallide userà i nuovi sottomarini per condurre spedizioni in acque profonde.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 4|Apri'ie instructs you to head to some hangars at a large port, where a team is waiting for the repair test. He hands you 130,000 credits when you land, and goes to check with the workers unloading the submarines.|2365|0
units.english: Apri'ie instructs you to head to some hangars at a large port, where a team is waiting for the repair test. He hands you 130,000 credits when you land, and goes to check with the workers unloading the submarines.
units.italian: Apri'ie ti indica di dirigersi verso alcuni hangar di un grande porto, dove una squadra attende la prova di riparazione. Ti consegna 130.000 crediti appena atterri, e va a controllare con gli operai che scaricano i sottomarini.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 4|	They are all taken from your cargo and swiftly put in the water as the team of Kimek boards a large ship that you guess is an old tanker. This ship prepares to follow the subs to the testing area, along with another smaller, newer ship with a thick crane on the front. Apri'ie approaches you before he boards the tanker, asking, "Come with us for the test, would you like, Captain? Take a while, it might. Not expected until after nightfall, the next tremors are."|2366|0
units.english: They are all taken from your cargo and swiftly put in the water as the team of Kimek boards a large ship that you guess is an old tanker. This ship prepares to follow the subs to the testing area, along with another smaller, newer ship with a thick crane on the front. Apri'ie approaches you before he boards the tanker, asking, "Come with us for the test, would you like, Captain? Take a while, it might. Not expected until after nightfall, the next tremors are."
units.italian: Vengono tutti tolti dalla stiva e messi rapidamente in acqua mentre la squadra di Kimek sale su una grande nave che supponi sia una vecchia petroliera. Questa nave si prepara a seguire i sottomarini fino all'area delle prove, insieme a un'altra nave più piccola e più nuova, con una spessa gru a prua. Apri'ie ti si avvicina prima di salire sulla petroliera, chiedendo: "Venire con noi per la prova, vi piacerebbe, capitano? Un po' di tempo, potrebbe volerci. Non previsti prima di notte fonda, i prossimi tremori sono."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 4|	"If it's alright, yeah. Could be interesting."|2368|0
units.english: "If it's alright, yeah. Could be interesting."
units.italian: "Se va bene, sì. Potrebbe essere interessante."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 4|	"I'll pass. I need some time to rest after the trip here."|2369|0
units.english: "I'll pass. I need some time to rest after the trip here."
units.italian: "Passo. Ho bisogno di riposare un po' dopo il viaggio fin qui."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 4|	You head up the ramp to the ship, and after a few minutes it sets off, following the submarines controlled remotely by the Kimek team. Exploring the tanker, you find an odd pile of what looks like broken up ship parts, secured as cargo on the back. The pieces are welded together into a shape similar to the cockpit of one of the smaller Heliarch ships, though it has several dents, as if hit by some explosives. Apri'ie notices you looking at it and comes to explain that it's the "prop" on which they'll test the repair functions.|2371|0
units.english: You head up the ramp to the ship, and after a few minutes it sets off, following the submarines controlled remotely by the Kimek team. Exploring the tanker, you find an odd pile of what looks like broken up ship parts, secured as cargo on the back. The pieces are welded together into a shape similar to the cockpit of one of the smaller Heliarch ships, though it has several dents, as if hit by some explosives. Apri'ie notices you looking at it and comes to explain that it's the "prop" on which they'll test the repair functions.
units.italian: Sali sulla rampa della nave, e dopo qualche minuto parte, seguendo i sottomarini controllati a distanza dalla squadra Kimek. Esplorando la petroliera, trovi uno strano mucchio di quelli che sembrano pezzi di nave rotti, assicurati come carico a poppa. I pezzi sono saldati insieme in una forma simile alla cabina di pilotaggio di una delle navi Heliarch più piccole, anche se ha diverse ammaccature, come se fosse stata colpita da qualche esplosivo. Apri'ie ti nota mentre la guardi e viene a spiegarti che è il "supporto" su cui testeranno le funzioni di riparazione.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 4|	Once the tanker comes to a stop, the smaller ship's crane grabs the prop and slowly maneuvers it away from the tanker before lowering it into the water and letting it sink. The submarines follow the prop as it goes down, until it comes to a stop after a few minutes.|2372|0
units.english: Once the tanker comes to a stop, the smaller ship's crane grabs the prop and slowly maneuvers it away from the tanker before lowering it into the water and letting it sink. The submarines follow the prop as it goes down, until it comes to a stop after a few minutes.
units.italian: Quando la petroliera si ferma, la gru della nave più piccola afferra il supporto e lo sposta lentamente via dalla petroliera prima di calarlo in acqua e lasciarlo affondare. I sottomarini seguono il supporto mentre scende, finché non si ferma dopo qualche minuto.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 4|	The Kimek operators then proceed to take shifts at their computers as everyone waits for a tremor to begin. After the moon is high in the sky, you notice odd shifts on the waves and trembling on the boats, with which the Kimek start their repair work. Once they're done, and after the tremors stop, the subs slowly bring the prop back up, where the crane places it on the tanker again.|2373|0
units.english: The Kimek operators then proceed to take shifts at their computers as everyone waits for a tremor to begin. After the moon is high in the sky, you notice odd shifts on the waves and trembling on the boats, with which the Kimek start their repair work. Once they're done, and after the tremors stop, the subs slowly bring the prop back up, where the crane places it on the tanker again.
units.italian: Gli operatori Kimek cominciano allora a fare i turni ai loro computer mentre tutti aspettano che inizi un tremore. Dopo che la luna è alta nel cielo, noti strani spostamenti sulle onde e tremolii sulle imbarcazioni, con cui i Kimek cominciano il loro lavoro di riparazione. Quando hanno finito, e dopo che i tremori cessano, i sottomarini riportano lentamente su il supporto, dove la gru lo posa di nuovo sulla petroliera.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 4|	"Let's see..." Apri'ie heads to the prop to check on the welded parts. "Yes, very good. Performed well, the welder arms have. Good for deployment, they should be." The submarines go ahead once again, lighting the way back to the port as the ships follow them until docking.|2374|0
units.english: "Let's see..." Apri'ie heads to the prop to check on the welded parts. "Yes, very good. Performed well, the welder arms have. Good for deployment, they should be." The submarines go ahead once again, lighting the way back to the port as the ships follow them until docking.
units.italian: "Vediamo..." Apri'ie va al supporto a controllare i pezzi saldati. "Sì, molto bene. Funzionato bene, i bracci saldatori hanno. Pronti per lo schieramento, dovrebbero essere." I sottomarini ripartono, illuminando la via del ritorno al porto mentre le navi li seguono fino all'attracco.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 4|	He heads to the tanker, and the ships set off, following the submarines. You walk for a while by the spaceport, stopping at a restaurant to have a Saryd pastry dish. You return to the port at sunset and wait until you finally spot the submarines' lights on the horizon heading toward the shore.|2377|0
units.english: He heads to the tanker, and the ships set off, following the submarines. You walk for a while by the spaceport, stopping at a restaurant to have a Saryd pastry dish. You return to the port at sunset and wait until you finally spot the submarines' lights on the horizon heading toward the shore.
units.italian: Sale sulla petroliera, e le navi partono, seguendo i sottomarini. Tu cammini un po' per lo spazioporto, fermandoti in un ristorante a mangiare un piatto di pasticceria Saryd. Torni al porto al tramonto e aspetti finché non vedi finalmente le luci dei sottomarini all'orizzonte che si avvicinano alla riva.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 4|	"Worked perfectly, the welders have. Ready for deployment, the subs should be," Apri'ie tells you as he steps off of the tanker.|2378|0
units.english: "Worked perfectly, the welders have. Ready for deployment, the subs should be," Apri'ie tells you as he steps off of the tanker.
units.italian: "Funzionato perfettamente, le saldatrici hanno. Pronti per lo schieramento, i sottomarini dovrebbero essere," ti dice Apri'ie mentre scende dalla petroliera.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 4|	The subs are once again placed atop the sleds and brought into your ship. Apri'ie thanks the Kimek team for handling the subs and heads back into your ship, saying, "Time for their final trip, it is. Bring the vessels and I to <destination>, you may."|2380|0
units.english: The subs are once again placed atop the sleds and brought into your ship. Apri'ie thanks the Kimek team for handling the subs and heads back into your ship, saying, "Time for their final trip, it is. Bring the vessels and I to <destination>, you may."
units.italian: I sottomarini vengono di nuovo sistemati sulle slitte e portati nella tua nave. Apri'ie ringrazia la squadra Kimek per aver gestito i sottomarini e rientra nella tua nave, dicendo: "Ora del loro ultimo viaggio, è. Portare i mezzi e me a <destination>, voi potete."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 4|dialog|2383|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Apri'ie and the unmanned submarines hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Apri'ie e i sottomarini senza equipaggio non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 4|The local workers carefully unload the submarines off your ship one at a time, bringing them to the icy waters nearby, where they will dive to perform deep sea explorations on the local fauna.|2388|0
units.english: The local workers carefully unload the submarines off your ship one at a time, bringing them to the icy waters nearby, where they will dive to perform deep sea explorations on the local fauna.
units.italian: Gli operai del posto scaricano con cura i sottomarini dalla nave uno alla volta, portandoli alle acque ghiacciate lì vicino, dove si immergeranno per condurre esplorazioni in acque profonde sulla fauna locale.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 4|	Once they're done, Apri'ie invites you to enter the research facility, just a few kilometers away from the spaceport tower, with hangars of its own for your ship. There you're met by a committee of sorts; a handful of the local scientists greet the two of you, and thank you for helping with transporting the subs. "Having trouble reaching deeper sections of the ocean, our older probes were, so able to analyze a multitude of new species, with these new subs we hope to be," one of them tells you.|2389|0
units.english: Once they're done, Apri'ie invites you to enter the research facility, just a few kilometers away from the spaceport tower, with hangars of its own for your ship. There you're met by a committee of sorts; a handful of the local scientists greet the two of you, and thank you for helping with transporting the subs. "Having trouble reaching deeper sections of the ocean, our older probes were, so able to analyze a multitude of new species, with these new subs we hope to be," one of them tells you.
units.italian: Quando hanno finito, Apri'ie ti invita a entrare nella struttura di ricerca, a pochi chilometri dalla torre dello spazioporto, con hangar propri per la tua nave. Lì ti accoglie una specie di comitato: una manciata di scienziati del posto saluta voi due e ti ringrazia per aver aiutato a trasportare i sottomarini. "In difficoltà a raggiungere le sezioni più profonde dell'oceano, le nostre vecchie sonde erano, quindi in grado di analizzare una moltitudine di nuove specie, con questi nuovi sottomarini speriamo di essere," ti dice uno di loro.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Submarines 4|	When they're done, they hand you <payment>, and Apri'ie follows you to your ship. "Thankful for you putting up with all the last-minute detours I am, Captain. Safe travels, may you have." He does a short gesture as a form of goodbye: you put your forearm on the ground, and he places one of his legs over it. Once you're done, he heads back to the research center.|2390|0
units.english: When they're done, they hand you <payment>, and Apri'ie follows you to your ship. "Thankful for you putting up with all the last-minute detours I am, Captain. Safe travels, may you have." He does a short gesture as a form of goodbye: you put your forearm on the ground, and he places one of his legs over it. Once you're done, he heads back to the research center.
units.italian: Quando hanno finito, ti consegnano <payment>, e Apri'ie ti segue alla nave. "Grato per aver sopportato tutti i cambi di programma all'ultimo minuto, io sono, capitano. Buon viaggio, che possiate avere." Fa un breve gesto come forma di saluto: tu appoggi l'avambraccio a terra, e lui posa una delle sue zampe sopra. Quando avete finito, torna al centro di ricerca.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 1|name|2396|0
units.english: Scouting Permit
units.italian: Permesso di ricognizione

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 1|description|2397|0
units.english: Transport Sedlitaris, a Heliarch Tribune, to the <destination>, where she will petition the Heliarch council to allow her to go on a scouting expedition out of the Coalition. Payment is <payment>.
units.italian: Trasporta Sedlitaris, una Tribuna degli Heliarchs, su <destination>, dove chiederà al consiglio degli Heliarchs il permesso di partire per una spedizione di ricognizione fuori dalla Coalizione. Il pagamento è <payment>.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 1|As you exit your ship and start heading to the spaceport, you hear a rushed galloping getting closer. As you turn you see a Saryd Heliarch coming to you, gesturing for you to wait. She slows down once she sees you're obliging, and slowly walks to you while glancing at your ship.|2408|0
units.english: As you exit your ship and start heading to the spaceport, you hear a rushed galloping getting closer. As you turn you see a Saryd Heliarch coming to you, gesturing for you to wait. She slows down once she sees you're obliging, and slowly walks to you while glancing at your ship.
units.italian: Mentre esci dalla nave e ti avvii verso lo spazioporto, senti un galoppo affrettato che si avvicina. Quando ti volti, vedi una Saryd Heliarch che ti viene incontro, facendoti cenno di aspettare. Rallenta quando vede che la stai assecondando, e cammina lentamente verso di te mentre dà un'occhiata alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 1|	"Apologize for cutting you off, I must, Captain <last>, but in need of extended transport services, I am," she says. "Sedlitaris Quatcid, my name is, and a Heliarch tribune, I am. Brought to <destination>, I must be. A petition to the council, I am to make."|2409|0
units.english: "Apologize for cutting you off, I must, Captain <last>, but in need of extended transport services, I am," she says. "Sedlitaris Quatcid, my name is, and a Heliarch tribune, I am. Brought to <destination>, I must be. A petition to the council, I am to make."
units.italian: "Scusarmi per avervi interrotto, io devo, capitano <last>, ma in bisogno di servizi di trasporto prolungati, io sono," dice. "Sedlitaris Quatcid, il mio nome è, e una tribuna degli Heliarchs, io sono. Portata a <destination>, io devo essere. Una petizione al consiglio, devo presentare."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 1|	"A 'petition'? What do you mean?"|2411|0
units.english: "A 'petition'? What do you mean?"
units.italian: "Una 'petizione'? Cosa intendi?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 1|	"I don't think you'd need some 'extended' service just for that."|2412|0
units.english: "I don't think you'd need some 'extended' service just for that."
units.italian: "Non credo che avresti bisogno di un servizio 'prolungato' solo per quello."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 1|	"Sorry, I'm not taking any more passengers right now."|2413|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not taking any more passengers right now."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, non prendo altri passeggeri al momento."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 1|	"Nearly a thousand years ago, leading an expeditionary fleet to outside of the Coalition, an ancestor of mine was," she explains. "Mimodum, his name was, and after having risen the ranks and lifted our family from poorer conditions, chosen to lead the expedition he was. Only, return, he did not. To find out what happened, I wish. Looking for you, I was, as after my request is approved, need a transport to bring me to planets he visited, I will."|2415|0
units.english: "Nearly a thousand years ago, leading an expeditionary fleet to outside of the Coalition, an ancestor of mine was," she explains. "Mimodum, his name was, and after having risen the ranks and lifted our family from poorer conditions, chosen to lead the expedition he was. Only, return, he did not. To find out what happened, I wish. Looking for you, I was, as after my request is approved, need a transport to bring me to planets he visited, I will."
units.italian: "Quasi mille anni fa, a guidare una flotta di spedizione fuori dalla Coalizione, un mio antenato lo fece," spiega. "Mimodum, il suo nome era, e dopo aver scalato i ranghi e sollevato la nostra famiglia da condizioni più povere, scelto per guidare la spedizione lui fu. Solo che, tornare, lui non lo fece. Scoprire cosa è successo, io voglio. Cercando voi, io ero, perché dopo che la mia richiesta sarà approvata, bisogno di un trasporto per portarmi sui pianeti che ha visitato, io avrò."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 1|	"I'd be glad to help you find out what happened. Let me show you to your bunk."|2417|0
units.english: "I'd be glad to help you find out what happened. Let me show you to your bunk."
units.italian: "Sarei felice di aiutarti a scoprire cosa è successo. Lascia che ti mostri la cuccetta."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 1|	"Couldn't you just have gone on your own, or paid someone to bring you there if you don't have a ship?"|2419|0
units.english: "Couldn't you just have gone on your own, or paid someone to bring you there if you don't have a ship?"
units.italian: "Non potevi semplicemente andare da sola, o pagare qualcuno per portarti lì se non hai una nave?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 1|	"Actually, I'm not going to be leaving Coalition space anytime soon. Sorry."|2420|0
units.english: "Actually, I'm not going to be leaving Coalition space anytime soon. Sorry."
units.italian: "In realtà, non lascerò lo spazio della Coalizione tanto presto. Mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 1|	She shakes her head. "Forbidden from leaving just like that, anyone is, and steal a jump drive for it, I'd need to. Obviously illegal, that is. Allowed to head out, only Heliarchs who have received permission from the council can. Finally time to hear my request again, they have, so go to <planet>, I must."|2422|0
units.english: She shakes her head. "Forbidden from leaving just like that, anyone is, and steal a jump drive for it, I'd need to. Obviously illegal, that is. Allowed to head out, only Heliarchs who have received permission from the council can. Finally time to hear my request again, they have, so go to <planet>, I must."
units.italian: Scuote la testa. "Vietato partire così su due piedi, a chiunque è, e rubare un motore di salto per questo, io dovrei. Ovviamente illegale, questo è. Autorizzati a partire, solo gli Heliarchs che hanno ricevuto il permesso dal consiglio possono. Finalmente tempo di ascoltare di nuovo la mia richiesta, loro hanno, quindi andare su <planet>, io devo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 1|	"Well, let's not keep them waiting then. Let me show you to your bunk."|2424|0
units.english: "Well, let's not keep them waiting then. Let me show you to your bunk."
units.italian: "Beh, non facciamoli aspettare allora. Lascia che ti mostri la cuccetta."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 1|	"I hope things work out for you, but I'm not heading out of the Coalition anytime soon. Sorry."|2425|0
units.english: "I hope things work out for you, but I'm not heading out of the Coalition anytime soon. Sorry."
units.italian: "Spero che le cose si risolvano per te, ma non parto dalla Coalizione tanto presto. Mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 1|	"Great! I promise you, very well paid you will be, once finished. For the moment, pay you <payment> I shall, when we arrive at the ring."|2428|0
units.english: "Great! I promise you, very well paid you will be, once finished. For the moment, pay you <payment> I shall, when we arrive at the ring."
units.italian: "Ottimo! Te lo prometto, molto ben pagato sarai, una volta finito. Per il momento, pagarti <payment> io lo farò, quando arriviamo all'anello."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 1|	You bring her inside your ship, and set a route to <destination>.|2429|0
units.english: You bring her inside your ship, and set a route to <destination>.
units.italian: La porti dentro la nave e imposti la rotta per <destination>.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 1|dialog|2432|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Sedlitaris hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Sedlitaris non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 1|Sedlitaris gives you your payment of <payment> before you open your hatch for her to leave. "Take a few hours, this might, so wait for me in the spaceport, you can. Know the layout well, I do, so find you without issue, I will."|2436|0
units.english: Sedlitaris gives you your payment of <payment> before you open your hatch for her to leave. "Take a few hours, this might, so wait for me in the spaceport, you can. Know the layout well, I do, so find you without issue, I will."
units.italian: Sedlitaris ti dà il pagamento di <payment> prima che tu apra il portello per farla uscire. "Qualche ora, potrebbe volerci, quindi aspettarmi allo spazioporto, voi potete. Conoscere bene la disposizione, io la conosco, quindi trovarvi senza problemi, io lo farò."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 1|	As you open your hatch to see her leave, you're faced with a Kimek Heliarch waiting for the two of you, startling Sedlitaris as she sees him.|2437|0
units.english: As you open your hatch to see her leave, you're faced with a Kimek Heliarch waiting for the two of you, startling Sedlitaris as she sees him.
units.italian: Mentre apri il portello per vederla uscire, ti trovi davanti un Heliarch Kimek che aspetta voi due, facendo sobbalzare Sedlitaris quando lo vede.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 1|	"Made it clear, have I not, that cease your stubborn attempts, you should, tribune?" he asks. "Too precious, the consuls' time is. Keep wasting it in telling you off, they cannot."|2438|0
units.english: "Made it clear, have I not, that cease your stubborn attempts, you should, tribune?" he asks. "Too precious, the consuls' time is. Keep wasting it in telling you off, they cannot."
units.italian: "Chiarito, non l'ho forse, che smettere con i vostri ostinati tentativi, dovreste, tribuna?" chiede. "Troppo prezioso, il tempo dei consoli è. Continuare a sprecarlo per rimproverarvi, loro non possono."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 1|	Sedlitaris brings a hand to her hair as she looks down. She opens her mouth, but cuts whatever she had to say at her throat. Instead, she goes down the ramp and leaves quickly for some section of the ringworld, ignoring the Kimek's protests. He sighs and approaches you. "Roped you into her exploration plan has she, Captain? An outsider with a jump drive, you are, so of course drawn to you, she would be, that girl..."|2439|0
units.english: Sedlitaris brings a hand to her hair as she looks down. She opens her mouth, but cuts whatever she had to say at her throat. Instead, she goes down the ramp and leaves quickly for some section of the ringworld, ignoring the Kimek's protests. He sighs and approaches you. "Roped you into her exploration plan has she, Captain? An outsider with a jump drive, you are, so of course drawn to you, she would be, that girl..."
units.italian: Sedlitaris si porta una mano ai capelli mentre abbassa lo sguardo. Apre la bocca, ma tronca in gola qualunque cosa avesse da dire. Invece, scende la rampa e si allontana in fretta verso qualche settore del mondo ad anello, ignorando le proteste del Kimek. Lui sospira e si avvicina a te. "Coinvolta nel suo piano di esplorazione vi ha, capitano? Un estraneo con un motore di salto, voi siete, quindi ovvio che attratta da voi, lei sarebbe, quella ragazza..."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 1|	"Are you two colleagues?"|2441|0
units.english: "Are you two colleagues?"
units.italian: "Siete colleghi voi due?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 1|	"What was that about her being stubborn?"|2442|0
units.english: "What was that about her being stubborn?"
units.italian: "Che storia era quella della sua ostinazione?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 1|	"Kicharri, I am. For many decades, the arbiter supervising Sedlitaris' work, I have been. A bright girl. Produced many excellent theoretical models of the outside, she has, but in recent years, obsessed with leaving on an official expedition, she became. Denied her nearly a dozen times, the consuls have, but get the hint, she won't." He rapidly taps the ground with his legs, as if the ground was hot to the touch. "Helped her set up this specific 'petition,' I have. Asked the council to be extra strict and definitive this time, I did. Contracted you for a longer trip, I assume she has, but be allowed to leave, she will not."|2443|0
units.english: "Kicharri, I am. For many decades, the arbiter supervising Sedlitaris' work, I have been. A bright girl. Produced many excellent theoretical models of the outside, she has, but in recent years, obsessed with leaving on an official expedition, she became. Denied her nearly a dozen times, the consuls have, but get the hint, she won't." He rapidly taps the ground with his legs, as if the ground was hot to the touch. "Helped her set up this specific 'petition,' I have. Asked the council to be extra strict and definitive this time, I did. Contracted you for a longer trip, I assume she has, but be allowed to leave, she will not."
units.italian: "Kicharri, io sono. Per molti decenni, l'arbitro che supervisiona il lavoro di Sedlitaris, io sono stato. Una ragazza brillante. Prodotti molti eccellenti modelli teorici dell'esterno, lei ha, ma negli ultimi anni, ossessionata dall'idea di partire per una spedizione ufficiale, lei è diventata. Negatole quasi una dozzina di volte, i consoli lo hanno, ma cogliere l'indizio, lei non lo farà." Batte rapidamente il terreno con le zampe, come se il suolo fosse rovente. "Aiutata a impostare questa specifica 'petizione', io l'ho. Chiesto al consiglio di essere particolarmente severo e definitivo questa volta, io l'ho fatto. Contrattata voi per un viaggio più lungo, presumo che lei l'abbia, ma autorizzata a partire, lei non lo sarà."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 1|	He wishes you a good day, and leaves to an office opposite to the spaceport.|2444|0
units.english: He wishes you a good day, and leaves to an office opposite to the spaceport.
units.italian: Ti augura buona giornata, e si allontana verso un ufficio di fronte allo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 2|name|2447|0
units.english: Relay Pylon
units.italian: Pilone relè

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 2|description|2448|0
units.english: Bring Sedlitaris and some representatives of the Heliarch council to <destination>, where members of House Idriss will provide her with a relay pylon to search for signs of her ancestor's expedition.
units.italian: Porta Sedlitaris e alcuni rappresentanti del consiglio degli Heliarchs su <destination>, dove i membri della Casa Idriss le forniranno un pilone relè per cercare tracce della spedizione del suo antenato.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 2|blocked|2450|0
units.english: You need <capacity> to take the next mission. Return here when you have the required space free.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> per accettare la missione successiva. Torna qui quando avrai lo spazio libero necessario.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 2|When you don't see Sedlitaris in the spaceport, you look for a spot to sit and wait for her, and notice a set of seats made for the Quarg, still around to this day. You take one that you assume was meant for a Quarg child, standing lower than the others, and wait. Captains and workers that pass by give you all sorts of looks, and after a few minutes even some Heliarch agents are gawking at you, discussing among themselves. Just as you decide you should get up and sit somewhere else, you look to see Sedlitaris coming into the spaceport.|2457|0
units.english: When you don't see Sedlitaris in the spaceport, you look for a spot to sit and wait for her, and notice a set of seats made for the Quarg, still around to this day. You take one that you assume was meant for a Quarg child, standing lower than the others, and wait. Captains and workers that pass by give you all sorts of looks, and after a few minutes even some Heliarch agents are gawking at you, discussing among themselves. Just as you decide you should get up and sit somewhere else, you look to see Sedlitaris coming into the spaceport.
units.italian: Quando non vedi Sedlitaris allo spazioporto, cerchi un posto dove sederti ad aspettarla, e noti una serie di sedili fatti per i Quarg, ancora lì a tutt'oggi. Ne prendi uno che supponi fosse destinato a un bambino Quarg, più basso degli altri, e aspetti. Capitani e operai che passano ti lanciano ogni tipo di sguardo, e dopo qualche minuto persino alcuni agenti Heliarchs ti fissano a bocca aperta, discutendo tra loro. Proprio quando decidi che dovresti alzarti e sederti altrove, vedi Sedlitaris entrare nello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 2|	"A short wait, wasn't it?" she comments once you're close. "Care to hear my case, the consuls didn't, just told me that to leave whenever I wish, I may. 'If I can,' they said, as provide me a jump drive, they won't, but that's where you come in."|2458|0
units.english: "A short wait, wasn't it?" she comments once you're close. "Care to hear my case, the consuls didn't, just told me that to leave whenever I wish, I may. 'If I can,' they said, as provide me a jump drive, they won't, but that's where you come in."
units.italian: "Un'attesa breve, non è stato?" commenta quando le sei vicino. "Ascoltare le mie ragioni, i consoli non l'hanno fatto, mi hanno solo detto che partire quando voglio, io posso. 'Se ci riuscite,' hanno detto, dato che fornirmi un motore di salto, loro non lo faranno, ma è qui che entrate in gioco voi."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 2|	"I certainly didn't wait around for long. So, where are we heading?"|2460|0
units.english: "I certainly didn't wait around for long. So, where are we heading?"
units.italian: "Di certo non ho aspettato a lungo. Allora, dove andiamo?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 2|	"Didn't care to hear your case? What do you mean?"|2462|0
units.english: "Didn't care to hear your case? What do you mean?"
units.italian: "Non hanno voluto ascoltare le tue ragioni? Cosa intendi?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 2|	"According to protocol, present valid reasoning for their expedition, and a thorough travel plan, aspiring inspectors must. This time, taken every legal detail into account, I had, in preparation for the meeting, but once I entered, barely time to greet them, they gave me." She explains. "Said that thought it over, they had, and willing to oblige, they were, so just sign a few documents, I did, and now officially an inspector, I am."|2463|0
units.english: "According to protocol, present valid reasoning for their expedition, and a thorough travel plan, aspiring inspectors must. This time, taken every legal detail into account, I had, in preparation for the meeting, but once I entered, barely time to greet them, they gave me." She explains. "Said that thought it over, they had, and willing to oblige, they were, so just sign a few documents, I did, and now officially an inspector, I am."
units.italian: "Secondo il protocollo, presentare ragioni valide per la loro spedizione e un piano di viaggio accurato, gli aspiranti ispettori devono. Questa volta, tenuto conto di ogni dettaglio legale, io l'avevo fatto, in preparazione dell'incontro, ma una volta entrata, a malapena il tempo di salutarli, loro me l'hanno dato." Spiega. "Detto che ci avevano pensato, loro, e disposti a concedere, erano, quindi firmare solo qualche documento, io ho fatto, e ora ufficialmente un'ispettrice, io sono."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 2|	"I take it inspector is what you call explorers?"|2465|0
units.english: "I take it inspector is what you call explorers?"
units.italian: "Immagino che 'ispettrice' sia come chiamate gli esploratori?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 2|	"Good to hear they had a change of heart. So, where are we heading?"|2466|0
units.english: "Good to hear they had a change of heart. So, where are we heading?"
units.italian: "Bene che abbiano cambiato idea. Allora, dove andiamo?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 2|	"No mere explorers, we are," she begins. "A rank granted with utmost respect to the Coalition's bravest, those unafraid to venture out into the void, to chart the unknown, it is. Date back thousands of years, the title does. First used by early Saryds, when set out to explore beyond the home system, they had, and then adopted by the Heliarchs, it was. Remain in use to this day, the term does," she says in excitement, pausing with a smile as if considering that she herself is one such "inspector" now.|2468|0
units.english: "No mere explorers, we are," she begins. "A rank granted with utmost respect to the Coalition's bravest, those unafraid to venture out into the void, to chart the unknown, it is. Date back thousands of years, the title does. First used by early Saryds, when set out to explore beyond the home system, they had, and then adopted by the Heliarchs, it was. Remain in use to this day, the term does," she says in excitement, pausing with a smile as if considering that she herself is one such "inspector" now.
units.italian: "Non semplici esploratori, noi siamo," comincia. "Un grado concesso con il massimo rispetto ai più coraggiosi della Coalizione, a quelli che non temono di avventurarsi nel vuoto, di mappare l'ignoto, esso è. Risale a migliaia di anni fa, il titolo. Usato per la prima volta dagli antichi Saryd, quando partirono per esplorare oltre il sistema d'origine, loro lo fecero, e poi adottato dagli Heliarchs, esso fu. Resta in uso ancora oggi, il termine," dice con entusiasmo, fermandosi con un sorriso come se stesse considerando che ora è lei stessa una tale "ispettrice".

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 2|	"So, will it be you paying me for the job, or is that the consuls now since they've officially approved this?"|2470|0
units.english: "So, will it be you paying me for the job, or is that the consuls now since they've officially approved this?"
units.italian: "Allora, sarai tu a pagarmi per il lavoro, o ora sono i consoli dato che hanno approvato ufficialmente la cosa?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 2|	"You seem eager to get started. So, where are we heading?"|2471|0
units.english: "You seem eager to get started. So, where are we heading?"
units.italian: "Sembri ansioso di cominciare. Allora, dove andiamo?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 2|	"Approval for us to leave, they gave me, but provide any further assistance - be that a jump drive, or funding - they won't," she explains. "Saved up well over the past few years, I have, so once done we are, pay you several million credits, I shall. But, who knows, maybe if exciting enough, our findings out there are, convinced to give you a bonus, the consuls might be," she smiles.|2473|0
units.english: "Approval for us to leave, they gave me, but provide any further assistance - be that a jump drive, or funding - they won't," she explains. "Saved up well over the past few years, I have, so once done we are, pay you several million credits, I shall. But, who knows, maybe if exciting enough, our findings out there are, convinced to give you a bonus, the consuls might be," she smiles.
units.italian: "L'approvazione a partire, loro me l'hanno data, ma fornire qualsiasi altro aiuto, che sia un motore di salto o fondi, loro non lo faranno," spiega. "Messo da parte bene più negli ultimi anni, io ho, quindi una volta finito, pagarvi diversi milioni di crediti, io lo farò. Ma chissà, magari se abbastanza emozionanti, le nostre scoperte là fuori, convinti a darvi un bonus, i consoli potrebbero essere," sorride.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 2|	"Ready to go outside, we are not. Not for the purpose of finding out about the last expedition, at least. A tool from House Idriss, we need, if to trace my ancestor's steps, we are. To <destination>, we must go."|2475|0
units.english: "Ready to go outside, we are not. Not for the purpose of finding out about the last expedition, at least. A tool from House Idriss, we need, if to trace my ancestor's steps, we are. To <destination>, we must go."
units.italian: "Pronti a uscire, noi non siamo. Non con lo scopo di scoprire l'ultima spedizione, almeno. Uno strumento della Casa Idriss, noi ci serve, se seguire le orme del mio antenato, dobbiamo. Su <destination>, dobbiamo andare."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 2|	As she's about to continue, your conversation is cut short by a Kimek rushing toward you two, shouting frantically. Once he's closer, you recognize him as Arbiter Kicharri from earlier, and Sedlitaris tries to calm him down while he's catching his breath. "Professor, if about my request this is, already met with the council, I have. Approved it-"|2476|0
units.english: As she's about to continue, your conversation is cut short by a Kimek rushing toward you two, shouting frantically. Once he's closer, you recognize him as Arbiter Kicharri from earlier, and Sedlitaris tries to calm him down while he's catching his breath. "Professor, if about my request this is, already met with the council, I have. Approved it-"
units.italian: Mentre sta per continuare, la vostra conversazione viene interrotta da un Kimek che corre verso di voi, gridando freneticamente. Una volta più vicino, lo riconosci come l'arbitro Kicharri di prima, e Sedlitaris cerca di calmarlo mentre riprende fiato. "Professore, se sulla mia richiesta si tratta, già incontrato il consiglio, io ho. Approvata la-."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 2|	"Know that, I do! Exactly what I'm furious about, that is!" He shouts. "Asked them to give you a definitive answer, I had, but not this kind of definitive! Listen, permission or not, safe to leave, it is not. Know that, you do." He looks at her for a few moments, then to you. "Captain, as her superior, greatly appreciate your intent to help Sedlitaris, I do, but too brash about this, she has been. Take her out of our space, you must not."|2477|0
units.english: "Know that, I do! Exactly what I'm furious about, that is!" He shouts. "Asked them to give you a definitive answer, I had, but not this kind of definitive! Listen, permission or not, safe to leave, it is not. Know that, you do." He looks at her for a few moments, then to you. "Captain, as her superior, greatly appreciate your intent to help Sedlitaris, I do, but too brash about this, she has been. Take her out of our space, you must not."
units.italian: "Lo so, io! Proprio quello di cui sono furioso, questo è!" Urla. "Chiesto loro di darvi una risposta definitiva, io l'avevo, ma non questo tipo di definitiva! Ascoltate, permesso o no, sicuro partire, non lo è. Lo sapete, voi." La guarda per qualche istante, poi guarda te. "Capitano, come suo superiore, apprezzo molto la vostra intenzione di aiutare Sedlitaris, io lo faccio, ma troppo impulsiva su questo, lei è stata. Portarla fuori dal nostro spazio, voi non dovete."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 2|	He looks at her again, as if expecting some response. When no response comes, he turns away slowly, saying, "Waste not, your life on this," and walks away. Sedlitaris sighs once he turns a corridor and says she's ready for the trip.|2478|0
units.english: He looks at her again, as if expecting some response. When no response comes, he turns away slowly, saying, "Waste not, your life on this," and walks away. Sedlitaris sighs once he turns a corridor and says she's ready for the trip.
units.italian: La guarda di nuovo, come se si aspettasse una risposta. Quando non arriva, si volta lentamente, dicendo: "Non sprecate la vostra vita in questo," e se ne va. Sedlitaris sospira quando lui svolta in un corridoio e dice che è pronta per il viaggio.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 2|	"Hold on, what did he mean by it not being safe to leave? I thought you had permission."|2480|0
units.english: "Hold on, what did he mean by it not being safe to leave? I thought you had permission."
units.italian: "Aspetta, cosa intendeva con 'non è sicuro partire'? Pensavo avessi il permesso."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 2|	"Alright, let's head back to the ship."|2481|0
units.english: "Alright, let's head back to the ship."
units.italian: "Va bene, torniamo alla nave."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 2|	"I do. Know what he meant, I also do not," she says, looking back to the corner Kicharri turned. "Approving of my wish for this trip, he never was. Some time to calm down, he needs. For now, back to your ship, we should go."|2483|0
units.english: "I do. Know what he meant, I also do not," she says, looking back to the corner Kicharri turned. "Approving of my wish for this trip, he never was. Some time to calm down, he needs. For now, back to your ship, we should go."
units.italian: "Ce l'ho. Cosa intendeva, nemmeno io lo so," dice, guardando di nuovo l'angolo in cui Kicharri è svoltato. "D'accordo con il mio desiderio di fare questo viaggio, lui non lo è mai stato. Un po' di tempo per calmarsi, gli serve. Per ora, alla nave, dovremmo tornare."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 2|	"Alright, let's go."|2485|0
units.english: "Alright, let's go."
units.italian: "Va bene, andiamo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 2|	"I'm not sure I'm comfortable going after that."|2487|0
units.english: "I'm not sure I'm comfortable going after that."
units.italian: "Non sono sicuro di sentirmi a mio agio dopo quello."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 2|	She steps back, seemingly shocked at your change of mind. "What? Captain, a superstitious Kimek, the arbiter is. Pay no mind to that rant, you should. Assure you I do, fine we will be."|2488|0
units.english: She steps back, seemingly shocked at your change of mind. "What? Captain, a superstitious Kimek, the arbiter is. Pay no mind to that rant, you should. Assure you I do, fine we will be."
units.italian: Fa un passo indietro, apparentemente scioccata dal tuo cambio di idea. "Come? Capitano, un Kimek superstizioso, l'arbitro è. Non badate a quella filippica, voi dovreste. Vi assicuro, staremo bene."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 2|	"I'm sorry, but I won't help you anymore."|2490|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but I won't help you anymore."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non ti aiuterò più."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 2|	"I better not regret this. Let's head to the ship."|2491|0
units.english: "I better not regret this. Let's head to the ship."
units.italian: "Meglio non dovermene pentire. Andiamo alla nave."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 2|	Sedlitaris doesn't say anything, but makes no effort to hide her frustration. She looks to where Kicharri headed, and storms off after him.|2493|0
units.english: Sedlitaris doesn't say anything, but makes no effort to hide her frustration. She looks to where Kicharri headed, and storms off after him.
units.italian: Sedlitaris non dice nulla, ma non fa nulla per nascondere la sua frustrazione. Guarda nella direzione in cui è andato Kicharri, e si avventa dietro di lui.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 2|	You find five Heliarchs waiting by your ship, who Sedlitaris introduces as representatives of the council, and who must be present when House Idriss provides the piece of equipment she wants. You show her and the others to their bunks and prepare for the trip.|2496|0
units.english: You find five Heliarchs waiting by your ship, who Sedlitaris introduces as representatives of the council, and who must be present when House Idriss provides the piece of equipment she wants. You show her and the others to their bunks and prepare for the trip.
units.italian: Trovi cinque Heliarchs che aspettano vicino alla nave, che Sedlitaris presenta come rappresentanti del consiglio, e che devono essere presenti quando la Casa Idriss fornirà il pezzo di equipaggiamento che desidera. Mostri a lei e agli altri le loro cuccette e ti prepari per il viaggio.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 2|dialog|2499|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Sedlitaris and the Heliarch council representatives hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Sedlitaris e i rappresentanti del consiglio degli Heliarchs non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|name|2503|0
units.english: Dusted Dead Drop
units.italian: Nascondiglio impolverato

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|description|2504|0
units.english: Head to <destination>, where Sedlitaris wishes to check an ancient Saryd vault for the route and logs of her ancestor's expedition.
units.italian: Dirigiti su <destination>, dove Sedlitaris vuole controllare un antico caveau Saryd per la rotta e i registri della spedizione del suo antenato.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|The Heliarch council representatives guide you far from the planet's equator to a region close to a snowy mountain, and tell you to land on top of a cube-shaped plateau. Dozens of searchlights are dotted along the edges, lighting the ground below, while a warehouse complex sits at the center of the plateau top. As you're approaching the plateau, your ship's sensors alert you to incoming vessels; you look at your radar to see a Saryd Sojourner, followed by three Travelers, getting closer to your ship. They appear unarmed, but as you land on the plateau and they follow you down, defensive turrets on the edges of the complex remain locked onto them.|2512|0
units.english: The Heliarch council representatives guide you far from the planet's equator to a region close to a snowy mountain, and tell you to land on top of a cube-shaped plateau. Dozens of searchlights are dotted along the edges, lighting the ground below, while a warehouse complex sits at the center of the plateau top. As you're approaching the plateau, your ship's sensors alert you to incoming vessels; you look at your radar to see a Saryd Sojourner, followed by three Travelers, getting closer to your ship. They appear unarmed, but as you land on the plateau and they follow you down, defensive turrets on the edges of the complex remain locked onto them.
units.italian: I rappresentanti del consiglio degli Heliarchs ti guidano lontano dall'equatore del pianeta verso una regione vicina a una montagna innevata, e ti dicono di atterrare sulla cima di un altopiano a forma di cubo. Decine di riflettori sono disseminati lungo i bordi, illuminando il terreno sottostante, mentre un complesso di magazzini si trova al centro della cima. Mentre ti avvicini all'altopiano, i sensori della nave ti avvertono di navi in arrivo; guardi il radar e vedi un Saryd Sojourner, seguito da tre Traveler, che si avvicinano alla tua nave. Sembrano disarmati, ma quando atterri sull'altopiano e ti seguono giù, le torrette difensive ai bordi del complesso restano puntate su di loro.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	Once the Sojourner lands, a Saryd comes down the ramp and heads to your ship. Sedlitaris sighs and leaves to meet him, followed by the representatives of the Heliarch council. Once you're all out of your ship, you see the Saryd has been stopped by a trio of Arach guards, clad in winter uniforms and blocking his path. "Told mother or father about this, have you?" he shouts at Sedlitaris as she walks closer. "Because important enough to be told, I apparently am not. That out to die you were, told I was by some Kimek arbiter that met, I never had!"|2513|0
units.english: Once the Sojourner lands, a Saryd comes down the ramp and heads to your ship. Sedlitaris sighs and leaves to meet him, followed by the representatives of the Heliarch council. Once you're all out of your ship, you see the Saryd has been stopped by a trio of Arach guards, clad in winter uniforms and blocking his path. "Told mother or father about this, have you?" he shouts at Sedlitaris as she walks closer. "Because important enough to be told, I apparently am not. That out to die you were, told I was by some Kimek arbiter that met, I never had!"
units.italian: Una volta che il Sojourner atterra, un Saryd scende dalla rampa e si dirige alla tua nave. Sedlitaris sospira e va a incontrarlo, seguita dai rappresentanti del consiglio degli Heliarchs. Quando siete tutti fuori dalla nave, vedi che il Saryd è stato fermato da tre guardie Arach, vestite con uniformi invernali e che gli bloccano la strada. "Ne hai parlato a madre o padre?" urla a Sedlitaris mentre lei si avvicina. "Perché abbastanza importante da essere avvertito, a quanto pare non lo sono. Che fossi qui per morire, me l'ha detto un arbitro Kimek che ho incontrato, cosa che non era mai successa!"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	"Repilor, a work trip, this is. Away for long, I won't be, so wish to trouble you all with the news, I didn't," she responds.|2514|0
units.english: "Repilor, a work trip, this is. Away for long, I won't be, so wish to trouble you all with the news, I didn't," she responds.
units.italian: "Repilor, un viaggio di lavoro, questo è. Lontana a lungo, io non lo sarò, quindi turbare tutti voi con la notizia, io non volevo," risponde.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	"Trouble us? In truth, know that wrong, you are, but face telling father that you're throwing your life away, you couldn't!"|2515|0
