units.english: "Trouble us? In truth, know that wrong, you are, but face telling father that you're throwing your life away, you couldn't!"
units.italian: "Turbarci? In verità, sappi che sbagli, tu, ma affrontare il padre dicendogli che stai buttando via la tua vita, non ci riuscivi!"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	He tries to push his way to her, but the guards stop him before he can make much progress. One of the Heliarch representatives gets closer, saying, "A restricted area, this is. Invading government property, you are, so suggest that you leave immediately, I do."|2516|0
units.english: He tries to push his way to her, but the guards stop him before he can make much progress. One of the Heliarch representatives gets closer, saying, "A restricted area, this is. Invading government property, you are, so suggest that you leave immediately, I do."
units.italian: Cerca di spingersi verso di lei, ma le guardie lo fermano prima che possa fare molti passi. Uno dei rappresentanti degli Heliarchs si avvicina, dicendo: "Un'area riservata, questa è. Invadere proprietà del governo, voi state, quindi suggerisco che ve ne andiate immediatamente, io lo faccio."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	"Restricted? What about the outside? Also restricted, is it not? Much more dangerous? Fine with sending my sister there, you seem," Repilor counters, and the Heliarch looks away after a moment. "If bothering the consuls so much, she was, just fired, she should've been!" He then looks at you, and continues, "And the human? Your transport out of here, I imagine? Or maybe the one who put these ideas in your head, they are?"|2517|0
units.english: "Restricted? What about the outside? Also restricted, is it not? Much more dangerous? Fine with sending my sister there, you seem," Repilor counters, and the Heliarch looks away after a moment. "If bothering the consuls so much, she was, just fired, she should've been!" He then looks at you, and continues, "And the human? Your transport out of here, I imagine? Or maybe the one who put these ideas in your head, they are?"
units.italian: "Riservata? E l'esterno? Anche quello è riservato, no? Molto più pericoloso? Mandare mia sorella lì, sembrate d'accordo," ribatte Repilor, e l'Heliarch dopo un momento distoglie lo sguardo. "Se infastidiva tanto i consoli, licenziata, sarebbe dovuta essere!" Poi guarda te e continua: "E l'umano? Il tuo trasporto per uscire di qui, immagino? O magari quello che ti ha messo queste idee in testa, è lui?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	"I've just been hired to transport her."|2519|0
units.english: "I've just been hired to transport her."
units.italian: "Sono stato assunto solo per trasportarla."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	"What's so wrong about her wanting to explore outside the Coalition?"|2521|0
units.english: "What's so wrong about her wanting to explore outside the Coalition?"
units.italian: "Cosa c'è di così sbagliato nel voler esplorare fuori dalla Coalizione?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	"Wait, what did you say about the outside being dangerous?"|2523|0
units.english: "Wait, what did you say about the outside being dangerous?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, cosa hai detto sul fatto che l'esterno è pericoloso?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	The Saryd looks at you, puzzled. Then, as if realizing something, he turns to Sedlitaris. "Told the human, you haven't?"|2524|0
units.english: The Saryd looks at you, puzzled. Then, as if realizing something, he turns to Sedlitaris. "Told the human, you haven't?"
units.italian: Il Saryd ti guarda, perplesso. Poi, come se avesse capito qualcosa, si volta verso Sedlitaris. "All'umano, non l'hai detto?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	"Enough that is, Repilor. Trespassing on a restricted area, you are. Escort him to his ship," she tells the guards, and after some struggle on Repilor's part, the Arachi manage to push him back inside the Sojourner. "Ignore that you should, Captain. Always... difficult, my brother was. Too stubborn to realize when to stop, and easy to impress with folk tales of the outside."|2525|0
units.english: "Enough that is, Repilor. Trespassing on a restricted area, you are. Escort him to his ship," she tells the guards, and after some struggle on Repilor's part, the Arachi manage to push him back inside the Sojourner. "Ignore that you should, Captain. Always... difficult, my brother was. Too stubborn to realize when to stop, and easy to impress with folk tales of the outside."
units.italian: "Basta così, Repilor. In un'area riservata, tu sei. Accompagnalo alla sua nave," dice alle guardie, e dopo qualche resistenza da parte di Repilor, gli Arachi riescono a spingerlo dentro il Sojourner. "Ignoratelo, dovreste, capitano. Sempre... difficile, mio fratello è stato. Troppo testardo per capire quando fermarsi, e facile da impressionare con racconti popolari dell'esterno."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	"If you say so. Should I wait in my ship until you all are done here?"|2527|0
units.english: "If you say so. Should I wait in my ship until you all are done here?"
units.italian: "Se lo dici tu. Devo aspettare nella mia nave finché non avete finito qui?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	"Folk tales or not, I'm not really willing to find out after that. He didn't seem to be lying."|2529|0
units.english: "Folk tales or not, I'm not really willing to find out after that. He didn't seem to be lying."
units.italian: "Racconti popolari o no, dopo quello non ho voglia di scoprirlo. Non sembrava stesse mentendo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	"What?" she exclaims. "Please Captain, fall for my brother's little rant, you cannot. Finally permission to leave, I have!"|2530|0
units.english: "What?" she exclaims. "Please Captain, fall for my brother's little rant, you cannot. Finally permission to leave, I have!"
units.italian: "Come?" esclama. "Vi prego, capitano, alla filippica di mio fratello non potete abboccare. Finalmente il permesso di partire, io ce l'ho!"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	"Alright, alright. But I hope I don't regret this."|2532|0
units.english: "Alright, alright. But I hope I don't regret this."
units.italian: "Va bene, va bene. Ma spero di non pentirmene."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	"I'm sorry. Whatever it is he was afraid of, I'm not willing to risk it."|2533|0
units.english: "I'm sorry. Whatever it is he was afraid of, I'm not willing to risk it."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace. Qualunque cosa lo spaventasse, non voglio rischiarla."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	"You won't." She says, heading to you and holding your hands with hers, as if in thanks. "Promise you I do, fine we will be, Captain."|2535|0
units.english: "You won't." She says, heading to you and holding your hands with hers, as if in thanks. "Promise you I do, fine we will be, Captain."
units.italian: "Non te ne pentirai." Dice, avvicinandosi e prendendoti le mani con le sue, come per ringraziarti. "Ve lo prometto, staremo bene, capitano."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	You hear her stomping her hoofs on the ground as you head back to your ship, and see her and the Heliarch council representatives arguing with one another as you close your hatch. When you're back on the spaceport landing area, a Sojourner lands next to your ship, and Repilor, the Saryd from earlier, comes out.|2538|0
units.english: You hear her stomping her hoofs on the ground as you head back to your ship, and see her and the Heliarch council representatives arguing with one another as you close your hatch. When you're back on the spaceport landing area, a Sojourner lands next to your ship, and Repilor, the Saryd from earlier, comes out.
units.italian: Senti i suoi zoccoli battere sul terreno mentre torni alla nave, e la vedi discutere con i rappresentanti del consiglio degli Heliarchs mentre chiudi il portello. Quando sei di nuovo nell'area di atterraggio dello spazioporto, un Sojourner atterra accanto alla tua nave, e ne esce Repilor, il Saryd di prima.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	"Forgive me for being rude earlier, you must," he says as he greets you. "Thought I had, that talked my sister into this you did. That filled her head with more grandiose tales of the outside, you must have." He sighs. "Thank you, Captain. Hate you now, my sister must, but the right thing, you did.|2539|0
units.english: "Forgive me for being rude earlier, you must," he says as he greets you. "Thought I had, that talked my sister into this you did. That filled her head with more grandiose tales of the outside, you must have." He sighs. "Thank you, Captain. Hate you now, my sister must, but the right thing, you did.
units.italian: "Perdonatemi per essere stato sgarbato prima, dovete," dice mentre ti saluta. "Ho pensato, che fossi stato tu a convincere mia sorella. Che le avessi riempito la testa con altri racconti grandiosi dell'esterno, devi averlo fatto." Sospira. "Grazie, capitano. Odiami ora, mia sorella deve, ma la cosa giusta, tu l'hai fatta.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	"That no inspector in the last 6000 years has ever returned from their expedition, the truth is, so afraid you were leading my sister to her death, I was. Better for the both of you, this is." He gives you a few seconds to process, then continues. "Please, hold it against her, I ask that you do not. Certain I am that intending you no harm, she was. It's just... trying to leave for so long, she has been, that afraid of telling you the whole truth, I imagine she was." He nods lightly in a bow, and heads back to his ship.|2540|0
units.english: "That no inspector in the last 6000 years has ever returned from their expedition, the truth is, so afraid you were leading my sister to her death, I was. Better for the both of you, this is." He gives you a few seconds to process, then continues. "Please, hold it against her, I ask that you do not. Certain I am that intending you no harm, she was. It's just... trying to leave for so long, she has been, that afraid of telling you the whole truth, I imagine she was." He nods lightly in a bow, and heads back to his ship.
units.italian: "Che nessun ispettore negli ultimi 6000 anni sia mai tornato dalla propria spedizione, la verità è, quindi avevo paura che stessi portando mia sorella alla morte, io ero. Meglio per entrambi, questo è." Ti dà qualche secondo per assimilare, poi continua. "Vi prego, non serbatene rancore con lei, io chiedo. Certo sono che non intendeva farvi del male. È solo che... cerca di partire da così tanto tempo, lei lo fa, che troppo spaventata per dirvi tutta la verità, immagino che fosse." China leggermente il capo in un inchino, e torna alla sua nave.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	"Awaiting 'explorers,' nothing but an unknown, certain doom is. Wish for that to be my sister's fate, I do not," he answers.|2543|0
units.english: "Awaiting 'explorers,' nothing but an unknown, certain doom is. Wish for that to be my sister's fate, I do not," he answers.
units.italian: "In attesa di 'esploratori', nient'altro che un ignoto, una rovina certa, c'è. Che questo sia il destino di mia sorella, io non lo voglio," risponde.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	"Captain <last> has nothing to do with it. Simply agreed to help me, they have, no different from the jobs you take, this is." Sedlitaris says.|2545|0
units.english: "Captain <last> has nothing to do with it. Simply agreed to help me, they have, no different from the jobs you take, this is." Sedlitaris says.
units.italian: "Il capitano <last> non c'entra nulla. Semplicemente accettato di aiutarmi, loro lo hanno, non diverso dai lavori che accetti, questo è." dice Sedlitaris.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	"A job, this is not, but a trek bound to end in tragedy." He thinks for a few seconds, looking at the Saryd ships that landed on the plateau. "Permission to leave, you have, but obligated to do so, you aren't. Quit, you still can. Leave the ranks, you could, and work with me. Give you my own ship, I will. Like that, would you not? To fly a ship of your own again?"|2546|0
units.english: "A job, this is not, but a trek bound to end in tragedy." He thinks for a few seconds, looking at the Saryd ships that landed on the plateau. "Permission to leave, you have, but obligated to do so, you aren't. Quit, you still can. Leave the ranks, you could, and work with me. Give you my own ship, I will. Like that, would you not? To fly a ship of your own again?"
units.italian: "Un lavoro, questo non è, ma un viaggio destinato a finire in tragedia." Pensa per qualche secondo, guardando le navi Saryd atterrate sull'altopiano. "Il permesso di partire, ce l'hai, ma obbligata a farlo, non sei. Dimetterti, puoi ancora. Lasciare i ranghi, potresti, e lavorare con me. Darti una nave mia, io lo farò. Ti piacerebbe, no? Volare di nuovo su una nave tua?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	"Finally allowed to leave, I am. Let go of this opportunity I won't, Repilor. Back in a few weeks, I'll be, lecture me all you want then, you can."|2547|0
units.english: "Finally allowed to leave, I am. Let go of this opportunity I won't, Repilor. Back in a few weeks, I'll be, lecture me all you want then, you can."
units.italian: "Finalmente autorizzata a partire, io sono. Lasciar perdere questa occasione, io non lo farò, Repilor. Di ritorno tra qualche settimana, io sarò, farmi la predica quanto vuoi allora, potrai."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	He stares her down for a while, bringing a hand to his face to wipe some tears forming on his eyes. "Wiser than this, the elder sibling should've been." He turns around and heads back to the Sojourner, which departs along with the three Travelers.|2548|0
units.english: He stares her down for a while, bringing a hand to his face to wipe some tears forming on his eyes. "Wiser than this, the elder sibling should've been." He turns around and heads back to the Sojourner, which departs along with the three Travelers.
units.italian: La fissa a lungo, portandosi una mano al viso per asciugare qualche lacrima che si forma nei suoi occhi. "Più saggio di così, il fratello maggiore sarebbe dovuto essere." Si volta e torna al Sojourner, che parte insieme ai tre Traveler.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	The representatives urge you and Sedlitaris to follow them into the complex, making your way past the walls and fences, and into one of the larger warehouses. Inside, large shelves stacked to the ceiling surround a hexagonal hole in the middle, closed off by metal bars and a shut gate. You're told it's an elevator and is bringing up the piece of equipment Sedlitaris requires.|2550|0
units.english: The representatives urge you and Sedlitaris to follow them into the complex, making your way past the walls and fences, and into one of the larger warehouses. Inside, large shelves stacked to the ceiling surround a hexagonal hole in the middle, closed off by metal bars and a shut gate. You're told it's an elevator and is bringing up the piece of equipment Sedlitaris requires.
units.italian: I rappresentanti vi esortano, te e Sedlitaris, a seguirli nel complesso, oltre i muri e le recinzioni, e dentro uno dei magazzini più grandi. All'interno, grandi scaffali impilati fino al soffitto circondano un buco esagonale al centro, chiuso da sbarre di metallo e da un cancello serrato. Ti dicono che è un ascensore e che sta portando su il pezzo di equipaggiamento che Sedlitaris richiede.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	"Deeply sorry for that scandal you witnessed, I am, Captain," she says while you wait. "Imagined, I hadn't, that follow us here, my brother would."|2551|0
units.english: "Deeply sorry for that scandal you witnessed, I am, Captain," she says while you wait. "Imagined, I hadn't, that follow us here, my brother would."
units.italian: "Profondamente dispiaciuta per lo scandalo a cui avete assistito, io sono, capitano," dice mentre aspettate. "Immaginato, io non l'avrei, che seguirci fin qui, mio fratello l'avrebbe fatto."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	"It's alright. It shows he cares a lot about you."|2553|0
units.english: "It's alright. It shows he cares a lot about you."
units.italian: "Va bene. Dimostra che tiene molto a te."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	"Wasn't he trespassing here? Why was he even allowed to do all of that?"|2555|0
units.english: "Wasn't he trespassing here? Why was he even allowed to do all of that?"
units.italian: "Non stava violando un'area riservata? Perché gli è stato permesso tutto questo?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	"What was he so worried about? Did something happen to make him afraid of you leaving?"|2557|0
units.english: "What was he so worried about? Did something happen to make him afraid of you leaving?"
units.italian: "Di cosa era così preoccupato? È successo qualcosa che lo ha reso timoroso che tu partissi?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	She thinks for a bit, then says, "Prohibited to leave, both civilians and regular Heliarchs are. Only agents with permission from the council - inspectors like myself - may do it. A simple measure to help protect our limited jump drives, it is, but birthed something of a taboo among the populace, that law has."|2558|0
units.english: She thinks for a bit, then says, "Prohibited to leave, both civilians and regular Heliarchs are. Only agents with permission from the council - inspectors like myself - may do it. A simple measure to help protect our limited jump drives, it is, but birthed something of a taboo among the populace, that law has."
units.italian: Pensa un po', poi dice: "Vietato partire, sia i civili sia gli Heliarchs comuni lo sono. Solo gli agenti con il permesso del consiglio, ispettori come me, possono farlo. Una misura semplice per aiutare a proteggere i nostri motori di salto limitati, è, ma ha generato una specie di tabù tra la popolazione, quella legge."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	She chuckles. "Probably because agree with him, the guards do. Seen Arbiter Kicharri's reaction, you did. Not very supportive of this expedition, most within the ranks are."|2561|0
units.english: She chuckles. "Probably because agree with him, the guards do. Seen Arbiter Kicharri's reaction, you did. Not very supportive of this expedition, most within the ranks are."
units.italian: Ridacchia. "Probabilmente perché d'accordo con lui, le guardie sono. Vista la reazione dell'arbitro Kicharri, voi l'avete. Non molto favorevoli a questa spedizione, la maggior parte dei ranghi lo è."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	"I suppose so. Just, wish that show it in less... brash ways, he would."|2564|0
units.english: "I suppose so. Just, wish that show it in less... brash ways, he would."
units.italian: "Suppongo di sì. Solo, vorrei che lo dimostrasse in modi meno... bruschi."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	The elevator arrives and brings up an Arachi pair carrying a tall, antenna-like pylon, covered in insulating wires that spiral around it. The Arachi bring the machine out of the elevator and present some documents for the Heliarch representatives, who take turns reading and signing them. At the end, Sedlitaris signs as well, and the Arachi bring the pylon to your ship.|2566|0
units.english: The elevator arrives and brings up an Arachi pair carrying a tall, antenna-like pylon, covered in insulating wires that spiral around it. The Arachi bring the machine out of the elevator and present some documents for the Heliarch representatives, who take turns reading and signing them. At the end, Sedlitaris signs as well, and the Arachi bring the pylon to your ship.
units.italian: L'ascensore arriva e porta su una coppia di Arachi che trasportano un pilone alto, simile a un'antenna, coperto di fili isolanti che gli si avvolgono intorno a spirale. Gli Arachi portano la macchina fuori dall'ascensore e presentano alcuni documenti ai rappresentanti degli Heliarchs, che a turno li leggono e li firmano. Alla fine firma anche Sedlitaris, e gli Arachi portano il pilone alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	Once everything's ready, the Heliarch representatives ask you to bring them to the spaceport city. They are quick to leave your ship once you land and do not bother to say goodbye to either you or Sedlitaris, instead just disappearing into a Heliarch building.|2567|0
units.english: Once everything's ready, the Heliarch representatives ask you to bring them to the spaceport city. They are quick to leave your ship once you land and do not bother to say goodbye to either you or Sedlitaris, instead just disappearing into a Heliarch building.
units.italian: Quando tutto è pronto, i rappresentanti degli Heliarchs ti chiedono di portarli nella città dello spazioporto. Sono rapidi a lasciare la tua nave appena atterri e non si disturbano a salutare né te né Sedlitaris, sparendo invece in un edificio degli Heliarchs.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	"Well, all set to leave now, we are," Sedlitaris says. "Ready to leave for our first stop, are you, Captain?"|2568|0
units.english: "Well, all set to leave now, we are," Sedlitaris says. "Ready to leave for our first stop, are you, Captain?"
units.italian: "Beh, ora siamo pronti a partire," dice Sedlitaris. "Pronto a partire per la nostra prima tappa, voi siete, capitano?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	"Of course. Where are we headed?"|2570|0
units.english: "Of course. Where are we headed?"
units.italian: "Ma certo. Dove siamo diretti?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	"Can you tell me what that machine is? How is it going to help?"|2572|0
units.english: "Can you tell me what that machine is? How is it going to help?"
units.italian: "Puoi dirmi cos'è quella macchina? Come ci aiuterà?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	"A decryption pylon, it is. Developed to keep our data safe, they were," she explains. "Generate a unique encryption pattern, each expedition would, so that find important information about them, outside forces couldn't. Calibrated to the pattern of my ancestor's expedition, this one is."|2573|0
units.english: "A decryption pylon, it is. Developed to keep our data safe, they were," she explains. "Generate a unique encryption pattern, each expedition would, so that find important information about them, outside forces couldn't. Calibrated to the pattern of my ancestor's expedition, this one is."
units.italian: "Un pilone di decrittazione, è. Sviluppati per tenere al sicuro i nostri dati, loro erano," spiega. "Generare uno schema di cifratura unico, ogni spedizione lo faceva, così che trovare informazioni importanti su di esse, le forze esterne non potessero. Calibrato sullo schema della spedizione del mio antenato, questo è."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	She asks to see your galaxy map, and compares the data with what's recorded in the pylon. After comparing what systems match for a few minutes, she points you to <destination>. "The first stop of every expedition, that world was. Kept there, a collection of log entries are, detailing the plans each leader had for their own expedition. Do you know if found this world, humans have, Captain?" You explain to her that <planet> is home to a small human town, but that you haven't heard of alien findings there. "Hope that found and picked it over, humans haven't. Much easier, it would be, if the precise location the fleet was headed to, we knew. Have to travel hundreds of systems in search of their stops, and later piece them together in order, we would not."|2575|0
units.english: She asks to see your galaxy map, and compares the data with what's recorded in the pylon. After comparing what systems match for a few minutes, she points you to <destination>. "The first stop of every expedition, that world was. Kept there, a collection of log entries are, detailing the plans each leader had for their own expedition. Do you know if found this world, humans have, Captain?" You explain to her that <planet> is home to a small human town, but that you haven't heard of alien findings there. "Hope that found and picked it over, humans haven't. Much easier, it would be, if the precise location the fleet was headed to, we knew. Have to travel hundreds of systems in search of their stops, and later piece them together in order, we would not."
units.italian: Ti chiede di vedere la tua mappa galattica, e confronta i dati con quelli registrati nel pilone. Dopo aver confrontato per qualche minuto quali sistemi corrispondono, ti indica <destination>. "La prima tappa di ogni spedizione, quel mondo era. Conservata lì, una raccolta di voci di registro è, che dettaglia i piani che ogni comandante aveva per la propria spedizione. Sapete se hanno trovato questo mondo, gli umani, capitano?" Le spieghi che <planet> ospita una piccola città umana, ma che non hai mai sentito di scoperte aliene lì. "Spero che trovato e saccheggiato, gli umani non l'abbiano. Molto più facile, sarebbe, se la posizione precisa verso cui la flotta era diretta, noi la sapessimo. Viaggiare per centinaia di sistemi alla ricerca delle loro tappe, e poi ricomporle in ordine, noi non dovremmo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|	You help her bring the pylon into her room and set course for <planet>.|2576|0
units.english: You help her bring the pylon into her room and set course for <planet>.
units.italian: La aiuti a portare il pilone nella sua stanza e imposti la rotta per <planet>.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 3|dialog|2579|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Sedlitaris hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Sedlitaris non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 4|name|2583|0
units.english: Report: Distant Home
units.italian: Rapporto: Casa Lontana

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 4|description|2584|0
units.english: Take Sedlitaris to <destination>, the first stop of the expeditionary fleet other than the vault, so that she can begin piecing together what happened.
units.italian: Porta Sedlitaris su <destination>, la prima tappa della flotta di spedizione oltre al caveau, così che possa cominciare a ricostruire cosa è successo.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 4|Coming down to <origin>, Sedlitaris checks for the coordinates where the ancient Saryd stop is, passing the data to your ship's systems. It brings you to a mesa on the desert, with a wide, ravine-like hole on top. You land close to a small opening on the mesa walls leading into the ravine and follow Sedlitaris into it, helping her bring the pylon inside. About halfway to the end, she points to another hole in the walls. "Past there, the pylons of previous expeditions should be. Find the one Mimodum left here, we must. A physical connection with the one we brought, for this first one we'll need. 'Wake up' the other ones his expedition left, it will, and enough battery for easier access to the data in those, they should have."|2592|0
units.english: Coming down to <origin>, Sedlitaris checks for the coordinates where the ancient Saryd stop is, passing the data to your ship's systems. It brings you to a mesa on the desert, with a wide, ravine-like hole on top. You land close to a small opening on the mesa walls leading into the ravine and follow Sedlitaris into it, helping her bring the pylon inside. About halfway to the end, she points to another hole in the walls. "Past there, the pylons of previous expeditions should be. Find the one Mimodum left here, we must. A physical connection with the one we brought, for this first one we'll need. 'Wake up' the other ones his expedition left, it will, and enough battery for easier access to the data in those, they should have."
units.italian: Scendendo su <origin>, Sedlitaris controlla le coordinate dove si trova l'antica tappa Saryd, passando i dati ai sistemi della tua nave. Ti porta su una mesa nel deserto, con un ampio buco simile a un burrone sulla cima. Atterri vicino a una piccola apertura nelle pareti della mesa che porta nel burrone e la segui dentro, aiutandola a portare il pilone. Circa a metà strada verso la fine, indica un altro buco nelle pareti. "Oltre là, i piloni delle spedizioni precedenti dovrebbero essere. Trovare quello che Mimodum ha lasciato qui, noi dobbiamo. Un collegamento fisico con quello che abbiamo portato, per questo primo ci servirà. 'Svegliare' gli altri che la sua spedizione ha lasciato, esso lo farà, e batteria sufficiente per un accesso più facile ai dati in quelli, dovrebbero avere."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 4|	She carries the pylon inside as you light the way. After some short minutes inside the tunnel dug into the mesa walls, you reach the end: a room carefully carved out, with ten objects similar to the pylon Sedlitaris carried there, though four are of very different design, being closer to a beige, blocky obelisk. She puts down the pylon, and asks that you shine a light on it so that she can configure it. Then, she begins to tinker with some wires connected to a panel on the lower half of the pylon. "To determine which one of these is the most recent, send a signal in its frequency, I will."|2593|0
units.english: She carries the pylon inside as you light the way. After some short minutes inside the tunnel dug into the mesa walls, you reach the end: a room carefully carved out, with ten objects similar to the pylon Sedlitaris carried there, though four are of very different design, being closer to a beige, blocky obelisk. She puts down the pylon, and asks that you shine a light on it so that she can configure it. Then, she begins to tinker with some wires connected to a panel on the lower half of the pylon. "To determine which one of these is the most recent, send a signal in its frequency, I will."
units.italian: Porta il pilone dentro mentre tu fai luce. Dopo qualche minuto dentro il tunnel scavato nelle pareti della mesa, raggiungete la fine: una stanza ricavata con cura, con dieci oggetti simili al pilone che Sedlitaris ha portato, anche se quattro sono di design molto diverso, più vicini a un obelisco beige e massiccio. Posa il pilone e ti chiede di illuminarlo così che possa configurarlo. Poi comincia ad armeggiare con alcuni fili collegati a un pannello nella metà inferiore del pilone. "Per determinare quale di questi è il più recente, invierò un segnale sulla sua frequenza, io lo farò."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 4|	"Was all this process set up so the Quarg couldn't get your logs, if they found them?"|2595|0
units.english: "Was all this process set up so the Quarg couldn't get your logs, if they found them?"
units.italian: "Tutto questo processo è stato ideato così che i Quarg non potessero ottenere i vostri registri, se li avessero trovati?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 4|	"What's with all the caving involved in getting to these pylons?"|2597|0
units.english: "What's with all the caving involved in getting to these pylons?"
units.italian: "Perché tutta questa storia di caverne per raggiungere i piloni?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 4|	"Understand your frustration, I do," she says. "After explored outside with jump drives, the first Saryds to leave the Coalition had, attempted to colonize a few worlds they found, they did. Failures due to the great distance to Saryd space, and difficulty in getting supplies, they were. Because of that, once leaving initial expedition logs in this world, we began, bothered to create proper infrastructure, my predecessors didn't." She thinks for a while, then continues, "Although, help make it less likely for others to find it, the poor entrance might."|2598|0
units.english: "Understand your frustration, I do," she says. "After explored outside with jump drives, the first Saryds to leave the Coalition had, attempted to colonize a few worlds they found, they did. Failures due to the great distance to Saryd space, and difficulty in getting supplies, they were. Because of that, once leaving initial expedition logs in this world, we began, bothered to create proper infrastructure, my predecessors didn't." She thinks for a while, then continues, "Although, help make it less likely for others to find it, the poor entrance might."
units.italian: "Capisco la vostra frustrazione, io la capisco," dice. "Dopo aver esplorato l'esterno con i motori di salto, i primi Saryd che lasciarono la Coalizione tentarono di colonizzare alcuni mondi che avevano trovato, loro lo fecero. Fallimenti per la grande distanza dallo spazio Saryd, e per la difficoltà nel procurarsi rifornimenti, furono. Per questo, una volta lasciati i registri iniziali delle spedizioni su questo mondo, abbiamo cominciato, senza preoccuparci di creare infrastrutture adeguate, i miei predecessori." Pensa per un momento, poi continua: "Ma forse, rendere meno probabile che altri lo trovino, l'ingresso misero potrebbe."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 4|	"No, employed this method before they ever came in conflict with the Quarg, the ancient Saryds did," she explains. "Actually, the ones who suggested it in the first place, the Quarg were. Worlds apart, the programs used before and after the War of Independence are, but kept in place, the overall practice was."|2601|0
units.english: "No, employed this method before they ever came in conflict with the Quarg, the ancient Saryds did," she explains. "Actually, the ones who suggested it in the first place, the Quarg were. Worlds apart, the programs used before and after the War of Independence are, but kept in place, the overall practice was."
units.italian: "No, impiegato questo metodo prima ancora di entrare in conflitto con i Quarg, gli antichi Saryd lo hanno," spiega. "In realtà, i primi a suggerirlo, i Quarg furono. Molto diversi, i sistemi usati prima e dopo la Guerra d'Indipendenza sono, ma mantenuta in uso, la pratica complessiva è stata."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 4|	Once she's done with the wires, she pushes a button and a humming beep comes from one of the machines with the same, spiraling design. "That one, it is," she says, and asks that you help her move her pylon close to the one that emitted the sound. She connects the two with cables by the base of each pylon; the older pylon clicks on after a moment, letting out several beeps in a short chant. "Enough energy to transfer its data now, it should have."|2603|0
units.english: Once she's done with the wires, she pushes a button and a humming beep comes from one of the machines with the same, spiraling design. "That one, it is," she says, and asks that you help her move her pylon close to the one that emitted the sound. She connects the two with cables by the base of each pylon; the older pylon clicks on after a moment, letting out several beeps in a short chant. "Enough energy to transfer its data now, it should have."
units.italian: Quando ha finito con i fili, preme un pulsante e un bip ronzante esce da una delle macchine con lo stesso design a spirale. "Quello, è," dice, e ti chiede di aiutarla a spostare il suo pilone vicino a quello che ha emesso il suono. Collega i due con cavi alla base di ciascun pilone; il pilone più vecchio si accende dopo un momento, emettendo diversi bip in un breve canto. "Energia sufficiente per trasferire i suoi dati ora, dovrebbe avere."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 4|	A few seconds pass, and another hum comes. She looks at a small screen on the panel, and confirms that the data's all safe. "Copy the data from expeditions prior to their pylon here, the sixth did, so saved us some time, they have. Play their recorded log via my translation device, I shall." She disconnects the two pylons from one another, and inputs a few commands on the panel. After a short pause, an audio message begins playing, and is picked up and translated by the box hanging from Sedlitaris' neck.|2604|0
units.english: A few seconds pass, and another hum comes. She looks at a small screen on the panel, and confirms that the data's all safe. "Copy the data from expeditions prior to their pylon here, the sixth did, so saved us some time, they have. Play their recorded log via my translation device, I shall." She disconnects the two pylons from one another, and inputs a few commands on the panel. After a short pause, an audio message begins playing, and is picked up and translated by the box hanging from Sedlitaris' neck.
units.italian: Passano alcuni secondi, e arriva un altro ronzio. Guarda un piccolo schermo sul pannello e conferma che i dati sono tutti al sicuro. "Copiare i dati delle spedizioni precedenti al loro pilone qui, la sesta lo ha fatto, quindi ci hanno risparmiato un po' di tempo. Riprodurre il loro registro tramite il mio dispositivo di traduzione, io lo farò." Scollega i due piloni l'uno dall'altro e inserisce alcuni comandi sul pannello. Dopo una breve pausa, parte un messaggio audio, che viene captato e tradotto dalla scatola appesa al collo di Sedlitaris.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 4|	"Log started, sixth expedition to the outside. Arbiter Mimodum, this is, leading the sixth. Using these pylons, keep track of our major stops, we shall. To push out further than what is recorded in our previous maps, if possible, the mission directive is. Wish to gather data on how safe the outside systems are, I do. Split the fleet in half, I have. To head straight east, the four Punishers of the split group are. After that, rendezvous with us as we come down from the north, they will. Regarding the Punishers currently under my command, headed to Distant Home, we are. Evaluate how the planet has developed, we shall, to determine if sustainable, a base or colony on the planet is. Set a pylon there with our findings, we shall."|2605|0
units.english: "Log started, sixth expedition to the outside. Arbiter Mimodum, this is, leading the sixth. Using these pylons, keep track of our major stops, we shall. To push out further than what is recorded in our previous maps, if possible, the mission directive is. Wish to gather data on how safe the outside systems are, I do. Split the fleet in half, I have. To head straight east, the four Punishers of the split group are. After that, rendezvous with us as we come down from the north, they will. Regarding the Punishers currently under my command, headed to Distant Home, we are. Evaluate how the planet has developed, we shall, to determine if sustainable, a base or colony on the planet is. Set a pylon there with our findings, we shall."
units.italian: "Registro iniziato, sesta spedizione verso l'esterno. L'arbitro Mimodum, sono io, a guidare la sesta. Usando questi piloni, tenere traccia delle nostre tappe principali, noi lo faremo. Spingerci più lontano di quanto sia registrato nelle nostre mappe precedenti, se possibile, la direttiva della missione è. Raccogliere dati su quanto siano sicuri i sistemi esterni, io voglio. Diviso la flotta a metà, io l'ho. Dirigersi dritti a est, i quattro Punisher del gruppo separato lo faranno. Poi, ricongiungersi con noi mentre scendiamo da nord, loro lo faranno. Quanto ai Punisher attualmente sotto il mio comando, diretti a Casa Lontana, noi siamo. Valutare come si è sviluppato il pianeta, noi lo faremo, per determinare se sostenibile, una base o una colonia sul pianeta sia. Lasciare lì un pilone con le nostre scoperte, noi lo faremo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 4|	The recording ends, and Sedlitaris picks up the pylon again, preparing to carry it back out of the caves. "Know our next destination, we now do," she says.|2606|0
units.english: The recording ends, and Sedlitaris picks up the pylon again, preparing to carry it back out of the caves. "Know our next destination, we now do," she says.
units.italian: La registrazione finisce, e Sedlitaris riprende il pilone, preparandosi a riportarlo fuori dalle caverne. "La nostra prossima destinazione, ora la sappiamo," dice.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 4|	"Do you have any idea where 'Distant Home' is?"|2608|0
units.english: "Do you have any idea where 'Distant Home' is?"
units.italian: "Hai idea di dove sia 'Casa Lontana'?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 4|	"What did he mean by 'if possible'? Was something stopping them from exploring past a point?"|2610|0
units.english: "What did he mean by 'if possible'? Was something stopping them from exploring past a point?"
units.italian: "Cosa intendeva con 'se possibile'? C'era qualcosa che impediva loro di esplorare oltre un certo punto?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 4|	"Stopping them?" She takes a long pause, eyes locked onto the pylon. "Wonder that, I also do. Perhaps encountered some complication, they had. Learn more from other log entries, I'm sure we will."|2611|0
units.english: "Stopping them?" She takes a long pause, eyes locked onto the pylon. "Wonder that, I also do. Perhaps encountered some complication, they had. Learn more from other log entries, I'm sure we will."
units.italian: "Impedire?" Fa una lunga pausa, gli occhi fissi sul pilone. "Chiedermelo, anch'io lo faccio. Forse hanno incontrato qualche complicazione, loro l'hanno avuta. Saperne di più da altre voci di registro, sicuramente lo faremo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 4|	"Our first attempt at colonizing an outside world, it was. Somewhere northwest of here, it should be, but consult your ship's records for the exact coordinates, we'll need to."|2614|0
units.english: "Our first attempt at colonizing an outside world, it was. Somewhere northwest of here, it should be, but consult your ship's records for the exact coordinates, we'll need to."
units.italian: "Il nostro primo tentativo di colonizzare un mondo esterno, è stato. Da qualche parte a nord-ovest di qui, dovrebbe essere, ma consultare i registri della vostra nave per le coordinate esatte, noi dovremo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 4|	You two make your way out of the cave, returning to the ravine, and from there head to your ship. Sedlitaris asks for your map and compares the coordinates with the data from the pylon again, finding that <destination> is what the recording referred to as Distant Home. She heads to her room, and you set <planet> as your destination.|2616|0
units.english: You two make your way out of the cave, returning to the ravine, and from there head to your ship. Sedlitaris asks for your map and compares the coordinates with the data from the pylon again, finding that <destination> is what the recording referred to as Distant Home. She heads to her room, and you set <planet> as your destination.
units.italian: Uscite dalla caverna, tornate nel burrone e da lì alla nave. Sedlitaris chiede la mappa e confronta di nuovo le coordinate con i dati del pilone, scoprendo che <destination> è ciò che la registrazione chiamava Casa Lontana. Va nella sua stanza, e tu imposti <planet> come destinazione.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 4|dialog|2619|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Sedlitaris hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Sedlitaris non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 5|name|2623|0
units.english: Report: Ancient Light
units.italian: Rapporto: Luce Antica

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 5|description|2624|0
units.english: Take Sedlitaris to <destination>, the next stop of the expeditionary fleet, where her ancestor wished to look into remnants of some alien ruins.
units.italian: Porta Sedlitaris su <destination>, la tappa successiva della flotta di spedizione, dove il suo antenato voleva indagare sui resti di alcune rovine aliene.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 5|As you pass through the first clouds of <origin>, Sedlitaris starts working on the pylon, getting a faint beep moments after she's done. "Further south, this world's pylon is." You fly your ship southward, and she asks that you stop halfway to the pole. She inputs commands again, and another beep comes. "Passed it, we have. Determine its exact position, we must. Little battery for these countersignals, the pylons have." You fly northeast, and then straight west, with her emitting a signal each time your ship stops.|2632|0
units.english: As you pass through the first clouds of <origin>, Sedlitaris starts working on the pylon, getting a faint beep moments after she's done. "Further south, this world's pylon is." You fly your ship southward, and she asks that you stop halfway to the pole. She inputs commands again, and another beep comes. "Passed it, we have. Determine its exact position, we must. Little battery for these countersignals, the pylons have." You fly northeast, and then straight west, with her emitting a signal each time your ship stops.
units.italian: Mentre attraversi le prime nuvole di <origin>, Sedlitaris comincia a lavorare sul pilone, ottenendo un debole bip poco dopo aver finito. "Più a sud, il pilone di questo mondo è." Fai volare la nave verso sud, e lei ti chiede di fermarti a metà strada verso il polo. Inserisce di nuovo dei comandi, e arriva un altro bip. "Superato, noi lo abbiamo. Determinare la sua posizione esatta, noi dobbiamo. Poca batteria per questi controsegnali, i piloni hanno." Voli a nord-est, e poi dritto a ovest, con lei che emette un segnale ogni volta che la nave si ferma.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 5|	After you've triangulated the pylon's coordinates, you fly down to a glacier and land on a spot that looks stable enough to handle the weight of your ship. Sedlitaris says the pylon must have gotten covered in the ice due to glacial melting and refreezing, though that doesn't seem to have damaged its systems; she accesses the data remotely after tinkering with the pylon in your ship for a while.|2633|0
units.english: After you've triangulated the pylon's coordinates, you fly down to a glacier and land on a spot that looks stable enough to handle the weight of your ship. Sedlitaris says the pylon must have gotten covered in the ice due to glacial melting and refreezing, though that doesn't seem to have damaged its systems; she accesses the data remotely after tinkering with the pylon in your ship for a while.
units.italian: Dopo aver triangolato le coordinate del pilone, scendi su un ghiacciaio e atterri in un punto che sembra abbastanza stabile da reggere il peso della nave. Sedlitaris dice che il pilone deve essere stato coperto dal ghiaccio per lo scioglimento e il successivo rigelo glaciale, anche se questo non sembra aver danneggiato i suoi sistemi; accede ai dati a distanza dopo aver armeggiato per un po' con il pilone nella tua nave.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 5|	Once it's done, she plays the log recording the expedition had for this planet: "Log started. Developing as expected, this world is, and apparently still untouched, it remains. Too cold for non-Saryd residents, it is, but with some terraforming efforts, a comfortable enough base for Kimek and Arachi agents alike, it could be. The planet aside, noted a great deal more hyperlane connections, we have. Dependent on them, this fleet is not, but differ greatly from previous records, current ones do, as if scrambled and then rearranged, they were. Heading to Ancient Light next, we are. Check on the ruins and dragons there, we must."|2634|0
units.english: Once it's done, she plays the log recording the expedition had for this planet: "Log started. Developing as expected, this world is, and apparently still untouched, it remains. Too cold for non-Saryd residents, it is, but with some terraforming efforts, a comfortable enough base for Kimek and Arachi agents alike, it could be. The planet aside, noted a great deal more hyperlane connections, we have. Dependent on them, this fleet is not, but differ greatly from previous records, current ones do, as if scrambled and then rearranged, they were. Heading to Ancient Light next, we are. Check on the ruins and dragons there, we must."
units.italian: Quando ha finito, riproduce il registro che la spedizione aveva lasciato per questo pianeta: "Registro iniziato. Sviluppandosi come previsto, questo mondo è, e a quanto pare ancora intatto, resta. Troppo freddo per residenti non Saryd, è, ma con qualche sforzo di terraformazione, una base abbastanza confortevole sia per agenti Kimek sia per Arachi, potrebbe essere. A parte il pianeta, notato molte più connessioni ipervia, noi abbiamo. Dipendente da esse, questa flotta non è, ma differiscono molto dai registri precedenti, quelli attuali lo fanno, come se fossero stati rimescolati e poi riorganizzati, lo erano. Diretti a Luce Antica dopo, noi siamo. Controllare le rovine e i draghi lì, noi dobbiamo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 5|	The recording ends, and Sedlitaris starts comparing the data she got with the map on your ship. "Right, he was. At some point after the fifth expedition, and before the sixth, altered, this region's hyperlane network was."|2635|0
units.english: The recording ends, and Sedlitaris starts comparing the data she got with the map on your ship. "Right, he was. At some point after the fifth expedition, and before the sixth, altered, this region's hyperlane network was."
units.italian: La registrazione finisce, e Sedlitaris comincia a confrontare i dati ottenuti con la mappa sulla tua nave. "Aveva ragione, lui. A un certo punto dopo la quinta spedizione, e prima della sesta, alterata, la rete ipervia di questa regione è stata."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 5|	"Any idea how that happened?"|2637|0
units.english: "Any idea how that happened?"
units.italian: "Hai idea di come sia successo?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 5|	"I take it that 'Ancient Light' is where we're going next?"|2638|0
units.english: "I take it that 'Ancient Light' is where we're going next?"
units.italian: "Immagino che 'Luce Antica' sia dove andiamo dopo?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 5|	"Vital to our communications network, the hyperlanes are. The most advanced group on that field, House Bebliss is, but learned of means to tamper with hyperlanes, even they haven't." She pauses, looking to the nearby systems bordering the Coalition. "No link to our space, there is, before or after the change. If a natural phenomenon, the scrambling of links is, very unlucky, we were."|2640|0
units.english: "Vital to our communications network, the hyperlanes are. The most advanced group on that field, House Bebliss is, but learned of means to tamper with hyperlanes, even they haven't." She pauses, looking to the nearby systems bordering the Coalition. "No link to our space, there is, before or after the change. If a natural phenomenon, the scrambling of links is, very unlucky, we were."
units.italian: "Vitali per la nostra rete di comunicazioni, le ipervie sono. Il gruppo più avanzato in quel campo, la Casa Bebliss è, ma venire a conoscenza di mezzi per manomettere le ipervie, nemmeno loro lo hanno fatto." Si ferma, guardando i sistemi vicini che confinano con la Coalizione. "Nessun collegamento con il nostro spazio, c'è, prima o dopo il cambiamento. Se un fenomeno naturale, il rimescolamento dei collegamenti è, molto sfortunati, noi siamo stati."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 5|	"Well, at least we know where to go next. Can you match coordinates with my map to find where 'Ancient Light' is?"|2642|0
units.english: "Well, at least we know where to go next. Can you match coordinates with my map to find where 'Ancient Light' is?"
units.italian: "Beh, almeno sappiamo dove andare dopo. Puoi confrontare le coordinate con la mia mappa per trovare dov'è 'Luce Antica'?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 5|	"And if it's not natural?"|2644|0
units.english: "And if it's not natural?"
units.italian: "E se non fosse naturale?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 5|	She stays quiet for a minute, not taking her eyes off the map. "Told the ancient Saryds of a group, the Quarg did. 'Drak,' I think they called them. Said that knit together the paths between star systems, they had. Maybe their doing, the scrambling was."|2645|0
units.english: She stays quiet for a minute, not taking her eyes off the map. "Told the ancient Saryds of a group, the Quarg did. 'Drak,' I think they called them. Said that knit together the paths between star systems, they had. Maybe their doing, the scrambling was."
units.italian: Resta in silenzio per un minuto, senza staccare gli occhi dalla mappa. "Parlato agli antichi Saryd di un gruppo, i Quarg lo hanno fatto. 'Drak', credo che li chiamassero. Detto che intrecciavano insieme i percorsi tra i sistemi stellari, loro lo facevano. Forse opera loro, il rimescolamento è stato."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 5|	She compares the coordinates for Ancient Light with your map, and finds <destination>. You tell her you'll set course for <planet>, and she heads back to her room.|2647|0
units.english: She compares the coordinates for Ancient Light with your map, and finds <destination>. You tell her you'll set course for <planet>, and she heads back to her room.
units.italian: Confronta le coordinate di Luce Antica con la tua mappa, e trova <destination>. Le dici che imposterai la rotta per <planet>, e lei torna nella sua stanza.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 5|dialog|2650|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Sedlitaris hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Sedlitaris non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 6|name|2654|0
units.english: Report: Summit
units.italian: Rapporto: Vetta

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 6|description|2655|0
units.english: Take Sedlitaris to <destination>, the furthest point north on the pylon's records and next stop of the expeditionary fleet.
units.italian: Porta Sedlitaris su <destination>, il punto più a nord nei registri del pilone e tappa successiva della flotta di spedizione.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 6|Sedlitaris starts triangulating to find the next pylon again, and brings you to a tall mountain where some of the local dragons appear to have made some form of nest or breeding ground. You do your best to avoid them as you fly around the mountain, and Sedlitaris continues to send signals to find the pylon.|2663|0
units.english: Sedlitaris starts triangulating to find the next pylon again, and brings you to a tall mountain where some of the local dragons appear to have made some form of nest or breeding ground. You do your best to avoid them as you fly around the mountain, and Sedlitaris continues to send signals to find the pylon.
units.italian: Sedlitaris ricomincia a triangolare per trovare il pilone successivo, e ti porta su una montagna alta dove alcuni dei draghi locali sembrano aver fatto una specie di nido o terreno di riproduzione. Fai del tuo meglio per evitarli mentre voli intorno alla montagna, e Sedlitaris continua a inviare segnali per trovare il pilone.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 6|	"Inside the mountain, it could be. From there, the countersignals are coming." She stops for a few minutes and looks at the view of the mountain on your monitors. She tries again, and asks that you get closer. When you're finishing yet another lap, she asks that you stop your ship, keeping it steady in the air. "Zoom your cameras here, could you, Captain?" she asks, pointing to the middle of a monitor. You zoom in and see a circle of large rocks, surrounded by dragon nests. Atop the rocks are some patches of foliage, and in the middle lies a small, dark, tower-like structure, stuck in the rocks by one end. After looking at it for a few seconds, you both realize it's an upside-down pylon. "Taken it as some form of token, the dragons must have," Sedlitaris says. "Hopes of retrieving some of the pylons physically, I had, but prefer to dig out the glacier for the previous one than test my luck against the dragons, I do. Unlock this one's data remotely, I will."|2664|0
units.english: "Inside the mountain, it could be. From there, the countersignals are coming." She stops for a few minutes and looks at the view of the mountain on your monitors. She tries again, and asks that you get closer. When you're finishing yet another lap, she asks that you stop your ship, keeping it steady in the air. "Zoom your cameras here, could you, Captain?" she asks, pointing to the middle of a monitor. You zoom in and see a circle of large rocks, surrounded by dragon nests. Atop the rocks are some patches of foliage, and in the middle lies a small, dark, tower-like structure, stuck in the rocks by one end. After looking at it for a few seconds, you both realize it's an upside-down pylon. "Taken it as some form of token, the dragons must have," Sedlitaris says. "Hopes of retrieving some of the pylons physically, I had, but prefer to dig out the glacier for the previous one than test my luck against the dragons, I do. Unlock this one's data remotely, I will."
units.italian: "Dentro la montagna, potrebbe essere. Da lì, i controsegnali arrivano." Si ferma per qualche minuto e guarda la vista della montagna sui tuoi monitor. Riprova, e ti chiede di avvicinarti. Quando stai completando l'ennesimo giro, ti chiede di fermare la nave, tenendola ferma in aria. "Ingrandire le telecamere qui, potreste, capitano?" chiede, indicando il centro di un monitor. Ingrandisci e vedi un cerchio di grandi rocce, circondato da nidi di drago. Sopra le rocce ci sono alcune chiazze di vegetazione, e al centro si trova una piccola struttura scura, simile a una torre, incastrata nelle rocce per un'estremità. Dopo averla guardata per qualche secondo, capite entrambi che è un pilone capovolto. "Preso come una specie di trofeo, i draghi devono averlo," dice Sedlitaris. "Speranze di recuperare fisicamente alcuni dei piloni, io le avevo, ma preferisco scavare il ghiacciaio per quello precedente piuttosto che tentare la fortuna con i draghi. Sbloccare i dati di questo a distanza, io lo farò."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 6|	A dragon perches on your ship as she begins the transfer. It tries to bite down on the engines, but you start moving your ship again to shake it off. You avoid other dragons as they fly by your ship until the download is complete, and head straight for the spaceport city.|2665|0
units.english: A dragon perches on your ship as she begins the transfer. It tries to bite down on the engines, but you start moving your ship again to shake it off. You avoid other dragons as they fly by your ship until the download is complete, and head straight for the spaceport city.
units.italian: Un drago si posa sulla nave mentre lei comincia il trasferimento. Prova a mordere i motori, ma ricominci a muovere la nave per scrollarlo di dosso. Eviti gli altri draghi mentre passano accanto alla nave finché il download non è completo, e ti dirigi dritto verso la città dello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 6|	Once your ship has safely landed at the hangars, Sedlitaris plays the audio log: "Log started. Scoured the planet with our searches, we have, but no trace of the previously visited ruins, or any other sign of the group that lived here, we found. Assured me that all our ships' navigation systems are working properly, the engineers have, but at the coordinates where they should be, the ruins are not, as if they had never been there. A confusing disappointment, this was, but continue with the mission, we must. Heading far north, to Summit, we are. The last point before regrouping with the split group, it will be."|2666|0
units.english: Once your ship has safely landed at the hangars, Sedlitaris plays the audio log: "Log started. Scoured the planet with our searches, we have, but no trace of the previously visited ruins, or any other sign of the group that lived here, we found. Assured me that all our ships' navigation systems are working properly, the engineers have, but at the coordinates where they should be, the ruins are not, as if they had never been there. A confusing disappointment, this was, but continue with the mission, we must. Heading far north, to Summit, we are. The last point before regrouping with the split group, it will be."
units.italian: Una volta che la nave è atterrata in sicurezza agli hangar, Sedlitaris riproduce il registro audio: "Registro iniziato. Setacciato il pianeta con le nostre ricerche, noi lo abbiamo, ma nessuna traccia delle rovine visitate in precedenza, né altro segno del gruppo che viveva qui, abbiamo trovato. Assicurato che tutti i sistemi di navigazione delle nostre navi funzionino correttamente, gli ingegneri lo hanno, ma alle coordinate dove dovrebbero essere, le rovine non ci sono, come se non fossero mai esistite. Una delusione confusa, questa è stata, ma continuare con la missione, noi dobbiamo. Diretti molto a nord, a Vetta, noi siamo. L'ultimo punto prima di ricongiungerci con il gruppo separato, sarà."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 6|	As the recording ends, Sedlitaris looks at you confused. "An intelligent species once lived on this planet. What findings Mimodum would have on them, I wondered, but found nothing, he did? Simply vanish out of nowhere, ruins cannot."|2667|0
units.english: As the recording ends, Sedlitaris looks at you confused. "An intelligent species once lived on this planet. What findings Mimodum would have on them, I wondered, but found nothing, he did? Simply vanish out of nowhere, ruins cannot."
units.italian: Quando la registrazione finisce, Sedlitaris ti guarda confusa. "Una specie intelligente viveva un tempo su questo pianeta. Che scoperte avesse Mimodum su di loro, me lo chiedevo, ma non ha trovato nulla? Semplicemente svanire nel nulla, le rovine non possono."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 6|	"How do you know about that species?"|2669|0
units.english: "How do you know about that species?"
units.italian: "Come sai di quella specie?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 6|	"What was in the ruins before they disappeared?"|2670|0
units.english: "What was in the ruins before they disappeared?"
units.italian: "Cosa c'era nelle rovine prima che sparissero?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 6|	"Found the ruins millennia ago, the first Saryds to come to the outside did. Recovered some artifacts, they also had, complex tools, such as very large, personal propelling devices, with dedicated storage space. Kept in some museums back in Saros, they are."|2671|0
units.english: "Found the ruins millennia ago, the first Saryds to come to the outside did. Recovered some artifacts, they also had, complex tools, such as very large, personal propelling devices, with dedicated storage space. Kept in some museums back in Saros, they are."
units.italian: "Trovate le rovine millenni fa, i primi Saryd che vennero all'esterno lo fecero. Recuperato anche alcuni manufatti, loro lo hanno, strumenti complessi, come dispositivi personali di propulsione molto grandi, con spazio di stoccaggio dedicato. Conservati in alcuni musei a Saros, sono."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 6|	"Did they ever find any member of that species?"|2673|0
units.english: "Did they ever find any member of that species?"
units.italian: "Hanno mai trovato qualche membro di quella specie?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 6|	"They couldn't find out anything more? Just some jetpacks with pockets?"|2674|0
units.english: "They couldn't find out anything more? Just some jetpacks with pockets?"
units.italian: "Non sono riusciti a scoprire nient'altro? Solo dei propulsori a reazione con le tasche?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 6|	She shakes her head. "Stocked primarily with provisions, those first expeditions were. Prepared to take on proper archaeological study on this planet, they were not. Asked the Quarg about the findings, the Saryds had, but to their surprise they acted as if there was nothing here. For the time, very odd of them to do that, it was." She turns to you with a curious look. "What about humanity, Captain? Found any clues about the species that lived here, have you?"|2675|0
units.english: She shakes her head. "Stocked primarily with provisions, those first expeditions were. Prepared to take on proper archaeological study on this planet, they were not. Asked the Quarg about the findings, the Saryds had, but to their surprise they acted as if there was nothing here. For the time, very odd of them to do that, it was." She turns to you with a curious look. "What about humanity, Captain? Found any clues about the species that lived here, have you?"
units.italian: Scuote la testa. "Dotate soprattutto di viveri, quelle prime spedizioni erano. Non erano preparate a intraprendere un vero studio archeologico su questo pianeta. Chiesto ai Quarg delle scoperte, i Saryd lo hanno, ma con loro sorpresa si comportarono come se non ci fosse niente qui. Per l'epoca, molto strano da parte loro, fu." Si volta verso di te con uno sguardo curioso. "E l'umanità, capitano? Trovato qualche indizio sulla specie che viveva qui, avete?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 6|	"No, I didn't even know there used to be ruins here."|2679|0
units.english: "No, I didn't even know there used to be ruins here."
units.italian: "No, non sapevo nemmeno che qui ci fossero delle rovine."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 6|	"Actually, yes. They were called Sheragi."|2683|0
units.english: "Actually, yes. They were called Sheragi."
units.italian: "In realtà, sì. Si chiamavano Sheragi."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 6|	"No, I didn't even know there used to be ruins here."|2684|0
units.english: "No, I didn't even know there used to be ruins here."
units.italian: "No, non sapevo nemmeno che qui ci fossero delle rovine."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 6|	Surprised that you know more, she listens to your story with Albert Foster, and how you had a dream about ships evacuating Zug. You tell her of the city buried under the layers of rock, the efforts to uncover it, and how the Quarg eventually sent someone to keep watch of the digging process.|2688|0
units.english: Surprised that you know more, she listens to your story with Albert Foster, and how you had a dream about ships evacuating Zug. You tell her of the city buried under the layers of rock, the efforts to uncover it, and how the Quarg eventually sent someone to keep watch of the digging process.
units.italian: Sorpresa che tu ne sappia di più, ascolta la tua storia con Albert Foster, e di come hai sognato navi che evacuavano Zug. Le racconti della città sepolta sotto gli strati di roccia, degli sforzi per riportarla alla luce, e di come i Quarg alla fine mandarono qualcuno a sorvegliare gli scavi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 6|	"Cities buried whole by lava? Tuned their scanners to look for such odd ruins, no expedition must have..." she stops and thinks for a few minutes, working on the pylon's command panel. "Tell the story again, could you, Captain <last>? Formally record the findings here, I would like." You spend the next few hours retelling what you saw, and helping her collect what information on the Sheragi and their ruins humans have learned since Foster published his initial findings.|2689|0
units.english: "Cities buried whole by lava? Tuned their scanners to look for such odd ruins, no expedition must have..." she stops and thinks for a few minutes, working on the pylon's command panel. "Tell the story again, could you, Captain <last>? Formally record the findings here, I would like." You spend the next few hours retelling what you saw, and helping her collect what information on the Sheragi and their ruins humans have learned since Foster published his initial findings.
units.italian: "Città sepolte intere dalla lava? Sintonizzato i loro scanner per cercare rovine così strane, nessuna spedizione deve aver..." si ferma e riflette per qualche minuto, lavorando sul pannello di comando del pilone. "Raccontate di nuovo la storia, potreste, capitano <last>? Registrare formalmente qui le scoperte, mi piacerebbe." Passi le ore successive a raccontare di nuovo quello che hai visto, e ad aiutarla a raccogliere le informazioni sugli Sheragi e sulle loro rovine che gli umani hanno appreso da quando Foster ha pubblicato le sue prime scoperte.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 6|	Once she's satisfied, you two look to your map and match coordinates with the next stop Mimodum made.|2690|0
units.english: Once she's satisfied, you two look to your map and match coordinates with the next stop Mimodum made.
units.italian: Quando è soddisfatta, guardate la mappa e confrontate le coordinate con la tappa successiva di Mimodum.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 6|label|2692|0
units.english: not know
units.italian: not know

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 6|	She frowns slightly. "Figured as much, I had. Well, finding out more about them, the point of this expedition wasn't. A nice bonus, it would've been, but prepare to look for the next pylon, we should."|2693|0
units.english: She frowns slightly. "Figured as much, I had. Well, finding out more about them, the point of this expedition wasn't. A nice bonus, it would've been, but prepare to look for the next pylon, we should."
units.italian: Aggrotta leggermente la fronte. "Immaginato, io l'avevo. Beh, scoprire di più su di loro, lo scopo di questa spedizione non era. Un bel bonus, sarebbe stato, ma prepararci a cercare il pilone successivo, noi dovremmo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 6|	You open your map, and using the coordinates, gather that "Summit" is <planet>, a small moon close to the entrance to The Deep. Sedlitaris returns to her bunk, and you set course to <system>.|2695|0
units.english: You open your map, and using the coordinates, gather that "Summit" is <planet>, a small moon close to the entrance to The Deep. Sedlitaris returns to her bunk, and you set course to <system>.
units.italian: Apri la mappa, e usando le coordinate deduci che "Vetta" è <planet>, una piccola luna vicino all'ingresso del Profondo. Sedlitaris torna nella sua cuccetta, e tu imposti la rotta per <system>.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 6|dialog|2698|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Sedlitaris hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Sedlitaris non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 7|name|2702|0
units.english: Curious Red Cloud
units.italian: Curiosa nube rossa

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 7|description|2703|0
units.english: Look for the system near Algieba where Mimodum, the expedition's leader, jumped to investigate the cosmological phenomenon in the system.
units.italian: Cerca il sistema vicino ad Algieba in cui Mimodum, il comandante della spedizione, saltò per indagare sul fenomeno cosmologico del sistema.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 7|You fly around the moon as Sedlitaris nails down the coordinates of the pylon, until you land close to one of the forests. "Deeper inside, the pylon must be. Uninhabited by humans this world is, correct?" You confirm this, and she prepares to leave. "No dragons to worry about here, there are, so try to bring this pylon back with us, I will."|2710|0
units.english: You fly around the moon as Sedlitaris nails down the coordinates of the pylon, until you land close to one of the forests. "Deeper inside, the pylon must be. Uninhabited by humans this world is, correct?" You confirm this, and she prepares to leave. "No dragons to worry about here, there are, so try to bring this pylon back with us, I will."
units.italian: Voli intorno alla luna mentre Sedlitaris individua le coordinate del pilone, finché atterrate vicino a una delle foreste. "Più all'interno, il pilone deve essere. Disabitato dagli umani, questo mondo è, giusto?" Lo confermi, e lei si prepara a uscire. "Nessun drago di cui preoccuparsi qui, ci sono, quindi provare a riportare questo pilone con noi, io lo farò."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 7|	You two leave your ship and enter the forest, taking turns carrying the pylon you brought, which is easy enough to do since the gravity is so much lower here. Occasionally Sedlitaris stops and has the pylon put down so that she can determine where to go next. Eventually, you notice the trees start getting smaller as you move on, until you reach a wide, odd clearing where the ground is devoid of any of the local flora. Sedlitaris spots the other pylon on the opposite side, half stuck in the ground, and moves to pull it out. As you follow her to the machine, you notice deep, perfectly straight holes in the ground, forming lines that sometimes cross the entire clearing and continue well past it. Soil and dust have filled most of them up, but in certain gaps you can look down to cracks that must be dozens of meters deep.|2711|0
units.english: You two leave your ship and enter the forest, taking turns carrying the pylon you brought, which is easy enough to do since the gravity is so much lower here. Occasionally Sedlitaris stops and has the pylon put down so that she can determine where to go next. Eventually, you notice the trees start getting smaller as you move on, until you reach a wide, odd clearing where the ground is devoid of any of the local flora. Sedlitaris spots the other pylon on the opposite side, half stuck in the ground, and moves to pull it out. As you follow her to the machine, you notice deep, perfectly straight holes in the ground, forming lines that sometimes cross the entire clearing and continue well past it. Soil and dust have filled most of them up, but in certain gaps you can look down to cracks that must be dozens of meters deep.
units.italian: Uscite dalla nave ed entrate nella foresta, portando a turno il pilone che avete portato, cosa abbastanza facile visto che la gravità qui è molto più bassa. Ogni tanto Sedlitaris si ferma e fa posare il pilone così che possa determinare dove andare dopo. Alla fine noti che gli alberi cominciano a diventare più piccoli man mano che proseguite, finché non raggiungete una radura ampia e strana, dove il terreno è privo di qualsiasi flora locale. Sedlitaris individua l'altro pilone sul lato opposto, mezzo incastrato nel terreno, e va a tirarlo fuori. Mentre la segui verso la macchina, noti buchi profondi e perfettamente dritti nel terreno, che formano linee che a volte attraversano tutta la radura e proseguono ben oltre. Terriccio e polvere ne hanno riempito la maggior parte, ma in alcune fessure puoi guardare giù fino a crepe profonde decine di metri.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 7|	Sedlitaris ties a rope around the end of the pylon that's visible and pulls it, forcing up the dirt as she brings the rest of the device to surface. She connects it with the pylon you brought and accesses the data from there. "Much more active here, the expedition was," she says. "Three recordings, there are. Bring these back to your ship, we should; listen to the first one there, we can."|2712|0
units.english: Sedlitaris ties a rope around the end of the pylon that's visible and pulls it, forcing up the dirt as she brings the rest of the device to surface. She connects it with the pylon you brought and accesses the data from there. "Much more active here, the expedition was," she says. "Three recordings, there are. Bring these back to your ship, we should; listen to the first one there, we can."
units.italian: Sedlitaris lega una corda all'estremità visibile del pilone e tira, sollevando la terra mentre porta in superficie il resto del dispositivo. Lo collega al pilone che avete portato e accede ai dati da lì. "Molto più attiva qui, la spedizione è stata," dice. "Tre registrazioni, ci sono. Portarle alla vostra nave, noi dovremmo; ascoltare la prima lì, noi possiamo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 7|	Both of you carrying a pylon, you make your way out of the forest and back to your ship, where Sedlitaris immediately plays the oldest entry: "Log started. Send two Punishers further north, I did, but returned yet, they have not. As for the crimson anomaly on the nearby western system, still unresponsive, it is. Be it a Finisher barrage or attempting to ram it, no reaction from the anomaly, there was. A simple nebula, the researchers claim it is not; think that we are missing something, they do. Wait a few more days for the Punishers to return, I will. In the meantime, back to that system, I will go. Maybe learn something about the anomaly, we can."|2713|0
units.english: Both of you carrying a pylon, you make your way out of the forest and back to your ship, where Sedlitaris immediately plays the oldest entry: "Log started. Send two Punishers further north, I did, but returned yet, they have not. As for the crimson anomaly on the nearby western system, still unresponsive, it is. Be it a Finisher barrage or attempting to ram it, no reaction from the anomaly, there was. A simple nebula, the researchers claim it is not; think that we are missing something, they do. Wait a few more days for the Punishers to return, I will. In the meantime, back to that system, I will go. Maybe learn something about the anomaly, we can."
units.italian: Entrambi con un pilone in braccio, uscite dalla foresta e tornate alla nave, dove Sedlitaris riproduce subito la voce più antica: "Registro iniziato. Mandato due Punisher più a nord, io l'ho fatto, ma tornati, ancora non sono. Quanto all'anomalia cremisi nel sistema vicino a ovest, ancora insensibile, è. Che fosse un fuoco di sbarramento di Finisher o un tentativo di speronarla, nessuna reazione dall'anomalia, c'è stata. Una semplice nebulosa, i ricercatori sostengono che non è; pensano che ci stiamo perdendo qualcosa. Aspettare ancora qualche giorno il ritorno dei Punisher, io lo farò. Nel frattempo, tornare in quel sistema, io andrò. Magari scoprire qualcosa sull'anomalia, noi possiamo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 7|	After Mimodum's voice has disappeared, Sedlitaris urges you to take off. "Heard of this 'anomaly' before, I had not. Look for the system it's in, at once we must. Hopefully still there after the centuries, it is."|2714|0
units.english: After Mimodum's voice has disappeared, Sedlitaris urges you to take off. "Heard of this 'anomaly' before, I had not. Look for the system it's in, at once we must. Hopefully still there after the centuries, it is."
