units.italian: Dopo che la voce di Mimodum è sparita, Sedlitaris ti esorta a decollare. "Sentito parlare di questa 'anomalia' prima, io non l'avevo. Cercare il sistema in cui si trova, subito noi dobbiamo. Speriamo che ci sia ancora dopo i secoli, è."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 7|dialog|2719|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Sedlitaris hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Sedlitaris non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 7B|Sedlitaris fiddles with the pylon you recovered from <origin>, and lets the second recorded log play while she gazes out to see the "crimson anomaly" Mimodum had mentioned.|2729|0
units.english: Sedlitaris fiddles with the pylon you recovered from <origin>, and lets the second recorded log play while she gazes out to see the "crimson anomaly" Mimodum had mentioned.
units.italian: Sedlitaris armeggia con il pilone che avete recuperato su <origin>, e lascia che il secondo registro si riproduca mentre guarda fuori verso l'"anomalia cremisi" di cui Mimodum aveva parlato.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 7B|	"Tried just about everything now, we have. A finisher barrage, bombardment from afar, driving asteroids through it, even activating our jump drive while immersed in the red cloud. Told me that it shows some signs of rotation, the chief researcher has; tried to show me the axis around which it spins, she did. Whatever the case, find anything worthwhile about the cloud, we could not. Returning to Summit now, we are, and from there to regroup with the fleet."|2730|0
units.english: "Tried just about everything now, we have. A finisher barrage, bombardment from afar, driving asteroids through it, even activating our jump drive while immersed in the red cloud. Told me that it shows some signs of rotation, the chief researcher has; tried to show me the axis around which it spins, she did. Whatever the case, find anything worthwhile about the cloud, we could not. Returning to Summit now, we are, and from there to regroup with the fleet."
units.italian: "Provato praticamente di tutto ormai, noi abbiamo. Un fuoco di sbarramento di Finisher, bombardamenti da lontano, asteroidi lanciati contro, persino attivare il nostro motore di salto mentre eravamo immersi nella nube rossa. Detto che mostra qualche segno di rotazione, il capo ricercatore lo ha; provato a mostrarmi l'asse attorno a cui ruota, lei lo ha fatto. Comunque sia, trovare qualcosa di utile sulla nube, noi non siamo riusciti. Tornare a Vetta ora, noi siamo, e da lì a ricongiungerci con la flotta."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 7B|	The recording ends, but Sedlitaris continues looking out to the "cloud" for a few minutes, in silence.|2731|0
units.english: The recording ends, but Sedlitaris continues looking out to the "cloud" for a few minutes, in silence.
units.italian: La registrazione finisce, ma Sedlitaris continua a guardare fuori verso la "nube" per qualche minuto, in silenzio.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 7B|	"Are you going to play the last one?"|2733|0
units.english: "Are you going to play the last one?"
units.italian: "Hai intenzione di riprodurre l'ultima?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 7B|	"Is something wrong?"|2735|0
units.english: "Is something wrong?"
units.italian: "C'è qualcosa che non va?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 7B|	"No, just... taking in the view, I was. Unlike any phenomena from within the Coalition, this is."|2736|0
units.english: "No, just... taking in the view, I was. Unlike any phenomena from within the Coalition, this is."
units.italian: "No, solo... stavo ammirando la vista, io. Niente di simile a qualsiasi fenomeno dentro la Coalizione, questo è."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 7B|	She moves back to the pylon, and hesitates for a moment. "Back to Summit, Mimodum said they would go. Better understand his next steps, we would, if listen to the last entry on that clearing where we found this, we did," she says, tapping the pylon.|2738|0
units.english: She moves back to the pylon, and hesitates for a moment. "Back to Summit, Mimodum said they would go. Better understand his next steps, we would, if listen to the last entry on that clearing where we found this, we did," she says, tapping the pylon.
units.italian: Torna al pilone, e esita un momento. "A Vetta, Mimodum ha detto che sarebbero tornati. Capire meglio i suoi passi successivi, noi potremmo, se ascoltare l'ultima voce su quella radura dove abbiamo trovato questo, noi facessimo," dice, battendo sul pilone.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 7B|	You tell her you'll go back to <origin> soon, and she heads to her bunk.|2739|0
units.english: You tell her you'll go back to <origin> soon, and she heads to her bunk.
units.italian: Le dici che tornerete a <origin> presto, e lei va nella sua cuccetta.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 8|name|2746|0
units.english: Lost Checkpoint
units.italian: Punto di controllo perduto

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 8|description|2747|0
units.english: Travel to the marked systems so that Sedlitaris may look for a signal frequency of the expedition.
units.italian: Viaggia verso i sistemi segnalati così che Sedlitaris possa cercare una frequenza di segnale della spedizione.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 8|You land next to the forest again and venture into it once more. The trail fresh in your memory, you two reach the clearing quickly, where Sedlitaris puts the pylon close to where it was before being dug out. "Almost like if we were there with them, this should be, being right where they left the pylon. Hopefully a better understanding of what they were thinking, it will also provide."|2760|0
units.english: You land next to the forest again and venture into it once more. The trail fresh in your memory, you two reach the clearing quickly, where Sedlitaris puts the pylon close to where it was before being dug out. "Almost like if we were there with them, this should be, being right where they left the pylon. Hopefully a better understanding of what they were thinking, it will also provide."
units.italian: Atterri di nuovo accanto alla foresta e ti avventuri dentro ancora una volta. Il sentiero è ancora fresco nella tua memoria, e raggiungete in fretta la radura, dove Sedlitaris mette il pilone vicino al punto in cui era prima di essere dissotterrato. "Quasi come se fossimo lì con loro, questo dovrebbe essere, trovandoci proprio dove hanno lasciato il pilone. Spero che una comprensione migliore di cosa pensavano, esso fornisca anche."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 8|	She starts the recording, and sharp, static beeps are the first thing you hear. After a moment, you can make out agitated voices, as if the crew was discussing something, but Sedlitaris' translator doesn't pick it up. Finally, the familiar voice of Mimodum comes out, "Destroyed, the rest of the fleet was. Made it back to the system, one of the Punishers that headed north must have; ran into some debris pieces floating about in the system, we did. Take off, the rest of those on Summit couldn't. The ground is..." the static returns, this time including some scratch-like stops. "... cut like clay... rock... molten..." It switches to static once again, then stops for a moment. When it's back, the interference noises are gone. "Meet with the split group, I must. Warn them of what happened, and head back home with them, I will."|2761|0
units.english: She starts the recording, and sharp, static beeps are the first thing you hear. After a moment, you can make out agitated voices, as if the crew was discussing something, but Sedlitaris' translator doesn't pick it up. Finally, the familiar voice of Mimodum comes out, "Destroyed, the rest of the fleet was. Made it back to the system, one of the Punishers that headed north must have; ran into some debris pieces floating about in the system, we did. Take off, the rest of those on Summit couldn't. The ground is..." the static returns, this time including some scratch-like stops. "... cut like clay... rock... molten..." It switches to static once again, then stops for a moment. When it's back, the interference noises are gone. "Meet with the split group, I must. Warn them of what happened, and head back home with them, I will."
units.italian: Avvia la registrazione, e bip acuti e statici sono la prima cosa che senti. Dopo un momento riesci a distinguere voci agitate, come se l'equipaggio stesse discutendo di qualcosa, ma il traduttore di Sedlitaris non le capta. Alla fine emerge la voce familiare di Mimodum: "Distrutta, il resto della flotta è stata. Riuscito a tornare nel sistema, uno dei Punisher che erano andati a nord deve esserci; incrociato alcuni pezzi di detriti che fluttuavano nel sistema, noi lo abbiamo fatto. Decollare, gli altri su Vetta non potevano. Il terreno è..." torna il fruscio, questa volta con alcune interruzioni simili a graffi. "...tagliato come argilla... roccia... fuso..." Passa di nuovo al fruscio, poi si ferma per un momento. Quando torna, i rumori di interferenza sono spariti. "Incontrarmi con il gruppo separato, io devo. Avvertirli di quello che è successo, e tornare a casa con loro, io lo farò."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 8|	You two look at the pylon in silence for a while, then she slowly approaches the machine to pick it up, saying, "Supposed to head back home immediately, expedition ships were, if destroyed, one of the Punishers was. If followed those orders, he had... no guarantee of the split group's survival, he had. If back home, they went..."|2762|0
units.english: You two look at the pylon in silence for a while, then she slowly approaches the machine to pick it up, saying, "Supposed to head back home immediately, expedition ships were, if destroyed, one of the Punishers was. If followed those orders, he had... no guarantee of the split group's survival, he had. If back home, they went..."
units.italian: Guardate il pilone in silenzio per un po', poi lei si avvicina lentamente alla macchina per prenderla, dicendo: "Dovute tornare a casa immediatamente, le navi della spedizione erano, se distrutto uno dei Punisher fosse stato. Se avesse seguito quegli ordini, lui avrebbe... nessuna garanzia della sopravvivenza del gruppo separato, lui aveva. Se a casa, sono tornati..."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 8|	"He could have, but then the other group wouldn't know that any Punisher was destroyed. They wouldn't know to go back."|2764|0
units.english: "He could have, but then the other group wouldn't know that any Punisher was destroyed. They wouldn't know to go back."
units.italian: "Avrebbe potuto, ma allora l'altro gruppo non avrebbe saputo che un Punisher era stato distrutto. Non avrebbero saputo che dovevano tornare."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 8|	"Seems like they didn't pick the best person to follow those orders."|2765|0
units.english: "Seems like they didn't pick the best person to follow those orders."
units.italian: "Sembra che non abbiano scelto la persona migliore a cui affidare quegli ordini."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 8|	"We don't know if he could've made it if he had gone back immediately. I'm sure we'll find out more with the next pylon."|2766|0
units.english: "We don't know if he could've made it if he had gone back immediately. I'm sure we'll find out more with the next pylon."
units.italian: "Non sappiamo se ce l'avrebbe fatta se fosse tornato indietro subito. Sono sicuro che scopriremo di più con il prossimo pilone."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 8|	She doesn't respond, instead looking down at the lines carving the clearing's ground. She moves close to one, laying down and reaching her arms to touch the cracks. A few minutes later, she gets back up and looks to you.|2768|0
units.english: She doesn't respond, instead looking down at the lines carving the clearing's ground. She moves close to one, laying down and reaching her arms to touch the cracks. A few minutes later, she gets back up and looks to you.
units.italian: Non risponde, limitandosi a guardare le linee che solcano il terreno della radura. Si avvicina a una, si sdraia e allunga le braccia per toccare le crepe. Qualche minuto dopo si rialza e ti guarda.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 8|	"Back to the ship, we should go," she says. "Try and figure out where Mimodum went next, I will. Where he was to meet with the split group."|2770|0
units.english: "Back to the ship, we should go," she says. "Try and figure out where Mimodum went next, I will. Where he was to meet with the split group."
units.italian: "Alla nave, dovremmo tornare," dice. "Provare a capire dove è andato dopo Mimodum, io lo farò. Dove doveva incontrarsi con il gruppo separato."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 8|	After taking the trail back, Sedlitaris goes into her bunk to tinker with the pylons. She comes out hours after nightfall, asking that you show her your map. "A pincer movement, the two groups were performing. Difficult to know the exact planet, it is, as the data from the split group, we don't have, but figured the overall region where the two groups would link up, I think I have."|2771|0
units.english: After taking the trail back, Sedlitaris goes into her bunk to tinker with the pylons. She comes out hours after nightfall, asking that you show her your map. "A pincer movement, the two groups were performing. Difficult to know the exact planet, it is, as the data from the split group, we don't have, but figured the overall region where the two groups would link up, I think I have."
units.italian: Dopo aver ripercorso il sentiero, Sedlitaris entra nella sua cuccetta ad armeggiare con i piloni. Esce molte ore dopo il calare della notte, chiedendoti di mostrarle la mappa. "Un movimento a tenaglia, i due gruppi stavano eseguendo. Difficile sapere il pianeta esatto, è, dato che i dati del gruppo separato, noi non li abbiamo, ma capito la regione complessiva in cui i due gruppi si sarebbero congiunti, credo di averlo fatto."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 8|	You help her match the coordinates, and end up with a group of systems between Sol and Tarazed. "Need to visit each system, we might. Pick up faint signals of their next pylon, while in the right system I can, but no way of knowing where that is exactly, I have."|2772|0
units.english: You help her match the coordinates, and end up with a group of systems between Sol and Tarazed. "Need to visit each system, we might. Pick up faint signals of their next pylon, while in the right system I can, but no way of knowing where that is exactly, I have."
units.italian: La aiuti a far combaciare le coordinate, e finite con un gruppo di sistemi tra Sol e Tarazed. "Visitare ogni sistema, potremmo doverlo fare. Captare deboli segnali del loro pilone successivo, mentre sono nel sistema giusto io posso, ma nessun modo di sapere dov'è esattamente, io ho."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 8|dialog|2775|0
units.english: Sedlitaris has the pylon start searching for any matching signals as soon as you jump into the system. A few hours pass and the machine doesn't return any coordinates, but it also doesn't report a failure. Sedlitaris looks at it puzzled, and reboots it. "Fly around the system for a while, could you, Captain? Maybe compromising the signal, the ship's current position is." You do as she suggests, and slowly cruise around for a few more hours. Once again, the pylon doesn't give any answer. Sedlitaris says it might be some oddly specific bug, and asks that you just move on to the next system.
units.italian: Sedlitaris fa partire la ricerca del pilone di qualsiasi segnale corrispondente appena saltate nel sistema. Passano alcune ore e la macchina non restituisce coordinate, ma non segnala nemmeno un errore. Sedlitaris la guarda perplessa e la riavvia. "Volare intorno al sistema per un po', potreste, capitano? Magari compromette il segnale, la posizione attuale della nave." Fai come suggerisce, e vai piano in crociera per qualche altra ora. Ancora una volta il pilone non dà alcuna risposta. Sedlitaris dice che potrebbe essere un difetto stranamente specifico, e ti chiede di passare al sistema successivo.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 8|dialog|2777|0
units.english: The pylon is quick to answer in this system, reporting no similar signals. Sedlitaris urges you to move to the next system, and goes back to checking the data.
units.italian: Il pilone è rapido a rispondere in questo sistema, segnalando nessun segnale simile. Sedlitaris ti esorta a passare al sistema successivo, e torna a controllare i dati.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 8|dialog|2779|0
units.english: Sedlitaris lets her pylon work for about an hour, but it returns no sign of any others in the system. "Passed by here, they might have, but a priority for recon, that world was not," she says as she points at Rand. You tell her you'll move on to the next system soon, and she goes back to working on the pylon.
units.italian: Sedlitaris lascia lavorare il pilone per circa un'ora, ma non restituisce alcuna traccia di altri nel sistema. "Passati di qui, potrebbero essere, ma una priorità per la ricognizione, quel mondo non era," dice indicando Rand. Le dici che passerete presto al sistema successivo, e lei torna a lavorare sul pilone.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 8|dialog|2781|0
units.english: The pylon searches for some time, but tells Sedlitaris no others are in the system. She sighs lightly, and asks you to move on to the next.
units.italian: Il pilone cerca per un po', ma dice a Sedlitaris che nel sistema non ce ne sono altri. Sospira leggermente e ti chiede di passare al successivo.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 8|dialog|2783|0
units.english: "If correct, my estimates were, the most likely meeting point, this should be," Sedlitaris says as you jump into the system. She lets the pylon work for a while, but it returns no signal of a similar device. "Well... either estimated wrong, I have, or issues in meeting here, the two groups had. Check the next system, we should."
units.italian: "Se corrette, le mie stime erano, il punto d'incontro più probabile, questo dovrebbe essere," dice Sedlitaris appena saltate nel sistema. Lascia lavorare il pilone per un po', ma non restituisce segnale di un dispositivo simile. "Beh... o sbagliato la stima, io ho, o problemi a incontrarsi qui, i due gruppi hanno avuto. Controllare il sistema successivo, noi dovremmo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 8|dialog|2785|0
units.english: After a couple of minutes, the pylon emits a few quiet whistles, and Sedlitaris celebrates briefly. "On that planet, it is! Glad that we managed to locate it, I am." You tell her you'll land on Hopper soon so you can search for the pylon on the planet.
units.italian: Dopo un paio di minuti, il pilone emette alcuni fischi sommessi, e Sedlitaris esulta brevemente. "Su quel pianeta, è! Contenta che siamo riusciti a individuarlo, io sono." Le dici che atterrerete presto su Hopper così potete cercare il pilone sul pianeta.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 8|dialog|2791|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Sedlitaris hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Sedlitaris non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 9|name|2795|0
units.english: Escape Route
units.italian: Via di fuga

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 9|description|2796|0
units.english: Explore the systems southwest of <system>, on possible routes to the Ablub system, so that Sedlitaris may look for a signal frequency of the expedition.
units.italian: Esplora i sistemi a sud-ovest di <system>, sulle possibili rotte per il sistema Ablub, così che Sedlitaris possa cercare una frequenza di segnale della spedizione.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 9|You fly around <origin> as Sedlitaris searches for the pylon's exact position, in the hopes that she can bring it back as well. She tells you to land by a mountain range, and has you readjust your landing spot every so often as she tries to nail the exact location of the pylon. "Buried it to protect it from the atmosphere's acidity, they must have," she comments.|2803|0
units.english: You fly around <origin> as Sedlitaris searches for the pylon's exact position, in the hopes that she can bring it back as well. She tells you to land by a mountain range, and has you readjust your landing spot every so often as she tries to nail the exact location of the pylon. "Buried it to protect it from the atmosphere's acidity, they must have," she comments.
units.italian: Voli intorno a <origin> mentre Sedlitaris cerca la posizione esatta del pilone, sperando di poterlo riportare indietro anche lei. Ti dice di atterrare vicino a una catena montuosa, e ti fa riaggiustare il punto di atterraggio ogni tanto mentre cerca di fissare la posizione esatta del pilone. "Sepolto per proteggerlo dall'acidità dell'atmosfera, devono averlo," commenta.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 9|	By the time she's done, you open your ship's hatch right to where the pylon should be and help her dig it out, taking care to not be out for too long. When the device is dug out, you bring it inside your ship while Sedlitaris fills up the hole with what dirt had been dug out.|2804|0
units.english: By the time she's done, you open your ship's hatch right to where the pylon should be and help her dig it out, taking care to not be out for too long. When the device is dug out, you bring it inside your ship while Sedlitaris fills up the hole with what dirt had been dug out.
units.italian: Quando ha finito, apri il portello della nave proprio dove dovrebbe essere il pilone e la aiuti a dissotterrarlo, facendo attenzione a non restare fuori troppo a lungo. Quando il dispositivo è dissotterrato, lo porti dentro la nave mentre Sedlitaris riempie la buca con la terra che era stata scavata.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 9|	As you're flying to the spaceport, she plays the pylon's entry: "Log started. Made a route from Summit straight to the meeting point, I had, but find the split group, I could not. Restless, agitated, the crew has become, heading straight to Ablub, we are, after buried, this thing is. If find this, anyone from the split group is, head back-" at that point an untranslated shouting muffles what Mimodum was saying, followed by dozens of legs in a rush. "No..." is heard right before the recording ends.|2805|0
units.english: As you're flying to the spaceport, she plays the pylon's entry: "Log started. Made a route from Summit straight to the meeting point, I had, but find the split group, I could not. Restless, agitated, the crew has become, heading straight to Ablub, we are, after buried, this thing is. If find this, anyone from the split group is, head back-" at that point an untranslated shouting muffles what Mimodum was saying, followed by dozens of legs in a rush. "No..." is heard right before the recording ends.
units.italian: Mentre volate allo spazioporto, riproduce la voce del pilone: "Registro iniziato. Tracciato una rotta da Vetta diritta al punto d'incontro, io l'avevo, ma trovare il gruppo separato, io non sono riuscito. Irrequieto, agitato, l'equipaggio è diventato, diretti dritti ad Ablub, noi siamo, dopo che sepolta, questa cosa è. Se trovare questo, qualcuno del gruppo separato lo fa, tornare indie-" a quel punto un urlo non tradotto copre quello che Mimodum stava dicendo, seguito da decine di zampe che corrono. "No..." si sente subito prima che la registrazione finisca.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 9|	You focus on flying the ship, but even when you've landed, Sedlitaris remains silent.|2806|0
units.english: You focus on flying the ship, but even when you've landed, Sedlitaris remains silent.
units.italian: Ti concentri sul pilotaggio, ma anche quando sei atterrato, Sedlitaris resta in silenzio.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 9|	"Are you alright?"|2808|0
units.english: "Are you alright?"
units.italian: "Stai bene?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 9|	"He said they were going back immediately, but they never made it. You think that was the last pylon?"|2809|0
units.english: "He said they were going back immediately, but they never made it. You think that was the last pylon?"
units.italian: "Diceva che tornavano indietro subito, ma non ce l'hanno mai fatta. Pensi che quello fosse l'ultimo pilone?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 9|	(Stay quiet.)|2810|0
units.english: (Stay quiet.)
units.italian: (Resta in silenzio.)

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 9|	She goes without a word for a while still. "Visit the systems between here and Ablub, could you, Captain? If follow the same route they used, we do, and if any more to find, there is, pick up the signals, I will."|2811|0
units.english: She goes without a word for a while still. "Visit the systems between here and Ablub, could you, Captain? If follow the same route they used, we do, and if any more to find, there is, pick up the signals, I will."
units.italian: Resta senza parole per un altro po'. "Visitare i sistemi tra qui e Ablub, potreste, capitano? Se seguire la stessa rotta che hanno usato, noi lo facciamo, e se ce n'è qualcun altro da trovare, captare i segnali, io lo farò."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 9|	You agree, and look to set a route southwest, in the direction of Ablub.|2812|0
units.english: You agree, and look to set a route southwest, in the direction of Ablub.
units.italian: Sei d'accordo, e ti prepari a impostare una rotta a sud-ovest, in direzione di Ablub.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 9|dialog|2815|0
units.english: While Sedlitaris remained in her bunk since you left for Ablub, you can hear her shouting from her bunk as you enter the system. She comes running to you, bringing along the pylon. "Picked up a signal, it has!" She says, pointing at the machine's panel, where some message is repeatedly beeping in and out. "Land on that planet we must, Captain!" You tell her you'll land soon, and she remains with you to figure out the pylon's location on Harmony once you've landed.
units.italian: Mentre Sedlitaris è rimasta nella sua cuccetta da quando sei partito per Ablub, senti le sue urla dalla cuccetta appena entri nel sistema. Corre da te, portando il pilone. "Captato un segnale, ha!" Dice, indicando il pannello della macchina, dove un messaggio bip in continuazione. "Atterrare su quel pianeta, noi dobbiamo, capitano!" Le dici che atterrerete presto, e lei resta con te per individuare la posizione del pilone su Harmony una volta atterrati.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 9|dialog|2821|0
units.english: You haven't yet found the sixth expedition's last pylon. Try searching for it on a route from this system to Ablub.
units.italian: Non hai ancora trovato l'ultimo pilone della sesta spedizione. Prova a cercarlo su una rotta da questo sistema ad Ablub.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|name|2825|0
units.english: Expeditions Past
units.italian: Spedizioni Passate

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|description|2826|0
units.english: Head back to the <destination>, where Sedlitaris will report her findings to the Heliarch council.
units.italian: Torna alla <destination>, dove Sedlitaris riferirà le sue scoperte al consiglio degli Heliarchs.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|Once you're close to the planet's surface, Sedlitaris starts trying to access the recorded data in the pylon. "If possible, recover it later, we can." She tries for a few minutes, but all she can get is a twisted static, so she starts working on determining its location. "Clear up the transmission, getting closer to it should."|2834|0
units.english: Once you're close to the planet's surface, Sedlitaris starts trying to access the recorded data in the pylon. "If possible, recover it later, we can." She tries for a few minutes, but all she can get is a twisted static, so she starts working on determining its location. "Clear up the transmission, getting closer to it should."
units.italian: Una volta vicino alla superficie del pianeta, Sedlitaris comincia a cercare di accedere ai dati registrati nel pilone. "Se possibile, recuperarlo più tardi, noi possiamo." Ci prova per qualche minuto, ma tutto ciò che ottiene è uno statico distorto, quindi comincia a determinarne la posizione. "Chiarire la trasmissione, avvicinarsi dovrebbe."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	You fly around until you're right above an ocean, with no land in sight wherever you look. "Below us, it is," she says. "Why underwater? Why throw it into an ocean, would they?" She works on transferring the data to her own pylon, as you won't manage to get to the original one, and clears up the recording as much as possible before playing it.|2835|0
units.english: You fly around until you're right above an ocean, with no land in sight wherever you look. "Below us, it is," she says. "Why underwater? Why throw it into an ocean, would they?" She works on transferring the data to her own pylon, as you won't manage to get to the original one, and clears up the recording as much as possible before playing it.
units.italian: Voli in cerchio finché non sei proprio sopra un oceano, senza terra in vista ovunque guardi. "Sotto di noi, è," dice. "Perché sott'acqua? Perché gettarlo in un oceano, loro?" Lavora al trasferimento dei dati sul suo pilone, dato che non riuscirai a raggiungere l'originale, e ripulisce la registrazione il più possibile prima di riprodurla.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	For a few seconds there are only a few ambient sounds, a low background humming, and some heavy breathing. "Ambushed us as we prepared to leave the last planet, they did," Mimodum speaks. "Enough fuel to make it back in one go, we had, so jumped as we could. Too many ships in this system there were, however, like a wall blocking us." He stops briefly, and you can make out something akin to metal falling lightly on a table. "Aware of it, they were. That exploring, we had been. That splitting up, we were. That make it back, we could not. Saw to that, dozens of their ships did. Tried to lose them on this planet, we had, but caught as we came down, we were. Cut off most of the engines, Skylance fire has. A lone, sinking ship, what remains of the sixth is. Hold together, the hull should, but no way out for us, there is." He pauses once again, for well over a minute. "If returned when the men first asked for... No, even then, already waiting, their ships must have been. If split up the fleet, I hadn't... outnumbered all the same, we would be. At least..." Another pause, this time just a few seconds long. "At least... still working, the rifles are."|2836|0
units.english: For a few seconds there are only a few ambient sounds, a low background humming, and some heavy breathing. "Ambushed us as we prepared to leave the last planet, they did," Mimodum speaks. "Enough fuel to make it back in one go, we had, so jumped as we could. Too many ships in this system there were, however, like a wall blocking us." He stops briefly, and you can make out something akin to metal falling lightly on a table. "Aware of it, they were. That exploring, we had been. That splitting up, we were. That make it back, we could not. Saw to that, dozens of their ships did. Tried to lose them on this planet, we had, but caught as we came down, we were. Cut off most of the engines, Skylance fire has. A lone, sinking ship, what remains of the sixth is. Hold together, the hull should, but no way out for us, there is." He pauses once again, for well over a minute. "If returned when the men first asked for... No, even then, already waiting, their ships must have been. If split up the fleet, I hadn't... outnumbered all the same, we would be. At least..." Another pause, this time just a few seconds long. "At least... still working, the rifles are."
units.italian: Per qualche secondo ci sono solo alcuni suoni ambientali, un basso ronzio di fondo, e un respiro pesante. "Ci hanno teso un'imboscata mentre ci preparavamo a lasciare l'ultimo pianeta," parla Mimodum. "Carburante sufficiente per tornare in un sol colpo, noi avevamo, quindi saltato appena possibile, noi lo abbiamo. Troppe navi in questo sistema c'erano, però, come un muro che ci bloccava." Si ferma brevemente, e riesci a distinguere qualcosa di simile a metallo che cade leggermente su un tavolo. "Ne erano a conoscenza, loro. Che stavamo esplorando. Che ci eravamo divisi. Che tornare, noi non potevamo. Ci hanno pensato, decine delle loro navi. Provato a seminarle su questo pianeta, noi lo abbiamo, ma catturati mentre scendevamo, noi siamo stati. Tagliati fuori la maggior parte dei motori, il fuoco degli Skylance li ha. Una nave sola, che affonda, quello che resta della sesta è. Tenere insieme, lo scafo dovrebbe, ma nessuna via d'uscita per noi, c'è." Si ferma ancora una volta, per ben più di un minuto. "Se tornato quando gli uomini l'hanno chiesto per la prima volta... No, anche allora, già in attesa, le loro navi dovevano essere. Se diviso la flotta, io non l'avessi... in inferiorità numerica comunque, noi saremmo stati. Almeno..." Un'altra pausa, questa volta di pochi secondi. "Almeno... ancora funzionanti, i fucili sono."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	The recording ends, and you two stay in an awkward silence for a minute. "Aware that he had died, I was. Too long it has been. Even if found a safe haven, habitable planet or a friendly group, the fleet had, I knew that long dead, all of them would be." She pauses, and the silence returns for another minute. She shuts off the pylon. "Only, expecting something... anything, I was. A heroic death, a summary of findings. Accomplished nothing, they did. Right after all, the consuls were."|2837|0
units.english: The recording ends, and you two stay in an awkward silence for a minute. "Aware that he had died, I was. Too long it has been. Even if found a safe haven, habitable planet or a friendly group, the fleet had, I knew that long dead, all of them would be." She pauses, and the silence returns for another minute. She shuts off the pylon. "Only, expecting something... anything, I was. A heroic death, a summary of findings. Accomplished nothing, they did. Right after all, the consuls were."
units.italian: La registrazione finisce, e restate in un silenzio imbarazzante per un minuto. "Consapevole che fosse morto, io lo ero. Troppo tempo è passato. Anche se trovato un rifugio sicuro, un pianeta abitabile o un gruppo amichevole, la flotta l'avesse, sapevo che morti da tempo, tutti loro sarebbero stati." Si ferma, e il silenzio torna per un altro minuto. Spegne il pilone. "Solo, mi aspettavo qualcosa... qualsiasi cosa. Una morte eroica, un riassunto delle scoperte. Non hanno concluso nulla. I consoli avevano ragione, dopotutto."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	"Heroic death or not, he still got some information, didn't he? Information you recovered."|2839|0
units.english: "Heroic death or not, he still got some information, didn't he? Information you recovered."
units.italian: "Morte eroica o no, ha comunque ottenuto qualche informazione, no? Informazioni che hai recuperato."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	"He didn't get the chance to act heroically. He was ambushed."|2841|0
units.english: "He didn't get the chance to act heroically. He was ambushed."
units.italian: "Non ha avuto la possibilità di agire eroicamente. È stato vittima di un'imboscata."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	"Massacred, if truthful about the Quarg's numbers, he was," she responds. "Risked a great deal of jump drives, the sixth expedition had. Thought, it was, that with a greater number of Punishers, a greater chance of a safe return, there was." She sighs. "Just decrease our reserve of them, it did."|2842|0
units.english: "Massacred, if truthful about the Quarg's numbers, he was," she responds. "Risked a great deal of jump drives, the sixth expedition had. Thought, it was, that with a greater number of Punishers, a greater chance of a safe return, there was." She sighs. "Just decrease our reserve of them, it did."
units.italian: "Massacrato, se si è sinceri sui numeri dei Quarg, lui lo è stato," risponde. "Rischiato un gran numero di motori di salto, la sesta spedizione lo ha fatto. Si pensava che, con un maggior numero di Punisher, una maggiore probabilità di ritorno sicuro, ci fosse." Sospira. "Solo ridurre la nostra riserva di essi, ha fatto."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	"Inconclusive reports on red nebulas or disappearing ruins, what good are they?" she sighs. "After met up in their pincer movement, the groups had, after exploring points of interest, supposed to drive further than we had previously, they were. To reach the galactic core, to maybe find friendly groups to facilitate more trips... achieved, none of the goals were."|2845|0
units.english: "Inconclusive reports on red nebulas or disappearing ruins, what good are they?" she sighs. "After met up in their pincer movement, the groups had, after exploring points of interest, supposed to drive further than we had previously, they were. To reach the galactic core, to maybe find friendly groups to facilitate more trips... achieved, none of the goals were."
units.italian: "Rapporti inconcludenti su nebule rosse o rovine che spariscono, a cosa servono?" sospira. "Dopo essersi incontrati nel loro movimento a tenaglia, i gruppi lo avevano fatto, dopo aver esplorato punti di interesse, dovevano spingersi più lontano di quanto avessimo fatto prima. Raggiungere il nucleo galattico, magari trovare gruppi amichevoli per facilitare altri viaggi... raggiunto, nessuno degli obiettivi è stato."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	She goes back to her bunk, saying she wishes to be alone for a while, and you fly to the planet's spaceport. A few hours later, she comes back out. "Finished my report, I have. Ready to go back home I am, Captain <last>. A long trip this was, and promised to pay you well, I did, so when <planet> we reach, give you your well-earned 10,000,000 credits, I shall. Present my findings to the council, I must."|2847|0
units.english: She goes back to her bunk, saying she wishes to be alone for a while, and you fly to the planet's spaceport. A few hours later, she comes back out. "Finished my report, I have. Ready to go back home I am, Captain <last>. A long trip this was, and promised to pay you well, I did, so when <planet> we reach, give you your well-earned 10,000,000 credits, I shall. Present my findings to the council, I must."
units.italian: Torna nella sua cuccetta, dicendo che desidera restare sola un po', e tu voli allo spazioporto del pianeta. Qualche ora dopo, esce di nuovo. "Finito il mio rapporto, io l'ho. Pronta a tornare a casa, io sono, capitano <last>. Un lungo viaggio, questo è stato, e promesso di pagarvi bene, io lo avevo, quindi quando <planet> raggiungeremo, darvi i vostri 10.000.000 crediti ben guadagnati, io lo farò. Presentare le mie scoperte al consiglio, io devo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	"That's a lot of money. I was worried you wouldn't even want to pay me, with how disappointed you were earlier."|2849|0
units.english: "That's a lot of money. I was worried you wouldn't even want to pay me, with how disappointed you were earlier."
units.italian: "Sono un sacco di soldi. Temevo che non avresti nemmeno voluto pagarmi, con quanto eri delusa prima."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	"Aren't you worried we'll get ambushed, like how Mimodum's ship was?"|2851|0
units.english: "Aren't you worried we'll get ambushed, like how Mimodum's ship was?"
units.italian: "Non sei preoccupata che ci tendano un'imboscata, come è successo alla nave di Mimodum?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	She grins for a moment, seemingly taking it as a joke. "If going to ambush us, the Quarg were, already done it, they would have. Too close to the Coalition by now, we are."|2852|0
units.english: She grins for a moment, seemingly taking it as a joke. "If going to ambush us, the Quarg were, already done it, they would have. Too close to the Coalition by now, we are."
units.italian: Sorride per un momento, come se la prendesse come uno scherzo. "Se tenderci un'imboscata, i Quarg volessero, già fatto, loro lo avrebbero. Troppo vicini alla Coalizione ormai, noi siamo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	"Ah, forgive me for that, Captain. True it is, that disappointed, I am. However, an inspector should not let that trouble her duties," she explains. "Done your work, you have, so now do mine, I must. Not discussed in Mimodum's audio entries, many details of interest to the council were. An initial gathering of that data, I have prepared."|2855|0
units.english: "Ah, forgive me for that, Captain. True it is, that disappointed, I am. However, an inspector should not let that trouble her duties," she explains. "Done your work, you have, so now do mine, I must. Not discussed in Mimodum's audio entries, many details of interest to the council were. An initial gathering of that data, I have prepared."
units.italian: "Ah, perdonatemi per quello, capitano. Vero è che delusa, io sono. Però un'ispettrice non dovrebbe lasciare che questo turbi i suoi doveri," spiega. "Fatto il vostro lavoro, voi l'avete, quindi ora fare il mio, io devo. Non discussi nelle voci audio di Mimodum, molti dettagli di interesse per il consiglio erano. Una raccolta iniziale di quei dati, io l'ho preparata."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	She asks that you bring her to <destination> as soon as possible, and goes back to her bunk to rest.|2857|0
units.english: She asks that you bring her to <destination> as soon as possible, and goes back to her bunk to rest.
units.italian: Ti chiede di portarla su <destination> il prima possibile, e torna nella sua cuccetta a riposare.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|dialog|2860|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Sedlitaris hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti rendi conto che la tua scorta con Sedlitaris non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio partire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|Sedlitaris uses your commlink to tell the spaceport authorities that she's returned, and soon after you land a crowd of Heliarchs and Coalition civilians alike are surrounding your ship. The Heliarch agents try and organize the crowd as best as they can, and a group of Heliarch consuls rush through the masses to meet you two at your ship.|2864|0
units.english: Sedlitaris uses your commlink to tell the spaceport authorities that she's returned, and soon after you land a crowd of Heliarchs and Coalition civilians alike are surrounding your ship. The Heliarch agents try and organize the crowd as best as they can, and a group of Heliarch consuls rush through the masses to meet you two at your ship.
units.italian: Sedlitaris usa la tua radio per dire alle autorità dello spazioporto che è tornata, e poco dopo che atterri una folla di Heliarchs e civili della Coalizione circonda la tua nave. Gli agenti Heliarchs cercano di organizzare la folla come meglio possono, e un gruppo di consoli Heliarchs si fa largo tra la massa per incontrarvi alla nave.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	"Inspector! A most... fortunate return this is. A great deal of information you've collected, we take it?" an Arach consul asks.|2865|0
units.english: "Inspector! A most... fortunate return this is. A great deal of information you've collected, we take it?" an Arach consul asks.
units.italian: "Ispettrice! Un ritorno... molto fortunato, questo è. Una grande quantità di informazioni avete raccolto, immaginiamo?" chiede un console Arach.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	"Yes, eager to hear your report, we are," one of the Kimek consuls continues. "A rare occasion, it is, to be able to learn of the outside from one of our esteemed inspectors."|2866|0
units.english: "Yes, eager to hear your report, we are," one of the Kimek consuls continues. "A rare occasion, it is, to be able to learn of the outside from one of our esteemed inspectors."
units.italian: "Sì, desiderosi di ascoltare il vostro rapporto, noi siamo," continua uno dei consoli Kimek. "Un'occasione rara, è, poter imparare dell'esterno da una delle nostre stimatissime ispettrici."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	A Saryd consul, who's kept a stern look on his face, cuts in. "Returned with his fleet, your ancestor, Mimodum, did not. Learned of the reason for that, have you?"|2867|0
units.english: A Saryd consul, who's kept a stern look on his face, cuts in. "Returned with his fleet, your ancestor, Mimodum, did not. Learned of the reason for that, have you?"
units.italian: Un console Saryd, che ha mantenuto un'espressione severa, interviene. "Tornato con la sua flotta, il vostro antenato, Mimodum, non lo ha fatto. Scoperto il motivo, avete?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	"Yes," she says. "Recover as much information as I wished to, I could not, but prepared a report on what Captain <last> and I found, I have. Additionally, recovered two of the pylons Mimodum left, we have."|2868|0
units.english: "Yes," she says. "Recover as much information as I wished to, I could not, but prepared a report on what Captain <last> and I found, I have. Additionally, recovered two of the pylons Mimodum left, we have."
units.italian: "Sì," dice. "Recuperare quante più informazioni volevo, io non ci sono riuscita, ma preparato un rapporto su quello che il capitano <last> e io abbiamo trovato, io l'ho. Inoltre, recuperato due dei piloni che Mimodum ha lasciato, noi li abbiamo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	One of the consuls addresses you, "Tell us, Captain, run into any er... complications during the trip, have you? Maybe occasioned by the tribune - the inspector - being with you?"|2869|0
units.english: One of the consuls addresses you, "Tell us, Captain, run into any er... complications during the trip, have you? Maybe occasioned by the tribune - the inspector - being with you?"
units.italian: Uno dei consoli si rivolge a te: "Diteci, capitano, incappato in qualche... ehm... complicazione durante il viaggio, avete? Magari causata dalla tribuna, l'ispettrice, con voi?"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	"She stayed inside my ship whenever there was a risk of humans seeing her, if that's what you're asking."|2871|0
units.english: "She stayed inside my ship whenever there was a risk of humans seeing her, if that's what you're asking."
units.italian: "È rimasta dentro la mia nave ogni volta che c'era il rischio che degli umani la vedessero, se è questo che state chiedendo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	"I didn't notice anything out of the usual, no."|2872|0
units.english: "I didn't notice anything out of the usual, no."
units.italian: "Non ho notato niente fuori dal normale, no."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	They call for some agents to get the pylons out of your ship and transport them to somewhere Sedlitaris can present her findings. As they tell her to follow them to the room where the presentation will happen, a Kimek Heliarch breaks through the line of agents keeping the crowd back. You recognize him as Arbiter Kicharri, who you met just before Sedlitaris received approval from the Heliarch council.|2873|0
units.english: They call for some agents to get the pylons out of your ship and transport them to somewhere Sedlitaris can present her findings. As they tell her to follow them to the room where the presentation will happen, a Kimek Heliarch breaks through the line of agents keeping the crowd back. You recognize him as Arbiter Kicharri, who you met just before Sedlitaris received approval from the Heliarch council.
units.italian: Chiamano alcuni agenti per far uscire i piloni dalla nave e trasportarli dove Sedlitaris possa presentare le sue scoperte. Mentre le dicono di seguirli nella stanza dove avverrà la presentazione, un Heliarch Kimek si fa largo tra la fila di agenti che tengono indietro la folla. Lo riconosci come l'arbitro Kicharri, che hai incontrato poco prima che Sedlitaris ricevesse l'approvazione del consiglio degli Heliarchs.

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	"What is this?" The Saryd consul steps in front of Kicharri as he approaches. "Arbiter, shared with you in due time, the findings will be, but the inspector's report to us consuls, the priority is, so return to your duties you-"|2874|0
units.english: "What is this?" The Saryd consul steps in front of Kicharri as he approaches. "Arbiter, shared with you in due time, the findings will be, but the inspector's report to us consuls, the priority is, so return to your duties you-"
units.italian: "Che succede?" Il console Saryd si mette davanti a Kicharri mentre si avvicina. "Arbitro, condivise con voi a tempo debito, le scoperte saranno, ma il rapporto dell'ispettrice a noi consoli, la priorità è, quindi tornate ai vostri doveri voi-"

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	"No, meet with her family, she will," Kicharri interrupts him. "Heard nothing but hell from her brother, I have. Devastated, her parents were. Now that returned, she has, see them and calm their worries, she will."|2875|0
units.english: "No, meet with her family, she will," Kicharri interrupts him. "Heard nothing but hell from her brother, I have. Devastated, her parents were. Now that returned, she has, see them and calm their worries, she will."
units.italian: "No, incontrare la sua famiglia, lei lo farà," la interrompe Kicharri. "Sentito nient'altro che guai da suo fratello, io ho. Devastati, i suoi genitori erano. Ora che tornata, lei è, vederli e calmare le loro preoccupazioni, lei lo farà."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	"By whose orders?" An Arach consul jumps in. "Intrigued by her findings, we all are, and listen to her at once, we must."|2876|0
units.english: "By whose orders?" An Arach consul jumps in. "Intrigued by her findings, we all are, and listen to her at once, we must."
units.italian: "Per ordine di chi?" interviene un console Arach. "Incuriositi dalle sue scoperte, noi tutti siamo, e ascoltarla subito, noi dobbiamo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	"Orders?" Kicharri exclaims. "Orders for her to leave and die, you thought you had given her!" Kicharri looks at Sedlitaris, then back at the consuls. "If so intrigued you are, surely to miss out on any information, you don't want. Best suited for giving a full report, she will be, once rested from her expedition, she has."|2877|0
units.english: "Orders?" Kicharri exclaims. "Orders for her to leave and die, you thought you had given her!" Kicharri looks at Sedlitaris, then back at the consuls. "If so intrigued you are, surely to miss out on any information, you don't want. Best suited for giving a full report, she will be, once rested from her expedition, she has."
units.italian: "Ordini?" esclama Kicharri. "Ordini perché partisse e morisse, pensavate di averle dato!" Kicharri guarda Sedlitaris, poi di nuovo i consoli. "Se così incuriositi siete, di certo perdere qualsiasi informazione, non volete. La più adatta a fare un rapporto completo, lei sarà, una volta riposata dalla sua spedizione, lei è."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	Irked by his response, the consuls have the agents clear the area and have your ship made into a makeshift meeting room for a while, making everyone get out while they head inside to discuss. After many minutes, they come back out, and one of the Kimek says, "Ten days of leave you will be given, tribune. After that, present us your findings, you must. Considered for promotion to arbiter, you also will be, for your bravery and work in the expedition."|2878|0
units.english: Irked by his response, the consuls have the agents clear the area and have your ship made into a makeshift meeting room for a while, making everyone get out while they head inside to discuss. After many minutes, they come back out, and one of the Kimek says, "Ten days of leave you will be given, tribune. After that, present us your findings, you must. Considered for promotion to arbiter, you also will be, for your bravery and work in the expedition."
units.italian: Irritati dalla sua risposta, i consoli fanno sgomberare l'area dagli agenti e trasformano la tua nave in una sala riunioni improvvisata per un po', facendo uscire tutti mentre loro entrano a discutere. Dopo molti minuti, escono di nuovo, e uno dei Kimek dice: "Dieci giorni di licenza vi saranno concessi, tribuna. Dopo di che, presentarci le vostre scoperte, voi dovrete. Presa in considerazione per la promozione ad arbitro, anche voi sarete, per il vostro coraggio e il vostro lavoro nella spedizione."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	The consul group leaves, and Kicharri approaches you and Sedlitaris. "Tell me about how you were right all along, later, you can," Kicharri tells Sedlitaris. "Right now, add you back to the list of active Heliarchs, I must. Marked as deceased by a 'glitch in the system,' you apparently were." He taps one leg on the ground repeatedly, glancing at your ship. "Glad that you are back safely, I am."|2879|0
units.english: The consul group leaves, and Kicharri approaches you and Sedlitaris. "Tell me about how you were right all along, later, you can," Kicharri tells Sedlitaris. "Right now, add you back to the list of active Heliarchs, I must. Marked as deceased by a 'glitch in the system,' you apparently were." He taps one leg on the ground repeatedly, glancing at your ship. "Glad that you are back safely, I am."
units.italian: Il gruppo dei consoli se ne va, e Kicharri si avvicina a te e Sedlitaris. "Raccontarmi di come avevate ragione fin dall'inizio, più tardi, potete," dice Kicharri a Sedlitaris. "Ora, aggiungervi di nuovo alla lista degli Heliarchs attivi, io devo. Segnata come deceduta per un 'errore nel sistema', a quanto pare voi eravate." Batte ripetutamente una zampa sul terreno, dando un'occhiata alla tua nave. "Contento che siate tornata sana e salva, io sono."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	He leaves as well, and Sedlitaris turns to you. "A bit disorganized, but at least welcomed we were, right?" She looks at your ship, then looks startled. "Your payment! No time to transfer the funds to you, they gave me," she pulls out a personal device, and transfers the 10,000,000 credits to your account. "There you are. Worth much more, your assistance was, but unfortunately limited, my funds are."|2880|0
units.english: He leaves as well, and Sedlitaris turns to you. "A bit disorganized, but at least welcomed we were, right?" She looks at your ship, then looks startled. "Your payment! No time to transfer the funds to you, they gave me," she pulls out a personal device, and transfers the 10,000,000 credits to your account. "There you are. Worth much more, your assistance was, but unfortunately limited, my funds are."
units.italian: Se ne va anche lui, e Sedlitaris si volta verso di te. "Un po' disorganizzati, ma almeno accolti siamo stati, no?" Guarda la tua nave, poi sussulta. "Il vostro pagamento! Nessun tempo per trasferirvi i fondi, loro mi hanno dato," tira fuori un dispositivo personale, e trasferisce i 10.000.000 crediti sul tuo conto. "Ecco fatto. Valso molto di più, il vostro aiuto è, ma purtroppo limitati, i miei fondi sono."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	"Don't worry, I'm glad to have helped."|2882|0
units.english: "Don't worry, I'm glad to have helped."
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti, sono contento di aver aiutato."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	"Why was everyone so surprised we made it back? Seems they expected to never see you again."|2884|0
units.english: "Why was everyone so surprised we made it back? Seems they expected to never see you again."
units.italian: "Perché erano tutti così sorpresi che fossimo tornati? Sembra che si aspettassero di non rivederti mai più."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	Her smile drops as you ask the question, and she seemingly struggles to find a place to look at. "I... I, Captain-" She looks around, then takes a deep breath. "Sorry I am, Captain. Ever since independence from the Quarg, we gained, six expeditions out of the Coalition, there were. Return, only ships of the first of them did. The most well equipped and numerous, my ancestor's fleet was, the sixth expeditionary fleet. Increasingly more fearful of leaving, we became, and with the last expedition having been centuries ago, a taboo, even talking about leaving has become. A year after the sixth had left, effectively forbid any further expeditions, the council did." She travels around with her eyes again. "Sorry I am, that kept it hidden from you, I have. Wish to find out what happened, I did. Afraid I was, that refuse to help me like everyone else, you would, if know of the risk, you did."|2885|0
units.english: Her smile drops as you ask the question, and she seemingly struggles to find a place to look at. "I... I, Captain-" She looks around, then takes a deep breath. "Sorry I am, Captain. Ever since independence from the Quarg, we gained, six expeditions out of the Coalition, there were. Return, only ships of the first of them did. The most well equipped and numerous, my ancestor's fleet was, the sixth expeditionary fleet. Increasingly more fearful of leaving, we became, and with the last expedition having been centuries ago, a taboo, even talking about leaving has become. A year after the sixth had left, effectively forbid any further expeditions, the council did." She travels around with her eyes again. "Sorry I am, that kept it hidden from you, I have. Wish to find out what happened, I did. Afraid I was, that refuse to help me like everyone else, you would, if know of the risk, you did."
units.italian: Il suo sorriso svanisce quando fai la domanda, e sembra lottare per trovare un punto dove guardare. "Io... io, capitano-" Si guarda intorno, poi fa un respiro profondo. "Scusarmi, io lo sono, capitano. Da quando l'indipendenza dai Quarg abbiamo ottenuto, sei spedizioni fuori dalla Coalizione, ci sono state. Tornare, solo le navi della prima lo hanno fatto. Le più attrezzate e numerose, la flotta del mio antenato era, la sesta flotta di spedizione. Sempre più timorosi di partire, siamo diventati, e con l'ultima spedizione avvenuta secoli fa, un tabù, persino parlare di partire è diventato. Un anno dopo che la sesta era partita, vietare di fatto ogni ulteriore spedizione, il consiglio lo fece." Gira di nuovo gli occhi intorno. "Scusarmi, io lo sono, per avervelo tenuto nascosto. Scoprire cosa è successo, io volevo. Avevo paura, io avevo, che rifiutaste di aiutarmi come tutti gli altri, voi lo avreste fatto, se aveste saputo del rischio."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	"Well, we made it back safely, and you were passionate enough about this to take the risk. I don't hold it against you."|2887|0
units.english: "Well, we made it back safely, and you were passionate enough about this to take the risk. I don't hold it against you."
units.italian: "Beh, siamo tornati sani e salvi, e tu ci tenevi abbastanza da correre il rischio. Non te la prendo."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	"So you lied to me. You could've gotten us both killed - we could be in a ship sinking into an ocean."|2889|0
units.english: "So you lied to me. You could've gotten us both killed - we could be in a ship sinking into an ocean."
units.italian: "Quindi mi hai mentito. Potevi farci ammazzare entrambi: potremmo essere su una nave che affonda in un oceano."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	She's taken aback. "Captain, no Quarg pursuing us, there were. Surely now that inhabit all those systems, humans do, avoid attacking ships like that..." She stops, and sighs. "Sorry for lying to you I am, Captain."|2890|0
units.english: She's taken aback. "Captain, no Quarg pursuing us, there were. Surely now that inhabit all those systems, humans do, avoid attacking ships like that..." She stops, and sighs. "Sorry for lying to you I am, Captain."
units.italian: Resta sorpresa. "Capitano, nessun Quarg ci inseguiva, non ce n'erano. Ormai che abitano tutti quei sistemi, gli umani lo fanno, evitare di attaccare navi così..." Si ferma, e sospira. "Scusarmi per avervi mentito, io lo sono, capitano."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	She breathes in relief. "Thank you, Captain. To trick you, my intention wasn't. Thanks to your help, maybe put an end to this fear of leaving, or even convince the council to get the expedition efforts going again, I can."|2893|0
units.english: She breathes in relief. "Thank you, Captain. To trick you, my intention wasn't. Thanks to your help, maybe put an end to this fear of leaving, or even convince the council to get the expedition efforts going again, I can."
units.italian: Tira un respiro di sollievo. "Grazie, capitano. Ingannarvi, non era la mia intenzione. Grazie al vostro aiuto, magari porre fine a questa paura di partire, o persino convincere il consiglio a rimettere in moto gli sforzi delle spedizioni, io posso."

units.id: mission:Coalition: Expeditions Past 10|	Suddenly, a Saryd Sojourner nearly rams your ship, just barely avoiding it as it lands less than twenty meters from your ship. "My little brother," Sedlitaris says as she looks at the ship. "Forgive me Captain, but get to seeing my family, I must. From the discussion earlier, very worried about me, they must have been. Thanks again for everything." Her brother rushes into hugging her as he leaves his ship, then proceeds to shake her while screaming something. units.italian: All'improvviso, un Saryd Sojourner quasi sperona la tua nave, evitandola per un soffio mentre atterra a meno di venti metri. "Mio fratellino," dice Sedlitaris guardando la nave. "Perdonatemi, capitano, ma andare a vedere la mia famiglia, io devo. Dalla discussione di prima, molto preoccupati per me, devono essere stati. Grazie ancora di tutto." Suo fratello si precipita ad abbracciarla appena lascia la nave, poi passa a scuoterla gridando qualcosa. Anche una coppia anziana di Saryd esce lentamente dal Sojourner, e Sedlitaris e suo fratello vanno a incontrarli, abbracciandoli ed entrando. Il Sojourner decolla prima che gli operai dello spazioporto possano persino iniziare a occuparsi della nave, e lo guardi mentre lascia il mondo ad anello.

units.italian: Acconsenti, e uno dei consoli Heliarchs di prima, un Saryd, entra. "Salve, capitano," ti saluta con una voce un po' tremante. "Stavamo solo passando in rassegna le scoperte..." fatica a trovare le parole, gli occhi fissi a terra. "Attirato di più la nostra attenzione, il rapporto su Luce Antica lo ha. Il rapporto sui 'Sheragi' e sulle rovine su un mondo vicino." Si ferma, e tira fuori un dispositivo simile a quello che Sedlitaris ha usato per trasferirti il pagamento. "Completato il viaggio degli antichi ispettori Saryd, gli sforzi dell'umanità, i vostri sforzi, lo hanno. Per questo, sperare di compensarvi abbastanza, voi e la ragazza, il consiglio non può." Inserisce alcuni comandi, e vedi che hai ricevuto altri 15.000.000 di crediti. "Mandata a morire, noi l'avevamo. Io l'avevo. E con risposte a segreti che i nostri antenati sognavano di svelare, è tornata." I suoi occhi si alzano finalmente, incontrando i tuoi. "Contento io sono, che fieri di almeno uno di noi, loro possano essere." Distoglie di nuovo lo sguardo, ti fa un cenno col capo, e lascia la nave.
